title: Personal companion
description:
**Company Description**
Healix Technologies supports research-intensive organizations in turning complex ideas into practical outcomes by building capability and connecting them with specialized talent. The company works across engineering, science, technology, AI, robotics, biotech, healthcare, energy, aerospace, electronics, manufacturing, universities, and R&D teams. Services include Research Capability Audits, Research Talent Solutions, and Research & Innovation Pilots. Typical projects involve capability assessment, evidence review, specialist matching, expert-network coordination, feasibility studies, validation planning, and implementation roadmaps. Team members collaborate with diverse experts and disciplines to enable impactful research and innovation.
  
**Role Description**
The Personal Companion role is a full-time, on-site position based in South Delhi. The Personal Companion will provide day-to-day support, including personal care, home care assistance, and companionship to individuals who may require help with daily routines. Tasks may include assisting with mobility, hygiene, meal times, light household support, and monitoring general well-being, while maintaining privacy, dignity, and respect. The role also involves engaging in conversation, providing emotional support, coordinating basic appointments or reminders, and liaising with family members or caregivers as needed. The Personal Companion is expected to follow safety guidelines, observe changes in health or mood, and report concerns promptly to designated contacts.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong caregiving and elder care skills, with experience supporting individuals who need daily assistance.
* Candidates should possess excellent interpersonal skills, including patience, empathy, and the ability to build trust and rapport.
* Candidates should possess home care and personal care skills, such as assistance with routines, hygiene, and a clean, safe living environment.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality, respect boundaries, and follow health and safety protocols.
* Prior experience as a personal companion, caregiver, or in a similar support role is preferred.
* Basic health awareness and ability to recognize signs of distress or changes in condition.
* Reliable, punctual, and able to work full-time on-site in South Delhi.

Brand Marketing, PR & Earned MediaIdentify and develop compelling stories emerging from Griffin's Salons, Retreats, institutional engagements and member milestones.Build relationships with relevant editors, journalists and media platforms to generate meaningful earned coverage.Drive Griffin's organic brand presence through its website, founder channels, selective storytelling and other relevant platforms.Build visibility without compromising member confidentiality, private conversations or the discretion expected of Griffin.Track qualified founder interest, referrals, earned media and brand visibility indicators. Brand Experiences & Event CommunicationOwn the brand and communication experience across Griffin Salons, Retreats, private dinners, international delegations and institutional gatherings.Lead communication across the event journey — save-the-dates, invitations, speaker communication, agenda narratives, attendee updates and post-event engagement.Conceptualise brand moments including gifting, limited-edition keepsakes, welcome experiences and partner-led activations.Translate concepts into clear creative briefs and work with design, operations and partnerships teams to bring them to life.Ensure every Griffin experience reinforces the brand's premium, thoughtful and understated character. Government, Institutional & Strategic CommunicationsDevelop high-quality communication for government leadership, embassies, regulators, institutional investors, global organisations and strategic partners.Support Griffin leadership with institutional decks, briefing notes, formal correspondence, introductions and follow-up communication.Position Griffin as a credible collective representing India's leading technology founders.Maintain the diplomatic judgment, accuracy and discretion required when engaging with senior stakeholders in India and internationally. title: High-Ticket Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist
description:
**Company:**
Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI)

**Industry:**
Business Coaching | Consulting | Fitness Entrepreneurship

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Remote – India

**Compensation:**
Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives

**Experience Required:**
1–3 Years (Relevant Experience Preferred)

About FBCI

Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI) is a premium business coaching and consulting company that helps fitness coaches, nutritionists, and health professionals build, grow, and scale profitable online coaching businesses.

We help entrepreneurs improve their client acquisition, sales processes, marketing strategies, business positioning, and operational systems.

Our mentorship programs range from ₹90,000 to ₹5,00,000+.

As we expand, we're looking for a highly motivated and communication-driven
**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist**
to join our sales team.

Important: This Is NOT a Traditional Telecalling Job

We are not hiring someone to simply make calls, read scripts, or fill our sales team's calendar.

**Your primary responsibility is to pre-qualify every incoming lead before they are connected with our sales department.**

You'll speak with fitness coaches and business owners, understand their current situation, identify their challenges, assess their investment readiness, and determine whether they're a suitable fit for our premium mentorship programs.

You must be someone who
**genuinely loves talking to people, enjoys understanding their problems, and is passionate about helping them find the right solutions.**

This role requires strong communication skills, business understanding, patience, persistence, and excellent follow-up discipline.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Qualification**

* Contact incoming leads through phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Conduct structured pre-qualification conversations.
* Understand prospects' current monthly revenue, business challenges, goals, and growth expectations.
* Assess their financial readiness and ability to invest in premium mentorship programs.
* Identify serious prospects who are genuinely interested in growing their businesses.
* Ensure only qualified leads are forwarded to the sales department.

**2. Appointment Setting**

* Book strategy consultations with the sales team for qualified prospects.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and expectations of the consultation.
* Coordinate appointment timings and ensure proper scheduling.
* Confirm appointments and maximize show-up rates.

**3. Follow-Ups & Relationship Building**

* Conduct multiple follow-ups with prospects through calls and WhatsApp.
* Maintain consistent communication with interested leads.
* Re-engage prospects who haven't responded or booked their consultations.
* Build genuine relationships rather than using aggressive sales tactics.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to poor follow-up.

**4. CRM & Sales Coordination**

* Maintain accurate lead information and conversation notes in the CRM.
* Update lead statuses, qualification details, and follow-up schedules.
* Coordinate with the sales closers to ensure smooth handovers.
* Provide regular updates on lead quality, appointment bookings, and follow-up performance.

Who We're Looking For

* Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong listening, questioning, and interpersonal skills.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, or a similar role.
* Comfortable making multiple calls and follow-ups daily.
* Ability to understand business problems and ask intelligent questions.
* Confident discussing revenue, business growth, and premium investments with entrepreneurs.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
* Comfortable using CRM software, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

**Preferred:**
Experience in business coaching, consulting, premium mentorship, digital marketing agencies, or high-ticket service businesses.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance will be measured by:

* Lead response time
* Number of leads contacted and qualified
* Qualified appointments booked
* Appointment show-up rate
* Follow-up completion rate
* Quality of appointments passed to the sales team
* CRM accuracy and lead management
* Contribution to overall sales conversions

**We value qualified appointments over the total number of appointments booked.**

Who Should NOT Apply

* Someone looking for a basic telecalling or scripted calling job.
* Someone who dislikes speaking with people or making follow-up calls.
* Candidates who book appointments without understanding the prospect's needs.
* Individuals who give up after one or two unsuccessful contact attempts.
* Someone who prioritizes quantity over quality.
* Candidates who are uncomfortable with accountability and performance targets.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
* Inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.
* Opportunity to work directly with fitness entrepreneurs and business owners.
* Training in business consultation, qualification, and premium sales processes.
* A performance-driven and growth-focused working environment.
* Career growth opportunities in Sales Operations, Senior Appointment Setting, and Sales Leadership.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume along with answers to these questions:

1. How much experience do you have in lead qualification or appointment setting?
2. How many leads or calls have you handled daily in your previous role?
3. Have you worked with high-ticket services or premium coaching programs?
4. How do you handle prospects who don't respond after multiple follow-ups?
5. Why do you believe you're a good fit for this role?

Our Hiring Philosophy

**We don't need someone who just makes 100 calls a day.**

We need someone who can turn meaningful conversations into qualified business opportunities.

Someone who listens carefully, asks the right questions, follows up consistently, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

**At FBCI, your success is not measured by how many appointments you book, but by how many of the right prospects you bring to our sales team.**

If you're a people person who loves conversations, takes ownership, and thrives in a performance-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Apply now and become part of Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI).**

description:
**Employment Type:**
Project, Full Time
  
  
**Title:**
Project Director, Preconception Nutrition & Care, India
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi, India
  
  
**Deadline for submission:**
October 31, 2025 (Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the position may be closed once a suitable candidate is identified.)
  
  
**About Us**
Nutrition International (NI) is a global organization dedicated to delivering proven nutrition interventions to those who need them most. Working in partnership with countries, donors, and implementers, our experts conduct cutting-edge nutrition research, support critical policy formulation, and integrate nutrition into a broader development agenda. For more than 30 years now, we have focused on delivering low-cost, high-impact, nutrition interventions to people in need, driven by our mission to achieve a world where everyone, everywhere, is free from malnutrition and able to reach their full potential. Our work is guided by a dedicated and talented team of experts working globally, regionally and within countries to end malnutrition worldwide.
  
  
If you are a motivated and passionate individual who shares our conviction that a better world is possible through improved nutrition, wants to leave the world a little better than they found it, and is looking to be part of a team with a clear vision, we want to hear from you. Please consider applying for the position below which is being advertised for an anticipated project.
  
  
**About The Project**
The Preconception Nutrition and Care project is an exciting new initiative in India. It aims to change how families begin: by reaching couples of reproductive ages with nutrition, health interventions and counselling before pregnancy, so that women enter pregnancy healthier and better nourished. Healthier beginnings lead to better maternal and birth outcomes. The project takes a systems-based approach. It brings together service delivery, evidence generation, learning and government partnership, so that preconception care becomes integrated into overall health system delivery. At the heart of the project is a commitment to putting the nutritional needs of women and couples at the center of design and implementation. The project aims to generate evidence and learning from implementation, and to use it to shape national dialogue on preconception nutrition and care.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Project Director will lead this work from New Delhi. You will head a small, focused team, guide a range of implementing partners and engage with state and national government. You will also be the primary voice of the project with the donor, government, research bodies and the private sector. You will work closely with Nutrition International's Maternal Newborn Health and Nutrition and Health Economics and Nutrition Financing portfolios, as well as colleagues in the Asia Regional Office and headquarters in Ottawa.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-visibility project, with full accountability for results, partnerships and resources. You will help set the direction for how India, and the wider region, approaches nutrition and care before pregnancy.
**In this role you**
**will be responsible to:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for donor/s, national government representatives and strategic partners to lead evidence-based negotiations on project priorities, scope, and deliverables
* Facilitate shared understanding of project scope, goals and deliverables and among project staff, partners and stakeholders
* Guide the implementation of project activities and ensure project staff and partners are executing the project according to the approved project plan
* Manage relations with partners, service providers and consultants of the project, according to Nutrition International's policies. This includes the development of terms of reference, service provided and consultant/firm selection, contracting, monitoring and end of contract processes
* Oversee and work closely with government stakeholders and partners to develop detailed annual workplans that clearly define the strategies, activities and resources (time, budget and equipment etc.) required for effective implementation of the project; and update workplans regularly to ensure the timely completion of activities and achievement of the deliverables
* Cultivate and manage strong, collaborative relationships with implementing partners, government authorities, donors and other key stakeholders. Ensure open communication channels and a shared understanding of the project's goals, responsibilities, and timelines
* Identify and engage with potential new partners that align with the project's objectives, ensuring their capacities complement the project's needs and strategies
* Ensure monitoring and learning strategies and systems are applied within the project in collaboration with the Monitoring, Data and Learning sub-unit
* Ensure a monitoring plan is developed and followed by the project team and partners. Ensure monitoring data is analyzed and used for course correction as needed
* Ensure that the project has a comprehensive staffing strategy with the appropriate composition of team members to ensure adequate oversight and quality assurance of all work within the project
* Manage project staff contracts and consultants in a timely manner and according to local legislation and Nutrition International policies
* Provide financial oversight for the full scope of the project. Maintain oversight on all sub-grants within the project and their associated budget(s) and ensure that partners establish appropriate financial procedures and tools required to be in alignment with Nutrition International requirements and standards
* Develop regular cash flow projections and monitor expenditure and review variance analysis to ensure the project operates within its budget parameters
* Ensure all project funds are managed according to established accounting policies, procedures and donor regulations
* Ensure donor stewardship with our committed donors to sustain relationships. Build and strengthen relationships with key project stakeholders and partners to ensure the project is harmonized with other donors funded project/programs and facilitates government leadership and ownership
* Establish mechanisms for regular communication within the project team, Country leadership and across partners and with Nutrition International leadership to maximize opportunities for program integration and to elevate issues or risks

**For more detailed information about the role**
, please click on the attached
**Job Description**

**About you**
You will have PhD or MD degree from a recognized university in one of the following areas: nutrition, public health, reproductive health and/or a related field, with atleast 10-12 years of work experience with international NGOs, UN agencies or similar working on public health, reproductive health, nutrition related programs with at least 5 years of senior level experience in project management. You will also have demonstrated the experience in managing complex partnerships with multiple stakeholders, including government bodies, NGOs, and international organizations.
  
  
Fluency in English is essential. Knowledge of Hindi and /or local languages of project states would be an advantage.
  
  
**Benefits**

Nutrition International offers a competitive market pay, including health and wellness benefits, medical insurance, accidental insurance plan, flexible work hours, four weeks of vacation (plus public holidays), and support for learning and development opportunities. relationships, coordinating with government ministries and departments, supporting project

opportunities into business.

Travel across multiple states to conduct promotional activities, meet prospective clients, generate leads, explain training programs and certification benefits, conduct follow-ups, and convert prospects into registrations or business opportunities.

Identify new business opportunities, develop prospective client networks, conduct sales presentations, negotiate with clients where required, and contribute towards achieving revenue and business growth targets.

Ensure accurate and efficient management of client, training, sales, and project-related data. Maintain updated records and prepare regular reports on leads, conversions, activities, and business performance.

Manage and utilize organizational software, CRM systems, data management platforms,

and other digital tools to improve operational efficiency and streamline processes.

Drive initiatives aimed at expanding the organization's client base, increasing training registrations, developing partnerships, and exploring new markets and opportunities.

Represent the organization at government meetings, conferences, training programs, exhibitions, promotional events, and other external engagements while fostering partnerships and strengthening the organization's brand presence.

Be willing to travel extensively across different states as required for business development, training promotion, client meetings, government coordination, events, and sales activities.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong client relationship and negotiation skills.

Sales and business development mindset.

Ability to communicate training and certification programs effectively.

Comfortable with extensive interstate travel and field sales.

Government/client coordination experience.

Good data management and analytical skills.

Proficiency in CRM, MS Excel, and business software.

Strong follow-up and lead-conversion abilities.

Event and training coordination skills.

Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams.

Professional presentation and networking skills.

The primary objective of this role is to strengthen client and government relationships, drive business growth, promote Fostac Training & Certification programs across different states, generate and convert sales opportunities, and ensure smooth execution of organizational projects and training initiatives.

With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. * Manage and maintain the NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro (Formerly Net Suite OpenAir) system, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.

* Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and user experience.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.

title: GSPANN - SAP BTP Consultant
description:
GSPANN is hiring an SAP Business Technology Platform Consultant to manage end-to-end SAP BTP administration, security, and integrations across cloud and hybrid environments. The role focuses on configuring SAP Cloud Connector, Identity Authentication Service (IAS), Identity Provisioning Service (IPS), and SAP Integration Suite, alongside monitoring SAP HANA Cloud and managing global account architecture.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Manage SAP BTP global accounts, directories, and sub-accounts, including entitlements, quotas, regions, and environments across Neo and Cloud Foundry.
* Lead day-to-day operations through the SAP BTP Cockpit, covering monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Implement SAP Cloud Connector to enable secure connectivity between on-premise systems and SAP BTP.
* Drive identity and access management using Identity Authentication Service (IAS) and Identity Provisioning Service (IPS).
* Support authentication and authorization mechanisms including OAuth 2.0, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0, OpenID Connect, and Role Collections.
* Develop REST API integrations and manage secure exposure via API Management (APIM).
* Build integrations in SAP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration, API Management, and event-based flows.
* Optimize SAP Extension Suite and application extensions on SAP BTP.
* Manage SAP HANA Cloud provisioning, access control, and connectivity.
* Ensure system health, compliance, and security tracking via Alert Notification Service and Audit Logs.
* Design cloud networking and security configurations, including destinations, trust setups, and secure communication channels.
* Collaborate with functional, development, and BASIS teams to support hybrid (on-premise plus cloud) SAP landscapes.
* Lead troubleshooting of BTP-related issues and coordinate with SAP support where required.
* Drive compliance with organizational security, governance, and best practices.

**Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of hands-on SAP BTP administration experience.
* Any experience with DRC tenant is desirable.
* Holding SAP BTP or cloud-related certifications would be an advantage.
* Apply expertise to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps concepts on SAP BTP.
* Demonstrate strong expertise in SAP BTP Cockpit and sub-account configuration.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of SAP Cloud Connector, IAS, IPS, and core security concepts.
* Work with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, REST APIs, APIM, and OpenID Connect for authentication and integration.

title: Creative Strategist
description: We are looking for a highly driven, performance-obsessed Lead Creative Strategist to own our entire creative ecosystem, from social media and content strategy to performance marketing creatives, creative testing, and scaling winning concepts.This is not a conventional social media role. We are looking for someone who understands that creative is one of the biggest drivers of paid marketing performance and knows how to turn consumer insights, cultural trends, product USPs, and performance data into creatives that convert.You will own the creative process end to end: identifying opportunities, developing concepts, building creative briefs, directing shoots, producing and editing content, analysing ad performance, identifying winning and losing creatives, and continuously feeding those insights back into the next round of creative production.Your mandate is to build a creative engine capable of developing, testing, and iterating on 50–100 creative assets per week, depending on production complexity, with a strong emphasis on speed, quality, learning, and performance.You should be equally comfortable thinking strategically, getting your hands dirty with execution, analysing Meta Ads performance, and making decisive calls on what to scale, what to iterate, and what to stop.We need someone who thrives in an intense, fast-paced, high-energy environment, takes complete ownership of outcomes, and can move from an idea to a live creative without unnecessary layers of management.The goal is simple: build a repeatable creative system that consistently produces high-performing content, improves customer acquisition efficiency, and drives profitable growth.1. End-to-End Performance Creative StrategyYou will own the strategy behind every creative we produce for paid acquisition, retargeting, organic social, and brand-building campaigns.Develop a comprehensive performance creative strategy aligned with business objectives, revenue targets, CAC goals, ROAS, and conversion rates.Identify the creative angles, messaging, formats, hooks, and visual approaches most likely to resonate with our target audience.Translate product features, benefits, ingredients, fragrances, differentiators, and consumer pain points into compelling advertising narratives.Develop creative concepts across UGC, founder-led content, product demonstrations, testimonials, problem-solution ads, educational content, product comparisons, lifestyle content, and aspirational brand storytelling.Build a systematic approach to testing different hooks, scripts, opening frames, CTAs, offers, formats, lengths, and storytelling structures.Ensure every creative has a clear hypothesis, audience, objective, and reason to exist.Develop creative strategies for prospecting, retargeting, customer acquisition, new product launches, and seasonal campaigns.Understand the relationship between creative performance, audience intent, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.2. Build and Operate a High-Velocity Creative EngineBuild and manage a creative production pipeline capable of delivering approximately 50–100 creative assets per week, including variations, iterations, and new concepts.Establish a structured weekly workflow covering research, ideation, scripting, production, editing, approvals, deployment, analysis, and iteration.Develop creative calendars and production schedules that keep the team consistently ahead of upcoming campaign requirements.Turn a small number of strong concepts into multiple meaningful variations without relying on superficial changes alone.Create systems for generating new hooks, angles, scripts, storyboards, headlines, visual treatments, and ad variations at scale.Maintain an organised creative library with naming conventions, campaign tags, concept IDs, performance history, and learnings.Build a continuous feedback loop between paid marketing results and the creative production pipeline.Reduce production bottlenecks and unnecessary approval cycles while maintaining brand quality.Establish standard operating procedures, creative templates, briefing formats, and testing frameworks that allow output to scale without compromising learning quality.3. Creative Performance Analysis: Know What Works and WhyMonitor creative-level performance across Meta Ads and other relevant paid channels.Analyse metrics including spend, impressions, CPM, CTR, CPC, thumb-stop or hook rate, hold rate, video retention, landing page views, conversion rate, CPA/CAC, ROAS, and purchase volume.Identify winning creatives, emerging trends, creative fatigue, underperforming concepts, and opportunities for further testing.Understand the difference between a creative that attracts attention and one that actually generates profitable customers.Diagnose performance issues by distinguishing between weak hooks, poor messaging, low engagement, weak offers, conversion problems, and potential audience or landing-page issues.Identify which elements are contributing to success: the opening three seconds, product demonstration, offer, creator, script, visual treatment, testimonial, or CTA.Make clear decisions on which creatives to scale, iterate, test further, or discontinue.Conduct regular creative performance reviews and communicate findings to the growth and leadership teams.Convert performance data into actionable briefs for the next production cycle.4. Continuous Testing, Iteration and ScalingDesign and maintain a structured creative testing roadmap.Develop clear hypotheses for each new concept and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, learning potential, and production effort.Run controlled tests wherever practical to understand which creative variables are driving performance.Develop multiple iterations of promising concepts, exploring new hooks, openings, scripts, creators, visual formats, product demonstrations, and messaging angles.Distinguish between testing a new concept and testing a variation of an existing winner.Identify repeatable creative patterns and turn them into scalable creative frameworks.Refresh creatives proactively when performance shows signs of fatigue.Maintain a healthy pipeline of new concepts so growth does not depend on a small number of winning ads.Document learnings from both successful and unsuccessful tests to prevent repeated mistakes.Work closely with the performance marketing team to align creative testing with campaign structure, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.5. Creative Production, Shoots and Content ExecutionWrite scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, shot lists, storyboards, and detailed creative briefs.Plan and direct product shoots, UGC shoots, creator collaborations, founder-led content, and campaign productions.Brief and manage creators, editors, designers, photographers, videographers, and production partners.Ensure that shoots are planned efficiently to generate a high volume of usable assets from each production day.Identify opportunities to capture multiple concepts, formats, hooks, and variations in a single shoot.Review edits and provide precise, actionable feedback on pacing, storytelling, visual hierarchy, opening frames, subtitles, product visibility, and CTAs.Use tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, or AI-assisted creative tools to create or refine assets when needed.Maintain a high standard of execution across both rapid-turnaround performance ads and more polished brand content.Manage production timelines, asset delivery, and creative quality control.6. Consumer Research, Competitor Intelligence and Creative InspirationConduct ongoing research into consumer behaviour, purchase motivations, objections, unmet needs, and product discovery patterns.Analyse customer reviews, testimonials, comments, DMs, feedback, and frequently asked questions to identify compelling messaging opportunities.Study competitor advertising, creative patterns, offers, positioning, creator partnerships, and campaign strategies.Use Meta Ads Library, social media research, customer feedback, and relevant advertising intelligence tools to identify emerging opportunities.Develop a structured repository of competitor references, creative inspiration, hooks, scripts, and tested concepts.Identify gaps in the market and develop differentiated creative angles rather than producing derivative content.Translate consumer and competitor insights into specific creative experiments and production briefs.Who We Are Looking For3–6 years of relevant experience in creative strategy, performance marketing, paid social, or D2C growth.Demonstrable experience developing and testing performance marketing creatives, ideally for consumer brands.Strong understanding of Meta Ads creative performance and the relationship between creative, CAC, ROAS, and conversion.Experience building structured creative testing systems rather than producing isolated campaigns.Ability to develop strong concepts, scripts, hooks, briefs, and iterations at speed.Experience analysing creative-level data and turning results into specific next steps.Strong understanding of short-form video, UGC, creator-led ads, product storytelling, and direct-response creative.Excellent written communication and the ability to provide clear creative direction.Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple creative workstreams simultaneously.Comfort working hands-on with editing, design, research, analytics, and production tools.A high level of ownership, urgency, accountability, and attention to detail.Strong advantagesExperience scaling a D2C brand in beauty, personal care, skincare, fragrance, fashion, wellness, or another visually driven consumer category.📍Full Time Role in Gurgaon, Haryana

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:

Criclive.in is a dedicated cricket platform that began with a mission to deliver the fastest live, ball-by-ball commentary on the internet, matching the pace of live telecasts. Over time, it has expanded into a complete cricket destination, offering sharp features, in-depth articles, and breaking news from across the cricketing world. The platform is designed to keep fans closely connected to the sport they love, wherever they are. A key highlight is its vibrant fan discussion page, where cricket enthusiasts from around the globe share views, celebrate big moments, and debate key topics. At Criclive.in, the focus is on creating an engaging community experience that feels like living the game together.

The Search Engine Optimization Specialist will be responsible for improving Criclive.in’s search visibility and organic traffic through strategic, data-driven SEO efforts. This full-time, on-site role is based in Janakpuri and involves conducting keyword research, optimizing on-page elements, and performing regular SEO audits to identify technical and content-related issues. The specialist will manage link-building initiatives, monitor performance using web analytics tools, and provide actionable insights to enhance rankings and user engagement. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with content creators, aligning SEO strategy with editorial plans, tracking competitors, and staying current with search engine algorithm updates and best practices. The role requires close coordination with the broader team to ensure that SEO supports the platform’s growth and audience engagement goals.

  **Keyword Research**

  **On-Page SEO**

  **Link Building**

  **Web Analytics**

**About Company**

DeHaat, a leading Agri-Tech startup, offers end-to-end solutions to India's farmers using AI technologies. *Great Place to Work certifications*

**Website:**
https://agrevolution.in/

**Role Overview:**

The Brand Manager – Agri Inputs will conceptualize and execute integrated marketing campaigns for DeHaat’s agri-input portfolio. The role involves close collaboration with business, category, agronomy, and sales teams to drive farmer awareness, retailer engagement, product adoption, and revenue growth. As a brand custodian, the incumbent will translate product benefits and agronomic insights into simple, credible, and locally relevant communication across key touchpoints. • 3–5 years of overall experience, including 2–3 years in brand management or integrated marketing. MBA/PGDM in Marketing. Relevant experience in agri-inputs, rural marketing or farmer-facing categories is desirable

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

* Strong strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
* Genuine interest in marketing, distribution, growth, or business strategy.
* Ability to move from ideas to execution and learn from experiments.
* Curiosity about user behaviour, learning, and community building.
* Initiative, ownership, consistency, and comfort with early-stage uncertainty.
* Willingness to collaborate, challenge assumptions constructively, and make decisions together.
* A genuine interest in building a venture over the long term.

Previous startup or growth experience is valuable, but we are open to candidates who can demonstrate strong thinking, initiative, and execution through projects or practical ideas.

A large personal following is not a requirement.

What this opportunity offers

* A genuine opportunity to help build BookVidya from an early stage.
* Shared strategic responsibility for growth and distribution.
* The opportunity to shape the venture's direction alongside the founding team.
* A founding partnership with equity and responsibilities to be discussed transparently and agreed upon.

**Important:**
This is an early-stage co-founder opportunity, not a guaranteed salaried position. Compensation, equity, time commitment, and other founding arrangements will be discussed with suitable candidates before any commitment is made.

How to express interest

Please share a brief introduction, relevant experience or projects, why BookVidya interests you, and how you would approach acquiring our first 100 genuinely engaged learners.

We are looking for a thoughtful partner who wants to build, experiment, and grow with us over the long term.

description: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time About Voice ArenaVoice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.About the roleVoice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.In this role, you willThe work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. title: Associate Content Manager
description:
**Role snapshot**

You run two things end to end. First, the Instagram personal brands of our founder and core team, from research and scripting to the shoot and a fully programmatic edit. Second, our influencer marketing: finding creators, closing partnerships and keeping them posting about us.

**Title**
:- Associate Content Manager

**Location:**
- Gurgaon, India (onsite, in office)

**Type**
:- Full time

**Platform**
:- Instagram

**You Run:**
- The founder's and core team's Instagram profiles, plus our influencer partners

**Reports**
to:- Head of Marketing

**What you'll doInstagram personal branding**

1. **Research.**
   Track what is working on Instagram every week: formats, hooks, audio, pacing and edit styles. Find the outlier reels in the founder and business niche and bring your next bets to the weekly review, backed by numbers.
2. **Script.**
   Turn founder calls, voice notes, podcasts and Slack threads into tight scripts. Weave in each person's real journey and point of view, land the hook in the first 2 seconds, and keep one idea per reel.
3. **Shoot.**
   Plan and direct talking-head and B-roll shoots in the office: light, mic, framing, and getting the best take from a busy founder in the least time.
4. **Edit in code.**
   Edit every video programmatically with Claude Code, using HyperFrames and Remotion for motion graphics, animation, captions and sound. Build reusable templates so each reel ships faster than the last.
5. **Support the team.**
   Help the founder and core team members with their own production, from prep and shoot setup to the final cut.
6. **Publish and learn.**
   Run the content calendar, get the owner's approval before anything goes live, and post on time. Track retention, shares, saves and follows; double down on what works and kill what does not.

**Influencer marketing**

1. **Outreach.**
   Find and reach out to new influencers whose audience matches ours.
2. **Partnerships.**
   Agree deliverables, timelines and what we give in return, and close the deal in writing.
3. **Coordination.**
   Keep every partner posting about us on schedule, and follow up the day a post slips.
4. **Keep our promises.**
   Make sure every partner gets everything we promised them, on time.
5. **Content for partners.**
   Write their posts and edit their videos when they need it.

**What we're looking for**

1. **Full time, onsite.**
   You work from our Gurgaon office every day. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
2. **Instagram native.**
   You can show reels you made, for yourself or someone else, and explain why each one worked or did not.
3. **Research first.**
   You spot a trend before it peaks and back your opinion with views, retention and follower data.
4. **A storyteller.**
   You can pull a real story out of a founder and shape it into a hook, a turn and a payoff.
5. **Comfortable in code.**
   You already edit with Claude Code, or you learn fast and are happy working in a terminal. Basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript helps.
6. **Organised with partners.**
   You can run many creator relationships at once, track every promise in both directions and follow up without being chased.
7. **A creative eye.**
   You are the last check on quality and you say no to weak creative.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running influencer or creator partnerships
* Hands-on work with Remotion or HyperFrames
* A motion design background (After Effects or similar)
* AI video tools such as Higgsfield
* An Instagram account you grew yourself
* Content for B2B, SaaS or startup founders

📩

**Hiring@inboxkit.com**

title: Head - Data M&E & Institutional Intelligence
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk operates on the principle that 'what gets measured, gets governed.' This role owns the data spine of the organisation — the independent control room that tells every layer of RightWalk whether systems are working, outcomes are real, and learning is being captured. Critically, this function must be independent of the program teams whose performance it measures. Data inflation and incentive-driven reporting are existential threats to RightWalk's credibility. The Head – Data, M&E & Institutional Intelligence is the institutional conscience of the organisation's evidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Data and indicator architecture**

* Design and own the end-to-end data architecture: from field input to impact indicators — definitions, collection protocols, validation logic, and storage.
* Build common data dictionaries across programs and states.
* Ensure indicator definitions are clear, auditable and usable by teams.
* Align program indicators with donor reporting, government dashboards and internal learning needs.

**2. Dashboards and institutional intelligence**

* Build and maintain real-time dashboards and standard report packs for the CEO, state teams, and donors.
* Drive institutional intelligence: cross-state comparisons, learning loops, and evidence synthesis for policy refinement.
* Convert data into actionable intelligence for policy, program and product decisions.
* Manage the Knowledge Management function — evidence library, document repositories, and institutional memory.

**3. M&E systems and quality assurance**

* Lead the M&E framework: indicator design, sampling methodology, periodic evaluation cycles, and external evaluation partnerships.
* Own data governance — data quality audits, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Lead and develop State M&E Leads (embedded in states, functionally reporting to this role).
* Conduct periodic verification, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag reviews and quality audits.
* Maintain strict independence from Program and State teams — this role's credibility depends on it.

**4. Learning loops and evidence building**

* Ensure field learning feeds into policy redesign, process improvement and product updates.
* Support impact evaluation readiness and external evaluation partnerships.
* Produce public-good outputs — impact reports, evidence briefs, and external publications that build RightWalk's credibility.

**5. Data governance and ethics**

* Define data access, privacy, anonymisation and data security protocols with Tech and People teams.
* Ensure responsible handling of beneficiary, field and government data.
* Create data discipline without making teams feel they are entering a tax raid.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* Organisation-wide M&E and data architecture drafted and adopted.
* A live dashboard exists that the CEO, State Directors, and donors can access — real-time, reliable, and action-oriented.
* Data quality audits are conducted every quarter; anomalies are surfaced, not suppressed.
* The organisation makes at least two key program design changes in direct response to M&E evidence.
* RightWalk publishes at least one credible external evidence brief that strengthens its policy positioning.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Setting programmatic targets — that is the program team's domain.
* Managing field delivery or GDN operations.
* Policy authorship or advocacy strategy.
* Tech platform development (though close collaboration with Tech is essential).
* Sit under state programs whose performance it must assess.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  10–16 years in M&E, data systems, evaluation, or research — ideally within development sector, government advisory, or research institutions.
* **Methods:**
  Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills — comfortable with both survey-based M&E and systems-level data architecture.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with MIS/dashboard design and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* **Independence:**
  Track record of building independent M&E functions that are trusted by leadership and donors alike.
* **Orientation:**
  Governance mindset - more interested in data integrity than in making numbers look good.
* **Sector:**
  Exposure to government data systems, HMIS, DISE, or similar public data infrastructure

BMC Helix Global Services Delivery (GSD) is responsible for delivering BMC Helix solutions to customers worldwide. The organization provides opportunities to solve complex business and operational challenges through a consultative approach, manage current BMC technologies, and help customers maximize value from their investments.
  
  
The AMS Consultant will provide post-implementation and go-live operational services for the Customer environment, with primary responsibility for BMC Helix TrueSight Server Automation (TSSA) and BMC Helix Automation Console (BHAC). The role combines platform administration, automation, vulnerability remediation enablement, troubleshooting, reporting, upgrades, and continuous service improvement in a high-volume, customer-facing managed services environment.
  
  
**Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC Helix's and your own success:**

* This is an on-site role at the Gurgaon location.
* Provide L2/L3/L4 operational support for TSSA and BHAC in line with agreed SLAs, operational procedures, and availability commitments.
* Administer and maintain TSSA and BHAC components, integrations, job schedules, content, catalogs, connectors, and supporting infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot application, platform, integration, authentication, database, agent, scan, patch, deployment, and reporting issues through structured problem management.
* Plan and execute server patching and remediation activities across Windows, Linux, and UNIX environments, including pre-checks, scheduling, deployment, validation, exception handling, and rollback coordination.
* Use BHAC to support vulnerability remediation workflows by importing or synchronizing vulnerability data, mapping vulnerabilities to remediation content, planning remediation, managing exceptions, and tracking closure status.
* Create and maintain automation jobs, packages, compliance rules, patch policies, remediation plans, dashboards, and operational reports based on approved customer requirements.
* Support application patching and software deployment through TSSA, including requirement gathering, package creation, testing, rollout planning, deployment, validation, and documentation.
* Monitor platform health, capacity, job performance, agent coverage, failed activities, backlog, and remediation progress; proactively identify and address risks.
* Recommend and plan product upgrades, patches, hotfixes, configuration improvements, and adoption of relevant new capabilities.
* Follow ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release, configuration, and knowledge management practices.
* Work closely with Customer service owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, application owners, BMC Helix Support, and internal stakeholders to coordinate delivery and resolve dependencies.
* Prepare service reviews, operational metrics, dashboards, root cause analyses, knowledge articles, runbooks, and continuous-improvement recommendations.
* Participate in shift operations, planned weekend activities, major incident support, and on-call coverage as required.

**To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.
* 5-15 years of relevant experience, including hands-on work in a managed services or enterprise production support environment.
* Extensive experience in implementation, administration, configuration, and support of BMC TrueSight Server Automation (TSSA/BSA)
* Hands-on experience with BMC Helix Automation Console (BHAC, earlier TSAC), including vulnerability remediation and patch management use cases.
* Experience with server inventory, compliance, patch management, software distribution, application deployment, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Experience deploying and configuring patch management for Windows, Linux, and UNIX servers.
* Ability to create and manage depot objects, packages, jobs, schedules, policies, compliance templates, remediation content, and customer-specific reports.
* Knowledge of TSSA architecture and components, including application servers, file servers, RSCD agents, databases, authentication, and high-availability considerations.
* Understanding of BHAC integration with TSSA and vulnerability management data sources, along with remediation planning, execution, and status reporting.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and UNIX operating systems; networking, database, security, and infrastructure concepts.
* Knowledge of automation or scripting using tools such as NSH, PowerShell, shell scripting, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience managing product upgrades, patches, hotfixes, disaster recovery readiness, performance tuning, and platform health checks.
* ITIL knowledge and practical experience with incident, problem, change, release, and service-level management.

**Why Work Here? Because You’ll Matter.**
We’re not hiring for roles—we’re hiring for
**impact**
. At Helix, you’ll solve hard problems, build smart solutions, and work with people who challenge and champion you. You’ll see your ideas come to life—and your work make a difference.
  
  
We believe in
**trust, transparency, and grit**
. Our culture is inclusive, flexible, and built for people who want to stretch themselves - and support others doing the same. Whether you’re remote or in-office, you’ll find space to show up fully and contribute meaningfully. You won’t be boxed in—you’ll be backed up.
  
  
**Make Your Mark At Helix**
If Helix excites you but you're unsure if you meet every qualification,
**apply anyway**
. We value diverse perspectives and believe the best ideas come from everywhere.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.
  
  
BMC Helix maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.
  
  
At HELIX we believe in pay transparency and have set the midpoint of the salary band for this role at INR. Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
  
  
The salary listed is just one component of HELIX's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring that our employees are paid fairly and equitably, and that we are transparent about our compensation practices.

title: Ultrasound Reporting Assistant
description:
Clinic Pankh is a multispecialty healthcare clinic in New Delhi dedicated to providing compassionate, comprehensive and patient-centered care to women, children and families. Clinic Pankh also provides Pregnancy Ultrasound, Follicular Monitoring, laboratory testing, mental health support, physiotherapy, nutrition counseling, yoga, Lamaze and lactation expertise, complemented by an in-house pharmacy and organic café. The team focuses on empowering individuals through knowledge, personalized attention and a supportive environment throughout their healthcare journey.

**Position**

You will work alongside our doctor to type, print and deliver ultrasound reports, and you will own all PCPNDT documentation so the clinic is always ready for inspection.

Daily tasks include reviewing ultrasound findings, entering patient and examination details into reporting systems, ensuring reports are complete and correctly formatted, and coordinating with healthcare professionals to clarify information as needed.

The Ultrasound Reporting Assistant helps manage patient flow by organizing records, maintaining confidentiality, and assisting with basic patient communication, such as explaining reporting timelines and follow-up procedures. The role also requires adherence to health and safety standards, accurate handling of patient documentation, and collaboration with the wider care team to support efficient, high-quality diagnostic services.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Ultrasound reporting**

* Type findings live during scans and format reports using standard templates.
* Check patient details, referral information and measurements before the doctor signs.
* Print reports, confirm they are signed, and hand them over to patients and referring doctors on time.
* Manage the report queue and keep templates up to date.

**PCPNDT documentation**

* Fill Form F accurately and completely for every pregnant patient, including obstetric history and the referral indication, and pass it to the performing doctor for signature.
* Fill Form F correctly for follicular monitoring and fertility scans as per Delhi PCPNDT advisories.
* Maintain the daily PNDT register and patient records.
* File Form F on the Delhi online portal and keep signed hard copies with referral slips and case papers.
* Prepare daily and monthly PNDT reports for the Appropriate Authority as required.
* Keep all PNDT files (digital and physical) organised and preserved for at least 2 years, ready for audits and inspections.
* Check daily that the "no sex determination" signage in English and Hindi, the registration certificate and a copy of the Act and Rules are displayed.
* Flag any gaps or discrepancies to the doctor in charge immediately.

**Requirements**

* Graduate (any stream).
* Experience as an ultrasound/radiology typist, medical transcriptionist or PNDT documentation staff at a diagnostic centre or clinic.
* Neat, legible handwriting and the ability to fill forms carefully.
* Fast, accurate English typing (40+ WPM); familiarity with ultrasound terminology.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Strong computer skills: MS Word, Excel, reporting software, printing/scanning, and online government portals.
* Presebtable and Respectful towards doctors and staff
* Strong patient care and interpersonal skills to interact respectfully and clearly with patients and clinical staff.
* Should have attention to detail, accuracy in documentation
* A commitment to patient confidentiality, professional ethics, and continuous learning in ultrasound reporting and clinical workflows.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on Form F experience, including fertility/follicular scans.
* Training in PCPNDT rules and guidelines (not mandatory; we will train the right person).

**Working hours**

Monday to Saturday, evenings (currently 5–8 PM). Timings may change based on clinic needs.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and expected salary to clinicpankh.talent@gmail.com and whatsapp 9354468030

title: Senior Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**About IDinsight**
*We're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and*
*non-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most*
*impact.*
IDinsight is a global nonprofit that equips leaders with the data, evidence and technology to
  
  
improve lives at scale. We partner with governments, NGOs, multilaterals, and funders to support decisions at every stage of their impact journey – from bold pilots to nationwide scale-ups. Our teams bring rigorous evidence and practical insights so leaders can make informed decisions that truly change lives. With our partners, we are pioneering the next frontier of social impact, where data and technology accelerate progress for millions. We help leaders overcome the three main barriers to impact:
  
  

* Figuring out what works
* Learning and improving
* Reaching and operating at scale

We work in multiple countries across Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors,
  
  
including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other
  
  
areas.
  
  
We have expertise in a variety of rigorous approaches and methodologies, which we tailor to each client depending on their needs and constraints. To achieve a positive social impact we:
  
  

* Support our partners with the full ‘data and evidenceʼ value chain – from primary data

collection to data systems, monitoring, evaluation, and learning tools, and data science
  
  

* Inform funding decisions – toward high-impact initiatives and away from less effective

programs or approaches
  
  

* Create cutting-edge AI-for-good products that make the delivery of social interventions

and learning tools more cost-effective and scalable
  
  
Our diverse, growing team of roughly 250 outstanding colleagues operate in nearly two dozen
  
  
countries around the world. Learn more about our mission, values, and principles at
  
  
www.IDinsight.org.
  
  
**Joining IDinsight at this moment**
IDinsight is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As demand for rigorous evidence and
  
  
AI-enabled solutions accelerates across the sectors and geographies we work in, we are actively investing in our teams, deepening our regional footprint, and expanding the frontier of what data and technology can do for social impact. This is a moment of real momentum for IDinsight. We're looking for people who want to use data and evidence to improve lives at scale; who are energized by taking on problems without a playbook; and who want a hand in shaping what IDinsight becomes as we grow.
  
  
**About The Financial Planning & Analysis Senior Manager Role**
The FP&A Senior Manager will support IDinsight with project and regional budgeting, forecasting, value-added analysis, and insightful financial reporting. The role sits in the Global Finance team and reports to the Head of Financial Planning & Analysis, working closely with the CFO and finance colleagues across our regional offices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Reporting and analysis**
***Project level***

* Oversee the monthly budget vs. actual BVA reporting process and share project-level

analysis and key takeaways with each project team, including quarterly review calls (or
  
  
more frequent ones, as warranted)
  
  

* Suggest and implement improvements to monthly project reporting tools and processes
* Develop and maintain a global dashboard for evaluating all projects, share meaningful

insights with the regions, and follow up on agreed action plans
  
  

* Give input into policies and guidelines for project reporting, charging, evaluation, and

ongoing forecasting
  
  

* Work closely with teams to keep pipeline and contract opportunities up to date, ensuring

annual revenue projections are accurate
  
  

* Prepare ad hoc reports for project teams and funders

***Regional level***

* Provide BVA analysis and commentary to leads of revenue-generating units through

monthly dashboards
  
  

* Help regional teams update the project pipeline with revenue projections
* Work with regions to interpret the utilization tracker and identify key takeaways for regional

leads and project managers
  
  

* Build project profitability analysis across the portfolio
* Prepare and update cash forecasts for each regional office, feeding into global reporting
* Help regions understand which opportunities are self-funded and analyze the related

utilization
  
  

* Prepare presentations for leadership of revenue-generating units and create additional

value-added financial reporting and tracking
  
  

* Prepare routine reporting on contribution revenue, restrictions, and receivables, working

with the accounting team to ensure accuracy
  
  

* Update specific sections of the quarterly board package, including the project pipeline and

dashboard
  
  
***Systems transition ERP/PSA***

* Lead FP&A reporting through IDinsight's ongoing finance systems transition, with a focus

on the project life cycle
  
  

* Work with regional and global finance and accounting teams to ensure data is accurate,

complete, and fit for reporting
  
  

* Work with systems analysts and implementation consultants to ensure reporting

requirements are built correctly into the new systems
  
  

* Train project teams to extract reports from the new systems and draw meaningful analysis

from them
  
  

* Document FP&A processes and SOPs, and prepare budgeting and revenue recognition

guidelines for the new systems
  
  

* Manage system maintenance from a project life cycle perspective alongside the system

administrator, including setting up new projects and team members
  
  
***Project and regional budgeting and forecasting***

* Guide FP&A Senior Associates as they support project teams with tools, analysis, and

guidance on project budget preparation, contract negotiations, and billing rate analysis
  
  

* Review project budgets after first-level review by FP&A Senior Associates
* Support revenue-generating units in annual budgeting and forecasting. This may include coordinating budget processes, supporting leadership in building their budgets, and coordinating project pipeline, staffing, and cash forecasts

***Revenue and receivables***

* Build processes to ensure correct billing of, and accrual for, all client revenue
* Review revenue recognition for client projects and ensure the amounts recorded reflect

progress toward project completion
  
  

* Ensure collection of all outstanding accounts receivable (external and intercompany),

working alongside the AR team
  
  

* Support the accounting team in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, and

reconcile it to management reporting and dashboards
  
  

* Support the monthly close and annual audit processes as needed

**Other**

* Lead or support other finance workstreams as needed, which may include cash forecasting

and investment management, finance operations, compliance, and treasury
  
  

* Coordinate with Legal and Operations on governance, compliance, and organizational

policy
  
  

* Coordinate with other finance functions, global support functions, and regions on projects

and processes that span the organization
  
  

* Act as backup for other finance functions

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 5 years of work experience in finance, covering all or most of the following: financial

planning (including budgeting and forecasting), financial reporting and dashboards,
  
  
accounting in a multi-entity environment, internal controls, and treasury
  
  

* Significant leadership experience in a finance function
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field
* Skills and attributes:
* Strong leadership skills
* Thrives in fast-paced environments and is excited by opportunities to explore and implement new ideas
* Proactive attitude with a bias to action
* Excellent communication skills
* Strong project management and change management skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams located across many

countries
  
  
**Preferred**

* Professional accounting qualification CPA, ACA, ACCA Part II, or equivalent)
* Experience in the social sector and in a project-based environment (both highly desirable)
* Master's degree in a related field (helpful but not required)

**Professional development**
Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long-term impact strategy, and
  
  
have been noted highlights of teammatesʼ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership, support from talented peers, and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real-time feedback is embedded in our culture and formal structure enables maximum professional growth. Additionally, teammates have access to an annual professional development stipend that they are encouraged to utilize to explore their career interests and develop their skills.
  
  
**Nuts & bolts**
**Location**
This position is based in IDinsightʼs
**Dakar, Senegal; Delhi, India; Manila, Philippines; Nairobi,**
**Kenya; or Rabat, Morocco**
office(s). This position is not eligible for remote work, or otherwise, from the United States.
  
  
**Start date**

title: Executive Assistant, Country Director's Office (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The Executive Assistant will report to the Principal Manager, Strategy and Special Projects, providing high-level administrative support to Senior Executives and the Country Director. This role requires exceptional multitasking abilities, attention to detail, and the capability to handle sensitive information. The ideal candidate will be proactive, organized, and skilled in handling all important executive tasks.
  
  
The Country Director's week spans senior government counterparts, funders, Evidence Action's global leadership across multiple time zones, and state-level teams. This role makes that possible: protecting leadership time, ensuring they walk into every engagement fully prepared, and closing the loop on what follows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Calendar and Scheduling
  
  

* Own and actively manage the Country Director's calendar, resolving competing priorities and protecting time for strategic and deep work
* Coordinate multi-stakeholder meetings involving senior government officials, funders, partners, and Evidence Action's global leadership across time zones
* Ensure the Director is prepared for every engagement, with agendas, briefing notes, and background materials circulated in advance

Travel and Logistics
  
  

* Plan and book domestic and international travel end to end: flights, accommodation, visas, and ground transport
* Build practical, well-sequenced field itineraries in coordination with state teams, including frequent travel to state capitals and program sites
* Prepare and submit travel expense claims and reimbursements accurately and on time, in line with organizational policy

Communication and Correspondence
  
  

* Draft, review, and edit correspondence, official letters to government counterparts, presentations, and reports on behalf of the Director
* Screen and prioritize incoming calls, emails, and requests; respond, route, or escalate as appropriate
* Act as a liaison between the Count Director and internal teams, state offices, government stakeholders, and external partners

Meeting Support and Follow-Through
  
  

* Take clear minutes in leadership, partner, and government meetings
* Track action items to closure with named owners and deadlines, following up proactively rather than waiting to be asked
* Maintain organized, easily retrievable records of key documents, agreements, approvals, and correspondence

Confidentiality and Judgment
  
  

* Handle sensitive personnel, financial, and government-related information with complete discretion
* Exercise sound judgment in the Director's absence on what requires immediate escalation and what can wait

**Requirements**
Essential
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in executive support, including at least 2 years supporting a senior leader (Country Director, CXO, Partner, or equivalent)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Suite, and comfort with collaboration tools such as Slack and Asana
* Demonstrated ability to manage a complex calendar and competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Exceptional attention to detail and reliable follow-through on every commitment
* Proven discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information
* Willingness to travel within India as needed, and to be reachable for occasional urgent matters outside standard hours

Desirable
  
  

* Experience supporting leadership in a non-profit, international development, public health, or government-facing organization
* Experience coordinating with government departments, ministries, or public officials
* Working knowledge of project management tools and methodologies
* Comfort using AI tools to draft, summarize, and organize work
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across time zones

This role is ideal for a highly organized and driven individual who wants their organizational skill to translate directly into public health programs reaching millions of people.
  
  
**Position Location -**
This role is based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Optional enrolment in the National Pension System (NPS) through our partner, HDFC Pension
* Optional Flexible Basket Plan, offering components such as meal allowance, fuel, top-up health and term insurance, and telecommunications & internet — all forming part of the employee's CTC
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.
  
  
Note: This role will be open for applications until 30th October 2027. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.
