title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**

- A complete performance marketer, not just a campaign operator.

- Strong on both Meta Ads and Google Ads. Experience with only one platform will not be sufficient.

- Analytical, with a data-driven approach to every decision.

- Meta Ads and Google Ads (both mandatory)

In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large-scale, distributed financial applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.
* Hands-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Golang, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence.
* Container Platforms & Orchestration: Architect resilient, multi-cluster Kubernetes topologies at scale. Define best practices for workload scheduling, networking (service mesh), custom controllers/operators, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), and multi-tenant isolation.
* Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails.
* Zero-Trust Security & Policy-as-Code: Embed DevSecOps at the architectural level—designing policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Kyverno), centralized secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), secure supply chain standards (SBOM, image signing, Trivy), and compliance baselines (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
* Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents.
* FinOps & Performance Optimization: Architect cost-efficient cloud topologies. Establish capacity planning models, multi-region traffic routing, right-sizing strategies, and automated cost-governance guardrails.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
* Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep Hands-on Coding & Automation: Proficiency in at least one modern systems programming language (e.g., Golang, Python) along with advanced scripting (Bash). Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems software design.
* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).
* Kubernetes Internals: Comprehensive understanding of Kubernetes internals (control plane components, CNI/CSI, custom controllers/operators, RBAC, API extensions, and scheduling primitives).
* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
* Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting platforms within highly regulated domains (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Banking).
* Deep experience with Securing Cloud Native Platform.
* Experience designing, building, or operating large-scale Data Platforms is highly desirable.

***The Opportunity: Associate Director – Fund Raising & Donor Relations***

As Associate Director – Fundraising & Donor Relations, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping and driving RightWalk’s resource mobilization strategy. Reporting directly to the Executive Leadership, you will be entrusted with building, nurturing, and expanding high-value relationships with foundations, corporations, and high-net-worth individuals (HNIs). Beyond securing immediate funding, your mandate will include strengthening the organization’s long-term fundraising pipeline, ensuring that RightWalk has the sustained resources to deliver impact at scale.

This is an opportunity for a senior fundraising professional to operate at the intersection of strategy and execution — translating the organization’s vision into compelling donor narratives, designing innovative fundraising models, and aligning partnerships with RightWalk’s mission of equity and inclusion. As a member of the senior leadership team, you will not only deliver ambitious fundraising targets but also serve as a key voice in influencing organizational strategy, ensuring that financial sustainability and mission alignment go hand in hand.

***Key Responsibilities***

***1. Fundraising Strategy Development***

* Lead the design and execution of a multi-year fundraising strategy to ensure long-term financial sustainability for RWF.
* Align fundraising goals with the organization’s strategic priorities and expansion plans.
* Explore innovative funding models (blended finance, CSR, multi-donor platforms) to diversify income streams.
* Regularly report to Executive Leadership and the Board on fundraising performance, risks, and opportunities.

***2. Fundraising Pipeline & Resource Mobilization***

* Build and manage a robust pipeline of potential donors across foundations, corporations, HNIs, and international agencies.
* Establish systems to track prospects, monitor progress, and ensure disciplined follow-through.
* Drive prospect research and due diligence to identify high-value opportunities and new geographies for growth.
* Convert qualified leads into committed partnerships through compelling pitches and tailored cultivation strategies.

***3. Partnership Cultivation & Donor Engagement***

* Serve as the face of RWF in external fundraising conversations, representing the organization with gravitas and credibility.
* Cultivate, negotiate, and close large-scale partnerships with key donors, CSR heads, and ecosystem actors.
* Deepen relationships with existing donors through strategic stewardship, regular impact updates, and co-creation opportunities.
* Lead donor visits, events, and campaigns to showcase impact and strengthen confidence in RWF’s work.

***4. Donor Relationship Management & Stewardship***

* Oversee the development of high-quality proposals, reports, and communication materials tailored to donor priorities.
* Ensure timely compliance with donor reporting requirements and demonstrate measurable outcomes.
* Design donor engagement frameworks that ensure consistency, personalization, and long-term trust.
* Strengthen the donor CRM and knowledge management systems to enhance visibility and accountability.

***5. Strategic Collaboration & Organizational Leadership***

* Partner with program and policy teams to design fundable initiatives and ensure donor priorities align with on-ground realities.
* Provide market intelligence and donor insights to inform organizational strategy.
* Mentor and build capacity within the fundraising team, enabling them to deliver on ambitious targets.
* Play a leadership role in external forums, representing RWF’s thought leadership on social policy and fundraising innovation.

***Who Will Thrive in This Role? -***
You’ll love this role (and we’ll love working with you) if:

* Bring 10+ years of fundraising experience, including 5–7 years in the development sector.
* Hold a full-time Master’s degree in Social Sciences, Management, or Social Work (Premier B-School preferred).
* Have strong knowledge of the social sector landscape, fundraising best practices, and donor ecosystems.
* Excel at proposal writing, donor communication, and pitching.
* Demonstrate strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, and are willing to travel for donor engagements.
* Are self-motivated, results-driven, and able to balance strategy with hands-on execution.
* Have proficiency in MS Office Suite, Canva, Salesforce for Nonprofits (or equivalent), with attention to detail and design aesthetics.
* At RightWalk, thriving also means embodying our core values every day
* **Integrity & Ethics:**
  Do what’s right, always.
* **Ownership & Excellence:**
  Take full charge, no excuses.
* **Resilience & Audacity:**
  Be fearless, even when it’s hard.
* **Empathy & End-User First:**
  Listen, understand, and design what matters most.
* **Helicopter Mindset:**
  Zoom out to think big, zoom in to deliver relentlessly.

title: Learning Diversity Teacher
description:
Posted: 16/10/2026
  
  
Closing Date: 30/10/2026
  
  
Job Type: Full Time - Fixed Term
  
  
Location: Macleod – University Campus
  
  
Job Category: Academic
  
  
**Job Description**
A school is built on the strength of its people.
  
  
Great people make great schools. People create culture.
  
  
At Ivanhoe Grammar School, our people create a culture of belonging. A place where ideas are heard and supported. Where you are encouraged to try something new. A place to feel included and valued. Ivanhoe Grammar School is a values-driven, co-educational independent school with a commitment to fostering a community where students, teachers and professional services staff can continually become the best version of themselves. At Ivanhoe Grammar School, we are always looking for great people to join our team. We are always seeking people who are energetic, collaborative and courageous.
  
  
**Seeking a Learning Diversity Teacher**
The Learning Diversity Teacher is a member of the Academic Staff based at our University Campus, Macleod. This role plays an integral part in supporting the intellectual, social, emotional and personal development of students, in line with the School’s commitment to fostering young people of character who give their best to everything they do.
  
  
Working with our Year 9 students, you will contribute to an inclusive, student-centred learning environment where every learner is known, challenged and supported to achieve personal growth.
  
  
This is a full-time, 12-month fixed-term position, commencing in January 2027.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role, you will support students with diverse learning needs to thrive at school. You will work collaboratively with colleagues and families, applying evidence-informed practice and reflective teaching to enable meaningful progress. Your work will model and promote the Ivanhoe Learner attributes – courageous, innovative, balanced, collaborative, ethical, reflective and compassionate – and contribute to a culture where every student feels valued, capable and supported to grow.
  
  
**You Have The Necessary Experience, Knowledge And Skills To**

* Design and deliver targeted intervention programs informed by diagnostic data, school priorities, and student learning profiles
* Use assessments, evidence, and professional judgement to identify learning needs, track growth, and adjust strategies to maximise student progress
* Work collaboratively with Teachers, Heads of Pedagogy, and Curriculum Leaders to co-plan supports that align with curriculum and the instructional model
* Build strong relationships with students and families, providing clear communication, learning updates, and guidance to support progress and wellbeing
* Support student transitions back to full classroom learning and contribute actively to co-curricular and campus life, modelling Ivanhoe’s values and expectations

**Who You Are**
You are a reflective and purposeful educator who believes that learning and character are inseparable. You recognise the potential in every young person and understand that high expectations, strong relationships, and compassionate support create the conditions for students to thrive. You model the Ivanhoe Learner attributes – courageous, balanced, innovative, collaborative, ethical, reflective and compassionate – and you strive to bring them to life in your practice.
  
  
**You Bring**

* Teaching experience within a school setting, with relevant qualifications and expertise in supporting diverse learners; postgraduate study in Special Education, Curriculum or Pedagogy is desirable
* The ability to design and deliver targeted learning support using data, professional judgement and evidence-informed practice
* Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills, with the capacity to build trust, collaborate effectively and engage confidently with students, staff and families
* A demonstrated commitment to child safety, inclusion, and student wellbeing, supported by current VIT registration
* A solutions-focused, growth-oriented mindset and the capacity to uphold high professional standards
* The ability to model and foster a culture of respect, reflection, resilience and responsibility, while supporting others to grow and succeed

**What We Offer You**

* An impactful teaching role embedded in a thriving and values-driven educational community.
* A meaningful opportunity to support secondary learners at our Year 9 Campus, contributing to their academic growth and personal development.
* A collaborative, student-centred team culture where wellbeing is prioritised.
* Opportunities for professional growth through the Ivanhoe Institute and school-led wellbeing programs.
* Beautiful learning environments with access to state-of-the-art facilities, including onsite café, gym and pool.
* Salary packaging, discounted health insurance and school tuition discounts.

**Always seeking great people. Your move.**
Further information can be found by visiting the Ivanhoe Grammar School’s website – Careers - Ivanhoe Grammar School or by viewing the position description - here.
  
  
For a confidential discussion please contact People and Culture via employment@ivanhoe.com.au.
  
  
Applications close
**30 October 2026**
at 5pm.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, as interviews may commence prior to this date.
  
  
Ivanhoe Grammar School is committed to providing a safe and inclusive environment where everyone is welcome to be themselves. We value student safety. All staff are required to adhere to the School’s policies and teachers are required to have a working knowledge and understanding of the Student Wellbeing Policy, the Health and Safety Policy, the Child Safety Code of Conduct and the Respectful Workplace Behaviour Policy.  All successful academic applications will be requested to complete a Summary Document of Relevant Work Experience, evidenced through the submission of Statements of Service.

title: Engineer/ Surveyor
description:
**Engineer/ Surveyor India Sub-Continent**

**Location:**
Delhi, India

**Contract Type:**
Permanent

**Hours:**
Full time, 44 hours per week, Monday to Friday

**Salary:**
171,240 (INR) Gross Pay per month, depending upon experience

**About the CWGC**

The Commonwealth War Graves Commission honours and cares for the people of the Commonwealth forces who died in the First and Second World Wars, ensuring they will never be forgotten. Funded by six Member Governments, our work began with building, and now maintaining, cemeteries at 23,000 locations all over the world.

Today, over a century after we first began, our work continues through our staff, supporters and volunteers who preserve our unique cultural, horticultural and architectural heritage and ensure that the stories of those who died are told.

**What you'll be doing**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Technical/Project Manager (Works) to lead a varied portfolio of estates, infrastructure and maintenance projects across the indian Sub-continent. This is a key role supporting the planning, development and delivery of works that help maintain our sites to the highest standards.

Working closely with operational teams and regional managers, you will oversee projects from survey and planning through to delivery. You will also play an important role in preventative maintenance programmes and construction-related cases across the area.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Undertake structural and property condition surveys and accurately input findings into the CWGC Condition Survey Software.
* Develop a programme of fully costed and internally approved projects, ranging from building refurbishment to heritage structure maintenance, for inclusion in the area’s five-year plan.
* Manage a small team consisting of a Technical Supervisor and manual operatives. Identifying development opportunities, providing clear guidance and supportive leadership.
* Work in partnership with Regional Managers and Contractors to deliver projects in line with the Area Business Plan and Estates Department guidelines.
* Manage all projects using the CWGC Project Management Office System, ensuring effective governance and delivery.
* Prepare and develop works contracts, including FIDIC and small works contracts, in collaboration with the legal team.
* Oversee the Area’s amendments and addenda process, identifying suitable solutions and preparing business cases for proposed works.
* Deliver the area’s planned preventative maintenance programme for all base sites and accommodation, ensuring continued compliance with Commission standards.
* Act as Project Manager for a range of property-related projects, ensuring outcomes meet organisational and stakeholder needs.
* Manage accommodation repairs across ISC, liaising directly with occupants to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and effectively.
* Manage delegated budgets, prepare cost estimates and submit monthly and quarterly expenditure reports as required.
* Work in collaboration with the Health and Safety Advisor to implement health and safety policies, with particular focus on contractor management and the promotion of safe working practices.
* Record and report project-related accidents and near misses, taking appropriate action to manage risk and support Area-wide health and safety compliance.
* Maintain accurate records of all building changes made during projects and provide as-built technical drawings, incorporating any new maintenance requirements into planned preventative maintenance schedules.
* Manage the procurement and installation of headstones and bronze plaques within your area.

**What you need to have**

* A recognised and relevant technical qualification (degree or equivalent).
* Experience (minimum 5 years) of working in a Managerial position.
* High computer literacy including AutoCad, Excel, Word, Outlook
* A qualification or proven training record in building surveying and/or architecture and conservation.
* Experience of working in different cultures, with understanding of cultural and political sensitivities and operations in complex environments.
* A recognised H&S qualification at the level of IOSH Managing Safely standard.
* Practical experience of direct project management (end to end – all phases).
* Experience of managing tendering processes for £50k to 300k range projects.
* Change and performance management at operational level.
* Experience in researching and compiling business case documents in support of project approval and bids for approved funding.
* Thorough knowledge of organisational policies, surveying practices, and a conservation-based approach to management of the Commission’s estate.
* Experience of travelling to remote locations including lone working.

**How to Apply**

If your skills and experience align with this opportunity, we would welcome your application.

Apply via our Career Portal (Engineer/Surveyor ISC at CWGC) by clicking the ‘Apply Now’ button.

As this is an active role, we will be interviewing as we go along, and the role will close when we have an offer accepted by a preferred candidate.

*We believe creating a diverse environment enriches our organisation and strengthens our mission, therefore, we welcome applications from everybody. Join our inclusive environment where every individual is valued.*

title: Transport Planner/Traffic Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a motivated and technically strong Transportation Planner/Traffic Engineer with approximately 4 years of professional experience in transport planning, traffic engineering, and modelling. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Traffic Impact Assessments (TIA), Travel Demand Forecasting, Traffic Simulation Modelling, and Urban Transport Design across residential, commercial, and area development projects.
  
  
The role requires strong analytical capability, proficiency in industry-standard tools, and the ability to independently deliver high-quality outputs while coordinating with multidisciplinary teams. The candidate should demonstrate clear progression in technical skills and project responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Support and deliver a range of transport planning and traffic engineering studies
* Conduct Traffic Impact Assessments (TIA), parking studies, and access/egress analysis for development projects
* Develop travel demand forecasts using appropriate modelling approaches and assumptions
* Build, calibrate, and validate traffic simulation models (micro-level) for urban corridors and developments
* Prepare traffic circulation plans, junction designs, and transport infrastructure layouts
* Contribute to urban transport and area planning studies, including multimodal integration
* Perform data analysis and interpretation to support planning recommendations
* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and client deliverables with high quality and clarity
* Coordinate with team leads, project managers, clients, and reviewers to ensure timely delivery
* Apply best practices and standards in transport planning and modelling
* Work independently on defined tasks while contributing to overall project objectives

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Transportation Planning / Transportation Engineering
* 4 years of relevant experience in transport planning, traffic engineering, and modelling

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
  
  
  

* Strong experience in Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) and transport studies
* Proficiency in AutoCAD for transport layout and design drawings
* Hands-on expertise in PTV VISSIM for traffic microsimulation modelling
* Experience in travel demand forecasting and modelling approaches
* Ability to develop, calibrate, and validate traffic simulation models

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to GIS tools (ArcGIS / QGIS) for spatial analysis
* Familiarity with junction design, road safety, and transport design standards
* Experience with macro-modelling tools such as PTV VISUM / CUBE / EMME
* Understanding of urban transport systems and multimodal planning

**Additional Information**
**Welcome to our Transport division**
Ramboll is a global transportation consultancy, and we work on some of the biggest and most innovative infrastructure projects in the world. We are close to 3,000 bright minds working within Transport worldwide, creating practical, sustainable, and economic solutions for national transport authorities, private contractors, and municipalities alike.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
* A challenging and interesting workday characterized by continuous learning, in an environment where you have many to spar with and learn from.
* Opportunity to work with varied work tasks, across the organization.
* Opportunity to develop and influence your own area of responsibility.

**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.
  
  
**Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do**
We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI

* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.

**Company Description**
Dietician Kajal's Clinic is a nutrition-focused wellness center dedicated to empowering individuals to achieve better health through expert, evidence-based guidance. The clinic offers highly personalized nutrition plans tailored to each client’s specific needs, including weight management, energy enhancement, and targeted support for health conditions. The Clinical Dietitian will provide individualized nutrition assessments, develop evidence-based meal plans, and deliver ongoing nutritional counseling to clients in accordance with their health status and goals. **Data Strategy:**
Develop and implement a comprehensive data strategy aligned with the organization's social development goals. This includes defining data governance standards, data collection and analysis methodologies, and data storage and security protocols.

* Develop and implement systems for tracking and reporting on key data metrics.
* Provide regular updates to leadership on the status & performance of data management systems.

**Data Management Systems:**

* Work closely with the Policy Research & Advocacy team to understand data requirements for effective policy development.

**Data Privacy and Security:**
Oversee data privacy & security measures, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA). Implement robust data protection protocols and ensure staff adherence.

* Implement data security protocols to safeguard sensitive information.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and ethical guidelines.
* Develop disaster recovery and business continuity plans.

**Technology Innovations, Partnerships, Continuous Improvement:**

* Collaborate with external partners, vendors, and experts to leverage technology solutions and best practices to enhance the organization's impact.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Policy Research & Advocacy & IT to ensure seamless integration of data systems with organizational processes.

**Qualifications:**

* Post-graduate degree in social sciences, management, Technology, computer science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of data governance, data privacy regulations & data security best practices.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and platforms. Experience with qualitative & quantitative data collection & analysis using packages like DHIS, ONA, GBVIMS, SPSS, MS-Excel, MS-Word, MS-Access, Tableau, etc.

title: State Consultant – Comprehensive Skills, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, 20 Months, Remotely (Open for Indian Nationals and Resident of Bhopal) Req#596373
description:
Contract Duration: 20 Months
  
  
Working arrangement:
*Homebased*
UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.
  
  
At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.
  
  
UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.
  
  
Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.
  
  
**For every child, the right to Education.**
**How can you make a difference?**
The purpose of this assignment is to provide technical support to the Education Department of Madhya Pradesh to roll out the comprehensive skills package with adolescents in the state. This includes working closely with the government, and other stakeholders in the eco-system, and ensure effective data collection and reporting as per requirements. The consultant is expected to be based in Bhopal and regularly engage with UNICEF and the government.
  
  
**Background and Rationale**
Madhya Pradesh’s adolescent education landscape analysis reveals challenges and opportunities to improve the learning outcomes of children in the state.and this evidence underscores the urgency of embedding 21st-century skills into Madhya Pradesh’s education system. Critical thinking, digital literacy, financial capability, creativity, and resilience are not optional—they are essential competencies for adolescents to thrive in higher education, the labor market, and civic life. For girls and marginalized groups, these skills are particularly vital to overcome structural barriers and participate meaningfully in India’s modernizing economy.
  
  
By integrating these competencies into curricula, pedagogy, and assessment, Madhya Pradesh can transform its demographic dividend into inclusive growth. Equipping adolescents with future ready skills will strengthen human capital, foster innovation, and ensure that every young learner contributes to building a resilient and equitable society.
  
  
Madhya Pradesh’s vision for Viksit Madhya Pradesh 2047 seeks to transform its economy from USD 197 billion in 2025 to USD 4.3 trillion by 2047, powered by youth and women through skills, entrepreneurship, and leadership. Central to this ambition is a globally competitive, inclusive, and technology-driven education system where AI-enabled classrooms, immersive digital content, and adaptive assessments redefine learning outcomes.
  
  
Aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, education must nurture values, character, and essential 21st Century skills—critical thinking, creativity, adaptability, and collaboration. For adolescents in Grades 9–12, this stage is decisive as they prepare for higher education, employment, and citizenship. Yet, while subject knowledge is taught effectively, students often struggle to apply concepts in real-world contexts, making the bridge between classroom learning and practical application essential. UNICEF Madhya Pradesh proposes an integrated intervention with three outputs: a co-created skills framework to support school-to-work transitions; strengthened teacher quality through targeted capacity building; and improved student proficiency in foundational, transferable life skills, digital literacy, and financial awareness. Embedding ICT and AI into daily teaching ensures blended learning, personalized support, and data-driven assessments. Integrated within government systems, this approach reinforces policy alignment rather than creating parallel structures.
  
  
**Skills**
The comprehensive skills package will have a blended learning approach combining the immediate support of interactive classroom with flexibility of digital learning for continuous reinforcement:
  
  

* Interactive sessions: Teacher-led, simple activity-based methods supported by structured lesson plans
* Self-paced digital learning: Curated course on Diksha/YouTube allowing students to learn concepts at their own pace and revise topics as needed.
* Service based learning: Self-learning (project based) helping students strengthen skills in real life

Through this vision, schools will evolve into hubs of innovation, teachers will become facilitators of holistic growth, and students will emerge as adaptable, creative, and productive citizens—laying the foundation for Madhya Pradesh’s long term economic and social aspirations.
  
  
Key Objectives of the Assignment
  
  
The consultant, while working closely with government institutions, will provide technical support for the integration of the comprehensive skills package into the secondary education system.
  
  
More specifically, they will provide support in the following areas:
  
  

* Contextualization of comprehensive skills package (including service-based learning component)
* Development of a capacity building plan for education functionaries including teachers, and facilitate its implementation
* Logistics support for printing and distribution of learning materials
* Formation and strengthening of state and district PMUs to guide programme implementation including coordination support for research

If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here:Terms of Reference TMC0006907.pdf
  
  
***To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have...***
**Education**
***Minimum requirements:***
Post-graduate degree in Education/ Social Sciences/ Humanities/ Policy
  
  
**Work Experience**

* At least 5 years’ experience of work in education sector with at least some of those for 21st century skills development
* Previous experience of working with education data - data analysis & report writing
* Experience of working with Education Government system.
* Expertise in using MS-Office application software (MS Word, Excel, Power Point) essential, especially Excel.
* Previous experience of working with the government administration

**Location required:**
To be based in Bhopal for the assignment. Candidates who are not residents of Bhopal but are willing to relocate to Bhopal for this consultancy will need to do so on their own expense.
  
  
**Language Requirements**
Good verbal and written communication skills in Hindi and English required
  
  
**Knowledge/Expertise/Skills**

* Ability to analyze data, identify bottlenecks to improve systems and provide recommendations
* Ability to liaison and advocate with state & district level government officers
* Ability to create a database to address contextual needs
* Ability to organize, manage and participate within teams

**Desirables**

* Previous experience of implementation of large-scale programmes with government desirable

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
  
  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  
  
You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
  
  
*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Familiarity with AI-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Copado, Gearset, Git-based deployment workflows, or similar tools

Success Measures

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description:
**Your Role**

This is an exciting, high-growth opportunity for a NOC Engineer to solve real-world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. Reporting to the Network Operations Centre Manager, this role will be responsible for resolving technical network issues, thinking creatively to identify and implement solutions, and delivering exceptional support experiences to customers. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values innovation, reliability, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for an experienced engineer looking to advance their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a NOC Engineer, part of your focus will be on efficiently diagnosing and resolving network incidents and customer-escalated issues through tickets, delivering technical solutions. This role plays a vital part in maintaining the stability of Megaport’s production network, ensuring uptime and performance and resolving complex network incidents. Leveraging your deep technical knowledge, you’ll assist in resolving escalated cases and critical alerts, collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions for complex scenarios. Additionally, you’ll contribute to the creation and maintenance of comprehensive documentation, helping to enhance team knowledge, processes, and overall service quality.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Technical Expertise & Problem Resolution**

* Diagnose and resolve complex network and customer issues across all company products and services, using a variety of monitoring tools.
* Perform remote troubleshooting sessions to resolve network issues efficiently.
* Plan, process, manage and implement network changes prescribed by Megaport Engineering and third-party suppliers.
* Provide advanced technical solutions and ensure the timely resolution of escalated tickets and alerts.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to root cause analysis and long-term preventive solutions.
* Escalate cases to the Level 3 engineering team when necessary, ensuring smooth handover and communication.

**Customer Support & Service Excellence**

* Provide escalation support for Technical Support Engineers and other internal business units, ensuring customer issues are responded to quickly and accurately.
* Collaborate with Technical Support Engineers and key business units to ensure high-level customer service, including the provision of accurate and detailed information.
* Proactively communicate incidents to internal and external stakeholders, including direct contact with customers/end users.

**Collaboration & Cross-Functional Work**

* Collaborate closely with global teams to ensure seamless support across regions and organisation-wide integration.
* Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve complex network issues.
* Contribute to projects alongside technical responsibilities, ensuring smooth collaboration and project execution.
* Ensure team coverage during staffing shortages and rotate through scheduled shifts to maintain continuous global support.

**Leadership, Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing**

* Contribute to internal knowledge management by maintaining and improving documentation.
* Support continuous learning and team development by sharing insights, training materials, and innovative troubleshooting techniques.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Networking, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in network support or infrastructure (ISP, cloud or data centre environments)
* CCNA or JNCIA certification (or equivalent) required.
* Strong proficiency with networking protocols such as MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Deep understanding of network infrastructure, including IP configurations, VLANs, MAC address management, switching, routing, and optical networking.
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, OpenGear and similar platforms).
* Proficiency with relevant software tools and systems used in technical support and network operations.

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams while also working independently when required.
* Team-oriented mindset with a focus on cooperation, mutual support, and shared success.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues across regions.

**Personal Attributes**

* Detail-oriented, organised, and committed to delivering high-quality results.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced technical environment.
* Eager to learn, adapt, and contribute to continuous improvement and innovation within the support organisation.

**You will be happy at Megaport if you:**

* Want to be part of a company that’s transforming the global network services landscape and driving innovation in connectivity, speed, and infrastructure.
* Take pride in making a tangible impact—ensuring seamless installations, rapid issue resolution, and optimised support operations that keep customers connected.
* Thrive on solving complex technical problems, using advanced troubleshooting skills and clear communication to deliver swift, effective solutions.
* Enjoy variety in your work—from hands-on technical problem-solving and mentoring team members to contributing to projects, documentation, and process improvement.
* Are excited to dive deep into advanced networking systems, monitor performance, and maintain uninterrupted service delivery in a dynamic tech environment.
* Value working closely with diverse global teams, fostering collaboration and clear communication across regions and time zones.
* Embrace a flexible work schedule across multiple shifts and find satisfaction in ensuring continuous, reliable customer support around the clock.

**Working Conditions, Location and Hours**

* **Office-based role:**
  Sector 26, Gurgaon Delhi, Gurugram, Haryana
* **Schedule:**
  8.5 hours per shift
* You will be scheduled to work on weekends, public holiday and night shifts in a rotating cycle
* Working visits to the Locations which are under your responsibility for meeting partners, vendors, team, checking the quality of the network
* 90-day notice period for resignation after the trial period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies.

**What We Offer**

* \*Subject to the internal policies of Megaport, which may be updated from time to time\*:
* Family health insurance according to complany policy
* A motivated team combining industry experts and emerging talent.
* Recognition programs – including Legend and Kudos Awards.

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com

If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".***

*All applications will be treated in confidence.*

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**About The Role**

**.**
As a DevSecOps Engineer at Payoneer, you’ll play a critical role in embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You’ll help design, implement, and maintain security controls and automations across our CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, and application stack.

* SAST (e.g., SonarQube)

* Strong troubleshooting skills
* Proactive by nature; internal drive for excellence and improvement

**Not a must but a great advantage**

* Experience with relational and non-relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL, MongoDB) Experience with software development and development frameworks
* Experience with event streaming and messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ
* Knowledge and understanding Storage and Networking

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

title: Support Engineer - Level 1
description:
**Your Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Support Engineer (L1) to solve real-world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. In this role, you’ll be the first line of response to customer-reported issues, taking ownership of tickets, performing essential diagnostics, and delivering exceptional support experiences. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values reliability, proactive monitoring, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for a motivated engineer looking to build their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a Support Engineer (L1), your primary responsibility involves efficiently addressing customer concerns communicated through tickets, live chat, and calls, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and resolve issues promptly. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for the proactive monitoring of our systems and services to identify and rectify potential problems before they impact operations. When faced with complex or high-severity issues, you will gather essential diagnostics and seek guidance from Senior Support Engineers to ensure swift and accurate escalations. Your consistent presence across our shift rotations, ensuring coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, underlines our commitment to providing uninterrupted support and maintaining operational continuity at all times.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Customer Support & Service Excellence**
* Deliver exceptional technical support and customer service via phone, email, and live chat. Process incoming customer calls promptly following ticket submissions to clarify issues, address queries, and ensure accurate understanding.
* Skillfully assess and prioritize tickets based on urgency and operational impact, ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction by resolving issues at the first point of contact whenever possible and keeping customers informed throughout the process.
* Meet or exceed defined KPIs and SLAs while adhering to established operating procedures and policies.
* Strive to independently resolve customer concerns at the first point of contact, escalating complex technical issues to Senior Support Engineers (L2) only when appropriate.
* Manage escalations between global teams (e.g., acting as a bridge between regional support teams) to ensure seamless communication and timely resolution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customers’ services or improve their overall experience.
* **Service Monitoring & Incident Response**
* Proactively monitor company services, network ports, and peering platforms using alerting and incident response tools to ensure high availability and stability.
* Process alert logs, detect anomalies, and take immediate corrective measures, including opening vendor or customer tickets when necessary.
* Perform system initialization post-server reboots, verifying that traffic restores to pre-reboot baselines and escalating timely if performance inconsistencies occur.
* Create and update detailed incident reports, maintaining accurate, real-time updates on status pages for customer transparency.
* Regularly monitor aggregated content and performance graphs to track trends and identify potential service degradation.
* Process maintenance notifications (internal and external).
* **Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to building and maintaining an integrated internal knowledge base by documenting known issues, standard operating procedures, and basic troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for designs, configurations, known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and post-incident learnings to enable repeatable outcomes and team uplift.
* Learn and adopt new systems, monitoring applications, and support tools introduced across integrated global operations.

**Your Success Metrics**

* **Installation Efficiency & Quality**
* Track the number, timeliness, and success rate of service installations.
* Maintain a high first-time success rate, minimising rework or follow-up visits.
* Collect and analyse customer feedback post-installation to gauge satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
* **Ticket & Alert Resolution Performance**
* Achieve a high percentage of received tickets and alerts resolved without further escalation.
* Achieve a strong First Time Resolution rate.
* Ensure essential diagnostic checks and detailed internal notes are completed for 100% of handled tickets within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure that all issues undergo thorough diagnostic checks before being resolved or escalated.
* Maintain strong adherence to KPIs and SLAs for response and resolution times.
* Quickly prioritize, categorize, and process monitoring alerts within target timelines, ensuring service-impacting events are properly communicated and documented.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in incident reports and status page updates to ensure full transparency for customers and internal teams.
* Aim for high first-contact resolution and reduced case reopen rates.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong foundational understanding of network infrastructure and protocols, including LAN/WAN fundamentals (Ethernet, switches, VLANs, IP addressing, ASN, prefixes, and BGP basics).
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, MikroTik, and similar platforms).
* Good understanding of networking protocols, including MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Familiarity with network hardware platforms and tools used in technical support and network monitoring operations.
* Proven experience in logical troubleshooting and resolving networking issues (minimum of three years).

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams while also working independently when required.
* Team-oriented mindset with a focus on cooperation, mutual support, and shared success.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues across regions.

**Personal Attributes**

* Detail-oriented, organised, and committed to delivering high-quality results.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced technical environment.
* High flexibility and readiness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment (including night shifts and weekends).

**Working Hours**

* **Office-based role:**
  Sector 26, Gurgaon Delhi, Gurugram, Haryana
* **Schedule:**
  8.5 hours per shift
* You will be scheduled to work on weekends, public holiday and night shifts in a rotating cycle
* Working visits to the Locations which are under your responsibility for meeting partners, vendors, team, checking the quality of the network
* 90-day notice period for resignation after the trial period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies.

**What We Offer**

* \*Subject to the internal policies of Megaport, which may be updated from time to time\*:
* Family health insurance according to complany policy
* A motivated team combining industry experts and emerging talent.
* Recognition programs – including Legend and Kudos Awards.

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com

**NOTE:
*All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".***

title: Staff IAM Engineer
description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.
  
  
Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.
  
  
At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
Senior Manager - AI & IT
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  
ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
  
  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
