title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
To realize our digital transformation, we need to transform our products, experiences, processes, technology and how we operate. Delivering our clients unrivalled experience of exceptional service, value and flexibility is part of our DNA. We are looking for people who are passionate about Agile ways of working and want to spread this approach within our teams and business processes.
  
  
As we advance our digital transformation initiatives, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to lead multiple strategic projects. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to oversee the development, configuration, and maintenance of our digital products, ensuring alignment with market trends and business needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the rollout of the Smart Booking platforms/offering to BCG offices worldwide, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption.
* Maintain and manage upgrades and enhancements to the Smart Booking platforms, ensuring their capabilities are fully leveraged within our spaces.
* Evaluate Smart Office related digital products to ensure they align with market trends and business requirements.
* Facilitate stakeholder discovery for feature definition, serving as a liaison between the IT squad and stakeholders.
* Ensure epics and user stories are prioritized, updated, and available for execution.
* Write user stories and conduct refinement sessions to ensure they meet team standards and acceptance criteria.
* Support business stakeholders in eliciting business and non-functional requirements, perform gap analysis and feasibility checks, and collaborate on comprehensive test plans.
* Provide end-user support, troubleshoot issues, and answer questions.
* Utilize tools (e.g., SaaS products, SQL, Snowflake, Alteryx, Tableau) to maintain system configurations, access data, develop logic, and analyze datasets to meet stakeholder needs.
* Leverage automation tools like Python, MS Forms, Workflows in Alteryx, and PowerShell to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop and implement automation scripts and workflows to improve system operations.
* Deliver AI-augmented SaaS capabilities using LLMs and Agentic AI.
* Automate workflows with Power Automate and integrate SaaS applications, APIs, and data sources.
* Work with REST APIs and MCP servers for secure AI and enterprise integrations.
* Build dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, ServiceNow, Jira, and Trello.
* Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer service orientation with a diverse group of stakeholders.
* Ability to balance customer needs with functional goals and objectives.
* Proficiency in cross-team collaboration to resolve challenges.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities based on customer needs.
* Experience coordinating and implementing digital solutions in a complex organizational environment.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS applications, including system configuration and integration.
* Experience working with cloud-based software and APIs.
* Working knowledge of security, access management, and data privacy for SaaS and AI solutions.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a role supporting digital products, preferably in an analyst or engineering role.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Directly interact with the Director & Chapter Lead and peers within the Product Portfolio.
* Collaborate with every member of your squad, including Product Owners, Scrum Leads, Software Engineers, and QA Engineers, as well as internal customers and technical members from other Product Portfolios.

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Proactively monitoring and resolving issues, effectively communicating with key stakeholders and management.
* Leading with a strategic vision while managing technical challenges, ensuring detailed and effective execution.
* Identifying and solving non-routine problems independently, applying broad knowledge to troubleshoot system issues.
* Translating business needs into clear, actionable Agile user stories.
* Gaining a deep understanding of digital products to serve as a subject matter expert.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in the smart booking space to ensure our product portfolio aligns with market demands.
* Understanding IT architecture and effectively extracting and analyzing data across business systems.
* Organizing and presenting data to enable quick, informed decision-making.
* Prioritizing tasks and working independently, while communicating clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Managing multiple complex tasks with high-quality results within deadlines.
* Applying Agile methodologies and principles, including work estimation techniques.
* Quickly learning and adapting to new tools and technologies.
* Collaborating with multicultural, distributed teams across time zones and managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Stay current with trends in Smart Booking, SaaS, AI, automation, APIs, and data visualization.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

title: Team Lead - Backup Simple
description:

Do you enjoy combining deep backup expertise with team leadership, service excellence, and customer success?

Are you looking for an opportunity to lead a global support team while driving continuous improvement across backup and recovery services?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations secure, protect, and optimize their technology environments through expert managed services and technical support. We are looking for a Team Lead – Backup Services (Commvault) to lead a global team supporting backup and recovery solutions while ensuring exceptional customer experiences, operational excellence, and technical quality.

As the Team Lead – Backup Services, you will be responsible for the day-to-day leadership of a technical support team focused on Commvault backup solutions. You will act as the primary escalation point for critical incidents, mentor team members, drive service improvements, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality support to customers across multiple regions and time zones.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Leading and supporting a team of backup specialists, ensuring high levels of service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
* Acting as the primary escalation point for complex or high-priority backup and recovery incidents, driving issues through to resolution.
* Conducting quality reviews, coaching sessions, and regular team engagement activities to support continuous development and performance growth.
* Monitoring service delivery metrics, incident trends, SLA achievement, and operational performance while driving service improvement initiatives.
* Coordinating shift coverage, stakeholder communication, vendor engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to support global customer operations.
* Providing leadership for major incident management, root cause analysis activities, process improvements, and technical knowledge sharing.

**Job Requirements**

* Experience leading, mentoring, or supervising technical support teams within backup, infrastructure, storage, or managed services environments.
* Strong expertise in Commvault backup and recovery solutions, including administration, troubleshooting, configuration, and operational support.
* Knowledge of backup infrastructure concepts including disaster recovery, storage systems, deduplication, retention management, and cloud backup targets.
* Experience managing major incidents, escalations, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.
* Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with the ability to engage customers, vendors, and technical teams.

title: L4- Product Support Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, delivering innovative solutions that ensure
*Life Is On*
for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for
**EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)**
—a cloud-connected, nextgeneration building automation platform used worldwide.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled
**L4 Product Support Engineer**
to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Level 4 Product Support Engineer provides expert-level technical support, advanced troubleshooting, and system-level diagnostics for complex issues that go beyond the scope of L3 support. This role serves as the technical escalation point for global support teams, partners, and country front-office engineers.
  
  
You will work closely with R&D, QA, product management, and field teams to analyze defects, replicate issues, propose corrective actions, and contribute to long-term product improvements. This role requires strong system thinking, analytical depth, and the ability to investigate issues spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile components.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile platforms.
* Analyze logs, traces, network captures, system metrics, and API interactions to identify root causes.
* Reproduce field issues in lab environments to validate hypotheses and support engineering teams.
* Own critical escalations from L3 teams, ensuring timely and high-quality resolution.
* Provide RCA documentation, corrective action proposals, and long-term recommendations.

**System-Level Analysis & Integration Support**

* Perform deep-dive analysis of EBA system architecture, including controllers, gateways, cloud components, and mobile workflows.
* Support integration efforts across different layers of the EBA platform and its external integrations.
* Validate end-to-end workflows to ensure subsystem interoperability and performance.
* Troubleshoot integration protocols such as BACnet, Modbus on the edge side and MQTT, REST APIs, HTTPS, and other IoT communication layers for the cloud communication
* Identify system bottlenecks, performance issues, and configuration defects.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing**

* Serve as the bridge between field support teams and R&D engineering groups.
* Provide detailed field insights to influence product roadmaps and design decisions.
* Document troubleshooting guides, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Deliver post-escalation briefings and contribute to continuous improvement loops.
* Mentor L3 engineers and help elevate the technical competence of the product support team.

**Support for Senior L4 Initiatives**

* Contribute to product quality improvement initiatives, including failure mode analysis and test coverage enhancements.
* Participate in cross-functional reviews, defect triages, and technical deep-dive sessions.
* Support the development of troubleshooting tools, diagnostic frameworks, and automation scripts.
* Recommend improvements in escalation workflows, documentation structure, and customer experience practices.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in system-level troubleshooting, advanced technical support, or product integration roles.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with experience diagnosing complex behaviours across distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with building automation, HVAC systems, IoT devices, or industrial automation platforms.
* Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation, data extraction, and analysis.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux fundamentals, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, certificates), and API-level debugging.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with HVAC systems and building controls.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Grafana, and Jenkins.
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, analyzers).
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and collaborative workflows.
* Experience working in global, multiregional support environments.

* Deliver timely and effective resolution of escalated critical issues within defined SLAs.

title: IT Engineer II, ITSE Solutions
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

title: Terminal Bench Specialist

description:

* Basic knowledge of IT systems, troubleshooting steps, or technical support processes is an advantage.
* Relevant diploma or degree in engineering, technology, or a related field is beneficial.
* Willingness to learn new tools and procedures and adapt to evolving project requirements.

title: IT Operations Assoc Manager - Digital Transformation (Supply Chain)
description:
**Overview**
The primary objective of this role is to enable, optimize, and digitally transform the end-to-end supply chain by designing, delivering, and sustaining technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, service levels, cost performance, and business agility.
  
  
The role acts as a strategic partner to Supply Chain functions—
**Planning, Procurement, Agro, Manufacturing, EHS, Quality, Warehousing, Logistics, and Customer Service**
—to ensure technology investments drive tangible business outcomes.
  
  
The purpose and scope of the role is to:
  
  

* Align Supply Chain business needs with digital & IT capabilities by deeply understanding functional processes and pain points.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives that leverage automation, analytics, AI/ML, and integrated platforms to modernize supply chain operations.
* Ensure seamless orchestration of systems and data across multiple functions and partners to support real-time visibility and decision-making.
* Serve as the bridge between business teams and technical teams, enabling solutions that are technically robust, scalable, secure, reasonable in cost and deliver the intended value.
* Enable continuous improvement and adoption, ensuring that solutions are effectively utilized and continually enhanced to meet evolving business needs.
* Engage cross-functional teams including Finance/Controls, Sales, R&D, Engineering and other external supply chain partners to ensure seamless integration of IT capabilities with business processes.

**Responsibilities**
**Business Engagement & Requirement Management**

* Act as the primary IT partner for Supply Chain teams across Planning, Manufacturing, Agro, Procurement, Logistics, Warehousing, and Customer Service.
* Proactively identify digital opportunities and pain points by engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
* Gather, validate, and translate functional requirements into clear solution specifications.
* Ensure alignment of all initiatives with supply chain strategy and enterprise architecture.

**Solution Design & Functional Leadership**

* Lead functional solution design for key Supply Chain processes (e.g. transportation, logistics, warehousing, Agro etc)
* Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions based on fit, scalability, cost, and integration needs.
* Set up and actively lead design workshops, process mapping sessions, and blueprint creation.
* Ensure data, process, and integration consistency across applications.

**Project & Program Delivery**

* End-to-end ownership of digital initiatives, including planning, vendor coordination, execution, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Drive cross-functional teams to meet timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* Conduct and coordinate for UAT (user acceptance test) cycles, ensuring scenarios reflect true operational needs.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.

**Stakeholder Communication & Change Management**

* Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and decisions needed.
* Prepare communication materials, training documentation, and user onboarding content.
* Foster a culture of digital adoption, helping users confidently leverage new tools and systems.

**Data & Analytics Enablement**

* Support accurate and timely data flows across systems.
* Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver dashboards, KPIs, and predictive insights.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and integration integrity across supply chain applications.

**Value Delivery & Performance Tracking**

* Track benefits realization of IT investments (cost savings, service improvements, automation benefits).
* Ensure digital initiatives directly support supply chain KPIs
* Present performance insights and improvement opportunities to leadership teams.

**Continuous Improvement & Digital Optimization**

* Identify automation, simplification, and digitization opportunities across supply chain processes.
* Lead process improvement initiatives using analytics and automation.
* Influence adoption through training, communication, and capability-building interventions.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure solutions follow IT and cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and audit guidelines.
* Maintain strong controls around change management, access management, and data protection.
* Represent Supply Chain IT in governance forums and architecture councils.

**Application Operations & Support**

* Ensure day-to-day stability, performance, and availability of supply chain applications.
* Act as the escalation point for high-priority incidents and coordinate resolution with support teams.
* Drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes to minimize repeated issues.
* Maintain system documentation, SOPs, and configuration records.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Coordinate with technology vendors, implementation partners, and managed service teams.
* Evaluate vendor deliverables, quality, SLAs, and compliance.
* Ensure external partners understand business context and deliver solutions aligned with expectations.

**Qualifications**
**Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Masters in Business Management
* 10–12 years of experience in Supply Chain IT, Digital, or Business-facing roles through Consulting assignments.
* Experience delivering or supporting large-scale digital transformation programs in FMCG or related industries.
* Proven experience in multi-stakeholder, cross-functional environments.
* Exposure to global or multi-market operations

**Technical & Systems Knowledge**

* Advanced Planning Systems (e.g. APO, Blue Yonder)
* WMS/TMS solutions (e.g. Blue Yonder, SAP EWM/TM)
* Control Tower platforms
* ERP (SAP ECC/S4HANA – core MM, PP, SD modules)
* Understanding of integration technologies (APIs, EDI, IDocs, event-driven platforms).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure) and their use in enterprise applications.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Support security audits by providing patching evidence, remediation documentation, and compliance reports.
* Identify systems that are non-compliant, unsupported, or approaching end of life and develop remediation plans.
* Manage patching exceptions, risk assessments, and remediation timelines in coordination with cybersecurity and risk teams.
* Drive improvements in patch coverage, patch success rates, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and overall security posture.

**Infrastructure Support & Incident Management**

* Provide advanced L2/L3 technical support for Linux, Windows, VMware, and infrastructure patching platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex operating system, patching, application compatibility, performance, and availability issues.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Investigate infrastructure incidents caused by failed patches, operating system updates, configuration changes, or security remediation.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, security, and infrastructure engineering teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
* Perform proactive infrastructure health checks, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Support production change implementation, maintenance activities, and emergency security patch deployments.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, patching procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
* Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities to ensure critical infrastructure availability.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 7 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Platform Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**

Microsoft Intune

NA

15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Senior Intune/MECM Administrator, a typical day involves managing and supporting Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enterprise environments. The role includes administering endpoint enrollment, device compliance, configuration profiles, application deployments, Windows Autopilot, patch management, Windows servicing, and co-management capabilities. The administrator provides advanced 3rd-line technical support, owns EUC incidents and problems through resolution, and works closely with internal teams and third-party vendors to troubleshoot complex endpoint issues. The role also involves supporting Modern Workplace initiatives, contributing to migration and transformation projects, developing technical documentation, and providing advisory support to customers on endpoint management and security strategies.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Expected to perform independently and become an SME in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM technologies.
  
  
Own and manage EUC incidents and problems, providing 3rd-line technical support through successful resolution.
  
  
Administer and support Microsoft Intune infrastructure, endpoint enrollment, device compliance, configuration policies, and application management.
  
  
Manage Windows Autopilot, Auto-Enrollment, Hybrid Azure AD Join, co-management, and modern endpoint provisioning solutions.
  
  
Administer MECM/SCCM infrastructure, including Distribution Points, Management Points, SUP, WSUS, collections, applications, packages, task sequences, and client health.
  
  
Manage software updates, patch deployment, Windows servicing, OSD, and application deployments across enterprise endpoints.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows client, enrollment, application, policy, and compliance issues using appropriate logs and diagnostic tools.
  
  
Configure and maintain device compliance policies, configuration profiles, security policies, VPN, Wi-Fi, email, device restrictions, and custom scripts.
  
  
Support Conditional Access, DLP, Exchange integration, certificate-based authentication, NDES, and SCEP deployments.
  
  
Manage application deployment across Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS platforms using appropriate application formats and deployment methods.
  
  
Collaborate with Microsoft and third-party vendors for advanced troubleshooting, escalation management, and resolution of critical incidents.
  
  
Support Modern Workplace initiatives by providing technical advisory services, migration roadmaps, business cases, and implementation strategies.
  
  
Contribute to Intune/MECM transformation, migration, upgrade, and co-management projects.
  
  
Collaborate with project, security, infrastructure, and service management teams to ensure successful delivery of endpoint management solutions.
  
  
Participate in team discussions and contribute to technical solutions for complex operational and project-related challenges.
  
  
Create and maintain SOPs, RACI matrices, SRTs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and KT materials.
  
  
Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to junior team members and offshore/nearshore delivery teams.
  
  
Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders in a large, matrixed organization.
  
  
Ensure endpoint solutions meet organizational security, compliance, availability, performance, and operational requirements.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills
  
  
Must To Have Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM.
  
  
Strong experience with Windows Autopilot, device enrollment, Auto-Enrollment, Hybrid Azure AD Join, and endpoint lifecycle management.
  
  
Strong understanding of Intune Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies, Device Restrictions, Security Policies, Custom Scripts, and Remediation.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Intune application deployment for Win32, MSI, EXE, APPX, APPXBUNDLE, LOB, PKG, IPA, and APK applications.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Conditional Access, DLP, Exchange integration, device compliance, and endpoint security.
  
  
Experience with Intune and SCCM co-management and dual-management environments.
  
  
Strong MECM/SCCM experience including Collections, Application Deployment, Packages, Task Sequences, OSD, Software Updates, SUP, WSUS, DP, MP, and client troubleshooting.
  
  
Experience in SCCM infrastructure administration, upgrades, migration, Current Branch/CU maintenance, and endpoint management.
  
  
Strong understanding of Windows patch management, servicing, software update deployment, and update channel management.
  
  
Experience with Windows Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, certificate management, and Windows Server technologies.
  
  
Hands-on experience configuring VPN, Wi-Fi, email, domain join, and other endpoint configuration profiles.
  
  
Knowledge of NDES and SCEP-based certificate deployment using Microsoft Intune.
  
  
Experience managing iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS device enrollment, compliance, retirement, and wipe processes.
  
  
Familiarity with MDT and Windows image management.
  
  
Good understanding of Azure Virtual Desktop/VDI environments and integration with VMware Horizon or similar technologies.
  
  
Exposure to third-party endpoint management and security integrations such as Jamf, TeamViewer, Nexthink, and related solutions.
  
  
Strong troubleshooting, log analysis, problem-solving, customer handling, and communication skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and make sound technical decisions.
  
  
Ability to engage with customers in an advisory capacity and translate business requirements into technical endpoint-management solutions.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
The candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Management technologies.
  
  
The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM administration.
  
  
Experience supporting medium to large enterprise or global endpoint management environments is preferred.
  
  
Experience working with global customers and distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore teams is an advantage.
  
  
Experience in Modern Workplace transformation, endpoint migration, and co-management projects is preferred.
  
  
Experience with MDT, Nexthink, Jamf, or other EMM/endpoint management solutions is an added advantage.
  
  
A Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
  
  
Experience providing voice-based technical support and handling high-priority customer situations is desirable.

title: Microsurfacing, Rut Filling, Micro Milling and Pavement Maintenance
description:
**Company Description**
Innovative Roadztech Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure services company specializing in advanced pavement maintenance solutions, including microsurfacing, rut filling, micro milling, and related road rehabilitation works. Based in Delhi, India, the company focuses on extending road life, improving driving safety, and delivering cost-effective treatments for urban and highway networks. Innovative Roadztech works with public and private sector clients to provide reliable, technically sound services that meet modern standards of quality and durability. Team members collaborate on projects that directly impact road performance, community mobility, and long-term asset management.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India, focused on microsurfacing, rut filling, micro milling, and pavement maintenance operations. The role involves participating in daily site activities such as surface preparation, operation and monitoring of specialized paving and milling equipment, material handling, and application of pavement treatments according to project specifications and safety standards. Responsibilities include supporting site planning, coordinating with supervisors and crew members, ensuring proper calibration and use of machines, and assisting with quality checks, measurements, and documentation. The role also requires adherence to safety protocols, basic equipment upkeep, and clear communication with project managers and client representatives to ensure timely and efficient completion of work.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Hands-on experience or strong interest in road construction, pavement maintenance, or civil works, particularly in microsurfacing, rut filling, and micro milling.
* Familiarity with operating or assisting in the operation of road maintenance machinery and tools, with attention to safety and equipment care.
* Basic understanding of construction site safety practices, traffic management around work zones, and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Ability to read and follow work instructions, technical guidelines, and project drawings, with strong attention to detail and quality.
* Good physical stamina to work in outdoor conditions and perform manual tasks as required by site operations.
* Effective teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate with supervisors, crew members, and stakeholders.
* Prior experience in road or infrastructure projects and/or a diploma or degree in civil engineering or a related field is an advantage.
* Willingness to work flexible hours based on project needs and to travel to various project sites in and around Delhi as required.

title: Head of Operations - Scaffolding & Painting
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Trade Links is a rapidly growing provider of mechanical and industrial services, specializing in industrial scaffolding, piping, civil, mechanical, and painting solutions. With thousands of completed projects across India, the company is recognized as a trusted construction partner delivering safe and cost-effective services. Its diverse, high-quality product range and strong network of reliable vendors support stringent quality standards and competitive pricing. A focus on expertise, ethical business practices, and continuous improvement has positioned Indian Trade Links as a market leader. Candidates can learn more about the company at www.indiantradelinks.in or by contacting info@indiantradelinks.in.

Head of Operations – Scaffolding & Industrial Services

**Company:**
Indian Trade Links

**Position:**
Head of Operations

**Department:**
Operations

**Industry:**
Scaffolding / Industrial Services / Projects

**Location:**
India, with travel to project sites as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Level:**
Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and commercially aware
**Head of Operations**
to lead and control our scaffolding and industrial project operations across multiple sites.

The ideal candidate must possess
**strong practical knowledge of scaffolding operations**
, including planning, erection, modification, dismantling, material management, manpower productivity, safety compliance, measurement and billing coordination.

The position will be responsible for ensuring that projects are executed
**safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets**
, while maintaining strong client relationships.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Scaffolding Operations

* Lead and monitor scaffolding activities across all project sites.
* Have sound knowledge of
  **scaffolding erection, alteration/modification and dismantling**
  .
* Understand different scaffolding systems such as:
* Tube and coupler scaffolding
* Cup-lock/system scaffolding
* Ring-lock/system scaffolding
* Mobile scaffolds
* Birdcage scaffolds
* Suspended and cantilever arrangements, where applicable
* Review scaffolding requirements based on site conditions, work fronts, access requirements and project schedules.
* Ensure proper planning for scaffolding material, manpower and equipment.
* Monitor erected quantity versus dismantled quantity and material utilization.
* Control excessive material consumption, unnecessary scaffolding retention and material losses.

B. Project & Site Management

* Take overall responsibility for operational performance of all active projects.
* Prepare and monitor project mobilization and execution plans.
* Conduct regular reviews with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, Safety personnel and commercial teams.
* Monitor:
* Daily progress
* Planned vs. actual work
* Productivity
* Manpower deployment
* Material availability
* Site constraints
* Client priorities
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action before they affect project commitments.
* Coordinate shutdown, maintenance and high-priority activities with site teams and clients.

C. Manpower & Productivity Management

* Plan manpower requirements project-wise.
* Ensure optimum deployment of scaffolders, helpers, supervisors, engineers and other operational personnel.
* Closely monitor
  **manpower productivity against actual work output**
  .
* Prevent unnecessary overtime and idle manpower.
* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization according to workload.
* Develop capable site supervisors and project leadership teams.

D. Safety & Quality

The Head of Operations must establish a strong safety culture, particularly because scaffolding is a safety-critical activity.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure scaffolding work is executed according to approved procedures, drawings and applicable client/site requirements.
* Ensure inspection and tagging systems are properly followed.
* Ensure use of appropriate fall-protection and personal protective equipment.
* Work closely with the safety team on risk assessments, job safety analysis, toolbox talks and corrective actions.
* Review accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and serious safety observations.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Participate in client safety audits and operational reviews.
* Ensure defective scaffolding material is identified, segregated and prevented from use.

E. Material & Inventory Control

* Monitor scaffolding inventory across stores and project locations.
* Review material requirements before approving additional movement or procurement.
* Control:
* Material shortages
* Excess stock
* Damage
* Loss/theft
* Inter-site transfers
* Return of dismantled material
* Ensure proper reconciliation of scaffolding material at project completion.
* Improve material utilization and reduce unnecessary rental or procurement costs.

F. Commercial & Cost Control

The role should have strong commercial awareness, not only technical knowledge.

* Monitor project budget versus actual expenditure.
* Review manpower, material, equipment and subcontracting costs.
* Support measurement and certification of completed work.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Commercial teams for timely client billing.
* Monitor unbilled work and operational issues delaying certification.
* Understand the commercial implications of additional work and scope changes.
* Support variation/change-order documentation before additional work becomes a commercial dispute.
* Drive improvement in project profitability through productivity and cost control.

G. Client Management

* Act as a senior operational contact for key clients.
* Attend project review meetings with clients.
* Handle operational escalations professionally and promptly.
* Ensure client complaints are closed with proper corrective action.
* Maintain good relationships with client Operations, Projects, Safety, Maintenance and Commercial teams.
* Protect the company's reputation through disciplined and professional site execution.

H. Reporting & Management Review

Prepare/review weekly and monthly operational dashboards covering:

* Project-wise progress
* Scaffolding quantities
* Manpower deployment
* Productivity
* Safety performance
* Material utilization
* Billing status
* Cost performance
* Major site constraints
* Client issues
* Pending decisions
* Recovery/action plans

Escalate critical issues to management with
**clear facts, financial/operational impact and recommended action**
.

3. Required Experience

* Preferably
  **10+ years of experience**
  in industrial/project operations, with substantial experience in scaffolding operations.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of scaffolding erection and dismantling activities.
* Experience managing
  **multiple industrial project sites**
  is highly desirable.
* Experience dealing with large industrial clients, EPC contractors, steel plants, power plants, refineries or similar facilities is preferred.
* Experience managing large site manpower and supervisory teams.
* Good understanding of project costing, productivity and commercial controls.

4. Educational Qualification

Preferred:

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in
  **Mechanical, Civil, Industrial or a related engineering discipline**
  .

Relevant scaffolding, safety or project-management certifications will be an advantage.

For an exceptionally experienced scaffolding operations professional,
**strong practical project experience may be considered alongside formal qualifications**
.

5. Essential Scaffolding Knowledge

The candidate should be able to confidently discuss and review:

* Scaffold types and their applications
* Erection and dismantling sequence
* Working platforms and access
* Guardrails and toe boards
* Bracing, ties and stability
* Base arrangements and foundations
* Loading considerations
* Inspection and tagging
* Work-at-height controls
* Material identification
* Scaffolding quantity measurement
* Material reconciliation
* Manpower productivity
* Safe modification of existing scaffolds
* Planning for shutdown and maintenance scaffolding

6. Key Skills

* Strong leadership and decision-making
* Excellent scaffolding operational knowledge
* Multi-site project management
* Manpower planning
* Cost and budget control
* Client management
* Safety leadership
* Material management
* Problem solving
* Negotiation
* Commercial awareness
* Strong communication and reporting skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent site requirements

7. Key Performance Indicators

Performance of the Head of Operations should be measured using objective business and project metrics such as:

* Safety compliance
* Project schedule adherence
* Scaffolding productivity
* Manpower utilization
* Material utilization and recovery
* Reduction in material loss/damage
* Project cost versus budget
* Billing and measurement readiness
* Client issue closure
* Rework reduction
* Timely mobilization/demobilization
* Project close-out performance

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a
**strong operations leader who understands scaffolding from the ground level and can also manage the commercial side of projects**
.

* The candidate should be comfortable moving between a project site, a client review meeting and a management profitability review. This is
  **not purely an office-based managerial position**
  . Regular involvement with project sites and operational teams will be essential.

title: Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)
description:
Position : Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)

Location : Delhi-NCR

Reports to : State Head

Tenure : 1 Year

HelpAge India is a secular, not-for-profit organisation in India, registered under the Societies’ Registration Act of 1860. Set up in 1978, the organisation works for
*‘the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life’*
. It runs healthcare, agecare, livelihood, disaster response and awareness initiatives throughout the country & advocates strongly for the elder cause. It became the first and only Indian organization to be honoured with the ‘UN Population Award 2020’ for its exemplary work in the field of ageing and population issues, and earlier in 2014, has been the recipient of
*‘Vayoshreshtha Samman’*
by Government of India, as an institution working for senior citizens. We have been awarded highest CRISIL VO 1A grading for excellence in operations and high credibility. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work.

**Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing the Digital & Financial Empowerment Programme for senior citizens across the state. The position requires close engagement with senior citizen associations, community volunteers, community stakeholders, and project teams to ensure effective program delivery, achievement of targets, and timely reporting.

**Programme Implementation & Coordination**

* **Coordinate and oversee programme implementation across designated districts and**
  urban locations.
* Develop and maintain a database of Senior Citizen Associations (SCAs), Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), clubs, elder groups, and urban slum communities.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, guidelines, and quality standards.
* Monitor programme activities and provide regular updates to the State Program Manager, State Head, and Programme Lead.

**Training & Capacity Building**

* Organize and facilitate monthly digital, financial, and legal literacy workshops for senior citizens.
* Conduct awareness sessions on digital safety, cyber fraud prevention, online services, financial inclusion, and legal rights.
* Train and mentor youth volunteers to support programme implementation.
* Build local resource networks to strengthen outreach and programme impact.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation**

* Ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly programme targets.
* Collect, verify, and maintain programme data for monitoring and evaluation.
* Prepare and submit progress reports, MIS reports, success stories, photographs, videos, and case studies.
* Track participant feedback and recommend improvements to enhance programme effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with SCAs, RWAs, elder groups, banks, financial institutions, legal authorities, and community stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder consultations, programme reviews, and planning meetings.
* Represent the programme at local events, networking forums, and observances such as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day (WEAAD) and International Day of Older Persons (IDOP).

**Administrative Support**

* Coordinate logistics for workshops, training programmes, and outreach activities.
* Maintain records of programme activities, attendance, and volunteer engagement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and project requirements.

Requirements
  
  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Sociology, Development Studies, Education, Management, or a related field.

* 1 to 3 years of experience in programme coordination, community development, outreach, training, or related social sector projects.
* Experience working with senior citizens, digital literacy, financial inclusion, or community-based programmes will be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Programme planning and project management
* Training and facilitation skills
* Stakeholder engagement and partnership building
* Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting
* Strong communication and presentation skills, proficency in local language is a must
* MIS and data management
* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Volunteer and team management
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and digital tools

*Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.*

HelpAge India is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without prejudice to caste, religion or belief, sex, gender identity, disability or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws.

HelpAge India is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity. For more information, visit www.helpageindia.org . Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Interested candidates may apply within 15 days of this advertisement, with a cover /motivation letter, and CV at recruitments@helpageindia.org; along with details of last salary drawn, expected salary, and three professional referees.

Due to the urgency of the position, interviews may be scheduled even before the closure of the advertisement. Hence, interested candidates are encouraged to apply at the earliest. Please note that we will not be able to notify all applicants. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified about the interview date.

• Experience in luxury hotels

Kindly apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by GDI for a call.

Exotel powers unified customer engagement to over 6000 companies in 60+ countries, including India, SE Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

Today, some of the fastest-growing companies in the emerging markets (Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Urban Company, HDFC Bank, Zomato, Oyo, etc.) manage their customer engagement with Exotel’s suite of communication APIs, Ameyo’s omnichannel contact centre (merger), and Cogno AI‘s conversational AI platform (acquisition) over the cloud. * Act as a subject matter expert on contact centre technologies, representing the company at industry forums and with key customers and partners.

* Take ultimate accountability for the reliability, performance, and scalability of the Enterprise Contact Centre product.
* Establish and enforce service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs) for the platform.
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks, and lead the resolution of complex production issues.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement, leveraging data and feedback to enhance system performance.

* Hands-on experience with benchmarking, load testing, and performance tuning large-scale systems, identifying bottlenecks at the OS, network, and application layers beyond general reliability metrics

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior architect or principal engineer role for an enterprise-grade product.

* Demonstrated experience in designing and building large-scale, distributed, and highly available systems.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

2–5 years running Meta ads on affiliate/CPA offers with your own P&L

Full-time, fixed salary + profit share

We’re an affiliate network running CPS, CPL and CPI offers from global brands and networks such as Impact and Accesstrade. * Net profit (revenue minus ad spend) per month
* ROI per offer and overall (target: 30%+ on scaled campaigns)
* Time to profitability on new offers (first verdict within 7–10 days)
* Number of offers moved from test to scale each month
* Zero avoidable account bans

* Hands-on experience running Meta ads for affiliate/CPA offers (not just agency client work)

* Strong with Ads Manager, pixel/CAPI, and at least one tracker
* Experience with international GEOs (US, UK, EU, LATAM, SEA or Tier-2/3 markets)
* Comfortable with numbers: CPA, EPC, CR, ROAS, break-even math

* Experience with CPS e-commerce, finance, sweepstakes, nutra or app-install offers
* Creative skills (Canva, CapCut, basic AI tools for ad creatives)

**What we offer**

* Fixed monthly salary + profit share on what you generate
* Our budgets, offers and network relationships, so you don’t risk your own money
* Direct access to the founders; quick decisions
* Clear path to lead a media-buying team as you scale

Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. Your best affiliate campaign: offer type, GEO, spend, revenue, ROI

title: IAM Operations Engineer
description:
As an
**IAM Operations Engineer at Topsoe**
, you will play a key role in the daily operation, monitoring, support, and troubleshooting of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform and its integrations.
  
  
Your work will help ensure that identity lifecycle processes and access-management services remain available, reliable, and compliant throughout the employee journey—from
**joiner to mover to leaver**
. You will also help bring IAM platform ownership in-house as we transition responsibilities from our external partner.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of the daily operations of Topsoe’s IAM platform and its integrations.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and connections with enterprise systems such as SAP.
* Handle L2/L3 support escalations from the L1 Service Desk and resolve incidents effectively.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, deprovisioning, access-request, and access-review issues.
* Investigate failed or delayed identity transactions and analyze access models and connectors.
* Coordinate complex investigations with development, architecture, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Support testing, deployment, rollback, access reviews, audits, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* You will also help educate L1 support colleagues, improve first-contact resolution, and maintain clear standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.

**What You Will Bring**
You should have more than 3 years of experience in operating IAM platforms and supporting identity lifecycle processes in a structured, service-oriented environment. You are analytical, methodical, and comfortable investigating technical issues with both business and security implications.
  
  
**We Are Looking For**

* Experience operating IAM platforms, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
* A good understanding of provisioning flows, connectors, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Experience with IT Service Management, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize incidents based on business and security impact.
* Clear documentation skills and experience maintaining operational procedures.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and scripting.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have**

* SailPoint certification or a willingness to pursue certification.
* Experience working in a global organization with distributed teams.
* Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and operational performance management.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.
* An ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience supporting access reviews, audit controls, or compliance activities.

**Your new team**
You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and help build the foundation for Topsoe’s future IAM operations. Together, the team will take on responsibilities currently managed by our external partner and develop effective ways of working for long-term operational ownership.
  
  
This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative and security-focused environment where your work will have a direct impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM capabilities.
* Help ensure reliable identity and access services across the organization.
* Improve operational processes, monitoring, and support practices.
* Support the onboarding and stabilization of new applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of the IAM team.
* Be part of Topsoe’s ongoing digital transformation.

**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline: 18-10-2026**
.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
We are looking for a
**skilled, analytical, and result-oriented SEO Executive**
with a strong understanding of traditional SEO, modern AI-powered search optimisation, and content strategies.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in
**On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Off-Page SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), AIO (AI Optimisation), and E-E-A-T principles**
.

You will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and improving organic search strategies across multiple client websites, with a strong focus on Google rankings, organic traffic, qualified leads, and visibility across AI-powered search platforms.

Key Responsibilities1. SEO Strategy & Execution

* Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies for multiple client projects.
* Perform keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and keyword mapping.
* Manage complete On-Page SEO, including metadata, headings, URLs, internal linking, image optimisation, and content structure.
* Conduct technical SEO audits and coordinate with developers to resolve issues.
* Optimise website architecture, crawlability, indexability, canonical tags, redirects, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and structured data implementation.
* Identify ranking opportunities, traffic gaps, and SEO growth potential.

2. GEO, AEO & AI Search Optimisation

* Develop strategies to improve website visibility across Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Bing Copilot, and other AI-powered discovery platforms.
* Optimise content for conversational queries, question-based searches, entity relevance, and direct-answer formats.
* Implement GEO and AEO best practices, including structured content, semantic relevance, and accurate schema markup.
* Understand AI-driven search behaviour, zero-click searches, and evolving search engine algorithms.
* Improve brand discoverability, topical authority, and content credibility across traditional and AI search experiences.
* Analyse AI-generated search visibility and recommend practical improvements.

3. Content Planning, Assignment & Optimisation

* Prepare SEO content strategies, topic clusters, content calendars, and keyword-based content plans.
* Create detailed content briefs and assign articles, landing pages, blogs, and service-page content to content writers.
* Define primary and secondary keywords, search intent, content outlines, internal links, and SEO requirements.
* Review submitted content for quality, originality, accuracy, keyword relevance, and SEO effectiveness.
* Ensure content aligns with
  **E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness)**
  principles.
* Coordinate with writers, designers, and developers for timely content publication.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to refresh existing pages.

4. Off-Page SEO & Authority Building

* Plan and execute ethical, white-hat link-building campaigns.
* Perform backlink analysis, competitor backlink research, and link prospecting.
* Manage relevant outreach, digital PR opportunities, and quality link acquisition.
* Conduct backlink audits and identify potentially harmful or spammy links.
* Work on brand mentions, citations, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation, and business listings where applicable.
* Track referring domains, backlink quality, and organic authority growth.
* Avoid spammy link-building practices and manipulative SEO techniques.

5. SEO Tools, Analytics & Reporting

**Strong hands-on experience with the following tools is expected:**

* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager (basic understanding)
* Ahrefs / SEMrush
* Screaming Frog SEO Spider
* Google Keyword Planner
* Google PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse
* Google Trends
* Rich Results Test / Schema Markup Validator
* Google Looker Studio
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI research or SEO productivity tools

**Additional tool knowledge:**
Surfer SEO, Frase, SE Ranking, Moz, Microsoft Clarity, and Rank Math / Yoast SEO will be an advantage.

6. Performance Monitoring & Client Reporting

* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, CTR, conversions, and leads.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Track SEO deliverables, content assignments, published pages, backlinks, and technical improvements.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend data-driven improvements.
* Maintain project trackers and ensure deadlines are met.
* Coordinate with internal teams and communicate SEO progress professionally.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum
  **2 years of practical SEO experience**
  , preferably in a digital marketing agency.
* Proven experience handling multiple SEO projects independently.
* Strong technical, on-page, and off-page SEO knowledge.
* Working understanding of GEO, AEO, AIO, and AI-driven search trends.
* Experience in keyword clustering, topic planning, content briefing, and assigning tasks to writers.
* Strong understanding of E-E-A-T, Google Search Essentials, and search intent.
* Ability to perform comprehensive SEO audits and prepare actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript SEO fundamentals, and CMS platforms such as WordPress and Shopify.
* Good analytical skills, attention to detail, and written English communication.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and consistently meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with international SEO projects targeting the USA, Canada, UK, or other global markets.
* Knowledge of Local SEO, e-commerce SEO, and programmatic SEO.
* Familiarity with Laravel, Next.js, or other JavaScript-based websites from a technical SEO perspective.
* Experience implementing and validating structured data.
* Basic knowledge of SEO automation and AI-assisted workflows.
* Demonstrable improvements in organic visibility, relevant traffic, or conversions.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who goes beyond routine keyword placement and backlink creation.

The candidate should be capable of
**thinking strategically, identifying growth opportunities, managing content execution, solving SEO challenges, and adapting to the changing search landscape driven by AI.**

**A proactive attitude, ownership of assigned projects, and a results-oriented mindset are essential.**

Why Join SAM Web Studio?

* Work on diverse Indian and international client projects.
* Gain hands-on exposure to SEO, GEO, AEO, and AI-powered search strategies.
* Collaborate with web developers, designers, and content teams.
* Opportunity to take ownership of SEO campaigns and contribute to measurable business growth.
* Professional working environment with opportunities for career advancement.

title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
description:

**Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)**

and uses AI tools intelligently to work faster and smarter.
