•   Analyse data to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into clear recommendations.

•   Present SEO and GEO performance, insights and strategy to clients and internal teams with confidence.

**﻿
What We're Looking For**

**Experience & Education**

•   Bachelor's or Master's degree with around
**3 years of hands-on SEO and analytics experience**

.

•   Experience in a digital agency environment, managing multiple clients and categories, is strongly preferred.

**Core Skills**

•   Strong command of technical, on-page and off-page SEO.

•   Working knowledge of GEO / AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) principles and how AI search platforms select and cite sources.

•   Proficiency in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.

•   Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs and Screaming Frog; familiarity with AI visibility tracking tools is a plus.

•   Practical, responsible use of AI tools in day-to-day SEO work.

•   Understanding of structured data, entity SEO and E-E-A-T.

•   Strong SEO writing skills: titles, meta descriptions, headers, FAQs and content briefs.

•   Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to tell a clear story with data.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV and a short note on how you are approaching SEO in the age of AI search to:

**glen.ireland@eightytwenty.co.in**

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
**Position Overview**
Vida is looking for an experienced and highly analytical Paid Search Manager to join our growing performance marketing team.
  
  
This role will help manage and grow paid search programs across multiple D2C brands within the Vida portfolio. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience managing significant Google Ads budgets across multiple e-commerce accounts and has a proven track record of driving revenue growth and ROAS improvement.
  
  
The Paid Search Manager will work closely with the Senior Manager, Paid Search and Director of Paid Media while independently owning day-to-day strategy, execution, optimization, testing, reporting, and performance management across assigned brands.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical Google Ads knowledge with commercial thinking and can identify opportunities to scale revenue while maintaining efficiency.
  
  
**Compensation:**
Indian Rupee $116,667 - $166,667 montly
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Paid Search & Shopping Management**

* Independently manage and optimize paid search programs across multiple D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across:

+ Google Search
+ Google Shopping
+ Performance Max
+ Demand Gen
+ Microsoft Ads

* Own campaign performance against revenue, ROAS, conversion, and profitability goals.
* Develop campaign structures and segmentation strategies based on product performance, category, brand, margin, seasonality, and business priorities.
* Conduct product-level performance analysis to identify top-performing products, underperformers, wasted spend, and opportunities to scale.
* Identify opportunities to increase profitable spend while maintaining efficiency targets.
* Monitor competitive activity, search demand, seasonality, promotions, and other factors impacting performance.

**Google Merchant Center & Product Feeds**

* Manage and troubleshoot Google Merchant Center, including product disapprovals, warnings, feed errors, account issues, and product eligibility.
* Work closely with product feeds and feed management platforms to improve Shopping and Performance Max performance.
* Analyze and optimize key feed attributes including product titles, descriptions, product types, Google product categories, custom labels, pricing, availability, images, and promotional information.
* Develop product segmentation strategies using custom labels and other feed attributes.
* Partner with internal teams and feed management partners to continuously improve product data quality and feed health.
* Identify feed optimization opportunities that can improve visibility, traffic quality, revenue, and ROAS.

**Campaign Strategy, Optimization & Performance Analysis**

* Develop keyword and search strategies across brand, non-brand, category, product, competitor, and seasonal campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management to improve traffic quality and efficiency.
* Evaluate and optimize match types, campaign structures, audiences, and account segmentation.
* Develop and manage bidding strategies including Target ROAS, Maximize Conversion Value, Target CPA, Maximize Conversions, and other automated bidding approaches.
* Understand when bidding targets, budgets, campaign structure, or conversion signals may be restricting growth.
* Manage budgets and pacing across assigned accounts while ensuring alignment with monthly and annual revenue goals.
* Recommend budget reallocations across campaigns, products, brands, and tactics based on performance and incremental growth opportunities.
* Develop structured testing roadmaps across bidding, campaign structure, Performance Max, Broad Match, landing pages, ad copy, audiences, feeds, promotions, and emerging Google Ads products.
* Analyze performance across revenue, ROAS, spend, conversion rate, CPA, CPC, average order value, impression share, and other key e-commerce KPIs.
* Diagnose performance changes and clearly communicate what changed, why it changed, and what actions should be taken next.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Proactively identify performance risks, account issues, testing opportunities, and areas for incremental growth.
* Stay current on Google Ads product updates, automation, AI-driven campaign capabilities, and changes within the paid search landscape.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-6+ years of hands-on paid search / Google Ads experience, preferably within an agency, multi-brand organization, or D2C/e-commerce business.
* Strong experience independently managing multiple paid search accounts simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant paid media budgets and being accountable for revenue and ROAS goals.
* Strong D2C/e-commerce experience with an understanding of how paid search contributes to overall business growth.
* Advanced hands-on knowledge of:

+ Google Search
+ Google Shopping
+ Performance Max
+ Demand Gen
+ Google Merchant Center
+ Microsoft Advertising

* Advanced understanding of Google Smart Bidding, including Target ROAS and value-based bidding strategies.
* Strong experience with Shopping campaign structures, product segmentation, and product-level performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience working with Google Merchant Center and product feeds.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, keyword strategy, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management.
* Ability to determine when performance issues are driven by bidding, budget, feed quality, campaign structure, conversion rate, tracking, competition, seasonality, or other factors.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs including revenue, ROAS, conversion rate, CPA, AOV, CPC, impression share, and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to QA campaign setups, budgets, conversion tracking, feeds, URLs, promotions, and account changes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple brands, projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to proactively bring recommendations and growth opportunities rather than relying solely on direction from senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with D2C retail, footwear, fashion, apparel, accessories, or consumer brands.
* Experience managing large e-commerce product catalogs and Shopping-heavy accounts.
* Experience managing high-spend Google Ads accounts.
* Experience with third-party feed management platforms such as Feedonomics, Productsup, DataFeedWatch, Channable, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing custom-label and product segmentation strategies.
* Understanding of GA4, conversion tracking, attribution, enhanced conversions, and e-commerce measurement.
* Experience managing Microsoft Ads alongside Google Ads.
* Experience with Performance Max channel analysis and understanding the interaction between Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display, and other inventory within PMax.
* Experience evaluating new customer acquisition, brand vs. non-brand performance, and incremental growth opportunities.
* Familiarity with Looker Studio or other reporting and visualization platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful Paid Search Manager will be able to independently own assigned accounts while consistently identifying opportunities to improve performance and grow the business.
  
  
Success in this role means:
  
  

* Growing profitable revenue across assigned brands.
* Meeting or exceeding ROAS and business performance targets.
* Identifying opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns, categories, and products.
* Quickly diagnosing and addressing performance declines.
* Effectively managing significant budgets and maintaining accurate pacing.
* Continuously improving Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and product feed strategies.
* Developing thoughtful testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Turning account and product data into clear strategic recommendations.
* Maintaining strong Merchant Center and feed health.
* Proactively identifying new opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Clearly communicating account performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to the Senior Manager, Paid Search.
* Taking strong ownership of assigned brands while collaborating effectively across the broader performance marketing team.

title: Guest Advisory Associate
description:
**About Atlys**

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a
**Guest Advisory Associate**
to turn customer interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.

You’ll be one of the first people travellers speak to at Atlys, understanding what they need, helping them navigate their options, and building trust through clear, thoughtful conversations.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can combine strong communication with commercial instinct, follow through consistently, and move quickly in a high-volume environment.

**The Job**

* **Engage and qualify potential customers**
  across calls, chats and email by understanding their travel needs and guiding them toward the right Atlys solution.
* **Explain our products and visa processes clearly**
  so customers understand their options, feel confident in their decision and know what happens next.
* **Drive leads through to conversion**
  through thoughtful follow-ups, objection handling and consistent ownership of the customer journey.
* **Learn from customer conversations**
  by identifying recurring questions, pain points and signals that can improve conversion and the overall experience.
* **Work closely across teams**
  with Marketing, Fulfilment and Product while keeping lead and interaction data accurate and up to date.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 1+ years of experience in pre-sales, sales, customer success or another customer-facing role.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, and can simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are persuasive without being pushy, with strong empathy and the ability to understand what a customer actually needs.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups in a fast-paced environment.
* Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity**
  so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance**
  covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy**
  with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**
  , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning & development credits**
  to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support**
  to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**
  , including high-spec equipment and software.

title: Customer Support Associate
description:
**About Zoop**

Zoop sells fashion through live auctions. We own our supply: factory outlet stock and excess and liquidation inventory from brands and manufacturers. Our in-house studios and creators sell it live, every day. We are based in New Delhi and backed by Peak XV Partners (Surge) and Lumikai.

**The role**

You will be the person our buyers talk to. Every question about an order — where it is, what size it was, why it looked different, how to send it back — comes to you, and how you answer it decides whether that buyer bids again.

Live auctions move fast and buy decisions are made in seconds, so our customers reach out often and expect quick, clear answers. You will handle those conversations end to end on WhatsApp and in-app chat, and you will own the problem until it is actually solved, not until it is passed on.

You will work closely with the operations, warehouse and studio teams, and report to the founders.

**What you'll do**

* **Answer buyer queries.**

  Handle WhatsApp and in-app chat conversations on order status, sizing, product condition, payments, shipping timelines and anything else buyers ask.
* **Own post-purchase end to end.**

  Process returns and refunds, chase delivery escalations with courier partners, and stay on a case until the buyer has an outcome.
* **Resolve, don't route.**

  Dig into what actually went wrong — wrong item, missed pickup, stuck shipment — and fix it, pulling in ops or warehouse only when you need them.
* **Set expectations honestly.**

  Our stock is surplus and off-price, so condition and sizing vary. Explain that clearly before a buyer is disappointed, not after.
* **Close the loop on quality.**

  Flag recurring complaints — a lot that keeps coming back, a supplier with sizing issues, a courier that keeps failing — to the sourcing and ops teams with the data to back it up.
* **Keep response and resolution times tight.**

  Work to our first-response and resolution targets across every open conversation, including on live show days when volume spikes.
* **Build the playbook.**

  Write and improve canned responses, FAQs and escalation SOPs as we grow, so the next five people on this team start faster than you did.

**Who we're looking for**

* 1–3 years in customer support, customer success or post-purchase operations, ideally at a D2C brand, marketplace or e-commerce company.
* Writes clearly and calmly in Hindi and English, and can switch between them the way our buyers do.
* Patient with frustrated customers without becoming a pushover on policy.
* Comfortable owning a problem across teams and following up until it's closed.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets and support tools: tracking tickets, response times, return reasons and repeat issues.
* Organised enough to run 40+ open conversations without losing track of any of them.

**Preferred**

* Experience on a WhatsApp-first support setup, and with tools like Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar.
* Has handled returns, refunds and courier escalations directly with logistics partners.
* Has worked in fashion or apparel and can speak credibly about fit, fabric and sizing.
* Experience supporting customers in a live commerce, quick commerce or high-volume sale environment.

**How we'll measure success**

* First-response and resolution time across WhatsApp and in-app chat.
* Percentage of cases resolved without escalation.
* Return and refund turnaround time.
* Customer satisfaction on resolved conversations.
* Repeat purchase rate among buyers who raised an issue.
* Recurring issues identified and fixed at source, not just handled case by case.

**Role details**

**Location:**

New Delhi, in-office

**Type:**

Full-time

**Reporting:**

Founders

**Compensation:**

Competitive salary + ESOPs

To apply, send your CV and a short note on the hardest customer situation you've handled: what the customer wanted, what you could actually offer, and how it ended.

title: Guest Advisory Lead
description:

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for

You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.ResponsibilitiesOwn a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisionsBuild the case and align stakeholders. title: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security
description:
**Designation: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security**

**Support level: L2 Operations**

**Domain: Network Security**

**Scope: Palo Alto Firewalls, Zscaler, SSE, ZTNA, Enterprise Browser, Internet Security (SWG and FWaaS), and Private Access**

**Job Location / Reporting Location: NCR - Gurugram**

**Process:**

• End-to-end incident management, from L1/L1.5 escalation to closure.

• Run firewall health checks (CPU and memory) and act on breaches.

• Collect logs and evidence for firewall alert events.

• Troubleshoot reported issues and check network connectivity.

• Enable new access per application needs, through the client's change process.

• Handle port and rule requests from other teams, including server teams.

• Apply firewall patches and OS upgrades under change control.

• Handle outage calls to restore connectivity.

• Support Zscaler and Palo Alto firewalls.

• Protect data in transit and at rest from unauthorised access.

• Report security issues promptly with recommended actions.

• Follow client security standards and guidelines.

• Keep ServiceNow tickets current, with clear resolution and closure notes.

• Join RCA reviews. Update SOPs and knowledge-base articles.

• Work with Connectivity, Hosting, IDAM, DLP and Malware Tools on cross-tower issues.

• Trace policy evaluation in SSE (Zscaler Internet Access, Prisma Access and similar) – URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection, DLP, CASB – and in Prisma Access (security, decryption, URL filtering rules) to find unexpected allows or blocks.

• Diagnose Private Access failures across application segments, segment groups, server groups, access policies and Private Service Edge.

• Troubleshoot forwarding profiles, PAC files, trusted network detection and bypass configuration.

• Diagnose GRE and IPsec tunnel failures to Zscaler, and Remote Network and Service Connection tunnels in Prisma Access, including IKE/IPsec phase issues.

• Resolve DNS issues for private apps, including split DNS, conditional forwarding and DNS search domains.

• Troubleshoot SAML assertion and attribute problems, SCIM provisioning failures and group sync issues with Entra ID, Okta or Ping.

• Resolve device posture and trusted network check failures.

• Take and analyse packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump, connector-side captures).

• Correlate logs across the SSE platform, SIEM, IdP and endpoint tools.

• Use ZDX and ADEM data to diagnose latency, edge selection and path problems.

**Tools:**

• Palo Alto firewalls (Cloud Firewalls)

• Zscaler

• Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, Strata Logging Service, Prisma Access

• Splunk SIEM

• Datadog

• Enterprise monitoring tools

• ServiceNow

• Okta (secondary skill)

**Technologies:**

• Subject-matter expertise (8+ years) in NGFWs, WAFs, multi-cloud networking and security controls, core networking protocols, and security architecture – primarily Palo Alto, AWS and Azure, with GCP and Alibaba Cloud as a plus.

• Deploying security policies with IPS, URL filtering, DNS security and SSL inspection.

• Firewall security policy tuning with tools such as AlgoSec.

• Quickly identifying and remediating root cause.

• ITaaS, ITIL, monitoring and metrics.

• Multi-cloud networking.

• Firewall administration.

• Secure web gateway.

• Access and rule management.

• Network segmentation.

• Firewall log analysis.

• TCP/IP and routing basics.

• Python or Ansible scripting.

• IaC tooling: GitHub, Octopus, Terraform.

• DNS expertise.

**Experience:**

• 12 years of experience in L2 network security operations

• 24x7 support environment

• Palo Alto firewall administration

• Zscaler administration (scope to be confirmed)

• Enterprise networking expertise

• Firewall rule and port request handling

• Log and evidence collection

• ITSM incident, problem and change processes

• Clear written and spoken English

**Certifications:**

• Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE

• Zscaler administrator certification

• CCNA

• A Proxy / SSE industry certification (Zscaler or Palo Alto)

title: GIS Subject Matter Expert
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced
**GIS Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
with 7+ years of professional experience to support Environmental, Social, Health & Safety (ESHS), Sustainability, ESG, and Impact Assessment projects across infrastructure, renewable energy, industrial, urban development, transportation, water, and manufacturing sectors. The role will focus on geospatial analysis, map development, web GIS applications, spatial databases, and GIS-based decision support for environmental and social assessments. GIS capabilities are an integral part of Ramboll's impact assessment, environmental review, site evaluation, due diligence, and sustainability services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop high-quality GIS maps, figures, dashboards, StoryMaps, and spatial products using ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online in accordance with Ramboll cartographic and quality standards.
* Conduct spatial analyses including environmental constraints mapping, land-use assessment, accessibility studies, socio-economic profiling, cumulative impact assessment, climate risk screening, and site suitability analysis.
* Integrate environmental, social, infrastructure, demographic, regulatory, and satellite datasets to support project planning and decision-making.
* Support project teams in site selection, alternatives assessment, permitting, due diligence, stakeholder engagement, and impact assessment studies.
* Develop and maintain web GIS applications, ArcGIS Online solutions, dashboards, and interactive mapping tools.
* Manage geospatial datasets, metadata, quality assurance, and GIS standards.
* Support biodiversity screening, critical habitat assessments, social baseline studies, climate risk assessments, and ESG due diligence through geospatial analysis.
* Prepare maps and geospatial deliverables for technical reports, client presentations, lender reviews, and regulatory submissions.
* Collaborate with environmental, social, biodiversity, health & safety, climate, and sustainability specialists in multidisciplinary projects.
* Contribute to proposal preparation, methodology development, innovation initiatives, and business development activities.
* Mentor junior GIS analysts and support the development of GIS best practices and workflows.
* Ensure all GIS deliverables adhere to organisational GIS standards, data governance requirements, cartographic guidelines, metadata standards, and quality assurance processes. Promote consistent use of approved ArcGIS workflows, templates, symbology standards, and enterprise geospatial services across projects.
* Support the development and maintenance of the organisation's enterprise geospatial ecosystem, including ArcGIS Online content, shared data services, map templates, and reusable GIS workflows.
* Review GIS outputs produced by other team members to ensure compliance with organizational standards, project requirements, and client expectations.
* Act as the geospatial subject matter expert for Environment & Health projects, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and best-practice recommendations to project teams and junior GIS professionals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in GIS, Geography, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Geology, or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of relevant GIS and geospatial analysis experience.
* Strong proficiency in ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Enterprise GIS, Web GIS, spatial databases, and geospatial data management. Experience with other GIS platforms is beneficial; however, GIS production workflows, map authoring, cartography, and client deliverables should be developed using the organisations standard ArcGIS platform.
* Experience in environmental and social impact assessments, sustainability, infrastructure planning, renewable energy, or related sectors.
* Experience working with satellite imagery, remote sensing data, and geospatial modelling techniques.
* Working knowledge of international standards such as IFC Performance Standards, World Bank EHS Guidelines, Equator Principles, ESG frameworks, and sustainability reporting requirements is desirable.
* Strong analytical, visualization, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Python, ArcPy, SQL, Power BI, FME, or GIS automation tools.
* Experience developing GIS dashboards, enterprise GIS solutions, and decision-support systems.
* Knowledge of biodiversity assessments, climate risk mapping, ESG due diligence, environmental permitting, and sustainability reporting.
* Experience supporting renewable energy, transportation, industrial, mining, water, urban development, or infrastructure projects.

**Key Competencies**

* GIS & Geospatial Analytics
* Environmental & Social Constraints Assessment
* Impact Assessment Mapping
* Site Suitability Analysis
* Spatial Data Management
* Web GIS & Dashboard Development
* Remote Sensing & Spatial Modelling
* Climate Risk & Sustainability Analytics
* Technical Report Preparation
* Stakeholder-Focused Data Visualization
* Multidisciplinary Collaboration
* Quality Assurance & Data Governance

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.

Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. title: Performance makreting
description:
We are looking for a data-driven and creative Performance Marketing Manager to lead our paid acquisition channels and scale our online store growth. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns that drive traffic, customer acquisition, and high Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  
The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of e-commerce metrics, an analytical mindset, and a sharp eye for what makes creative fashion ad content convert.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
• Campaign Management: Strategy, setup, and day-to-day management of paid acquisition channels, primarily focusing on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, and marketplaces.
  
• ROAS & Budget Optimization: Track, allocate, and optimize daily/monthly budgets to hit monthly revenue targets while maintaining healthy Customer Acquisition Costs (CAC)
  
• A/B Testing: Continuously run split tests on ad copy, visuals, landing pages, and audience targeting to maximize conversion rates.
  
• Data & Analytics: Monitor and analyze e-commerce KPIs (Conversion Rate, AOV, LTV, Click-Through Rate) using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Shopify analytics, and ad platforms.
  
• Reporting: Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports highlighting key insights, wins, losses, and strategic next steps for leadership.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
• Experience: 3+ years of proven experience managing performance marketing campaigns specifically for an e-commerce or Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand (fashion/apparel experience is a huge plus).
  
• Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (including Performance Max), and marketplaces ads
  
• E-commerce Stack: Proficiency with Shopify (or similar e-commerce platforms) and Google Analytics (GA4).
  
• Analytical Skills: Strong ability to manipulate data, interpret trends, and turn complex numbers into actionable growth strategies.
  
• Creative Instincts: Understanding of what hooks a customer visually in the fashion space and how to guide content creators to produce high-converting assets.
  
• Mindset: Highly organized, detail-oriented, agile, and comfortable working in a fast-paced retail environment.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
• performance-based Commission on sales upto 10%
  
• Generous employee discount on all products
  
• Flexible working hours and hybrid options.
  
• Clear paths for career growth in a rapidly expanding business.

title: Care Manager
description:

* Willing to travel locally within Delhi NCR

* A meaningful role at the heart of a growing, purpose-driven elder care brand

* Competitive compensation, aligned with experience

title: Industrial Trainee - Internal Audit
description:
**Role Purpose**

To support the Internal Audit function in conducting risk-based audits, Internal Financial

Controls (IFC) testing, process reviews, compliance audits, and ensuring timely closure

of audit observations across business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Internal Audit Execution

• Conduct process audits across business functions (Sourcing, Finance, Stores,

Production, HR, etc.).

• Perform risk assessment and identify control gaps.

• Execute audit programs and document working papers.

• Evaluate adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls.

• Draft audit observations with root cause analysis and risk rating.

• Discuss findings with process owners and obtain management responses.

2. Internal Financial Controls (IFC) Testing

• Perform design and operating effectiveness testing of IFC controls.

• Assist in preparation and updating of Risk Control Matrix (RCM).

• Identify control deficiencies and suggest remediation measures.

• Support management in strengthening financial reporting controls.

• Track remediation of IFC gaps.

3. Risk & Governance

• Assist in enterprise risk identification and documentation.

• Monitor key financial and operational risks.

• Evaluate compliance with policies, SOPs, and statutory requirements.

• Support governance framework improvements.

4. Compliance & Regulatory Review

• Review compliance with Companies Act, GST, Income Tax, Labour Laws, MSME

Act, etc.

• Ensure proper documentation and record retention as per statutory

requirements.

• Identify non-compliance areas and recommend corrective actions.

5. Audit Reporting & Follow-up

• Prepare draft audit reports with actionable recommendations.

• Maintain audit tracker and monitor closure of findings within agreed timelines.

• Conduct follow-up audits to ensure effective implementation.

• Maintain documentation repository for audit evidence.

6. Data Analysis & Controls Monitoring

• Perform data analytics for exception identification.

• Review transactional data for anomalies, fraud indicators, or control breaches.

• Assist in automation of audit processes where feasible.

**Key Deliverables / KPIs**

• Completion of audits as per audit plan.

• Timely closure of audit findings.

• Effective IFC testing with minimal repeat observations.

• Improvement in control environment maturity.

• Proactive identification of financial and operational risks.

**Qualifications & Experience**

• CA Inter / CMA / MBA (Finance) / Semi-qualified professional.

• 1–4 years of experience in Internal Audit / Risk Advisory / IFC.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and internal controls.

• Knowledge of ERP systems.

• Good drafting and communication skills

* Support internal, statutory, GST, and tax audits by providing the required records and explanations.

* Ability to manage multiple vendors and payment deadlines.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.

**Location**
Delhi
  
  
**About Central Square Foundation**
Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working to ensure quality school education for all children in India. We believe strong foundational learning outcomes are critical for lifelong learning and equity. CSF focuses on four core areas: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN), EdTech, Early Childhood Education (ECE), and School Governance.
  
  
**About RMEAL At CSF**
The Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment & Learning (RMEAL) function at CSF serves as the organization's central evidence and learning spine. RMEAL partners closely with program verticals—including EdTech—to design, execute, quality-assure, and translate rigorous evidence into actionable insights for decision-making at scale.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As Project Lead (Consultant) – RMEAL, you will drive the design, quality assurance, and learning agenda for evidence generation across CSF's EdTech and AI-enabled initiatives. You will work in close partnership with the EdTech vertical to ensure evaluations are methodologically robust, decision-relevant, and embedded into program and ecosystem strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Evidence Design & Methodological Execution:
  
  

* Design and review rigorous evaluation approaches (RCTs, quasi-experimental, mixed-methods).
* Review SAPs, tools, and analytical outputs.

**Evaluation Quality Assurance & Process Stewardship**

* Guide end-to-end evaluation processes.
* Use structured QA tools and templates.

**Learning, Insights & Translation**

* Translate findings into actionable insights and learning products.

**Stakeholder & Partner Engagement**

* Support funder, government, and partner engagements.

**Team Support & Capability Building**

* Mentor junior team members and support onboarding.

**Planning, Delivery & Portfolio Management**

* Manage timelines, budgets, and reporting.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Education, Statistics, or related field.
* 7–10 years of experience in research, evaluation, or evidence-informed program design.
* Experience with quantitative and mixed-methods evaluations.
* Ability to translate research into decision-oriented insights.

**Technical Skills Required**

* Strong command of statistical analysis using tools such as Stata, R, or Python.
* Ability to develop and review study plans and Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) for experimental and quasi-experimental study designs.
* Ability to work with complex survey data, sampling designs, and weighting.
* Experience working with dashboards or data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Data Studio) is desirable.
* Familiarity with qualitative analysis tools and mixed-methods research workflows is an added bonus.
* Strong documentation skills (methods notes, technical briefs, learning memos).

**Desired Qualities**

* Commitment to rigorous, ethical evidence.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills.
* Comfort working across ambiguity and multiple workstreams.
* High learning agility.

**Compensation**
Compensation will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks.

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.
  
  
Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**Strategy & Operations - Role Overview**
The S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.
  
  
This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.
  
  
**If this sounds like you, and you have**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles.
* Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams
* A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'

Then let’s chat!

title: Shopify Support Trainee
description:
Company: SimplePlan Media

Experience: Freshers welcome (0-6 months) / Minimum 6-12 months for experienced applicants

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Customer Success & Support

**About the Role**

 

We're looking for a proactive and tech-savvy support trainee to help merchants get the most out of our Shopify apps. You'll be responsible for communicating with merchants, understanding their software requirements, assisting with app setup and customization requests, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring a smooth experience with our products. You'll work closely with our development and product teams to resolve merchant concerns and improve customer satisfaction. 

* Work days: Monday to Friday (Saturday subject to requirement)
* Work hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
* Setup: Fully on-site role

**Key Responsibilities**

• Merchant Communication: Handle merchant queries through live chat, email, and video calls with clear, professional, and friendly communication. 

• App Setup & Onboarding: Help merchants install, configure, and use our apps based on their business requirements. 

• Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate app-related issues, reproduce bugs, identify possible causes, and coordinate resolutions with developers. 

• Customization Support: Understand merchant customization requirements, suggest available solutions, and coordinate with the development team for advanced changes. 

• Store & Platform Assistance: Guide merchants through admin dashboards, theme editors, app embeds, app blocks, and other relevant storefront configurations. 

• Merchant Success: Follow up with merchants, ensure successful app adoption, and proactively address concerns to improve satisfaction and retention. 

• Product Feedback: Collect merchant suggestions, identify recurring issues, and share actionable insights with the product team. 

• Documentation & Testing: Maintain support records, prepare clear bug reports, test fixes, and contribute to help articles and FAQs.

**Required Skills & Knowledge—Must Haves / Core Competencies**

1. Technical Background & AI Enthusiasm

• Strong tech background, a natural curiosity about software and technology, and enthusiasm about AI and innovative tech solutions.

• Solid client service aptitude, patience, and a strong desire to help users succeed.

2. Platform Knowledge (Shopify or General E-commerce)

• Working understanding of the Shopify ecosystem, Shopify Admin, or general e-commerce platforms.

• Familiarity with products, collections, variants, inventory, discounts, and customer accounts.

• Basic knowledge of themes, theme customization, and theme editors.

• Understanding of app installation, app embeds, and app blocks.

• Familiarity with storefront functionality, including product pages, cart, and checkout.

3. Apps & E-commerce Product Knowledge

• Understanding of how software applications integrate with storefronts and extend store functionality.

• Basic familiarity with e-commerce features such as product bundles, upsells, wishlists, subscriptions, wholesale pricing, and discounts.

• Ability to learn new app features quickly and explain their functionality to merchants.

• Understanding of common merchant requirements and how to translate them into app configurations or customization requests.

4. Basic Technical Knowledge

• Basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

• Familiarity with browser developer tools and identifying basic storefront issues.

• Ability to troubleshoot app installation, display, configuration, and compatibility issues.

• Ability to prepare clear technical reports with steps to reproduce, screenshots, and screen recordings.

• Basic familiarity with JavaScript and Liquid is an added advantage.

5. Communication & Customer Service

• Excellent written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to understand merchant concerns and explain technical solutions in simple language. • Strong problem-solving skills, patience, and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple merchant conversations and prioritize issues.

• Strong ownership mindset and willingness to follow through until issues are resolved.

**Good to have skills and knowledge.**

• Previous experience supporting merchants or working with app companies.

• Limited or no prior exposure to Shopify is completely acceptable, provided there is a strong, demonstrated interest in learning.

• Experience using customer support tools such as Crisp, Intercom, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with Partner Dashboards and collaborator access.

• Experience conducting merchant onboarding or product demo calls.

• Understanding of SaaS customer success, customer retention, and app adoption.

**Who We're Looking For**

Someone who is:

• A confident communicator who enjoys helping customers.

• Curious about technology, software products, AI, and e-commerce.

• Comfortable investigating issues before escalating them.

• Quick to learn new features and explain them clearly.

• Responsible, organized, and focused on resolving merchant problems.

• Comfortable collaborating with developers, designers, and product teams.

**About SimplePlan:**

SimplePlan Media is a product and development company building innovative apps that help e-commerce businesses grow. Our products include BundleSuite, WishlistSuite, SubscriptionSuite, and B2B Wholesale Suite, helping merchants improve conversions, increase revenue, and manage their stores more effectively. If you enjoy solving problems, communicating with customers, and working with cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you

title: Lead - Leasing & Warehousing
description:
Lead – Leasing & Warehousing

Purpose of the Role

The Lead – Leasing & Warehousing will be responsible for driving leasing growth, optimizing warehouse occupancy, and supporting investment decisions across existing and prospective warehousing assets. The role focuses on end-to-end leasing management, commercial evaluation, client onboarding, contract execution, warehouse readiness, and customer relationship management. The incumbent will play a critical role in maximizing asset utilization, enhancing customer experience, and aligning warehousing operations with business growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Leasing & Business Development

Drive end-to-end leasing transactions, including lead generation, negotiations, LOI finalization, term sheet preparation, and execution of lease agreements. Collaborate with legal, finance, and operational teams to ensure timely closure of leasing opportunities. Support occupancy enhancement initiatives and maximize revenue realization across warehousing assets. Identify and develop relationships with prospective clients across diversified industry segments.

Investment Analysis & Commercial Evaluation

Evaluate new warehousing and leasing opportunities through financial modeling, IRR calculations, feasibility assessments, and business case preparation. Support investment decision-making by conducting techno-commercial evaluations and market viability studies. Monitor and analyze project financial performance against planned investment objectives.

Client Onboarding & Relationship Management

Ensure seamless transition of customers from the leasing phase to warehouse operations through structured onboarding and handover processes. Act as a key point of contact for customers to address operational and commercial concerns. Drive superior customer experience through proactive engagement, issue resolution, and service excellence.

Market Intelligence & Business Insights

Track market trends, warehousing demand-supply dynamics, rental benchmarks, and competitor activities. Generate actionable market intelligence to support pricing strategies, leasing decisions, and business expansion initiatives. Strengthen direct customer engagement to understand evolving market requirements and identify growth opportunities.

Budgeting & Cost Management

Support annual budgeting exercises, leasing forecasts, and capital expenditure planning. Monitor leasing-related expenditures and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Contribute to cost optimization initiatives while maintaining operational effectiveness.

Contract & Compliance Management

Coordinate preparation, review, and execution of lease-related documentation. Ensure compliance with approved commercial terms, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements. Maintain contract records and monitor key lease obligations and milestones.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards to track leasing pipeline, occupancy levels, warehouse utilization, revenue performance, and turnaround timelines. Generate periodic management reports and present insights to business leadership for decision-making. Leverage CRM systems and digital tools to improve pipeline visibility and reporting accuracy.

Digital Transformation & Innovation

Drive adoption of digital platforms and automation tools across leasing and warehousing processes. Stay updated on emerging technologies, digital solutions, and AI-driven capabilities to improve business efficiency and competitiveness. Identify opportunities for process improvements through data analytics and technology enablement.

People Leadership

Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Mentor and guide team members to enhance capabilities and professional growth. Build high-performing teams focused on achieving business and customer-centric objectives.

Key Stakeholders

Internal Stakeholders: Business Head – Agri Logistics & Warehousing, Head – Warehousing, Functional Heads and Cross-Functional Teams, Operations, Finance, Legal, Projects, and Commercial Teams, Direct and Indirect Reportees. External Stakeholders: Customers across diverse industry sectors, Government and Regulatory Authorities, Industry Associations, Trade Bodies, and Federations, Consultants, Channel Partners, and Service Providers, Market Competitors and Industry Networks.

Educational Qualifications

SecNinjaz is building sovereignty-aligned cybersecurity and IT solutions designed to empower organizations with secure, resilient, and open technologies.

Our mission is to become a one-stop cyber solutions partner — architecting and delivering secure infrastructure, cybersecurity platforms, and advanced technology solutions while prioritizing open-source, sovereignty, and operational resilience.

Internally, we maintain a sophisticated infrastructure stack combining on-premise virtualization, secure networking, GPU compute, and developer platforms, enabling both product development and cybersecurity operations.

We are looking for a hands-on Infrastructure & Platform Lead who can take ownership of our internal IT and infrastructure, bring operational maturity, and build systems that scale with the company.

The Infrastructure & Platform Lead will be responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving SecNinjaz's internal infrastructure and IT environment.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of managing virtualization, secure networking, identity systems, developer platforms, and security infrastructure while leading a small team of IT engineers. The candidate will also mentor junior infrastructure engineers and help establish professional operational standards.

You will ensure that our internal systems are secure, resilient, well-documented, professionally operated and compliant, forming the backbone of our cybersecurity and product engineering teams.

Candidates should demonstrate strong understanding of secure infrastructure design and operational security practices.

- Manage and maintain virtualization infrastructure

- Operate internal technology platforms and services

- Maintain secure networking and remote access infrastructure

- Implement monitoring, alerting, and backup systems

- Improve infrastructure documentation and operational processes

- Lead and mentor junior IT / infrastructure engineers

### Compliance & Governance

- Support and maintain organizational compliance requirements related to IT and cybersecurity

- Ensure infrastructure and systems align with defined security and compliance standards

- Assist in audits by providing required technical evidence and documentation

- Maintain proper access controls, logging, and system configurations as per compliance needs

Candidates should have experience with:

- Linux system administration

- virtualization platforms (Proxmox / VMware / KVM)

- networking fundamentals

- VPN technologies

- infrastructure monitoring

- backup systems

- infrastructure documentation

## Preferred Experience

Exposure to any of the following is beneficial:

- developer platforms (GitLab Premium/Ultimate)

- containerization technologies

- infrastructure automation

- storage systems

## Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

- is hands-on with infrastructure technologies

- has experience managing production environments

- values documentation and structured operations

- is comfortable working in a fast-growing technical organization

Experience working with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 9001, STQC, SOC2, etc.) is a plus.

## Important Note

We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. * In-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable - Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

Strong MECM/SCCM experience including Collections, Application Deployment, Packages, Task Sequences, OSD, Software Updates, SUP, WSUS, DP, MP, and client troubleshooting.
  
  
Experience in SCCM infrastructure administration, upgrades, migration, Current Branch/CU maintenance, and endpoint management.
  
  
Strong understanding of Windows patch management, servicing, software update deployment, and update channel management.
  
  
Experience with Windows Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, certificate management, and Windows Server technologies.
  
  
Hands-on experience configuring VPN, Wi-Fi, email, domain join, and other endpoint configuration profiles.
  
  
Knowledge of NDES and SCEP-based certificate deployment using Microsoft Intune.
  
  
Experience managing iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS device enrollment, compliance, retirement, and wipe processes.
  
  
Familiarity with MDT and Windows image management.

Strong troubleshooting, log analysis, problem-solving, customer handling, and communication skills.

description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Senior Vulnerability Remediation Engineer

P R O D U C T S E C U R I T Y · A N A P L A N

**Reports to:**
Senior Manager, Platform Security
  
**Working model:**
Gurugram (Hybrid)

Why this role matters

This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at Anaplan! In this role, you will be at the forefront of scaling security through automation and self-service. You’ll be the driving force behind transforming security intent into enforced, self-service controls across the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines. Think dependency policy, secrets handling, least-privilege access, and the guardrails that allow engineering teams to innovate rapidly without compromising security.

When done right, this is some of the most high-leverage work in our function. Every control you implement will run continuously for every team, seamlessly integrated into their workflows!

Why Anaplan

Anaplan is not just another SaaS application; it’s a powerful platform that performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modeling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. Our technical landscape is rich and varied, featuring the legacy Hyperblock engine, the innovative Polaris engine, and an expanding suite of AI-powered products like CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational, analyst-style planning support.

With AI revolutionizing software development, we are embracing more generated code and autonomous changes, making the need for encoded, verifiable guardrails more critical than ever. Security is woven into the fabric of how our platform evolves, rather than treated as an afterthought. Join our small, dynamic team where your contributions to automation will set the gold standard!

What you'll do

* Automate across the pipeline: build security automation into CI/CD and the broader SDLC so that controls run as code.
* Leverage AI to scale security automation: harness AI and LLM-assisted tools to speed up control development, triage, and remediation, extending automated coverage beyond what traditional scripts can achieve.
* Implement policy-as-code: encode guardrails for dependency and package policies, secrets, and configurations so they enforce themselves effortlessly.
* Build the controlled-repository model: automate the restriction of external dependencies and provide safe, approved package paths for our engineers.
* Automate secrets management and detection: ensure mishandled or leaked secrets are automatically caught and managed without the need for manual sweeps.
* Reduce standing privilege: develop automation for least privilege and just-in-time access, making persistent access the exception rather than the rule.
* Tame scanner output: integrate detection into low-noise, actionable workflows that feed remediation, preventing overwhelming flood of alerts.
* Automate attack-surface hardening: drive the creation of hardened, golden images and enforce baselines through code.
* Make controls self-service: default to providing engineers with a paved path wherever it’s safe to do so, rather than imposing unnecessary gates.

What we're looking for

* Strong automation and engineering skills, particularly in languages such as Python or Go, along with expertise in infrastructure-as-code and pipeline work.
* In-depth knowledge of DevSecOps: CI/CD security and hands-on experience with policy-as-code using tools like OPA, Conftest, or Kyverno.
* Foundational understanding of cloud-native security, particularly in Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider, along with knowledge of secrets management and identity basics.
* A builder's instinct: you create tools that engineers love because they simplify their work.
* Genuine care for developer experience, always striving to reduce friction rather than adding unnecessary barriers.
* The discernment to identify which controls are truly worth encoding and which can be set aside.

Nice to have

* Experience with supply-chain security: understanding of provenance and signing, as well as software or model bills of materials.
* Familiarity with zero-trust and least-privilege automation, including just-in-time access.
* Experience working in a regulated, enterprise environment.
* Contributions to open-source security tooling or relevant certifications.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled

in accordance with

assist

our team in evaluating qualifications.

Interpret.

The Consumer Science and Product Intelligence (CSPI) Wellness India Senior Scientist role is a strategic and operational role that ensures we put the Consumer First, Always in everything we do. The role leads consumer science and product intelligence for the Wellness portfolio in India, partnering across R&D, Category, Innovation and Commercial teams to develop, deliver and review innovations and in-market products so they win with consumers at the point of purchase and throughout the usage experience, delivering meaningful and noticeable superiority.
  
  
Critical elements of the role are:
  
  

* Provide insights and evidence that enable consumer-led Wellness innovations that deliver meaningful and noticeable superiority.
* Champion the “Consumer First, Always” approach for Wellness India from early insight and prototype development through claims support, launch and post-launch review.
* Lead consumer and product intelligence for Wellness India to guide product, portfolio, claims, communication and renovation decisions.
* Build a clear understanding of the India Wellness landscape, including competitors, product performance, consumer reviews, complaints, claims evidence and emerging format trends.
* Translate global category strategies into locally relevant India execution, while using local insights to influence global innovation decisions.
* Bring actionable local consumer and product insights to Category teams and wider R&D, partnering with CBIA where appropriate.
* Drive faster, better innovation using ideal product models and evidence-based product narratives through the stage-gate process.
* Ensure consumer testing in India is compliant, fit for purpose and aligned with agreed work processes.
* Partner with Category, Innovation, Commercial, R&D and Medical & Scientific Affairs to focus CSPI resources on high-impact opportunities and develop consumer-relevant claims, demos, visualisations and communications.
* Use evidence to support prioritisation and deploy Wellness India CSPI resources where they can most improve consumer choice, usage and repeat purchase.

**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
E2E Consumer Science for Wellness India
  
  

* Select and apply fit-for-purpose consumer science, product research and sensory methods according to each project’s decision, risk and value.
* Deliver consumer and product evidence to identify superiority, guide product design, support claims, and create compelling product stories and visualisations versus competition
* Develop and apply leading-edge testing methods, including AI- and digitally enabled tools, to improve decision speed and deliver noticeable, meaningful product superiority.
* Lead end-to-end consumer evidence delivery from early need definition and prototype learning through formulation lock, launch and post-launch optimisation.
* Validate non-clinical claims with consumers using robust qualitative and quantitative research.
* Conduct post-launch reviews, monitor complaints and use insights to improve India Wellness products.
* Track emerging trends through social listening, market signals and product intelligence to guide pipeline and portfolio decisions.

Integrated Product Experience and Insight Generation
  
  

* Integrate consumer research, product performance, complaints, reviews, commercial signals and competitor benchmarking into unified product intelligence that guides India Wellness decisions.
* Build understanding of what drives trial, usage, repeat purchase and priority product formats in India.
* Identify consumer jobs to be done, usage occasions and unmet needs with Category CSPI to inform superior product design.
* Partner with Sensory Scientists to integrate sensory-panel and consumer evidence into clear product-design decisions.

Product Intelligence
  
  

* Maintain a clear, evidence-based view of the India Wellness product landscape in partnership with Category CSPI.
* Lead product benchmarking to identify where Haleon products are superior, at parity or exposed versus competitors.
* Translate benchmarking into recommendations on where to renovate, defend, premiumise, simplify or avoid over-investment.
* Identify product and experience gaps that could improve consumer choice, usage, repeat purchase and business outcomes.

Capability, Governance and Collaboration
  
  

* Build and share Consumer Science & Product Intelligence best practices and capabilities.
* Champion consumer closeness and coach R&D colleagues outside CSPI in consumer-led decision making.
* Ensure consumer interactions comply with the Human Subject Testing Policy and all quality and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate directly with R&D, CBIA and Marketing teams to deliver decisions effectively in a matrixed environment.

**Why you?**
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* BSc degree or equivalent in an appropriate subject.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience, preferably within FMCG/CPG or Healthcare.
* Appropriate specialisations include Chemistry, Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Physics, Mathematics, Sensory Science, Food Science, Biochemistry or Biological Science.
* Preferred: MSc degree in an appropriate scientific discipline. Essential Capabilities
* Broad experience across consumer science, product research, sensory/product experience, claims evidence and product intelligence, with the ability to select fit-for-purpose approaches.
* Connect consumer science and product intelligence to clear business outcomes and growth.
* Lead through cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders.
* Turn complex priorities and evidence into simple, practical recommendations.
* Shape product, portfolio, claims and communication decisions with strong evidence and judgement.
* Apply commercial judgement and integrate multiple data sources into clear, actionable insights.
* Develop and embed novel methodologies that deliver business impact.
* Demonstrate strong analytical, strategic, communication and change-leadership skills.
* Experience across qualitative and quantitative research, consumer modelling, consumer need definition, product validation and claims substantiation.
* Commercially savvy, entrepreneurial and collaborative, with experience independently leading research programmes and solving problems in a matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Ability to problem solve
* Scientific expertise
* Project management experience
* Experience analyzing data
* Ability to influence others

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

title: Analyst
description:
Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI-first world. We bring deep expertise across eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product and AI, and are building technology-enabled learning experiences for higher education and enterprise learning.

As a Analyst, you will work at the intersection of Product, Data, AI and Learning. You will contribute to the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences, while using product and learner insights to identify opportunities and drive better product decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, understanding user behaviour and translating insights into impactful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Work on the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences across higher education and enterprise learning.

• Partner with business, academic and technology teams to identify product opportunities and define clear problem statements.

• Analyse product usage data, learner behaviour and engagement metrics to uncover insights and guide product decisions.

• Work closely with Product Managers to prioritize features, define success metrics and track outcomes for ongoing and new initiatives.

• Conduct structured research, competitive benchmarking and user feedback analysis to identify improvement areas in the learning experience.

• Support end-to-end execution of pilot launches, A/B testing and post-launch analysis for new features or program modules.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that communicate product performance, trends and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Content and Design teams to ensure seamless delivery of high-quality learner experiences.

**What We're Looking For**

• 1-3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or a similar analytical role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product insights.

• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL.

• Strong understanding of product metrics, data analysis and experimentation.

• Ability to analyse user behaviour and product data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

• Strong interest in AI/ML, LLMs and AI-powered products.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• High ownership, curiosity and attention to detail.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and cross-functional environment.

**Why Join Us?**

**• Build AI-powered Education -**
Work on AI-powered products shaping the future of higher education and enterprise learning.

**• High-Growth Learning Environment -**
Work in a fast-scaling organization where ownership, innovation and excellence are valued.

**• Cross-Functional Exposure -**
Work closely with Business, Product, AI, Engineering, Content, Design and Academic teams.

**• Accelerated Career Growth -**
Take ownership of high-impact projects and build expertise across Product, AI and Learning.

**• Make a Meaningful Impact -**
Contribute to products designed to improve learning experiences and outcomes for thousands of learners.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.

We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.
