We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Builds domain knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of relevant tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Databricks or similar enterprise data platforms) to act more independently
* Stays up to date about emerging analytics technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve ways of working

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs
* Experience working in a corporate environment
* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.
* Experience with support platforms like ServiceNow is preferred

title: UX Manager – AI-Native Products
description: INCEDO · JOB DESCRIPTION UX Manager – AI-Native Products (Conversational & Agentic Interfaces )LEVEL -Manager (player-coach) TEAM -Products & Platforms EXPERIENCE 10–14 yearsABOUT THE ROLE Incedo’s Products & Platforms team builds AI-native products for enterprise clients. Our users ask questions in natural language, review what the AI finds and recommends, and decide what to act on. You’ll set the design direction for that experience and lead a senior UI/UX designer. This is a player-coach role: most of your time goes into hands-on design. WHAT YOU’LL DO • Set the interaction model for our AI-native products: when to use conversation, when to use structured UI, and how the two combine across dashboards, workspaces and agent workflows. • Design trust into every AI output, including sources and provenance, confidence and uncertainty, explanations an expert can check, and approval steps before an agent acts. • Personally own the hardest flows end to end, from research and concepts through prototypes built on live model outputs to shipped product. • Build and govern the design system, including AI patterns for streaming and partial results, latency, errors and refusals, multi-turn context, undo and handoff to a human. • Set up a research and quality practice: regular usability testing, feedback loops from real usage, and UX metrics for AI features that guide priorities with product. • Lead and grow the senior UI/UX designer, set the quality bar and critique practice, partner with product, engineering and data science, and shape the demos we put in front of client executives. WHAT YOU BRING • 10–14 years in UI/UX design, including 3+ years leading design for complex B2B or enterprise products, and at least one AI-powered product (assistant, copilot or agent) that you shipped and then improved based on real usage. • A demonstrated point of view on AI interaction design: when conversation helps and when it gets in the way, how much autonomy an agent should have, and how to show uncertainty without eroding trust. • Deep conversation design: context across turns, disambiguation, repair when the model misunderstands, and response guidelines for tone, length and structure. • Agentic and trust patterns for high-stakes work: plan previews, approval gates, undo and rollback, audit trails, and explanations experts can verify quickly. • Experience measuring AI experiences through task success, time to answer, correction and override rates, and qualitative trust signals. • Design-system leadership: tokens, components and patterns adopted across multiple products or teams, built to WCAG 2.2 AA by default. • Senior-level hands-on craft in visual and interaction design for data-dense screens, and in prototyping with live model outputs; expert in Figma or equivalent tools. • A portfolio of case studies showing framing, trade-offs and outcomes, including what didn’t work and what you changed.

title: Growth Marketeer at Zoop (Backed by Peak XV)
description:
**Location:**

Chhatarpur, New Delhi

**Work Mode:**

Work From Office

**Experience:**

3+ years

**Website:**
https://zooplive.com

**About Zoop**

Zoop is a live commerce platform where shoppers discover and buy trendy and branded lifestyle products through live drops and auctions. It's shopping that feels like an event, not a catalogue scroll.

Zoop is backed by Peak XV and Lumikai and built by a founding team obsessed with how India shops. Our vision is to build India's defining live shopping destination: a platform where the best deals feel like entertainment.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a customer-obsessed Growth Marketeer to own how Zoop finds, wins and keeps its first wave of loyal shoppers. You'll use consumer insight and user psychology to drive signups, live viewership, conversion and repeat purchase. You'll test fast across paid, community, creator and organic channels and turn what works into a repeatable growth engine. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role that works directly with the founders, and it can grow into owning the revenue and P&L.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop a deep understanding of who our shoppers are, what makes them tune into a live drop, and what makes them bid and buy.
* Run customer research such as calls, surveys and live-session behaviour analysis, and turn it into sharper positioning, messaging and offers.
* Own acquisition across Meta ads, creator and UGC programs, Reddit and Whatsapp channels, and improve CAC and ROAS over time.
* Build the funnel end to end, from first touch to signup, app install, first live, first purchase and repeat.
* Drive initiatives that lift live concurrency, conversion rates, average order value and customer lifetime value.
* Analyse campaign performance, cohorts and funnel metrics (we use PostHog) to make fast, evidence-based decisions.
* Work with product, content, creators and the live-ops team to design campaigns.
* Work with founders to set growth targets, prioritise experiments and shape the buyer-side strategy.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* 3–6 years of experience in Growth, Performance, Consumer or Brand Marketing.
* Experience at a consumer app, marketplace, D2C brand, social commerce platform or high-growth startup.
* Strong grasp of consumer psychology and the behaviour of Indian shoppers, especially in fashion or deals.
* Hands-on with Meta ads and comfortable running creator, community or WhatsApp-led growth.
* A data-driven mindset and comfort with funnels, cohorts and experiment design.
* Clear communication and the ability to work across functions.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and a hunger to own outcomes, not just tasks.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A steadily growing base of engaged shoppers who show up for lives.
* Better CAC, ROAS and signup-to-purchase conversion.
* Clear understanding of our core customer segments and what drives them to buy and come back.
* Strong repeat-purchase and retention cohorts.
* A scalable, documented growth playbook that the team can build on.

**Why This Is a Rare 0→1 Opportunity**

Most growth roles hand you a mature funnel and ask you to squeeze out a few more percentage points. This one doesn't. Zoop is at the stage where the playbook hasn't been written yet, and you'll be the one writing it.

* **You'll shape a new category in India.**

  Live shopping is already huge in China and the US but still early here. You get to define how India discovers, trusts and buys through live commerce.
* **You'll build from zero to one.**

  You'll help find our first truly loyal customers, crack our core acquisition channels and turn early traction into a repeatable growth engine.

**Why Join Us?**

* Help build the next big consumer platform in India from the ground up.
* Work closely with the founders and leadership, backed by top-tier investors (Peak XV, Lumikai).
* Long-term wealth creation through ESOP participation.
* A high-ownership, high-impact role in a fast-moving team.

* Build search and content growth through keyword clusters, search-intent frameworks, topical authority programs, and pillar-cluster content models tied to measurable commercial outcomes such as traffic, leads, and conversions
* Execute AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategies to improve brand visibility, citations, and representation across AI-powered search, answer engines, and emerging discovery platforms

* Plan go-to-market efforts for new regions and markets through SEO and content, identifying priority markets, keyword opportunity, and competitive gaps
* Track, analyze, and report performance using analytics tools, translating data into clear business impact and actionable recommendations
* Stay ahead of Google Core Updates, E-E-A-T, Helpful Content guidelines, and emerging AI-search behavior, adapting strategy proactively
* Collaborate cross-functionally with content, design, business, PR, and software teams.

**Requirements:**

* 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience with a track record of measurable organic growth results
* Proven experience managing SEO across multiple regions, specifically India and EMEA markets
* Strong knowledge of Google ranking factors, algorithm updates, and current SEO best practices
* Hands-on proficiency with SEO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Screaming Frog
* Solid grounding in technical SEO, including site audits, crawl and indexation troubleshooting, structured data, and working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and website architecture
* Strong command of content strategy, including keyword research, search-intent mapping, topical authority building, and pillar-cluster planning
* Working understanding of AEO and GEO principles and how content is surfaced, cited, and represented in AI-powered and generative search experiences
* Ability to read performance data and turn it into prioritized, business-relevant recommendations rather than just reporting metrics
* Clear, confident communicator who can align content, design, and engineering teams around an SEO roadmap without needing constant hand-holding

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4-8 years of experience in
  **SEO, Organic Growth, and Content Marketing**
* Experience applying local SEO, international SEO, and e-commerce SEO
* Experience in the events, entertainment, or experiential marketing industry is a plus
* Relevant certifications such as Google Analytics, SEMrush Academy, Ahrefs Academy, or HubSpot
* Demonstrated experience navigating a Google Core Update or major algorithm shift and adjusting strategy accordingly

title: Direct Response Copywriter | Coaches, Consultants & Advisors
description:
**Direct Response Copywriter | Coaches, Consultants & Advisors**

Hybrid | Delhi | ₹50,000 to ₹60,000 per month (depending upon skillset and experience)

**Who we are:**

We’re a premium lead generation agency for coaches, consultants, and advisors. We run paid ads and organic brand building under one roof, so our clients get booked calls and revenue, not just views.

We don’t write for brands. We write for experts who sell themselves. That’s a different craft.

**The role:**

You’ll own the copy behind our clients’ ads and landing pages. You write it, you test it, and you decide what a page should look like to convert better.

Anyone can write a script. We want someone who looks at an ad and knows why the headline works, why that color is wrong, and why the banner is losing the click.

**What you’ll do:**

* Write ad copy and ad scripts (video, static, carousel) for coaches, consultants, and advisors
* Build and ship landing pages fast, using Claude, ChatGPT, or whatever tools get it live
* Choose the copy, banner, color palette, and layout that will convert, and explain why
* Study what’s running in our clients’ markets and turn it into new angles
* Work with our performance team on test plans. You’ll read results and rewrite based on what the data says
* Listen to client calls and sales conversations and pull out the exact language their buyers use
* Rework AI drafts by hand until they sound like a real person talking
* Move quickly. We’d rather test five versions this week than polish one for a month

**What we’re looking for:**

* Strong grounding in copywriting as a skill: hooks, offers, objections, positioning, CTAs
* Proven experience writing ads and scripts for individuals and creators (coaches, consultants, advisors), not brands
* Real comfort with AI tools, plus the taste to know when the output is mid and fix it manually
* A sharp eye for design that converts: color, hierarchy, banners, page flow
* Excellent observation and listening skills. You catch what the client says, what the customer says, and what they mean
* Curiosity about performance: you care what happened after the ad went live
* Senior-level ownership. You don’t need hand-holding, and you push back when something won’t work

**Good signs:**

* You’ve written for lead gen funnels, webinars, or application-based offers
* You’ve shipped landing pages yourself
* You can show a before and after with a result attached

**What you get:**

* Hybrid setup: 2 to 3 days a week at our coworking space in [Delhi / Chandigarh], rest from home
* Direct access to the founders and to live ad accounts
* Room to grow into a lead role on the creative side
* Referral bonuses.
* Financial support for online courses/masterminds/webinars.
* Employee engagement activities and gatherings.
* Access to best in class trainings / courses / tools to upskill and 10x productivity

**Our Agency's Core Values:**

* Ownership is the foundation of everything we do.
* First-principles thinking drives our problem-solving approach.
* We are disciplined and uphold a strong work ethic.
* Decisions are data-driven, never based on whims or guesses.
* We cultivate optimism—pessimists have no space here.
* Procrastination isn’t in our DNA.
* And, we have a deep passion for art and the artist

title: COMMUNITY MANAGER (FOREX TRADING)
description:
**\*JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are looking for a passionate and proactive COMMUNITY MANAGER to lead our Discord channel at FXStreet. This is a pivotal, hands-on role: you will build the community from zero and own what it becomes. Your primary focus will be to launch, grow, and protect this community, turning conversation into retention and organic product adoption.

We're looking for a COMMUNITY MANAGER and ACTIVE TRADER who understands the markets from the inside and knows how traders behave online, who thrives on building authentic engagement, and has a keen eye for sparking meaningful conversations. 

As our COMMUNITY MANAGER you will be the authentic voice and insightful ears of FXStreet within our Discord community, fostering a vibrant, engaged, and trustworthy space for traders.

**\*ROLE TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1-Community Launch & Engagement**

* Own the Discord community launch end-to-end: channel structure, roles, permissions..
* Be present throughout the trading week, run recurring formats, and promote active members into moderator and contributor roles.
* Design and launch a loyalty program that rewards engagement and retention within the channel.
* Promote FXStreet's key products organically and naturally within conversations, without turning the channel into an ads feed.

**2-Moderation & Trust**

* Write and enforce house rules, define entry and posting requirements, and document escalation paths before they are needed.
* Manage the community through negative moments, including when the market moves against a public call.

**3-Content & Analyst Collaboration**

* Schedule and host regular sessions with our analysts, and turn published analysis into conversation that members carry on themselves.
* Run live community activity around high-impact market events, scheduled against the economic calendar.

**4-Monitoring & Reporting**

* Monitor community engagement and sentiment, and report regularly on what is working and what is not.
* Bring member feedback back to the product team, acting as the closest link between users and the company.

**\*DESIRED PROFILE**

* Proven Trading experience, hands-on trading experience on your own account (a funded account, or a prop firm challenge) with a solid understanding of trading instruments, leverage, and risk management.
* Experience managing an online community, ideally on Discord and for a trading, finance, or prop firm brand.
* Education in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is a plus.
* Hands-on Discord administration: roles, permissions, verification, bots, and moderation
* Experience with other community platforms such as Reddit, WhatsApp, or Telegram
* Familiarity with community analytics, engagement reporting, and scheduling or publishing tools.
* Exceptional English communication Skills (written and verbal)
* Proactive, empathetic, calm under pressure, organized, and a strong sense of ownership.

**\*JOB CONDITIONS**

* Full time Freelance collaboration agreement
* 100% remote work
* 40h/week (from Monday to Friday)
* Working time hours depending on candidate's country home (in accordance with live coverage of high-impact market events )
* Fixed annual salary
* Paid 15 days holiday leave and other social benefits
* Direct collaboration with FXStreet's analyst desk, product, and data teams.
* Opportunity to build a trader community from zero and own what it becomes.
* Collaborative and international team environment

title: Growth Marketer
description:
**About Trademo**

Trademo is an AI-native platform for global trade management and intelligence. It helps enterprises stay compliant with global trade regulations, optimize tariffs, uncover new business opportunities, and discover qualified suppliers.

Its proprietary global trade data foundation spans tariffs, customs, import-export controls, corporate ownership, sanctions, PEPs, AIS connectivity, and 3.5 billion shipment records, powering TrademoKG, the company’s proprietary knowledge graph. Purpose-built AI agents automate critical workflows across trade compliance, classification, prospecting, and supplier discovery.

Trademo was founded in 2020 by Shalabh Singhal, a third-time entrepreneur and alumnus of IIT BHU, the CFA Institute, and Stanford GSB Seed. The company has raised $12.5 million in seed funding from Amit Singhal, former SVP at Google; Sridhar Ramaswamy, CEO of Snowflake; Neeraj Arora, former Chief Business Officer at WhatsApp; and Saama Capital.

**Role Overview**

As a Growth Marketing Specialist, you will own the demand generation engine at Trademo. You will be responsible for driving qualified pipeline through targeted account programs, lifecycle email marketing, events, and structured growth experiments. This role sits at the intersection of sales and marketing, and requires someone who can move from strategy to execution without losing either. You will also own marketing operations and reporting, ensuring leadership always has visibility into what is working and what is not.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end ABM execution: define target account lists in coordination with sales, build account-specific campaigns, track engagement signals, and influence pipeline at the account level
* Build and manage Trademo's lifecycle email program, including onboarding sequences, nurture flows tied to firmographic signals, and re-engagement campaigns
* Own Trademo's events calendar end to end: webinars, trade shows, and industry roundtables, from logistics and speaker coordination to post-event follow-up sequences that convert attendance into pipeline
* Run structured growth experiments across channels and programs; document learnings, kill what does not move the needle, and scale what does
* Own the marketing tech stack including email platform, CRM integration, and ABM tooling; maintain clean data hygiene and lead scoring logic
* Build and manage weekly and monthly reporting dashboards tracking MQLs, pipeline influenced, email performance, account engagement, and event ROI
* Own the lead handoff process between marketing and sales, ensuring clear qualification criteria and consistent follow-through

**Ideal Candidate**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, preferably in SaaS, data, or intelligence products
* Hands-on with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot or Marketo, and comfortable working within a CRM
* Familiar with ABM principles and at least one approach to account-level targeting, whether tool-driven or LinkedIn-native
* Strong with data: can build a reporting dashboard, interpret funnel metrics, and make channel decisions based on numbers
* Good writer who can draft email copy, event landing pages, and account-specific messaging independently
* Thrives in a fast-moving environment and does not need perfect clarity to start executing.

title: Content Creator and Strategist at Zoop (Backed by Peak XV)
description:
**Location:**

Chhatarpur, New Delhi

**Work Mode:**

Work From Office

**Experience:**

2+ years

**Website:**
zooplive.com

**About Zoop**

Zoop is a live commerce platform where shoppers discover and buy trendy and branded lifestyle products through live drops and auctions. It's shopping that feels like an event, not a catalogue scroll.

Zoop is backed by Peak XV and Lumikai and built by a founding team obsessed with how India shops. Our vision is to build India's defining live shopping destination: a platform where the best deals feel like entertainment.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Gen Z Content Creator & Strategist who can think it, write it and shoot it. You'll own the creative that powers Zoop's growth: high-converting Meta ads, influencer campaigns and UGC that make people stop scrolling, tune into a live drop and buy.

You'll come up with the ideas, write the scripts, shoot content yourself and brief and manage the creators who shoot the rest. You'll live on Instagram, spot trends before they peak and turn them into content that performs. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role, and it can grow into leading Zoop's content and creative function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop a deep understanding of Zoop's shoppers: what grabs their attention, what makes them tune into a live drop, and what makes them bid and buy.
* Own the creative pipeline for paid ads: generate ideas, write scripts and hooks, and deliver a steady flow of Meta ad creatives (Reels, Stories, statics and carousels) built to convert.
* Write sharp, scroll-stopping scripts for ads, influencer integrations, UGC and organic content, and keep a constant bank of fresh scripting ideas and angles.
* Shoot and edit content yourself: on-phone UGC-style videos, product showcases, unboxings, hauls, reactions.
* Source, brief and manage influencers and UGC creators end to end, from scripts and short lists to feedback, timelines and final delivery.
* Track Instagram memes and trends, and turn the right ones into Zoop content fast.
* Work with the growth team to test hooks, angles, formats and creators, read ad performance (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and double down on what works.
* Build a library of winning hooks, scripts and creative learnings that the team can reuse and scale.
* Work with the founders, growth, product and live-ops teams to plan campaigns around drops, auctions and launches.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* Super comfortable working with AI to generate creatives. We use AI to experiment with creatives, while we don’t appreciate AI slop scripts and copy.
* 2-4 years of experience in content creation and performance creative generation.
* Experience at a consumer tech company, or D2C brand .
* Proven track record of making Meta ad content that drove results. Should be prepared to share examples and the numbers behind them.
* Strong scriptwriting skills, with a knack for hooks and a never-ending supply of content ideas.
* Comfortable on both sides of the camera: shooting, directing and editing content yourself (CapCut, InShot, Premiere or similar).
* Lives on Instagram and knows what's trending, what's dated and why something works.
* A strong grasp of Indian shoppers, especially in fashion, lifestyle and deals.
* Comfort using performance data to judge creative quality and decide what to make next.
* Fluency in English and Hindi, and the ability to write in the voice of Indian internet culture (Hinglish).
* An entrepreneurial mindset and a hunger to own outcomes, not just tasks.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A steady, high-volume flow of ad creatives, with clear winners that scale.
* Better hook rates, CTR, CPA and ROAS on Meta, driven by stronger creative.
* A reliable bench of influencers and UGC creators who deliver on brief and on time.
* Zoop content that feels native to Instagram and gets people to show up for lives.
* A documented creative playbook of winning hooks, scripts, formats and learnings that the team can build on.

**Why This Is a Rare 0→1 Opportunity**

Most content roles hand you a brand book and a calendar and ask you to fill it. This one doesn't. Zoop is at the stage where the creative playbook hasn't been written yet, and you'll be the one writing it.

**You'll shape a new category in India.**

Live shopping is already huge in China and the US but still early here. You get to define how live commerce looks, sounds and feels to Indian shoppers.

**You'll build from zero to one.**

You'll find the hooks, formats and creators that work for Zoop and turn them into a repeatable creative engine.

**You'll learn at startup speed.**

Ads go live and drops run every day, so you see how your content performs within hours, not quarters. Few roles let you test this many ideas this fast.

**You'll have a seat at the table.**

You'll work directly with the founders on strategy, not just execution, with a clear path to leading content and creative as we scale.

**The work will be on your résumé for a long time.**

Being part of the founding team of the next big consumer platform in India is the kind of experience that defines a career.

﻿

**Why Join Us?**

* Help build the next big consumer platform in India from the ground up.
* Work closely with the founders and leadership, backed by top-tier investors (Peak XV, Lumikai).
* A high-ownership, high-impact role in a fast-moving team.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
description: About the RoleWe are looking for a highly organised, analytical and execution-oriented person to work closely with the Founder as part of the Founder’s Office.This is not a conventional Executive Assistant role.The person will act as an extension of the Founder — helping track priorities, follow up with teams, structure information, solve operational problems, prepare analyses and ensure that important decisions and tasks actually move from discussion to execution.The role will sit at the intersection of business operations, execution, MIS, project tracking and executive support.You should be comfortable moving between a founder discussion, an Excel sheet, a team follow-up, a business analysis and an operational problem — often on the same day.What You Will Own1. Founder’s Priorities & Execution TrackingMaintain a clear view of the Founder’s key priorities, commitments and pending actions.Convert discussions and decisions into clearly defined tasks, owners and deadlines.Track progress across functions and ensure commitments are followed through.Proactively follow up with team members rather than waiting for updates.Identify delayed, blocked or at-risk tasks and escalate them to the Founder with context.Maintain weekly and monthly execution trackers.Prepare concise updates for the Founder on:What is completedWhat is pendingWhat is delayedWhat requires interventionWhat needs a decisionThe expectation is not merely to maintain a tracker, but to make sure the work gets done.2. Executive / Founder SupportAct as an extension of the Founder in day-to-day execution.This may include:Managing and organising the Founder’s action items.Preparing meeting agendas and capturing decisions.Maintaining a follow-up list after meetings.Coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders.Preparing briefing notes, summaries and background information before important meetings.Following up on commitments made by the Founder or to the Founder.Helping prioritise competing requirements.Ensuring important information reaches the Founder in a clear and usable format.Handling selected correspondence, coordination and scheduling requirements.The role will require judgement and ownership, not just administrative support.3. Business MIS & Performance TrackingBuild and maintain a simple, reliable view of business performance.Depending on the business requirement, this could include:Sales and revenue trackingStore performanceE-commerce performanceInventory and stockHiring and manpowerMarketing performanceKey project statusFinancial / operational metricsDepartment-wise targets and progressResponsibilities include:Collecting information from relevant owners.Validating data and identifying inconsistencies.Maintaining dashboards / MIS reports.Tracking targets versus actuals.Highlighting trends, gaps and exceptions.Preparing concise management reports.The objective is to help the Founder see what is happening in the business without having to chase information from multiple people.4. Cross-Functional Project ManagementTake ownership of selected business projects from start to completion.For example:Implementing a new process or systemSetting up a new dashboardImproving an existing workflowOpening / setting up a new storeHiring for a critical positionVendor / partner coordinationProcess documentationCost optimisation initiativesNew business initiativesFor every project, you will be expected to define:Objective → Action Items → Owner → Deadline → Status → Blocker → Next StepYou will coordinate with the relevant people and ensure that projects keep moving.5. Problem Solving & Business AnalysisSupport the Founder in answering business questions through structured analysis.Examples:Why are sales declining in a particular store/channel?Which categories are performing or underperforming?Where are operational bottlenecks?What is causing a recurring process issue?Which vendor / option is commercially better?What is the impact of a proposed business decision?Where can costs or time be saved?What information should be tracked going forward?You should be comfortable taking an ambiguous question and turning it into:Problem → Data / Information → Analysis → Options → Recommendation → Action6. Process & Systems ImprovementIdentify repetitive, inefficient or unclear processes and help improve them.This could involve:Mapping existing processesIdentifying gaps and bottlenecksCreating SOPs and checklistsImproving reporting systemsAutomating repetitive reporting where possibleCreating standard trackersImproving information flow between teamsEnsuring accountability and ownershipYou do not need to be a technical developer, but you should be comfortable with systems, data and technology.7. Team Coordination & AccountabilityWork closely with functional heads and team members to ensure execution.This includes:Regularly following up on open items.Collecting updates from owners.Understanding reasons for delays.Helping unblock dependencies.Escalating issues when required.Maintaining accountability without becoming a bottleneck.Ensuring decisions made by leadership are communicated and acted upon.The role requires someone who is comfortable asking:“What is the status?”“What is blocking this?”“Who owns the next step?”“When will this be closed?”What We Are Looking ForMust HaveStrong analytical and problem-solving ability.Excellent organisation and follow-through.Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.Ability to work with data and MIS.Strong written and verbal communication.Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.High ownership and accountability.Strong attention to detail.Ability to work independently with limited supervision.Comfort working directly with senior leadership / founders.Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into structured action plans.

○ Implement and enforce operational policies and procedures to ensure consistency across all sites.

○ Manage facility maintenance and ensure compliance with health and safety regulations. ○ Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to operations and customer satisfaction.

**Financial Management:**

title: Quality Control (QC) – Culling Expert
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
  
  
From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
  
  
We’re a fast-growing, passionate team backed over 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
  
  
Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
  
  
If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role focuses on
**quality, critique, and real-world photography workflows**
.
  
  
As a QC, you will review labelled data and AI outputs inside the Aftershoot app, evaluating them from a photographer’s perspective. You’ll help identify gaps between what photographers expect and what the product currently delivers.
  
  
If you’ve used multiple photography tools and enjoy giving thoughtful, structured feedback on image selections and product behaviour, this role is for you.
  
  
**💼 What you’ll do:**

* Perform quality checks on labelled datasets and flag errors or inconsistencies
* Review AI culling outputs within the Aftershoot app
* Critique selections from a photographer’s point of view
* Identify edge cases, failure patterns, and quality gaps
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve labelling standards
* Share suggestions to improve product behaviour and culling logic
* Collaborate with ML and Product teams to align outputs with real photographer workflows

**🫂What You’ll Bring**

* Professional photography experience or deep hands-on usage of photography tools
* Strong understanding of real-world photography workflows
* Experience using other culling or editing tools (Lightroom, Photo Mechanic, etc.)
* Ability to critique image selections and explain why something works or doesn’t
* Strong attention to detail and structured thinking
* Comfort working from the Delhi office on a full time basis

**What happens after you apply?**

title: Manager/SM- Consumer Insight
description:
**Manager/Senior Manager: Consumer Insights (AI-First)**

**About Urban Compan**
y

Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.

Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -

* Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
* Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
* Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry.

**About the Role**

Urban Company is at the scale where every category decision - a pricing change, a new SKU or a change to the consumer journey moves meaningful NTV. Sharp research is our muscle that sets those decisions up for success. And the industry itself is being rewritten: consumer studies that took weeks now take days with AI moderators and synthesis; pricing studies that needed 400 CATI interviews can be run end-to-end with AI calling.

We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager - Research who can do two things at o
**nce**
. One, run the research engine across category research as an independent opera
**tor.**
Two, reimagine how that engine works in an AI-first world - building the tooling, ops automation and operating model that lets a lean research function punch far above its weight.

This is a solo IC role today. There is no layer between you and agencies or the category & business leaders. You will own and scale the practice.

**What you'll own**

* **Consumer research**
  : Usage & attitude studies, customer journey mapping, agile qual + quant studies that inform real-time service, ops and category decisions across UC's range of services & produts (InstaHelp, Native, Beauty, Cleaning, AC, Revamp and more)

  earch: Brand health tracking, funnel drop-off insights. The go-to research partner for brand and marketing
* **Category & market res**
  earch: Market/occasion sizing, competitive intelligence, pricing studies, new SKU/category validation. The person category leaders pull in when they need an evidence base for a bet.
* **UC's AI-first research pra**
  ctice: Build the infrastructure, tooling and ways of working that let UC operate research at 5x the speed and scale of an industry-standard setup.
* **AI-led primary research**
  : qual + quant consumer insights via AI moderation (already in practice), pricing studies via AI calling + synthesis
* **Research ops automa**
  tion: auto-generated discussion guides from study objectives, automated data cleaning and quality flags, sample size recommendations driven by hypothesis/objectives/answers needed.
* **Internal AI to**
  oling: Custom GPTs / agentic workflows that synthesize multiple data inputs (e.g. consumer support tickets, NPS data, app/playstore reviews) to put structured research self-service in the hands of category and brand teams.

**How you'll operate**

You will own the agency ecosystem end-to-end: scoping, briefing, costing, QA, insights to final business recommendations. You will sit close to marketing & business leaders, translate fuzzy questions into sharp research questions, and come back with actionable, evidence-based business recommendations, not just findings or insights.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-haves**

* **Expe**
  rience: 4-8 years of research experience (consumer / brand / market) at a research agency, strategy consultancy, or in-house at a consumer or internet company. Level (Manager vs Sr Manager) will be calibrated to the candidate.
* **Foundationa**
  l craft: strong in qual and quant methodologies, sample design, questionnaire design, statistical literacy. You know a leading question or a biased sample from a mile away.
* **Demonstrably inde**
  pendent: Have run multi-stakeholder research programs end-to-end with minimal oversight: owned the agency relationship, not just attended the presentation.
* **Comfortable presenting to senior business stak**
  eholders and pushing back when the data says one thing and institutional intuition says another.
* **Genuine, hands-on enthusiasm for AI in r**
  esearc
  *h: Have bui*
  lt with AI tools vs. having read about them/used AI in an ad-hoc fashion. You bring a point of view on where AI replaces, augments, or fails in research.
* **Owner’s**
  mindset: Comfortable shipping/iterating in the open & collaborating with teams.

**Good to have**

* Experience in a consumer internet, services or D2C business.
* Familiarity with the India research partner landscape (quant + qual) and the ability to manage the entire relationship end to end.

**Why take this role**

* **Greenfield AI-firs**
  t mandate: Most research jobs in India are still wired around 2018 ways of working. This one explicitly isn't.
* **High autonomy &**
  ownership: You'll have ownership & visibility that typically comes two levels up.
* **Scale & breadth of problem s**
  tatements: UC runs millions of services a year across India and international markets. The decisions your research informs are consequential.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Security Operations Analyst will support build out of our internal capability and partner closely with our outsourced SOC provider. This role focuses on incident response coordination, security monitoring, vulnerability management and remediation oversight, helping to strengthen our overall security posture through effective operational processes and active stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
You’ll play a vital role in ensuring we meet both our internal security obligations and the high expectations of our financial services clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the in-house lead for escalations from our third-party MDR/SOC, supporting triage, investigation of alerts from the SIEM, EDR and cloud security tooling (Rapid7 InsightIDR, AWS GuardDuty/CloudTrail), and coordination of incident response
* Investigate security alerts across endpoint, identity, network and cloud environments, correlating available evidence to determine severity, business impact and appropriate response actions.
* Analyse Windows and identity-related security events, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos and NTLM authentication activity, and coordinate investigation and remediation with relevant technical teams.
* Review network security events involving TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common enterprise protocols, identifying suspicious behaviour and recommending appropriate follow-up actions.
* Escalate confirmed or complex incidents to the Senior SOC Analyst and the Rapid7 SOC. Support containment and recovery activities
* Document incidents from detection to closure in the ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow)
* Follow established SOC runbooks and playbooks while contributing to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of incident response runbooks, playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Support the vulnerability management programme such as scan scheduling, triage, risk prioritisation, and remediation tracking
* Monitor the threat landscape to inform detection and response activities
* Support audits and client due diligence processes where required

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 3–5 years’ experience in a security operation, incident response, or SOC analyst role (in-house or MSSP/MDR)
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise SIEM. Rapid7 InsightIDR / InsightVM preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar or equivalent accepted)
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common protocols.
* Practical experience investigating security events in Microsoft Windows environments, with working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos, NTLM and common authentication flows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear incident summaries, document evidence, and coordinate actions with infrastructure, application, engineering, and third-party SOC teams.
* Solid understanding of vulnerability management tools and risk-based remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and client security expectations in financial services or highly regulated environments
* Knowledge of attack techniques and incident response frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK)
* Beneficial:

+ scripting/automation, cloud security experience (AWS/Azure).
+ experience using approved AI-assisted security tools for alert triage, investigation, SIEM query development and reporting, with the ability to validate AI-generated outputs and handle sensitive security data appropriately.
+ Industry security certifications are a bonus.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Edge [T500-27945]
description:
**About REA Group:**

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way the world experiences property?”

Could we? Yes. Are we done? Never.

Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. The secret to our growth is staying true to that ‘day one’ mindset; the hunger to innovate, the ambition to change the world, and the curiosity to reimagine the future.

Our new Tech Center in Cyber City is dedicated to accelerating REA Group’s global technology delivery through relentless innovation. We’re looking for the best technologists, inventors and leaders in India to join us on this exciting new journey.

If you’re excited by the prospect of creating something magical from scratch, then read on.

**What the role is all about:**

We’re seeking a Staff Engineer - EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.

You’ll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes.

This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer-facing experiences at scale. You’ll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment.

**While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:**

* Set technical direction for the EDGE platform across CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, DNS and traffic management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business priorities.
* Lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities using Akamai and Kasada, making sound architectural decisions that balance security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Define and drive reusable platform patterns using Terraform, with strong platform thinking that enables self-service, consistency, governance and safe adoption across engineering teams.
* Work across AWS, networking, CDN and edge security domains to solve complex end-to-end problems and raise the technical maturity of internet-facing systems.
* Partner closely with product, platform, security and development teams to influence roadmaps, shape designs early and ensure edge capabilities are built as strategic platform services rather than one-off solutions.
* Improve operational excellence through PagerDuty, incident leadership, runbooks, on-call practices, service readiness reviews and clear ownership models.
* Define technical standards, guardrails and engineering best practices for the EDGE domain, and ensure they are adopted effectively across teams.
* Own and drive meaningful technology outcomes through OKRs, architecture direction and measurable improvements in security, reliability, performance and platform adoption.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 9+ years’ experience in cloud platform, SRE, network and edge engineering roles, including strong hands-on delivery and technical leadership in production environments.
* Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade-offs.
* Strong experience with bot management platforms such as Kasada, or similar capabilities used to detect and mitigate automated abuse at scale.
* Strong depth in AWS and a broad understanding of networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet-facing architectures, with the ability to reason across the full request path.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, including designing reusable modules, standards, abstractions and governance mechanisms for wider engineering adoption.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building internal tooling, automation and platform integrations used by multiple teams.
* Proven ability to solve ambiguous, high-impact technical problems across distributed systems and drive outcomes that improve security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product, security and leadership stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
* A high degree of accountability and ownership, including experience shaping or owning OKRs, driving execution and being responsible for measurable platform outcomes.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick-up and drop-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health & wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

**The values we live by:**

Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. title: Technical Analyst(SAAS Applications-Techno_Functional)
description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
  
  
Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
We are seeking a motivated and skilled Technical Analyst - SaaS Applications to join our team. This role focuses on administering, supporting, enhancing, and continuously improving enterprise SaaS applications. The successful candidate will ensure that business applications remain secure, reliable, and aligned with organisational objectives while supporting digital transformation initiatives and the adoption of new technologies
  
  
**What You'll Do**




+ SaaS Application Administration and Management

You will support the implementation, administration, and ongoing management of enterprise SaaS applications, ensuring seamless integration with existing business systems. You will contribute to product roadmaps, platform enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining high levels of system performance and user satisfaction.
  
  

* User Access and Configuration Management

You will manage users, roles, permissions, workflows, business rules, and platform configurations, ensuring secure and efficient operation of business applications. You will administer access controls in line with company policies and compliance requirements.
  
  

* Data Management and Integrations

You will perform data uploads, extracts, validation, reconciliation, and support integrations between SaaS applications and enterprise platforms. You will ensure data accuracy, consistency, and seamless information flow across systems.
  
  

* Production Support and Issue Resolution

You will provide L2/L3 production support, troubleshooting application, workflow, data, integration, and access-related issues while ensuring incidents and service requests are resolved within agreed service levels.
  
  

* Testing, Releases and Deployments

You will support SIT, UAT, regression testing, releases, patches, upgrades, and deployments across Development, Test, and Production environments. You will assist in delivering enhancements and business requirements while maintaining application stability and quality.
  
  

* Root Cause Analysis and Documentation

You will perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and maintain technical and functional documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
  
  

* Platform Governance and Continuous Improvement

You will monitor platform health, identify optimisation opportunities, and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, user experience, security, and operational effectiveness.
  
  

* Strategic Support and Execution

You will collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to support strategy development, identify process improvement opportunities, and help deliver initiatives that drive operational excellence and digital transformation.
  
  

* Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

You will act as a key point of contact for application-related initiatives, communicating progress, risks, and solutions to stakeholders. You will also support user training, adoption activities, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  

* Technical Expertise and Support

You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across SaaS platforms and interfaces, maintain application documentation, and support integrations and automation initiatives to improve interoperability between systems.
  
  

* Business Process Support

You will support business processes enabled through SaaS applications, ensuring systems remain aligned with operational requirements, regulatory obligations, and organisational objectives.
  
  

* Implementation of New Solutions and Digitalisation

You will participate in the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of new SaaS solutions and digital capabilities. You will work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment, change management, and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Usage Analytics and Reporting

You will analyse platform utilisation, user adoption, and consumption trends to identify optimisation opportunities. You will develop reports, dashboards, and recommendations that support informed business decisions and maximise value from SaaS investments.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology, Data Science, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 3 years' experience administering, supporting, or implementing enterprise SaaS applications.
* Experience managing cloud-based applications throughout their lifecycle, including implementation, support, upgrades, and optimisation.

**SaaS Platforms Experience**
Hands-on experience administering and supporting one or more enterprise SaaS platforms, including: SAP Fieldglass, Ivalua, and other enterprise SaaS applications.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Experience with user and access management, role-based security, workflow administration, and application configuration.
* Experience with system integrations, APIs, data imports/exports, and middleware platforms.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, reporting, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with cloud-based integration technologies and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience supporting application releases, upgrades, testing cycles, and production environments.
* Knowledge of IT service management practices, incident management, problem management, and change management processes.

**Methodologies and Tools**

* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and experience using Azure DevOps or similar tools for project and backlog management.
* Experience working within IT governance, security, audit, and compliance frameworks.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive issues to resolution.
* Excellent documentation, presentation, and knowledge-sharing skills.
* Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives and driving continuous improvement.

**Desirable**

* Professional certifications relevant to SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, IT service management, or project delivery.
* Experience working within global, cross-functional environments.
* Exposure to automation, AI-enabled solutions, and data analytics platforms.

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development:**
Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
  
  
🙌

Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture

title: Manager, Water Treatment Operations (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a technically strong, operationally rigorous Manager to own the ILC intervention through its full lifecycle — first establishing and validating the pilot, then driving its scale-up across new and existing geographies. This is a sequential mandate: the Manager sets up the pilot, proves the model on the ground, and subsequently leads the transition into full-scale, multi-site operations. Throughout, the role carries direct ownership of regional teams and ground operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep operational and technical experience — someone who has run field operations hands-on, solved device- and system-level problems directly, and later scaled those operations into a repeatable, standardised model. 5-8 years relevant experience required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operations Delivery (35%) —**

* Own day-to-day ground operations end-to-end: site setup, installation quality, O&M adherence, supply and logistics, and water-quality benchmarks.
* Establish the pilot's operational backbone —SOPs, workflows, escalation paths — then progressively harden and standardize these systems for scale.
* Run root-cause analysis on operational bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement across sites
* Manage vendor performance, field logistics, and resource allocation in low-infrastructure settings.

**Technical Ownership (30%)**

* Serve as the technical lead for the ILC intervention — dosing calibration, chlorine residual management, device configuration, and troubleshooting across varied field infrastructure
* Own operational performance across intervention sites, including installation quality, O&M adherence, water-quality benchmarks, and real-time data validation through dashboards and raw-data review
* Diagnose recurring technical and operational failures, design scalable solutions, and embed corrective protocols across teams and geographies
* Collaborate with academic and technical partners, vendors, and the product team to strengthen device performance and field protocols

**Team Building & Management (20%)**

* Hire, structure, and lead new field and coordination teams - defining roles, KPIs, and reporting lines aligned to program priorities
* Provide direct leadership, mentorship, and structured performance management to team members, driving accountability and a culture of transparency and learning
* Run structured performance management via trackers, dashboards, and review cadences

**Stakeholder Collaboration (15%)**

* Contribute to the development of tools, frameworks, training materials, and methodologies for effective knowledge transfer and capacity building
* Represent the LMT with government departments (e.g., JJM, PHED / RWSS), academic partners, and community stakeholders, championing technical and programmatic excellence
* Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations to ISW leadership in a timely and structured manner

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Chemical, or Environmental) or a closely related technical discipline
* Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in technically complex program delivery, with demonstrable, including hands-on field operations and a subsequent scale-up
* Proven experience hiring, structuring, and leading teams, ideally across dispersed geographies in rural or resource-limited settings
* Strong ability to use data for decision-making, protocol design, and continuous improvement
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to synthesise information and produce high-quality documents to tight deadlines
* Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time domestically

**Desirable**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Management, or a related discipline
* Experience running large, multi-site field operations, ideally having taken an operation from pilot through to scale-up
* Exceptional ability to work with minimal supervision while proactively surfacing progress and bottlenecks to leadership

**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees which include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

**Compensation**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale
  
  
All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.
  
  
**Note:**
This role will be open for applications until May 31st, 2026. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

description:
**Company Description**

KLAY is India’s largest company-owned and operated early childhood partner, supporting over 80,000 families across 180+ centres in more than 20 cities. Founded in 2011, KLAY is built on the belief that parents should be able to return to work without guilt while every child’s unique potential is nurtured. A global non-profit advisory and research organization focused on social impact and data analytics is hiring an Associate Director/Senior Manager to lead its AI Advisory practice.
