This is an opportunity to drive meaningful public sector transformation at the intersection of AI, governance, and consulting.The organization partners with governments, NGOs, and enterprises to deliver mission-driven solutions.

**Application Link: https://www.otavo.ai/jobs/cmucx3jgo000801nkcwgl6uzb**

(The above link is the only way to apply)

Location: Delhi | Full Time Role

Compensation: 45L-55L fixed salary + 5L-7L variable pay | Negotiable

**About the organization**

> We amplify social impact by partnering with leaders to develop tailored solutions. Our mission is to improve lives with data and evidence. We transform how the world fights poverty.

> We are a global nonprofit that equips leaders with the data, evidence and technology to improve lives at scale. We partner with governments, NGOs, multilaterals, and funders to support decisions at every stage of their impact journey – from bold pilots to nationwide scale-ups. Our teams bring rigorous evidence and practical insights so leaders can make informed decisions that truly change lives. With our partners, we are pioneering the next frontier of social impact, where data and technology accelerate progress for millions. We help leaders overcome the three main barriers to impact:

- Figuring out what works

- Learning and improving

- Reaching and operating at scale

> We work in multiple countries across Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors, including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other areas.

> We have expertise in a variety of rigorous approaches and methodologies, which we tailor to each client depending on their needs and constraints. To achieve a positive social impact we:

- Support our partners with the full 'data and evidence' value chain – from primary data collection to data systems, monitoring evaluation and learning tools, and data science

- Inform funding decisions – toward high-impact initiatives and away from less effective programs or approaches

- Create cutting-edge AI-for-good products that make the delivery of social interventions and learning tools more cost-effective and scalable

**Must Haves:**

> Demonstrated experience with AI technologies, products, or technology transformation. The candidate should understand AI capabilities, limitations, and practical implementation, particularly in complex organizational environments.

> Candidates must be technically strong enough to evaluate AI solutions, guide technical teams, and advise government stakeholders on feasibility, implementation, and risks.

> Ideally 8–15 years of relevant experience, with the maturity to engage senior stakeholders and independently lead complex initiatives. Senior Director-level profiles are preferred, although exceptional candidates with 7–9 years of experience will also be considered.

> Candidates should demonstrate a strong motivation to work on technology-driven solutions for governments and social sector organizations. Alignment with mission and willingness to work on intellectually challenging, high-impact problems are important.

> Candidates should have substantive experience developing, evaluating, implementing, or leading AI-driven initiatives, rather than merely having AI-related terminology or responsibilities in their profiles.

> Prior exposure to government advisory, public sector transformation, or development-sector projects is beneficial along with strong AI and technology capabilities.

**Preferred Candidate Backgrounds**

> Potential backgrounds include Dalberg, BCG's public sector or social impact practices, Bridgespan, Samagra, and similar organizations, provided candidates have meaningful technical exposure.

2. Product Leaders from Leading Technology Companies

> Senior product managers and technology leaders from companies such as Google and other established technology organizations, ideally with 7–8+ years of experience and a strong understanding of AI products or technology platforms.

> Candidates should demonstrate a genuine interest in transitioning from commercial technology roles into public sector or social impact initiatives.

3. Specialist Technology and AI Leaders from Consulting Firms

> Professionals working in dedicated AI, digital transformation, technology, or product practices at leading consulting organizations, particularly MBB firms.

> Preference is for candidates with specialist technology expertise rather than purely generalist strategy consulting experience.

4. AI Startup Founders and Senior Leaders

> Founders, product leaders, or senior technology professionals from established or high-potential AI startups who may be interested in applying their technical expertise to larger-scale, mission-driven initiatives.

> Such candidates should demonstrate the ability to operate strategically, manage stakeholders, and translate AI capabilities into practical organizational solutions.

**Candidate Evaluation Priorities**

Candidates will be assessed particularly on:

> Depth and credibility of AI and technology experience

> Ability to evaluate AI solutions and guide technical implementation

> Seniority, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities

> Experience of translating technology into practical organizational outcomes

> Genuine motivation to work with governments and social impact organizations

> Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to build new initiatives

title: Human Resources Associate
description:
Talent Acquisition & HR Operations AssociateDarwix AI | Full-Time | On-Site | 0–2 Years Experience

**Location:**
Imperia Mindspace, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana

**Working hours:**
10:45 AM – 8:00 PM

**Working days:**
Monday to Friday + Alternate Saturdays

**Experience:**
0–2 years (exceptional freshers encouraged to apply)

**Department:**
Human Resources & Talent Acquisition

**Reporting to:**
Founders / Leadership Team

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, Work from Office

About Darwix AI

Darwix AI is a growing enterprise AI company building physical-first Agentic AI solutions for complex business workflows, particularly in BFSI.

Our technology combines Voice AI Agents, Sherpa AI, Real-Time Agent Assist, Document Intelligence, QA and Compliance Intelligence, and an agentic orchestration layer to help enterprises translate real-world conversations into structured intelligence and governed actions.

With 50+ enterprise relationships across six geographies, we are building a team capable of solving meaningful AI and business challenges at scale.

We are looking for a highly energetic, resourceful, technology-oriented HR professional who wants to help build that team.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional HR coordination position.

We are looking for someone who enjoys finding exceptional people, engaging with prospective candidates, understanding their capabilities, convincing them to explore opportunities, and driving hiring processes to closure.

You will be responsible for building recruitment pipelines for technical, product, AI, sales, business and operations positions while simultaneously supporting end-to-end HR operations.

You should be comfortable using LinkedIn, professional databases, hiring platforms, AI tools, campus networks and unconventional sourcing techniques.

You will work closely with the founders and hiring managers, gaining exposure to how a rapidly growing enterprise AI business hires and operates.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Recruitment Ownership

* Understand hiring requirements directly from founders and functional heads.
* Translate requirements into clear JDs, ideal candidate profiles and screening criteria.
* Independently source, shortlist, engage and evaluate suitable candidates.
* Conduct initial HR screening and qualification calls.
* Evaluate experience, communication, motivation, compensation expectations, availability and role alignment.
* Coordinate technical, functional and leadership interviews.
* Maintain candidate engagement throughout the selection process.
* Own follow-ups, offer discussions, negotiation and joining coordination.
* Build backup pipelines for critical positions.
* Track recruitment progress against agreed hiring priorities.

2. AI, Engineering and Product Hiring

A significant part of this role involves recruiting for technology and product positions.

You should develop a functional understanding of profiles such as:

* AI/ML Engineers
* Generative AI and LLM Engineers
* Python / Backend Engineers
* Full-Stack Developers
* AI Product Managers
* Product Analysts
* Data Scientists and Analysts
* AI Implementation and Solutions Engineers
* Technical interns and graduate trainees

You are not expected to be a software engineer. However, you should be willing to learn enough about technical terminology and candidate backgrounds to distinguish credible profiles from keyword-heavy resumes.

Develop familiarity with Python, APIs, LLMs, RAG, model evaluation, AI workflows and software development fundamentals.

Work with technical hiring managers to understand essential skills, project depth and interview evaluation criteria.

3. Sales, Growth and Business Hiring

Support recruitment for:

* Enterprise Sales
* B2B and SaaS Sales
* Business Development
* SDR / BDR
* Customer Success
* Account Management
* Implementation and Client Delivery
* Growth and Marketing
* Business Operations

Assess candidates for commercial awareness, communication, enterprise selling exposure, target ownership, stakeholder management and ability to operate in a startup environment.

4. LinkedIn and Multi-Channel Sourcing

Develop consistent, high-quality sourcing capabilities across:

* LinkedIn and LinkedIn Recruiter
* Naukri, Instahyre, Indeed, Wellfound and Cutshort
* GitHub and relevant technical communities
* College placement networks and alumni groups
* Employee referrals
* Professional communities
* Existing resume databases
* Targeted outreach and candidate referrals

Key activities include:

* Boolean and X-ray search.
* Competitor and target-company talent mapping.
* Identifying passive candidates.
* Creating personalized recruitment messages.
* Building reusable candidate pipelines.
* Re-engaging suitable candidates from previous hiring processes.
* Measuring sourcing-channel effectiveness.

We are especially interested in candidates who enjoy finding talent rather than simply waiting for job applications.

5. AI-Enabled Recruitment

You should be enthusiastic about applying modern AI tools to recruitment and HR workflows.

Examples include:

* Using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar tools to help create JDs.
* Generating structured screening questions.
* Extracting job-relevant information from resumes using approved tools.
* Creating consistent candidate evaluation summaries.
* Personalizing sourcing messages.
* Preparing interview scorecards.
* Consolidating interview feedback.
* Identifying recruitment pipeline bottlenecks.
* Building hiring reports and dashboards.
* Automating repetitive administrative activities.

You must verify AI-generated outputs, protect candidate information and ensure recruitment decisions receive appropriate human review.

6. Campus Recruitment and University Partnerships

Build relationships with placement cells and talent teams across universities and colleges.

Responsibilities include:

* Identifying campuses relevant to AI, engineering, product and business hiring.
* Coordinating internships and graduate hiring opportunities.
* Managing communication with placement officers.
* Organizing assessments, hiring drives and interviews.
* Maintaining a database of college relationships.
* Creating structured internship-to-employment pipelines.
* Managing joining and documentation for campus hires.

7. Salary Negotiation and Offer Closure

Own candidate conversations across the offer stage, including:

* Understanding current compensation and candidate expectations.
* Evaluating fixed versus variable compensation structures.
* Working within approved salary budgets.
* Managing competing-offer situations.
* Communicating compensation and employment terms accurately.
* Negotiating professionally without making unauthorized commitments.
* Issuing and coordinating offer documentation.
* Managing offer acceptance and notice-period engagement.
* Minimizing offer-to-joining drop-offs.

We value candidates who can balance employee expectations, business economics and relationship management.

8. HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle

Support smooth day-to-day HR operations, including:

**Pre-joining and onboarding**

* Documentation and joining formalities.
* Employee database creation.
* Offer and employment records.
* Induction and onboarding coordination.
* IT, administration and reporting-manager coordination.

**Employee operations**

* Attendance and leave administration.
* Payroll-input coordination with finance.
* Maintaining accurate employee records.
* HR policies and internal communication.
* Employee query resolution.
* Probation review coordination.
* Employee engagement activities.
* Tracking important employee lifecycle milestones.

**Exit management**

* Exit formalities.
* Asset and document handovers.
* Clearance coordination.
* Employee record updates.
* Exit feedback administration.

Maintain confidentiality and professional handling of employee information.

9. Recruitment Analytics and Founder Reporting

Maintain accurate, frequently updated hiring trackers.

You should be comfortable reporting on:

* Open positions and priority vacancies.
* Candidates sourced and contacted.
* Response and screening conversion rates.
* Shortlists submitted.
* Interview progress.
* Interview-to-offer conversion.
* Offer acceptance and joining rates.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Sourcing-channel productivity.
* Campus hiring progress.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong verbal and written English communication.
* Confidence in professional outreach and candidate conversations.
* Interest in technology, AI and enterprise business.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn.
* Ability to conduct structured research.
* Attention to detail and disciplined follow-up.
* Basic spreadsheet and data-management capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Professional judgment and confidentiality.
* Comfortable using modern productivity and AI tools.
* Ability to independently execute tasks and take ownership.
* Strong willingness to learn and adapt.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Psychology or a related discipline.
* 0–2 years of experience in recruitment, HR operations, talent acquisition, internships or campus placement activities.
* Prior exposure to startup recruitment, IT hiring, SaaS hiring or technical talent sourcing is advantageous.
* Experience conducting LinkedIn sourcing or initial candidate screening is desirable.
* Freshers with demonstrable recruitment projects, internships or strong sourcing capabilities are welcome.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

Someone who:

* Enjoys speaking to new people and building professional relationships.
* Is persistent without being unnecessarily aggressive.
* Can move comfortably between AI engineering and sales hiring requirements.
* Enjoys discovering and experimenting with new technology.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for repeated instructions.
* Understands that hiring success requires both quality and speed.
* Is organized enough to manage several parallel hiring journeys.
* Is comfortable working closely with founders.
* Wants to build a meaningful long-term career in talent acquisition and HR.

Working Arrangements

This is a full-time, work-from-office position.

**Office:**
Imperia Mindspace, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana.

**Office hours:**
10:45 AM to 8:00 PM.

**Working schedule:**
Monday to Friday, with alternate Saturdays working.

title: Admission counselor
description:
**Company Description**
RisingARC is an education guidance and enrollment-support company that helps working professionals and ambitious learners select career-aligned online undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive programs. The team simplifies higher-education decisions by clarifying university options, program structures, eligibility, fees, accreditations, and long-term career relevance. Counselors provide end-to-end support, from program discovery and application guidance through to enrollment coordination, so learners can make confident, informed choices. RisingARC supports programs such as online MBA, MCA, BBA, BCA, and other recognized degree and executive pathways, and also partners with universities for student outreach, counseling, lead management, and enrollment support. The company is based in Gurugram and serves learners across India through personalized, goal-based, and transparent counseling.

**Role Description**

The counselor will guide prospective learners through the program discovery and selection process, understanding their background, goals, and constraints to recommend suitable online UG, PG, and executive programs. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting counseling sessions via phone, email, and in-person meetings; explaining program features, eligibility, fees, and university details; and addressing applicant queries with clarity and empathy.

The role involves managing leads, following up with prospective learners, supporting them through application and documentation steps, and coordinating with university partners to ensure smooth enrollment. The counselor will also contribute to outreach campaigns, maintain accurate records in CRM systems, and work closely with the team to meet enrollment and service quality targets.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong interpersonal communication and general communication skills to engage effectively with diverse learners and stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess customer service skills, including active listening, problem-solving, and the ability to provide clear, supportive guidance throughout the counseling and enrollment process.
* Candidates should possess sales-related skills, such as consultative selling, lead follow-up, and conversion, while maintaining an ethical, learner-first approach.
* Candidates should possess education-focused skills, including understanding of higher-education pathways, online learning models, and the ability to explain program structures and career relevance.
* Relevant qualifications may include a bachelor’s degree in education, counseling, business, psychology, or a related field, along with prior experience in admissions, counseling, edtech, or customer-facing roles.
* Additional beneficial skills include proficiency with CRM or lead management tools, comfort with digital communication platforms, strong organizational and time-management abilities, and fluency in English and Hindi.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Us**

Trevolution is a global leader in air ticketing and travel services, serving retail and corporate clients across 50+ markets. With over 20 years of expertise and a strong entrepreneurial mindset, we combine modern technology with a customer-first approach to simplify travel.

Through partnerships with 70+ airlines, we deliver a full booking experience supported by expert service — focused on value, convenience, and reliability. Our portfolio spans online sales, call bookings, and semi-OTAs, and continues to evolve with market trends.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Tech Lead**
to take ownership of a mission-critical backend platform within the Trevolution travel division at Dyninno Group.

You will lead the technical direction of a high-traffic, distributed backend system that sits at the core of our daily business operations. This is a true end-to-end technical ownership role requiring strong engineering judgment, hands-on expertise, and the ability to guide a team through complex, ambiguous problem spaces.

The ideal candidate combines strong Go engineering skills with experience in scalable distributed systems, a pragmatic engineering mindset, and proven leadership capabilities in growing engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of complex backend systems and integrations with downstream services.
* Own the architecture of core backend components, driving decisions around scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Define and govern integration patterns across multiple services in a distributed microservices environment.
* Ensure performance, reliability, and scalability of high-volume, low-latency systems.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Mentor and guide engineers; establish best practices in code quality, testing, observability, and security.
* Lead technical decision-making, trade-off analysis, and architectural governance.
* Own production stability, including troubleshooting incidents, performance issues, and system bottlenecks.
* Partner with peer platform teams to align architecture and share engineering standards.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Experience:**

* 6–12 years of software engineering experience.
* At least 2+ years in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* Proven experience leading high-traffic, production-scale backend platforms.
* Experience in the travel domain is a plus.

**Technical Skills:**

* Go (Golang)/ Node.js: Strong proficiency required, including concurrency, memory management, and idiomatic patterns.
* Databases: Strong experience with at least one at scale (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).
* Redis: caching strategies, streams, and key/value design patterns.
* Elasticsearch: search and analytics use cases.
* Microservices & APIs: REST, JSON, service design, and integration contracts.
* Security: OAuth, JWT, API security best practices.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Sentry, distributed tracing.
* Containers & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI (or similar).
* Cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure experience.
* Event-driven architecture: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging systems.
* Testing: strong discipline in unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools) and using AI agents to improve engineering productivity.

There is no one-size-fits-all here; we are quite flexible and use an individual approach with every candidate we meet. While getting familiar during our interview, we try to understand where your working experience, professional skills, and future contribution to the company can be applied within our multiple business projects.

**With us, you will**

* Be part of a top-tier team of professionals working on global products used by millions of customers worldwide.
* Build and scale complex, in-house solutions that power real business impact.
* Learn and grow through internal lectures, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions led by colleagues and team leads.
* Benefit from comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Enjoy convenient parking options.

**Company:**

About MantraCare

MantraCare Health Pvt. Ltd. is a global healthcare and corporate wellness organization providing Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), mental health solutions, chronic disease management, and holistic wellness services to corporate and individual clients across India and internationally.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced
**Credentialing Specialist**
to manage US healthcare provider enrollment and credentialing processes. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with US insurance payer enrollment, credentialing platforms, and provider databases, along with the flexibility to work night shifts aligned with US business hours.

Key Responsibilities

* **Provider Enrollment:**
  Complete and submit provider enrollment applications to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance carriers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with documentation requirements.
* **Credentialing Coordination:**
  Collect, verify, and organize provider documentation for initial credentialing and re-credentialing processes.
* **Database Management:**
  Maintain and update provider enrollment records, internal trackers, and credentialing statuses to ensure accurate documentation and timely follow-ups.
* **Payer Communication:**
  Coordinate with insurance payers and provider networks to resolve enrollment issues, delays, and requests for additional information.
* **Compliance:**
  Ensure all enrollment and credentialing activities comply with federal, state, and payer-specific regulations, particularly those applicable to post-acute care.
* **Provider Support:**
  Act as a point of contact for healthcare providers and administrative teams regarding enrollment progress and credentialing-related queries.
* **Regular Follow-ups:**
  Follow up with insurance payers to track application progress, resolve pending issues, and expedite approvals.
* **Reporting:**
  Prepare regular updates and reports on provider enrollment status, pending applications, and approval timelines.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Work closely with billing and revenue cycle management teams to ensure providers are properly enrolled and credentialed for smooth claims processing.

Required Skills & Experience

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Minimum
  **1 year of experience**
  in US healthcare provider credentialing and enrollment.
* Experience independently managing end-to-end provider enrollment processes.
* Hands-on experience with
  **CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and US insurance payer portals**
  .
* Strong understanding of US healthcare provider enrollment workflows, payer requirements, and processing timelines.
* High attention to detail, as credentialing errors can lead to application delays and claim processing issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with practice management systems or EHR platforms such as Epic, AdvancedMD, or athenahealth.
* Familiarity with credentialing platforms such as Modio, MD-Staff, Verity, or similar systems.
* Previous experience handling US healthcare providers and insurance payer communication.

Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:**
  Completed Bachelor's degree in any discipline is mandatory. Candidates currently pursuing their degree or with incomplete graduation are not eligible.
* **Experience:**
  At least 1 year of relevant US provider credentialing/enrollment experience.
* **Communication:**
  Moderate-to-strong spoken and written English communication skills for payer follow-ups, professional emails, and documentation.
* **Technical Skills:**
  Comfortable using payer portals, CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, Excel, Word, and internal tracking systems.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Ability to manage multiple applications, follow-ups, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  Must be comfortable working night shifts aligned with US business hours.

Work Schedule

* Full-time, night-shift position.
* Working hours aligned with US business hours.
* Candidates must be comfortable working during evening and overnight hours in India.

Notice Period

Immediate joiners or candidates serving a short notice period will be preferred.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant US healthcare credentialing and provider enrollment experience are encouraged to apply.

title: AI Harness Engineer
description:
We're hiring an experienced AI-native engineer to build the core systems behind Diligent's AI agents. This is not a prompt-writing role. This is a software engineering role for someone who can design reliable AI systems: prompts, context, tools, evals, orchestration, memory, observability, and production workflows.

**About Us**

Diligent is the new venture from the founding team of Leverage Edu, a Series D edtech company. There, our founders built and scaled multiple businesses from zero, including student mobility, cross-border payments and student housing.

Diligent is building the AI growth team every business deserves. Instead of hiring an agency or a five-person marketing team, our clients get a squad of AI agents that research competitors, plan budgets, generate creatives, and run and optimise campaigns on Meta and Google, with senior marketers guiding every move. A campaign that takes an agency weeks to set up goes live in under 30 minutes.

We're a small team building fast. Everyone here uses AI every day, and you will too.

**The Role**

You'll work on the core agent architecture behind Diligent.

Your job will be to build the harness around frontier models: prompt engineering, context engineering, tool design, agent orchestration, evals, memory, model routing, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop systems.

You should be equally comfortable thinking about system design and writing production code.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and build AI agent workflows for marketing, growth, reporting, creative analysis, SEO/AEO, lead intelligence, and reputation monitoring.
* Build production-grade harnesses around LLMs using prompts, context, tools, memory, structured outputs, evals, guardrails, and human review loops.
* Work on prompt engineering, context engineering, tool calling, workflow decomposition, and agent orchestration.
* Build backend systems that connect with databases, APIs, CRMs, ad platforms, Slack, WhatsApp, dashboards, and internal tools.
* Design systems for ingesting, cleaning, storing, and retrieving business context for AI agents.
* Build evaluation pipelines to test prompt changes, model changes, agent quality, regressions, and edge cases.
* Implement model routing strategies to balance quality, latency, and cost. Improve observability: logs, traces, prompt versions, model outputs, failure analysis, and feedback loops.
* Work closely with product and growth teams to convert messy business workflows into reliable AI systems. Own engineering quality across architecture, code, testing, debugging, deployment, and maintenance.

**Who You Are**

title: Eye Doctor
description:
**Company Description** 
 EyeMantra Foundation is a not\-for\-profit organization dedicated to eliminating preventable blindness and expanding access to high\-quality eye care for underserved communities. Since 2013, the foundation has delivered sight\-saving surgeries, eyeglasses, medications, and diagnostic services to more than 40 million individuals across rural and low\-income regions in India. EyeMantra focuses on vulnerable populations, including children, older adults, and women, through outreach camps, school screening programs, and permanent vision centers. Its model combines community\-based engagement with advanced ophthalmic care, supported by partner hospitals, vision technicians, and volunteer doctors. EyeMantra’s mission is to build sustainable eye care ecosystems so that no person loses vision due to poverty or geographic isolation.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Eye Doctor will provide comprehensive ophthalmic care to patients served by EyeMantra Foundation’s facilities and outreach programs. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Delhi, India, and involves conducting routine and specialized eye examinations, diagnosing and managing ocular diseases, and performing or supporting surgeries such as cataract and other common procedures. The Eye Doctor will participate in school screening initiatives, community eye camps, and follow\-up care for patients referred from rural vision centers. Responsibilities include developing treatment plans, prescribing medications and corrective lenses, maintaining accurate medical records, and coordinating care with optometrists, vision technicians, and partner hospitals. The role also involves contributing to patient education, training local health workers, and supporting quality improvement and clinical governance activities aligned with EyeMantra’s mission.
   

**Qualifications**
* Clinical ophthalmology expertise, including comprehensive eye examinations, diagnosis and management of common ocular conditions, and familiarity with cataract and other routine eye surgeries.
* Proficiency in using standard ophthalmic equipment and diagnostic tools such as slit lamps, tonometers, ophthalmoscopes, and visual field testing devices.
* Strong patient\-centered communication skills, with the ability to counsel individuals and families from diverse cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds.
* Experience or interest in community eye health, outreach programs, and working in resource\-limited or rural settings.
* Commitment to ethical, non\-discriminatory care and to EyeMantra’s mission of equitable access to eye health services.
* Recognized medical degree (MBBS) with specialization in Ophthalmology (MD/MS/DNB) and valid registration with the appropriate medical council in India.
* Ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams, supervise and mentor junior clinicians or vision technicians, and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
* Working knowledge of basic electronic medical records or willingness to learn digital documentation systems.

While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, serving industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center has grown to more than 1,000 professionals.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Manager, Transformation \& Operations, you will own transformation workstreams and operational initiatives within A\&M’s Corporate Shared Services team in the Gurgaon Global Capability Center. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Shared Services \& Operations, you will convert strategic priorities into executable plans, reliable transitions, improved processes, and reusable operating capability. Your scope will span GCC/GBS transition planning, process design, documentation, business\-case analysis, and operational excellence across functions such as HR, Marketing, and IT. This is a senior execution role for a hands\-on operator with consulting rigor. You will work independently with functional teams, local operations, regional partners, and senior leaders while influencing without direct authority. The role is not a people\-management position or a client\-facing advisory role, although you will mentor junior colleagues and contribute to capability building.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own two to three transformation or operational workstreams from planning through execution, using structured project plans, risk controls, quality reviews, and leadership reporting to deliver agreed outcomes.
* Execute GCC process transitions through detailed plans, handover controls, process documentation, training content, and change support that enable stable adoption by functional and operations teams.
* Design and maintain reusable playbooks, job aids, process libraries, and knowledge assets that codify best practices, improve consistency, and reduce dependency on individual process owners.
* Analyze costs, volumes, productivity, and efficiency metrics to identify improvement opportunities and build financial models, ROI calculations, and business cases for leadership decisions.
* Translate complex operational information into clear leadership updates, recommendations, and implementation priorities that support operating model governance and timely decisions.
* Partner with HR, Marketing, IT, regional teams, and GCC operations to resolve dependencies, influence without direct authority, and maintain momentum across interconnected initiatives.
* Mentor junior team members in consulting\-style problem\-solving, documentation standards, and execution discipline while supporting training plans for new associates.
* Track lessons learned and transition outcomes to strengthen future implementation methods, improve operational readiness, and build scalable capability across the growing GCC.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 10–15 years of experience, including at least 10 years in GCC/GBS transformation, shared services, operations consulting, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations roles.
* Strong knowledge of GCC/GBS operating models, shared services best practices, transition planning, process improvement, process documentation, and execution\-level change management.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex workstreams from planning through delivery, with the ability to manage risks, dependencies, deliverable quality, and multiple moving pieces independently.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, including cost, volume, efficiency, financial modelling, business\-case development, and ROI analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clear documentation, training materials, leadership updates, and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and geographies, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and present findings effectively to functional leaders and operations teams.
* Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance, with prior consulting firm experience and knowledge of India GCC or multinational shared services environments preferred.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering GCC/GBS transformation engagements, shared services implementations, or operating model transitions across multiple corporate functions.
* Prior experience in a Big Four firm, boutique consulting firm, consulting practice, or a comparable transformation\-focused operations environment.
* Exposure to building reusable playbooks, process libraries, training programs, and capability\-development mechanisms for growing operations teams.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring 10–15 years of professional experience, including 10 or more years in GCC/GBS transformation, operations consulting, shared services, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations. Your experience shows sustained ownership of complex execution rather than strategy recommendations alone.
* You bring hands\-on capability in workstream management, transition planning, process improvement, documentation, and change execution. You can turn broad priorities into detailed plans, control risks, maintain quality, and deliver outcomes with limited supervision.
* You bring strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to assess costs, volumes, efficiency, ROI, and operating trade\-offs. You can build credible financial models and business cases that help leaders prioritize investments and improvements.
* You bring a Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance and communicate with clarity across senior leaders, functional teams, regional partners, and operations colleagues. You influence without authority, manage detail, mentor others, and remain effective in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Alvarez \& Marsal, you will join a global professional services firm where practical execution, independent thinking, and measurable results shape the work. This role offers the opportunity to help build and strengthen a rapidly growing Global Capability Center in India while working directly with local and global leadership. You will have visibility into strategic decision\-making and direct ownership of transformation workstreams that influence how corporate functions operate and scale. The small central operations team provides meaningful responsibility, close collaboration, and room to expand your scope as the GCC and its capabilities grow. You will work across functions, geographies, and industries while building expertise in transitions, operating models, process improvement, and business performance. A\&M supports professional growth through mentorship, formal training, A\&M University, on\-the\-job learning, internal mobility, and performance development. The culture values integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal contribution, while encouraging people to bring an entrepreneurial, action\-oriented approach to complex problems.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to local and global leadership, meaningful ownership of transformation workstreams, and the opportunity to influence operating practices within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.
* A development environment combining formal training, A\&M University, mentorship, on\-the\-job learning, performance development, and internal mobility for continued professional growth.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, wellness resources, work\-life balance support, employee resource groups, flexible work models, and opportunities to contribute to community programs.

title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
 



**Consumer Insight:** 
 Build a strong read on the Indian Gen Z and Millennial consumer — fashion trends, buying behaviour, and sentiment — to keep Meller's proposition sharp.
 



  





**4\. Global Coordination, Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 




**Global Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary interface between the Barcelona\-based Meller team and Lenskart's India leadership — aligning on strategy, brand consistency, and market learnings.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Category, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure the business runs as one integrated system.
 



**Team Building:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a lean, high\-performing India team capable of running Meller as an independent, founder\-led business within Lenskart.
 



**Leadership Reporting:** 
 Own business reviews and reporting cadences with Lenskart and Meller global leadership — covering performance, strategy, and course corrections.
 



  





**The Essentials** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 Proven experience in business leadership, general management, or P\&L ownership roles, with meaningful experience building or scaling a D2C brand; exposure to fashion/lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands is a strong plus, as is an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
* **P\&L \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven ability to own and grow a P\&L — balancing revenue growth, margin, and working capital while making sound commercial trade\-offs.
* **Brand \& Retail Understanding:** 
 Strong grounding in brand building, retail operations, and consumer behaviour, particularly within fashion, lifestyle, or eyewear categories.
* **Entrepreneurial Track Record:** 
 Experience building or scaling a business, brand, or new market with founder\-like ownership, ideally in a fast\-growing or category\-disrupting environment.
* **Cross\-Border Collaboration:** 
 Experience or strong aptitude for working with global teams, balancing brand consistency with local market relevance.
* **Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior leaders across commercial, retail, marketing, and finance functions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.



  





**🧠 The Mindset** 




  




* **Founder's Mentality:** 
 You think and act like you own the business — chasing outcomes, not just tasks, and taking full accountability for Meller's success in India.
* **Brand Storyteller:** 
 You understand how to turn a brand's design DNA into stories and experiences that resonate with a new generation of consumers.
* **Globally Minded, Locally Grounded:** 
 You carry a brand's global identity faithfully while adapting it with nuance for Indian consumers and platforms.
* **Commercially Grounded:** 
 You balance brand ambition with the discipline of running a healthy, profitable business.
* **Entrepreneurial Bent of Mind:** 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity, quick to take ownership, resourceful with limited support, and driven to make things happen rather than wait for a playbook.
* **Collaborative Operator** 
 : You move easily between strategic, creative, and commercial conversations, working across category, retail, and global brand teams to get things done.
* **Execution\-Focused:** 
 You don't just set strategy — you see it through, chase details, and hold the bar high at every touchpoint.

title: Veterinary pathologist
description:
**Company Description** 
 VETLAB, a division of ALL VET DIAGNOSTIC SOLUTIONS PVT LTD, has been a leader in veterinary diagnostics and imaging in India for over 12 years. With multiple centers nationwide, VETLAB is recognized for delivering reliable, high\-quality diagnostic services that strengthen veterinary care and resilience. As India’s first privately managed veterinary laboratory accredited by NABL and compliant with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 standards, the organization upholds strict quality and accuracy in biological testing. Its extensive service portfolio includes haematology, biochemistry, microbiology, clinical pathology, histopathology, endocrinology, molecular diagnosis, and advanced imaging such as digital X\-rays and ultrasonography. VETLAB serves a wide range of clients, including veterinary hospitals, private clinics, dairy farms, government institutions, race clubs, and security agencies, guided by a deep commitment to animal health and welfare.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Veterinary Pathologist will work full time on\-site at the New Delhi laboratory, providing expert diagnostic support for a variety of animal species. In this role, the individual will perform gross and microscopic examination of tissues, interpret histopathology and cytology results, and prepare clear, timely diagnostic reports for clinicians and partners. Daily responsibilities include correlating clinical findings with laboratory data, collaborating with haematology, microbiology, and molecular diagnostics teams, and participating in quality control and assurance activities to maintain NABL and ISO/IEC standards. The role also involves consulting with veterinary practitioners, contributing to case discussions, supporting the development of diagnostic protocols, and assisting in training team members on pathology best practices. The Veterinary Pathologist will help advance VETLAB’s mission by ensuring accurate diagnoses that guide effective treatment and improve animal health outcomes.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Advanced veterinary pathology expertise, including experience in clinical pathology, histopathology, and cytology, with strong diagnostic interpretation skills.
* Solid grounding in laboratory disciplines such as haematology, biochemistry, microbiology, serology, parasitology, endocrinology, and molecular diagnosis.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, concise, and clinically useful pathology reports, and to communicate complex findings effectively to veterinary professionals.
* Experience working in accredited diagnostic laboratories, with familiarity with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 standards, quality control, and standard operating procedures.
* Commitment to animal welfare, attention to detail, and strong problem\-solving skills in high\-volume, time\-sensitive diagnostic environments.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, manage multiple cases simultaneously, and maintain professional ethics and confidentiality.
* Masters of Veterinary Patholgy and minimum 2\-3 years experience in similar field

By working with customers to certify medical technologies, support safe and sustainable healthcare practices, and advance responsible aquaculture and ocean stewardship, we help manage risks, meet regulatory demands, and achieve long\-term goals. Drawing on deep technical expertise, we partner with customers worldwide to bridge trust gaps between patients, providers, producers, and consumers—driving sustainable results and improved ESG performance.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of our continued growth, we are looking to recruit technical and experienced Medical Device Assessors/Lead Auditors. The successful candidates will be responsible for planning and conducting audits / assessments against the manufacturing of medical devices, in accordance with ISO 13485, IVDR 2017/745 and MDSAP standards, enabling the delivery of assessment and certification services that meet customer requirements and appropriate accreditation standards.
   

  

**Scope**
 A Medical Device Auditor evaluates whether medical device companies comply with regulatory requirements and quality standards.

**Key behaviors**
* Customer\-Centricity

 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. **Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).

* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Overview**
 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world.  Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
 As a member of
 **Cloud Infrastructure team** 
 , you will design, build, and operate the AWS foundation that underpins Cvent’s products. You will own complex infrastructure services end\-to\-end, drive automation\-first practices, and help evolve our “paved road” for engineers building on AWS.
   

  

 A key focus for this role is to
 **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations** 
 – using single and multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks to automate diagnostics, runbooks, and workflows while maintaining strong guardrails around security, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**
* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as AWS CDK / CloudFormation, enforcing standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns.
* Develop automation and tooling (primarily in Python/TypeScript) to remove repetitive operational work (provisioning, patching, configuration, cleanup, compliance checks, reporting).
* Contribute to and sometimes lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and RFCs for new or evolving infrastructure services.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements across accounts and regions.


**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**
* Identify high‑value Cloud Infra workflows (e.g., incident triage, change impact analysis, runbook execution, capacity/cost recommendations) that can be automated using AI agents.
* Design and implement agentic workflows (single and multi‑agent) using modern AI orchestration patterns and frameworks (e.g., tool‑calling, planners, evaluators, guardrails).
* Integrate agents with existing cloud APIs, observability tools, ticketing systems, and runbooks to provide end‑to‑end, human\-in\-the\-loop automation.
* Define and enforce safety, security, and approval guardrails for AI‑driven actions (RBAC, policy checks, dry‑runs, explicit approvals, audit logging).
* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.
* Help define and evolve paved road standards for AWS infrastructure, automation, and AI agent usage across Cloud Infrastructure.
* Contribute to runbooks, design docs, knowledge base articles, and internal training sessions, including AI and automation best practices


**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.
* You are actively mentoring Engineer I/II teammates and influencing our standards for AWS, automation, and responsible AI usage.


**Cloud Infrastructure**
* Design, develop, and troubleshoot automation jobs for complex workflows across AWS accounts and regions.
* Create and assign Jira tasks to drive progress with clear ownership and follow‑through.
* Create and maintain wiki documentation / README files for workflows, procedures, and tooling enhancements.
* Identify gaps in runbook coverage and author new runbooks that enable repeatable, reliable operations.
* Display mastery of service(s) within a single pillar (e.g., Networking, Compute, Storage, Security, Orchestration).
* Demonstrate competency across multiple pillars, understanding how services interact end‑to‑end.
* Collaborate effectively across CloudOps, SRE, Security, Product Engineering, and other technology teams.


**Cvent Behavioral Competencies**
* Anticipates customer needs and delivers services beyond expectations, with a strong internal customer mindset.
* Uses customer insights and data to influence and guide new infrastructure and automation offerings.
* Serves as a strategic partner to build, grow, and maintain long‑term, sustainable, and profitable relationships.


**CloudOps Core Competencies**
* Troubleshoot high‑complexity issues, including multi‑service and multi‑region incidents.
* Coordinate and troubleshoot issues involving 3rd‑party vendors, assisting in vendor relationship management.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to junior engineers on troubleshooting, design, and best practices.
* Share knowledge broadly (e.g., lunch‑and‑learns, mentoring, internal training, documentation).
* Perform as an individual contributor on high‑complexity tasks, owning them end‑to‑end.
* Act as primary point of contact for internal and cross‑tech (CTC) level projects in your domain.
* Help allocate work across individual contributors and identify when additional support is needed.
* Recognize when project timelines are at risk and partner with leadership to adjust scope or approach.
* Communicates progress, risks, and needs clearly to management and stakeholders.
* Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, and respectful organizational culture.


 If you’re passionate about
 **Cloud Infrastructure** 
 , enjoy
 **building automation and tools** 
 , and are excited about applying
 **AI agents and orchestration to real‑world infrastructure problems** 
 , we’d love to talk to you.

 Product \& Design  
 



**Team:** 
 New Product Development 
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Founder 
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon (Hybrid) 
 



  
 



  





**About Nurturing Green** 
  
 



  





 Nurturing Green is India's leading gardening lifestyle brand, making plants and gardening products accessible to millions of customers through Retail, E\-commerce and Quick Commerce. 
 



  





 Featured on
 **Shark Tank India Season 4** 
 , we are present across Amazon, Flipkart, Blink it, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket, Myntra and multiple offline retail formats, with an aggressive vision to become India's most loved gardening brand. 
 



  





 We believe great products are born where design, functionality, and storytelling come together. We're looking for a design\-first creative leader who can shape the next generation of Nurturing Green products and create collections that customers love. 
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 
  
 



  
 


* We are looking for an
 **NPD Lead** 
 who combines strong creative thinking with hands\-on product development, category knowledge and execution capabilities.
* The role will own the product journey from
 **concept to sampling, refinement, costing, packaging, production readiness and launch** 
 , while also driving the visual communication of products across catalogues, e\-commerce and marketing touchpoints.
* Working closely with the Founder, Product/Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales and Marketing teams, the NPD Lead will ensure products are creatively strong, commercially viable and operationally ready for scale.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 



  





**1\. Product Development \& NPD** 
  
 


* Identify new product opportunities through consumer insights, market trends, category gaps and business requirements.
* Translate ideas and trends into commercially relevant product concepts and collections.
* Develop concepts, sketches, mood boards, specifications, prototypes and samples.
* Build cohesive collections across plants, planters, home décor, gifting, lifestyle and related categories.
* Own the NPD process from
 **concept → sourcing → sampling → iteration → costing → final approval → production readiness → launch** 
 .
* Maintain product specifications, BOMs, dimensions, material details and NPD documentation.
* Manage sampling cycles and resolve design, functionality, quality and production issues.



  





**2\. Category, Material \& Manufacturing Knowledge** 
  
 


* Develop strong knowledge of relevant product categories, materials and manufacturing processes.
* Evaluate materials, construction methods, finishes and production techniques based on design, cost and feasibility.
* Work with vendors and manufacturers to identify practical and commercially viable solutions.



  





**3\. Vendor, Sourcing \& Cross\-functional Coordination** 
  
 


* Work closely with Purchase, Merchandising and vendors throughout the development cycle.
* Brief vendors on product concepts, specifications, materials, finishes and packaging requirements.
* Evaluate samples and drive revisions until products meet the required design and quality standards.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Warehouse, Sales,and Operations to ensure smooth product development and launch.
* Proactively manage timelines, dependencies, and development challenges.



  
 



**4\. Packaging Design \& Product Communication** 
  
 


* Lead the design and development of
 **product packaging, labels, inserts, tags, sleeves, boxes and other product communication elements** 
 .
* Ensure packaging balances
 **brand presentation, functionality, product protection, cost and production feasibility** 
 .
* Lead or guide the development of
 **product catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives, Quick Commerce creatives and marketing graphics** 
 for new products and collections.
* Ensure product features, specifications, USPs and visual communication are accurate and consistent across customer\-facing touchpoints.



  
 



  





**5\. Team Management** 
  
 


* Lead and mentor Junior Product Designers and other NPD resources.
* Set clear briefs, timelines, and development expectations.
* Conduct regular product and design reviews.



  





**Core Requirements** 
  
 


* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in Product Design, Product Development, NPD, Category Development, or a similar role within consumer/lifestyle brands.
* Strong experience taking products from concept through sampling and production.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, product development, and collection building.
* Hands\-on experience with vendors, manufacturers, and sampling cycles.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, construction, finishes, and product costing.
* Experience in categories such as home décor, lifestyle, gifting, ceramics, hardgoods, furniture, accessories, handicrafts, gardening products or similar consumer products.
* Good understanding of packaging design and development, including production\-ready artwork, materials,timelines, finishes, and vendor coordination.
* Experience with catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives or marketing graphics is preferred.
* Strong creative and aesthetic sensibility with the ability to translate trends into commercially relevant products.
* Ability to manage multiple NPD projects and timelines independently.
* Graduate/Postgraduate from NID, NIFT, Srishti, Pearl Academy, MIT Institute of Design or equivalent design/product development institutes preferred.
* Candidates from pure fashion/apparel design backgrounds are not preferred unless they have significant hardgoods/lifestyle product development experience.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; Canva and AI\-assisted design workflows are preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 
  
 


* Develop differentiated and commercially relevant product collections.
* Move products efficiently from concept to production and launch.
* Build strong vendors and manufacturing relationships.
* Maintain high standards of product quality, design, and functionality.
* Deliver products within expected cost and timeline parameters.
* Ensure packaging and product communication effectively support the product proposition.
* Enable smooth collaboration across NPD, Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales, Marketing and Operations.
* Strengthen Nurturing Green's product portfolio through a balance of creativity, category knowledge, functionality, manufacturability and commercial viability.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**About the job** 



* Role: Performance Marketer

**WHO WE ARE** 




 We're a team of IIT Delhi alumni building Dalvoy AI, the only platform an aspirant needs to crack any government exam in India.
 



  





 Within just a few months of launch, 1 in every 5 UPSC aspirants is already using Dalvoy for their preparation. We've raised our seed round from leading venture capital firms in India and are now building the team for our next stage of growth.
 



  





 We're looking for exceptional people to join us early, take real ownership and help build India's best test\-prep platform.

 Own paid acquisition across Google and Meta, improve acquisition efficiency and scale campaigns that bring in engaged, paying users.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 



* Plan, launch and optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns across both app and web acquisition.
* Manage budgets, bidding, targeting and campaign structure. Forecast acquisition volumes and costs, monitor daily spend and decide when to stop, improve or scale campaigns.
* Run structured experiments across creatives, messaging, audiences and landing pages. Work with designers and video editors to maintain a regular pipeline of new ads and address creative fatigue.
* Track the journey from ad click to sign\-up, activation and payment. Work with product and engineering to identify and resolve conversion drop\-offs.
* Own campaign reporting and monitor acquisition cost, paid conversion, ROAS and payback. Evaluate campaign quality using renewals, retention and customer lifetime value, beyond installs and initial purchases.

* Use Claude Code to analyse campaign performance, automate reporting, research competitors and improve advertising workflows.



  





**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Working knowledge of GA4, Firebase, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and mobile attribution tools such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.
* Strong analytical ability: comfortable investigating campaign and funnel data, designing experiments and translating findings into action.
