**AI FLUENCY** 




 Hands\-on experience with Claude, Codex or comparable tools to automate workflows, check outputs and improve efficiency is required.
 



  





**WHY JOIN US** 



* Work directly with the founders and take on broader responsibilities as Dalvoy grows.
* Upskill fast enough to lead your own area at Dalvoy, working hands\-on with frontier AI tools every day.
* Meaningful ESOPs, sized for an early hire.
* Relocation support if you're moving to Gurgaon.
* Health insurance cover and periodic team offsites.
* Free meals and conveyance allowance.



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 



* Apply at https://www.dalvoy.com/careers/performance\-marketer
* Share your CV, notice period and examples of Google and Meta campaigns you personally managed. Include your experience across app and web acquisition, approximate monthly budgets, timeframe and business results. Briefly describe how you use Claude Code in your work. Anonymised examples are welcome.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.

 We're looking for someone who can help us build the next version of StartupGyaan.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a Content \& Growth Lead who can take ownership of StartupGyaan's content strategy and help us build a high\-growth, personality\-driven business media brand.
 



  





 Your first and most important mandate will be: Make StartupGyaan's Instagram Reels impossible to ignore.
 



  





 You'll be responsible for understanding what makes people stop scrolling, developing repeatable content formats and IPs, building a strong brand persona, and eventually expanding that strategy into podcasts, long\-form YouTube and other formats.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll simply receive a content calendar and execute it.You'll be expected to think, experiment, analyse, fail, learn and build.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Instagram Reels — Primary Responsibility
 


* Develop the overall short\-form content strategy for StartupGyaan
* Identify topics, trends, narratives and formats with high potential
* Develop strong hooks and storytelling structures
* Create and improve scripts
* Develop repeatable Reel formats/IPs
* Analyse performance and continuously optimise content
* Study retention, shares, saves, comments and follower conversion
* Identify why certain content works and why other content doesn't
* Build a system capable of consistently producing high\-performing organic content



  





 2\. Build the StartupGyaan Brand \& Personality: We don't want StartupGyaan to remain just another "startup/business facts" page. You will help develop:
 


* Brand personality
* Tone of voice
* Content philosophy
* Storytelling style
* Point of view
* Recurring themes
* Founder/personal\-brand integration
* Distinctive content formats



  





 The goal is to make people recognise:"This is StartupGyaan"even before they see the logo.
 



  





 3\. Build Arnab's Personal Brand: A major part of this role will be developing the founder's presence within StartupGyaan. You'll work closely with Arnab to develop:
 


* His on\-camera personality
* Opinions and points of view
* Storytelling style
* Recurring personal\-brand formats
* Founder\-led content
* Business commentary
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Thought leadership



  





 The objective is to create a genuine connection between Arnab and the audience, rather than having StartupGyaan feel like a faceless media page.
 







 4\. Content IP Development: You will be expected to build repeatable content properties, not just individual viral Reels. For example:
 


* Business breakdown formats

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
**Senior Video Editor, AI \& Video Automation** 




 📍 Pitampura, Delhi \| Full\-Time \| 3\+ Years Experience \|
 



  





 Cut fast. Scale faster. Turn one script into fifty videos.
 



  





 We don't need someone who edits one polished video a week. We need someone who can take a single brief, run it through AI tools like Higgsfield, and come back with twenty variations worth testing.
 



  





**About Jolt** 




 Jolt is building a fast\-growing consumer app with ambitions to scale across India and international markets. We're a lean, high\-ownership team, with no committees and no layers of sign\-off — just people who own outcomes end to end.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Jolt needs a constant stream of fresh video content across Meta Ads, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and the old way of editing one video at a time can't keep up. We're looking for a video editor who can combine real editing craft with AI\-driven video tools to produce content at volume, without every video feeling like a copy\-paste. You'll be the person turning a single idea into a full set of testable creative variations.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 01 Video Editing \& Craft
 


* Edit ad creatives, social videos, and YouTube content end\-to\-end, with strong pacing, sound design, and visual storytelling.
* Maintain a consistent editing style and brand feel across every format, from a 6\-second Reel to a longer YouTube piece.



  





 02 AI Video Production \& Automation
 


* Use AI video tools such as Higgsfield and similar platforms to generate, automate, and scale video production beyond manual, one\-at\-a\-time editing.
* Build repeatable workflows and templates that let you (or the wider team) turn a single script or brief into many videos quickly.



  





 03 Scaling Content for Testing
 


* Turn a single brief or script into multiple ad variations, different hooks, formats, and aspect ratios, built for rapid A/B testing.
* Iterate fast on what's working, producing new variations based on performance rather than gut feel alone.



  





 04 Cross\-Platform Formatting
 


* Produce and format videos for Meta Ads, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts and long\-form, respecting each platform's best practices.



  





 05 Collaboration \& Feedback Loops
 


* Work closely with the marketing team to understand what's performing and translate that feedback into the next batch of edits.



  





 06 Asset \& Workflow Management
 


* Keep an organised library of raw footage, templates, and brand presets, so the production pipeline stays fast as volume grows.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* 90 Days: You've mapped the current video workflow, set up AI tooling like Higgsfield, and delivered your first batch of scaled creative variations.
* 6 Months: Video output has scaled up meaningfully without sacrificing quality, and you're consistently producing multiple testable variations every week.
* 12 Months: You own a video production system that keeps performance marketing fed with fresh creative at scale, and can point to specific videos that drove real results.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio spanning ads, social content, and organic video.
* Hands\-on experience with AI video tools such as Higgsfield or similar platforms, for generating, automating, or scaling video production.
* Strong command of standard editing software (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent).
* Experience producing high volumes of short\-form video for Meta Ads, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.
* A real understanding of what makes content perform, including hooks, pacing, and retention, and comfort iterating based on data rather than instinct alone.
* Ability to build repeatable workflows and templates for producing video at scale, not just one\-off edits.
* A strong sense of storytelling, pacing, sound design, and visual style.
* A bias for speed and volume, without letting quality slip.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with motion graphics or basic 3D tools to add polish to key creatives.
* Experience building automated or batch\-processing pipelines for video production, beyond manual editing.
* A portfolio or reel showing before\-and\-after examples of AI\-assisted edits or scaled campaigns.
* Experience in a startup or high\-growth environment.
* Someone who has personally driven real results through their edits before — higher CTR, more views, better engagement, or more conversions — and can speak to exactly how they did it.



  





**Location** 




 On\-site at our office in NSP, Pitampura, Delhi.
 



  





**Ready to Cut This?** 




 Send your resume with a reel or portfolio, and a short note on a video or campaign where AI\-assisted editing helped you scale output. Tell us what results it drove.
 



 📍 Jolt · NSP, Pitampura, Delhi

title: System Transformation - SAP - Senior Associate

This role involves analyzing transportation systems, supporting regional planning initiatives, conducting research, and providing recommendations to improve transportation networks and community development outcomes.

**Organizational Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* Part of the Aditya Birla Financial Service Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9 th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans
* ABHFL operates in the Rs. 11\.4 trillion Indian Housing Finance market, which has grown at a steady rate of 17% CAGR over the last 3 years while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of newer entrants in niche segments like affordable housing and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market and has remained stable at \~37% as on December 2015
* The nature of the HFC business (dealing largely with retail customers in the potentially sensitive area of housing/ mortgages), along with the additional regulatory and control mechanisms imposed as a result, means it is imperative that all functions and processes align and comply with sound risk management guidelines and applicable regulations/ controls proactively and judiciously. This is vital for managing risk and protecting interests of both the business as well as the customer


**Job Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* The Risk team provides core underwriting services fundamental to the ABHFL business health, risk management and sustainability. Structured as a dual to the Sales/ Sourcing team, with positions mapped against corresponding Sales roles across the organization, the Risk team is responsible for necessary controls and process checks to ensure business performance and health
* While the core responsibility for this function is to control the business via robust underwriting and risk management, supporting business expansion via joint evaluation of different product/ market growth proposals with the Sales team is also an important contribution
* The Credit Manager plays the role of executing risk and credit operations in line with established guidelines and norms, and securing the organization against diverse risks in local business operations via process measures and checks. This role is responsible for ensuring robust and efficient creditworthiness and risk assessment. He/ She is the “ears on the ground” member of the Risk Team who meets every customer as part of the underwriting process and also visits the property which is being funded. Therefore, he/she needs to have an understanding of the Legal and Valuation framework to be able to perform their role satisfactorily


**Key Challenges**
* While the ABFL Mortgages team also works with retail customers in the property space, the ABHFL business is exposed to the additional Construction Risk, i.e. risk from under construction projects not getting completed as planned. The Risk Team must factor for this when designing and implementing control mechanisms, and evaluating business proposals
* ABHFL is in its inception phase as a company and in the midst of rapid growth. The Risk function must therefore be able to balance priorities of risk management and business growth efficiently, without increasing sub\-prime exposures or impacting business health and sustainability
* The housing space is characterized by state\-wise norms and business practices, as well as varied interpretations of regulatory guidelines by different stakeholders. It is therefore essential for Risk function team members to remain up to date on business practices/ norms in their respective states/ locations and work within regulatory guidelines in a manner that minimizes business risk and also supports growth objectives


****Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications****
* Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, analytical skills, interpersonal and presentation skills, and execution capabilities
* Education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a CA/ MBA – Finance with minimum 0 – 3 yrs of experience in a bank/ NBFC/ HFC
* Principal Accountabilities

 Underwriting and Portfolio Quality Management
   

  

* Execute risk and credit operations for basic transactions assigned, in adherence with defined frameworks and principles across ABHFL business lines
* Seek guidance from seniors proactively and gather insights on technical aspects as well as state/ property specific considerations for effective risk assessment of individual cases
* Liaise with relevant ABFL Risk team members for clarifications on Legal\-Technical evaluations, as required


 Process Efficiency
   

  

* Execute risk operations efficiently and in a manner that enables business performance while ensuring risk management imperatives
* Coordinate seamlessly with Credit Processing Analysts to ensure case files are logged appropriately before proceeding to initiate credit operations
* Work as per process\-driven coordination mechanisms with Sales and Operations teams for effective decision making and problem solving in line with business and risk management needs; escalate to RCM as required


 Risk Compliance \& Control
   

  

* Ensure compliance with established risk management principles and norms; compile periodic and need based MIS, reports, escalation case documents, etc.
* Conduct local risk operations in line with defined ‘Maker – Checker’ mechanism with Sales and Operations teams in a systematic manner, across key aspects such as exception approvals, collateral valuation, PDD completion, cheque bounce collections, etc.


 Collection Efficiency
   

  

* Work in alignment with process\-driven mechanisms for coordination with the Collections/ Operations team on tracking delinquency cases and driving collections efficiently and effectively

title: Fulfilment Intern
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Fulfilment Intern** 
 to support the end\-to\-end processing of visa applications and learn how high\-quality travel operations work at scale.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with our regional operations team to review applications, track cases, coordinate across stakeholders and support customers through the visa process.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, on\-ground internship where attention to detail, reliability and a willingness to learn matter every day. The role is based in\-office and operates on a 6\-day work week.
   

  

**The Job**
* Support customers through the visa process by helping communicate requirements, documentation and next steps.
* Review visa documentation for completeness and accuracy, escalating issues or missing information when needed.
* Coordinate across teams and external stakeholders to help keep applications moving and support communication with consulates and embassies.
* Track application progress closely and help ensure customers receive timely updates on status and required actions.
* Support accurate and reliable execution by maintaining customer data confidentiality and contributing to a smooth experience from start to finish.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are hungry to learn, take ownership and build real\-world experience in a fast\-moving environment.
* Are detail\-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks without losing accuracy.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
* Are comfortable using digital tools, learning new systems and figuring things out quickly.
* Are proactive, dependable and willing to get hands\-on with whatever it takes to keep things moving.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Inventory Liquidation & Stock Optimization Manager
description:
Inventory Liquidation \& Stock Optimization Manager
   


**Location:** 
 Bijwasan, Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 5–12 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  




 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Inventory Liquidation \& Stock Optimization Manager** 
 with strong expertise in the
 **Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry** 
 .
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring that inventory remains
 **liquid, productive and commercially viable** 
 , with a strong focus on reducing ageing, slow\-moving and non\-moving stock and preventing unnecessary inventory accumulation. The ideal candidate should have strong
 **market/customer connect, inventory analytics, pricing \& discounting expertise, and commercial understanding** 
 to convert inventory into sales while protecting
 



 margins.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Inventory Liquidation \& Ageing Management
 * Analyse inventory ageing across SKU, brand, category, model and location.
* Develop and execute liquidation plans for
 **slow\-moving, non\-moving, obsolete and excess inventory** 
 .
* Define SKU\-wise liquidation priorities based on ageing, value, demand and margin.
* Monitor inventory turnover and ensure continuous stock movement.
* Develop mechanisms to prevent inventory from becoming stagnant.



  




 2\. Data \& Inventory Analytics
 * Analyse
 **inventory ageing, stock holding, sell\-through, inventory turnover, sales velocity and SKU performance** 
 .
* Prepare regular MIS and dashboards for inventory movement and liquidation.
* Identify dead stock and excess inventory through data\-driven analysis.
* Analyse customer purchase patterns and historical sales to identify potential buyers for specific inventory.
* Track liquidation value, recovery value, discount impact and margin realization.



  




 3\. Customer \& Market Development
 * Build and maintain a strong network of
 **distributors, dealers, retailers, workshops and other trade customers** 
 .
* Proactively approach customers for specific slow\-moving or excess SKUs.
* Map available inventory against customer demand and market requirements.
* Develop alternate sales channels for products with low regular movement.
* Maintain strong market intelligence on pricing, demand and competitor activity.



  




 4\. Pricing \& Discount Management
 * Design
 **SKU\-wise/customer\-wise discount structures** 
 for inventory liquidation.
* Determine appropriate discount levels based on stock ageing, purchase cost, market price and expected recovery.
* Balance liquidation speed with
 **gross margin and contribution margin** 
 .
* Develop promotional/bulk\-buying offers for ageing inventory.
* Monitor the impact of discounts on inventory recovery and profitability.



  




 5\. Commercial \& Working Capital Management
 * Focus on reducing
 **working capital blocked in inventory** 
 .
* Monitor inventory value versus sales velocity.
* Identify opportunities to convert dormant inventory into cash.
* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, Purchase and Warehouse teams for liquidation decisions.
* Recommend purchase controls based on inventory performance and demand trends.



  




 6\. Process \& Control
 * Establish SKU\-level inventory movement targets.
* Create ageing buckets and liquidation action plans.
* Set up regular review mechanisms for
 **30/60/90/120\+ day inventory** 
 .
* Develop escalation processes for high\-value and long\-ageing inventory.
* Maintain accurate records of liquidation activities, pricing approvals and customer conversions.



  




 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Inventory Turnover Ratio
* Reduction in 90\+/120\+ day ageing inventory
* Slow \& Non\-Moving Inventory Reduction
* Inventory Liquidation Value
* Inventory Recovery %
* Stock\-to\-Sales Ratio
* Gross Margin / Contribution Margin
* Discount vs. Recovery Analysis
* Working Capital Released
* SKU Sell\-Through Rate
* Reduction in Dead Stock



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **5–12 years of relevant experience** 
 in inventory liquidation, inventory management, commercial operations, sales or stock optimization.
* **Mandatory experience in Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry.**
* Strong understanding of
 **automotive spare parts, accessories, brands, applications and aftermarket distribution** 
 .
* Strong customer and market network in the automotive aftermarket.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **inventory ageing and liquidation strategies** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of pricing, discounting, margins and commercial negotiations.
* Advanced Excel/MIS and strong data interpretation skills.
* Experience working with
 **ERP/inventory management systems** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take commercially sound decisions.



  




 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is someone who understands that
 **inventory is not an asset if it is not moving** 
 . The person should be commercially strong, highly data\-driven and well connected with the automotive aftermarket, with the ability to convert
 **ageing and excess inventory into sales and cash while protecting margins** 
 .
 



  





**Location: Bijwasan, Delhi**

**ABOUT PLAN INDIA**




  





 Plan International (India Chapter), also referred to as Plan India, is an Indian registered not\-for\-profit organization that is constantly striving to advance welfare and development for children and equality for all girls and women in India. Through its grassroots social development work, Plan India seeks to create lasting impact in the lives of poor and vulnerable children, their families and communities, by gender transformative child\-centered community development.
 



  





 Since 1996, Plan India has improved the lives of millions of children and young people by enabling them to access and benefit from the safety nets and schemes of the government for child protection, quality education and healthcare services, healthy environment, livelihood opportunities and participation in community development. To know more about Plan India, visit www.planindia.org
 



  





**PROJECT OVERVIEW**









 Plan India has been selected as Sub Recipient by National AIDS Control Program under Global Fund grant cycle for the period from 1st April 2024 to 31st March 2027 (GC7\) for “Strengthening strategic communication to enhance the delivery of HIV prevention to care continuum programs”. As part of this initiative, Plan India has to develop and deliver different communication packages including SBCC toolkit, Multimedia Campaign strategy and creatives, organising national events, developing and designing NACO’s publications and managing Social Media campaigns. For undertaking this project, the team at Plan India has onboarded communication agency and vendors for the project period.
 



**JOB SUMMARY**




 Plan India seeking a dynamic and visionary Creative/ Content Development to lead our creative team and manage thematic areas. This role is pivotal in driving the development of compelling creatives for both multimedia campaigns (MMC) and social media campaigns. The Manager will provide strategic guidance to our communication agency, ensuring alignment with NACO’s brand’s vision and objectives.
 



**KEY FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**



* **Identify and define key thematic areas for development of multi media campaigns that resonate with the programmatic objectives with National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO).**

* **Review and approve creative outputs, ensuring they meet the desired standards and project requirements.**
* **Facilitate effective communication between internal teams and external creative partners.**
* **Collaborate with marketing and product teams to align themes with overall NACO’s communication strategy.**
* **Develop creative strategies that support marketing and communication goals.**
* **Plan and manage creative project timelines, budgets, and resources.**
* **Monitor campaign performance and make data\-driven adjustments to enhance effectiveness.**








**EDUCATION AND EXPEREINCE**









**Education:** 
 PG degree or diploma in Communications/ Designing or related field.
 



  





**Experience:** 
 Minimum of 5 years of experience in a creative leadership role, preferably within a marketing or advertising agency.
 



  





**Skills:** 



* Strong creative vision and the ability to translate ideas into impactful campaigns.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and project management skills.
* Proficiency in creative software tools.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.



  





**Personal Attributes:** 



* Creative thinker with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong strategic and analytical mindset.
* Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented.

 Plan is an equal opportunity employer and qualified women candidates are encouraged to apply. Our policies and procedures reflect our commitment to child rights and child protection.

 Please send us your updated resume along with suitability note (single Word document only) for the position of “Manager (Creative/ Content Development)’ at planindiacareers@planindia.org.  Over the past 15 years we have built ourselves into one of the leading names in Operation Theatre equipment, ICU equipment and hospital furniture — operating theatre tables, surgical lights, ICU systems, hospital beds and related accessories. Our products today stand at par with the best organisations in the world, not merely the best in India. We compete against global brands in open tenders and win on specification, quality and service.
 



  





**About the Role:** 





 We are hiring one sincere, organised graduate for a long\-term career opportunity in commercial operations, government tenders and executive support, working directly with the CEO.
 




  





**Please read this description fully before applying. We are looking for a few genuine applications, not many casual ones.** 




 This is a hands\-on backend business\-operations role. You will become the dependable person who ensures documents are correct, deadlines are met, customers receive replies, and the company can win and execute serious institutional business.
 



 The work has four connected parts:
 


* **Government tender operations** 
 — monitoring GeM and e\-tender opportunities, compiling documents, submitting bids, tracking corrigenda, EMDs, performance guarantees and deadlines
* **Commercial coordination** 
 — quotations, pricing inputs, vendor documents, orders, banks, logistics, imports and suppliers

 — technical\-commercial documentation, hospital correspondence, demonstrations and order execution



  





 You are
 **not expected to know GeM, tendering, bank guarantees, imports or hospital procurement on Day 1\.** 
 You shall receive a formal structured training. A structured, hands\-on training programme is planned for the first
 **4 to 6 weeks** 
 , delivered by an experienced specialist in this field. You will not be reading manuals — you will be taken through live tenders, real documents, actual hospital correspondence and banking processes as they happen.
 



  





 This is an intensive learning period. It suits someone who takes notes carefully, asks questions the same day rather than a week later, and wants to become genuinely capable rather than merely occupied.
 



  





**What we need from you:** 




 Qualifications are simple. Graduate in any stream, from any college with 0\-1 year experience. Freshers with good written and spoken English and Hindi. Working knowledge of Excel, Word, email, PDFs and online portals.
 



 What actually matters is temperament:
 


* **Learning ability** 
 — you absorb an unfamiliar process quickly, write things down, and do not need the same thing explained repeatedly
* **Ownership** 
 — work given to you gets completed without reminders
* **Initiative** 
 — you ask the question or close the gap yourself instead of waiting to be told
* **Accuracy** 
 — a single wrong figure can lose a tender

 — chasing inputs politely but persistently, again and again

 ₹1\.8–3\.0 lakh per annum, depending on aptitude, communication ability, computer skills and interview performance

 Monday to Saturday, 10 AM – 7 PM
* **Location:** 
 Work from office, Gurugram, Haryana



  





 Candidates from smaller towns and cities are genuinely welcome. Your college name and home town do not matter to us. Sincerity, accuracy and willingness to learn do.
 



  





**Growth with the Organization** 




 This is a trainee\-to\-ownership career path, not a temporary support job. Our philosophy is to give people real responsibility and let capability decide the rest — people in this organisation have grown from junior positions into executive roles by upgrading their skills and taking ownership. Your salary and responsibility will grow with your demonstrated capability.
 



  





 As we expand our product range and move toward export markets, the person in this role will be positioned to grow with that expansion. We are looking for someone who wants to stay and build a career here over several years.
 



  





**PLEASE APPLY ONLY IF:** 




  





 The stated compensation range of ₹1\.8–3\.0 lakh CTC is acceptable to you
 


* You can work from our Gurugram office, Monday to Saturday, 10 AM – 7 PM
* You can arrange your own accommodation if relocating
* You are genuinely interested in documentation\-, coordination\- and deadline\-intensive work
* You are looking for a long\-term learning opportunity, not a short\-term stopgap

 You are seeking remote or hybrid work, a five\-day week, a purely field\-sales or marketing role, immediate independent authority, or compensation above ₹3\.0 lakh CTC. Candidates currently drawing substantially above this range are

 .

 Email your résumé along with a note of

title: Consultant - TB Diagnostics Expert, Infectious Disease – Tuberculosis
description:
PATH current employees \- please log in and apply
 **Here**
 PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
   

  

**About the Project: REACH Bangladesh**
 REACH Bangladesh — Integrated Molecular Diagnostics, Laboratory Systems Strengthening, Emergency Preparedness, and Integrated Laboratory Response Systems — is funded by the U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy (GHSD), and implemented by PATH. The award is a fixed amount award issued under the America First Global Health Strategy to ensure continuity of lifesaving health assistance and to support integrated, country\-led health systems programming, with an anticipated implementation period of approximately 10–12 months.
   

  

 Bangladesh continues to face a significant burden of tuberculosis and other priority infectious diseases, compounded by fragmented laboratory networks, limited decentralized diagnostic access, and gaps in emergency and outbreak\-response readiness at sub\-national levels. PATH will implement the Bangladesh component in close collaboration with the Government of Bangladesh — the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the National Tuberculosis Programme (NTP), the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), and divisional and district health authorities — with BRAC and icddr,b as potential implementing and research partners. Coverage spans 30 districts across seven geographic clusters, alongside national and divisional coordination.
   

  

 The project is organized around three strategic priority areas: (1\) integrated molecular diagnostics and laboratory network strengthening; (2\) laboratory quality, biosafety and workforce excellence; and (3\) emergency preparedness and laboratory resilience — each delivered at national, regional, and district levels and supported by strengthened data systems, MIS, coordination, and learning.
   

  

**PATH is hiring a Consultant – TB Diagnostics Expert, based in India.**
 The Consultant – TB Diagnostics Expert, under the overall supervision of the Deputy Director – TB, South Asia, PATH, and in close coordination with the PATH Bangladesh country team and project leadership, will provide technical oversight and undertake preparatory and inception\-phase activities for the diagnostics, laboratory systems, and emergency preparedness workstreams of REACH Bangladesh. The consultant will bring regional expertise in molecular diagnostics, laboratory network optimization, quality assurance, and biosafety to support rapid start\-up, co\-design with government and donor stakeholders, and the development of technical packages, SOPs, and monitoring frameworks required for implementation.
   

  

**Specific Roles of this Position include\-**
* Provide technical oversight to the REACH Bangladesh diagnostics and laboratory workstreams, and support PATH teams and potential sub\-awardees in translating the co\-design workshop outputs into an approved inception workplan, staffing plan, implementation schedule, and coordination plan.
* Support preparatory work for updating the national laboratory network optimization plan for integrated HIV, TB and priority infectious diseases, and for developing an integrated molecular testing strategy leveraging existing GeneXpert, Truenat, and RT\-PCR platforms.
* Contribute technical inputs to the national roadmap for novel screening and diagnostic tools for TB — including CAD/AI\-assisted handheld X\-ray, N\-PoC, CRISPR, and repurposing of molecular infrastructure — and to the design of a tiered laboratory network defining testing menus and referral pathways.
* Guide preparatory design of decentralized molecular testing, district specimen collection hubs, specimen referral and transportation networks, QR\-code\-enabled sample referral tracking, electronic specimen tracking, and turnaround\-time monitoring, including outreach testing for hard\-to\-reach populations.
* Support development of the national laboratory quality improvement roadmap, updated biosafety guidelines, expansion of External Quality Assessment to peripheral facilities, competency frameworks, certification and leadership programmes, laboratory performance scorecards, and QA process indicators.
* Provide technical oversight for preparatory activities under emergency preparedness and laboratory resilience, including the integrated emergency laboratory preparedness plan, One Health laboratory coordination, harmonized SOPs and referral protocols, laboratory surge planning, rapid response laboratory teams, and simulation and tabletop exercise designs.
* Support integration of TB–DM–HIV testing pathways and alignment of diagnostic protocols with national algorithms and NTP/DGHS guidance.
* Provide technical inputs to MIS, dashboards, data quality assurance, and performance monitoring frameworks for diagnostic and laboratory indicators, including turnaround time, referral pathway performance, and quality improvement indicators.
* Support preparation for co\-creation and coordination engagements with the U.S. Embassy Dhaka, Government of Bangladesh counterparts, technical working groups, and partners, including preparation of agendas, technical briefs, presentations, and workshop documentation.
* Undertake travel to Bangladesh and within the region (approximately 20–30% of time) for co\-design workshops, stakeholder consultations, laboratory assessments, and technical review meetings, as required.
* Prepare periodic progress updates and document technical products, best practices, and lessons learned for internal and external sharing, in line with donor branding, reporting, and milestone verification requirements.
* Perform any other project\-related tasks assigned by the supervisor.


**Qualifications And Competencies Required**
* PhD or postgraduate degree in Public Health, Microbiology, Laboratory Sciences, Health Administration, or an equivalent discipline from a recognized university.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in public health programmes, of which at least 5 years should be in TB or infectious disease diagnostics, laboratory systems strengthening, or diagnostic network management at national or state/provincial level; regional or international experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in molecular diagnostics (GeneXpert, Truenat, RT\-PCR), laboratory network optimization, specimen referral systems, external quality assessment, biosafety, and laboratory quality management systems.
* Familiarity with national TB diagnostic algorithms, laboratory accreditation and certification frameworks, and emergency preparedness and One Health approaches.
* Experience working with government counterparts, donors, and multi\-partner consortia; prior experience with U.S. Government\-funded programmes and milestone\-based reporting is an added advantage.
* Excellent technical writing skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop strategies, SOPs, guidelines, and donor\-ready technical documents.
* Fluency in English is required; working familiarity with Bangla is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate clearly, mentor, and work collaboratively across geographies and time zones under demanding timelines.


 The position requires travel to Bangladesh and within the region as per project needs. We are looking for a self\-motivated, hard\-working, energetic, and creative individual who is a good team player and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
   

  

**Location:** 
 India (Delhi preferred), with travel to Bangladesh
   

  

**Duration:** 
 From the date of joining to August 2027
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Deputy Director – TB, South Asia, PATH
   

  

 The candidate must have legal authorization to work in India.

* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.

**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**

* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.

title: Trainer- Academic Counsellor
description:
Position: Trainer\- Academic Counsellor
   

  

 Location: Gurugram
   

  

 ️ Working Days: Monday to Saturday
   

  

 Experience Required: 2\+ years
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Trainer for the Counselling team, you will own how our counsellors show up in every student conversation. Counsellors are a student’s first meaningful window into the institute — the people who help prospective students and their families understand the institution and confidently take the next step in their application journey. Your job is to make sure every counsellor is equipped, sharp and consistent in those conversations.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role centred on capability building and quality. You will train new joiners, continuously re\-train and sharpen experienced members, assess the quality of every conversation, and personally hand\-hold those who need the most support to bring them up to standard. The role is dynamic by nature — priorities shift with intake cycles, team needs and individual performance — and calls for someone who can move quickly between coaching, assessment and feedback without losing the quality bar.
   

  

 If you love developing people, raising standards, and seeing others succeed because of how you coached them, this role is for you.
   

  

 Role Expectations
   

  

* Train the Team on the Craft of the Conversation
+ Design and deliver structured training on how counsellors engage students and families — how to open a conversation, understand a student’s aspirations, communicate the story with clarity and conviction, address concerns and objections, and guide students confidently toward the next step in their application.
+ Build and maintain a practical training toolkit — pitch frameworks, talk\-tracks, objection\-handling guides, FAQs and role\-play scenarios — and keep it current as the institution and its offerings evolve.
+ Run regular role\-plays, mock conversations and practice sessions so every counsellor can apply what they learn in real student interactions.

* Own Onboarding, Training \& Continuous Re\-Training
+ Take full ownership of training across the entire team — both new joiners and experienced members — ensuring everyone is brought to, and kept at, a high and consistent standard.
+ Run ongoing refresher and re\-training programs for existing members to correct drift, introduce improvements, and keep the whole team sharp as expectations and messaging change.

* Quality Assessment \& Monitoring
+ Assess the quality of counsellor conversations through call and interaction reviews, evaluated against clear, well\-defined quality parameters.
+ Identify gaps in knowledge, approach or communication, and translate what you observe into specific, actionable coaching for each counsellor.
+ Track quality trends across the team over time and use them to shape training priorities and continuously raise the overall standard.

* Hand\-Hold \& Uplift Bottom Performers
+ Take personal ownership of the team’s bottom performers — diagnosing where each of them is struggling and building tailored, hands\-on improvement plans.
+ Provide close, patient, one\-on\-one support — shadowing, live feedback and repeated practice — to bring them up to standard and help them rebuild confidence.
+ Track their progress closely and stay with them until improvement is visible and sustained.

* Partner with Team Leaders on Continuous Feedback
+ Work closely with Team Leaders, giving them regular, specific feedback on the performance and development needs of each of their team members.
+ Share clear observations and recommendations so TLs can reinforce training on the floor and support their teams day to day.
+ Build a tight, two\-way feedback loop with TLs so coaching, quality and on\-ground management stay aligned and consistent.


 Ideal Candidate
   

  

* Prior experience in a trainer role, with a proven ability to build capability and improve how a student\-facing or customer\-facing team performs in conversations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the presence and clarity to be a credible role model for the team.
* Well\-presented and professional — someone counsellors naturally look to and learn from.
* Strong coaching instincts — able to observe a conversation, pinpoint exactly what to improve, and give feedback people can act on.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast\-changing environment, moving fluidly between training, assessment, coaching and feedback.
* A genuine interest in developing people and taking ownership of their growth and success.


 What you can expect in return
   

  

* A high\-ownership role with direct impact on the quality and success of a large, student\-facing team.
* The autonomy to build and shape the training and quality function from the front.
* Exposure to a world\-class leadership ecosystem of founders, CEOs, investors and policymakers.
* The chance to directly shape how thousands of students experience their first conversations.


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 For many students, a counsellor is their first real conversation with the institute — the moment a name becomes a place they can picture their future in. How well that conversation goes depends on how well the counsellor has been trained.
   

  

 As the Trainer for the Counselling team, you are the person who builds that capability. Every counsellor you train, every conversation you sharpen and every performer you lift contributes to a better student experience — and to building the next generation of the community.
   

  

 If you love developing people, raising standards and creating real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Performance Advertising Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* ROAS Optimization \& Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real\-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop).
* Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low\-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi\-touch attribution (MTA) datasets.
* Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic’s performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats.
* Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* CTV \& Video: Implement precise cross\-device graph integrations, household\-level frequency capping, and server\-to\-server attribution systems.
* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.
* Data Engineering \& Scale: Hands\-on experience engineering pipelines handling terabyte\-to\- petabyte scale data via distributed frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).
* Experience deploying production\-grade Machine Learning frameworks for CTR/CVR prediction.
* Strong system\-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

 Our work impacts SDG 6\.2, which aims to provide access to adequate sanitation and hygiene for all and end open defecation, paying special attention to the needs of women and girls and those in vulnerable situations. To increase the reach of our product line and improve sanitation globally, we have established long\-lasting partnerships with local manufacturers, NGOs, and inter\-governmental organizations such as UNICEF, USAID, and JICA (Japan International Cooperation Agency).
   

  

 SATO is a brand of LIXIL, the maker of pioneering water and housing products that solve every day, real\-life challenges, making better homes a reality for everyone, everywhere. We realize our purpose through our portfolio of the industry's most trusted brands, including INAX, GROHE, American Standard, and TOSTEM. The company is present in 150 countries and employs approximately 55,000 people worldwide. We are proud that our products touch the lives of more than a billion people every day.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.sato.lixil.com and www.lixil.com

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Brand Ambassador Intern
description:
**About Knytra** 




 Knytra is a streetwear brand built around bold, everyday fits. We're growing fast and looking for people who can bring the brand to their own circles.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Brand Ambassador Intern, you'll represent Knytra in your network and community and turn that reach into sales. You'll work independently, own your own approach, and see your results directly.
 



  





**Selection process** 



* Shortlisted candidates get an assignment: bring in one sale (a paid pre\-order counts) and share your sales strategy
* Selected candidates then start a two\-week period with Knytra
* Your sales target starts only after you join



  





**What you'll do** 



* Promote Knytra's products through your social media, college, and personal networks
* Bring in sales and lead customers to our store
* Come up with and run your own sales strategy
* Give regular updates on your progress and learnings
* Share feedback on what your audience likes so we can improve



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Strong communication and persuasion skills
* An active network, on campus or online
* Self\-driven, comfortable with targets, and quick to act
* Interest in streetwear, fashion, or brand building
* Students and freshers welcome, with no prior experience required



  





**Work arrangement** 



* Fully remote
* About 4 hours a day, with no fixed shift timings
* Sundays off
* Daily punch\-in and punch\-out on OrangeHRM, with daily tasks assigned in ClickUp



  





**Targets and confirmation** 



* To continue for a further month, you need to complete 5 sales within the first two weeks
* If you don't reach 5 sales, you'll be removed from the Knytra system and paid only for the two weeks you worked



  





**What you'll get** 



* A paid internship with a ₹2,000 monthly stipend
* Hands\-on experience in sales, brand building, and marketing



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply at careers.knytra.in.

 Role Overview

 **Head of Human Resources**
