title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring
 



  





 \- Support monitoring of project implementation across 90 police stations in three states, including field visits to selected police stations on quarterly basis.
 



  





 7\. Coordination
 



  





 Ensuring smooth communication, information exchange and prompt follow up with:
 



  





 \- All state project monitoring units (State Supervisor \& Research Associates in 3 states)
 



 \- External agencies engaged in data analysis (CESS, Hyderabad \& CGG, Hyderabad)
 



 \- Evaluation Agencies for Baseline \& Endline Evaluation in 3 states
 



 \- Donor Agency
 



  





 8\. Documentation and Reporting
 



  





 \- Documentation of Best Practice Visit reports submitted by the Project Coordinator, State Supervisors \& Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher (himself).
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to the Donor Agency as and when required.
 



 \- Preparation of the Final Project Report, based on Public consultation meetings, Change Manual, baseline and endline evaluation reports from the respective states and monthly reports from respective State Supervisors.
 



  





 9\. Miscellaneous
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher will report to the Project Director and Project Coordinator.
 



 \- In\-addition to the above\-mentioned job chart, the Project Director \& Project Coordinator may assign any other project related tasks from time to time.
 



  





 SALARY AND OTHER SERVICE CONDITIONS
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research): Rs. 75,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- Senior Researcher: Rs. 60,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- The selected candidate will have to give the undertaking in the form of the bond to serve for minimum period of one year.
 



 \- Economy\-class airfare for visits to various States and UTs
 



 \- Accommodation in police guest houses (or will be reimbursed as per IPF policy).
 



 \- Other service conditions will be governed by IPF HR and other policies
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Selection will be based on a written examination and an interview (if you clear the written exam) to be held on 15th \& 16th October 2026 at IPF HQ New Delhi.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Please visit https://www.policefoundationindia.org/careers for detailed guidelines.
 



  





 \- Download the application form and fill it out electronically, along with updated CV in PDF format \& send them to us at recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com
 



 \- For queries, write to recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com or contact 9625878853 (Admin Officer) \& 9910224876 (Project Coordinator).
 



 \- Last date for online submission of applications: 5th October 2026 till 4:00 PM only.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Infra Dev Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**
 Infra Dev Specialist role in a global organization focused on building reliable observability and monitoring solutions using Grafana Dynatrace and Splunk. The role requires eight to ten years of experience in infrastructure engineering and automation with responsibilities centered on designing dashboards creating monitoring pipelines and optimizing system performance for critical business services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design monitoring solutions that transform raw infrastructure and application telemetry into meaningful insights by using Grafana Dynatrace and Splunk ensuring reliable visibility for business critical platforms.
* Develop and maintain standardized dashboards and visualizations that help operations and product teams quickly understand service health performance trends and capacity risks across on premises and cloud environments.
* Implement automated alerting strategies that minimize noise while rapidly detecting incidents using dynamic thresholds synthetic tests and user experience metrics to protect key customer journeys.
* Optimize data collection pipelines by defining log metric and trace ingestion patterns that balance observability depth with storage and licensing efficiency across multiple environments.
* Collaborate with infrastructure application and security stakeholders to understand monitoring requirements and translate them into robust observability solutions that support organizational objectives.
* Troubleshoot complex performance and stability issues by correlating metrics logs and traces and work with relevant teams to identify root causes and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Document standards runbooks and operating procedures for monitoring tools so that support teams can consistently operate dashboards alerts and analytics in a repeatable manner.
* Enhance platform reliability through proactive capacity planning utilization analysis and trend forecasting using observability data to recommend scaling and optimization actions.
* Automate recurring operational tasks such as dashboard deployment alert configuration and data source onboarding through scripts and infrastructure as code practices that align with internal governance.
* Coordinate with project teams during releases and infrastructure changes to ensure that new services are instrumented monitored and validated with appropriate dashboards and alerts before entering production.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory expectations by defining observability configurations that protect sensitive information while still enabling effective monitoring and diagnostics.
* Provide knowledge transfer and mentoring to peers by sharing best practices on effective use of Grafana Dynatrace and Splunk helping teams build a strong data driven culture.
* Continuously evaluate new features and improvements in observability tools and recommend enhancements that increase resilience efficiency and customer satisfaction for enterprise systems.


**Qualifications**
* Require eight to ten years of hands on experience in infrastructure engineering or site reliability roles with a strong focus on monitoring observability and operational excellence.
* Require advanced practical expertise in Grafana including dashboard creation data source configuration and alert rule definition across complex distributed environments.
* Require strong experience with Dynatrace for full stack monitoring including configuration of services dashboards problem detection and integration with existing workflows.
* Require deep exposure to Splunk for log management data onboarding search queries dashboards and creation of meaningful alerts that support incident investigations.
* Require solid background in Linux or Windows server administration networking fundamentals and troubleshooting of applications hosted on virtualized or cloud platforms.
* Require experience with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell to automate monitoring configurations data transformations and integration tasks.
* Nice to have familiarity with infrastructure as code tools and configuration management platforms to manage consistent deployment of monitoring and observability assets.
* Nice to have exposure to performance testing capacity modeling and reliability engineering practices that support continuous improvement of service health.
* Nice to have experience working within large multinational organizations where collaboration across time zones and functions is critical for delivering reliable technology services.

**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Build advanced custom reports, dashboards, metrics, and scorecards using Workday Reporting.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**Core Competencies**

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadline
* Strong business acumen
* Collaborative and proactive partnership mindset

title: Wellbeing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vamani Overseas Private Limited is a leading apparel manufacturing and garment export company in India and a key vertical of the 40\-year\-old, $200 million C. Dass Group of Companies. The organization has expanded from a team of over 100 professionals in 2008 to a workforce of about 14,000 employees in 2026, reflecting strong growth and long\-term career opportunities. Vamani specializes in apparel manufacturing, fashion sourcing, private label production, and end\-to\-end supply chain solutions for global fashion brands and retailers. The company focuses on quality, innovation, sustainability, and ethical manufacturing practices, combining technology and creativity to deliver products that meet international standards and changing consumer trends. With a customer\-first philosophy, Vamani aims to be a preferred global apparel manufacturing partner for leading fashion brands and retailers.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Wellbeing Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida \& Faridabad, responsible for supporting the health, wellness, and overall wellbeing of employees across the organization. The role involves planning and implementing wellbeing programs, workshops, and awareness campaigns that address physical, mental, and emotional health needs. Day\-to\-day tasks include coordinating with HR and management to understand employee concerns, organizing wellness activities, maintaining records of participation and outcomes, and ensuring initiatives are inclusive and accessible. The Wellbeing Executive will also identify external partners or service providers when necessary, monitor the effectiveness of wellbeing interventions, and provide regular reports and recommendations to improve employee experience. Collaboration, empathy, and proactive communication are central to the role, helping to foster a supportive and positive workplace culture.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills to engage with employees at all levels.
* Experience or education in human resources, psychology, social work, occupational health, or a related field.
* Ability to plan, coordinate, and evaluate wellbeing initiatives, events, and training sessions.
* Skills in data collection, basic reporting, and use of office productivity tools (such as spreadsheets and presentation software).
* Understanding of workplace wellbeing concepts, including stress management, mental health awareness, and employee engagement.
* Proactive, organized, and detail\-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines.
* Prior experience in employee engagement, CSR, HR support, or wellness programs in a large organization is an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site in a manufacturing environment and collaborating with diverse teams and shift\-based staff.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Role Summary** 




**Manage the end\-to\-end HR lifecycle for the blue\-collar workforce — hiring, onboarding, attendance, statutory compliance, engagement and retention — across on\-roll and contractual staff at the site.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




*Recruitment \& Sourcing* 



* Fulfil bulk hiring for operators, helpers, machine attendants, drivers, loaders, housekeeping and security roles
* Build and manage sourcing channels: local referrals, ITIs, labour contractors, staffing vendors, job melas, field networks and hiring apps such as Apna and WorkIndia
* Screen candidates, run walk\-in drives, coordinate trade tests and roll out offers
* Maintain a ready pipeline so manpower fill rate stays above target at all times



*Onboarding \& Documentation* 



* Verify Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, address proof, medical fitness and police verification where applicable
* Complete joining formalities, ID and access cards, PPE issuance and safety induction
* Maintain accurate employee master data in the HRMS



*Attendance, Payroll \& Vendor Management* 



* Manage biometric attendance systems, shift rosters, overtime and leave records
* Share monthly payroll inputs and resolve wage and deduction queries
* Track contractor invoices, headcount reconciliation and vendor SLA performance



*Statutory Compliance \& IR* 



* Ensure compliance with PF, ESIC, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Factories Act and Shops \& Establishment Act
* Maintain statutory registers and muster rolls; support labour inspections and audits
* Handle disciplinary matters, show\-cause notices, domestic enquiries and grievance redressal
* Liaise with workers' committees and unions to maintain healthy industrial relations



*Engagement \& Retention* 



* Drive attrition control initiatives, exit interviews and stay conversations
* Run welfare activities covering canteen, transport, restrooms, safety drives, festival celebrations and reward programs
* Act as the first point of contact for worker grievances



*Reporting* 



* Publish daily and weekly dashboards on manpower, absenteeism, attrition and compliance to management



**Requirements** 



* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR or MSW preferred
* 2–5 years handling a frontline or blue\-collar workforce in manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, retail or facility management
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory filings
* Fluency in Hindi and the local regional language along with working English; strong ground\-level communication
* Proficiency in Excel and HRMS or attendance software
* Willingness to work in shifts and travel to nearby sites



**Preferred** 



* Experience managing large headcount and multiple contractor vendors
* Exposure to a unionised environment or multi\-site operations



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* **Manpower fill rate • Time\-to\-hire • Monthly attrition % • Absenteeism % • Statutory compliance score • Payroll input accuracy**

title: Client Services and Administration
description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

title: Application Engineer, Aladdin Product Engineering, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
 At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Application Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global Aladdin Accounting Retail fund operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise\-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. You’ll also help the team explore and adopt emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering and Generative AI, where they can meaningfully improve engineering productivity, operational workflows, or user experience.
   

  

**About Aladdin Accounting**
* Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest\-growing commercial product businesses within Aladdin.
* A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments.
* Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations.
* Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and Kafka to manage high\-volume, real\-time data.
* Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business\-critical capabilities.
* Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop robust, high\-performance back\-end systems using Java 21\+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
* Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands\-on approach.
* Build and maintain microservices and event\-driven systems to process and distribute large\-scale financial data with API\-first approach.
* Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real\-time streaming platforms.
* Implement and optimize Redis\-based caching and data stores for low\-latency access patterns.
* Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning.
* Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem\-solving, and design thinking.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI and GenAI capabilities where appropriate to improve software development, operational efficiency, and user experiences, while maintaining strong standards around security, validation, and maintainability.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes.


**Qualifications / Competencies**
* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in Java and object\-oriented design.
* Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modelling.
* Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence.
* Hands\-on exposure to Kafka or similar publish\-subscribe systems for real\-time event processing.
* Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming).
* Exposure to Generative AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development, or agentic AI patterns.
* Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP).
* Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
* Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis.
* Interest in applying AI capabilities responsibly within enterprise software and engineering workflows.
* Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Sr Engineer IT Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Role Purpose**
 A Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, secures, and scales an organization's core technology systems across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role combines deep hands\-on expertise across enterprise compute, storage, and virtualization with knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* System Reliability, Monitoring \& Capacity Planning: Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable systems across hybrid and cloud environments. Define SLIs/SLOs, build out the monitoring and observability roadmap, and analyze resource usage to forecast and manage capacity as traffic and data grow.
* Infrastructure as Code, Automation \& CI/CD: Architect and maintain end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines and code\-driven infrastructure, automating provisioning and reducing manual operational work to enable rapid, safe, and repeatable delivery.
* Hybrid \& Cloud Platform Engineering: Serve as technical lead for the full lifecycle of on\-prem and cloud\-based resources — compute, storage, backup, and virtualization — and design secure, cost\-effective cloud architectures, including migration of on\-premises workloads to the cloud.
* FinOps \& Cost Optimization: Drive FinOps best practices by monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing cloud spend, including cost allocation and reporting.
* Advanced Troubleshooting \& Incident Response: Serve as the final escalation point for high\-impact technical challenges, providing Tier 3 support and leading incident response to minimize downtime across on\-prem and cloud systems.
* Security \& Compliance: Maintain a strong security baseline across platform and cloud services and ensure compliance with standards such as SOC 2 and PCI\-DSS.
* Mentorship, Collaboration \& Documentation: Guide and mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote SRE/DevOps best practices; partner with development, architecture, and security teams, and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards.


**Key Skills \& Qualifications**
* Compute \& Storage Skills
* 10\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure engineering experience, with a proven track record in global enterprise environments.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across Operating Systems (Windows and Linux), enterprise storage, backup (Veeam or similar), and virtualization/hyper\-converged systems (Nutanix), including physical infrastructure in on\-prem or hybrid environments.
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, VPN, SMTP) and core security practices (SSL/TLS, SSH, encryption, LDAP).
* Experience with configuration management (Chef, Ansible, Puppet) and orchestration platforms (CloudBolt, Rundeck).
* Automation and scripting experience (e.g., Python, Shell, PowerShell) to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
* Relevant industry certifications (Microsoft, Red Hat, Nutanix, VMware, backup/storage, Cisco, or security\-related) are a plus.
* Cloud Skills
* Deep, hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP) — including compute, storage, networking, database, and security services; multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud experience preferred.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager) and cloud networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, DNS, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity).
* Experience leading migration of on\-premises applications and data to the cloud.
* Demonstrated experience driving FinOps strategies to optimize cloud spend without compromising performance or security.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS).
* Professional\-level cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect) are a plus.


**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem\-solving skills, with the ability to correlate and troubleshoot complex issues across diverse platforms.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences, and a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle.


**Education**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and work\-related experience.

title: Zonal Admission Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Zonal Admission Manager – North Zone
   

  

 Company: ODM Educational Group
   

 Position: Zonal Admission Manager
   

 Zone: North Zone
   

 Base Location: Gurugram, Haryana
   

 Travel Requirement: Mahendragarh, Kotputli and other North Zone school locations as required
   

 Reporting To: Senior Management / Zonal Leadership
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 ODM Educational Group is looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Zonal Admission Manager – North Zone to lead and oversee admission operations across multiple schools within the assigned zone.
   

  

 The candidate will be based at Gurugram and will be responsible for managing admission performance across the existing schools in Gurugram, Mahendragarh, Kotputli, and additional schools that may be added to the North Zone in the future.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will act as the central point of coordination between the management and individual school admission teams, ensuring that every school achieves its monthly, quarterly, half\-yearly and annual admission targets through structured outreach, counselling, follow\-up, conversion and parent engagement.
   

  

 The role requires strong leadership, sales and admission management capability, data\-driven decision\-making, excellent communication skills and the ability to build a high\-performance admission culture across multiple locations.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Zonal Admission Target \& Performance Management
   

  

 \- Take complete ownership of admission targets for all schools under the North Zone.
   

 \- Translate annual admission targets into half\-yearly, quarterly and monthly actionable targets for each school.
   

 \- Monitor school\-wise:
   

 \- Enquiries
   

 \- Leads
   

 \- Walk\-ins
   

 \- Counselling
   

 \- Applications
   

 \- Admissions/Enrollments
   

 \- Conversion ratios
   

 \- Follow\-ups
   

 \- Lost leads
   

 \- Pending cases
   

 \- Scholarship cases
   

 \- Identify gaps against targets and implement corrective action plans.
   

 \- Ensure consistent admission performance across all schools rather than focusing only on individual high\-performing locations.
   

 \- Prepare and present regular performance reviews to senior management.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Leadership of School Admission Teams
   

  

 Each school will have its own Admission Manager and Counselling Team.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will:
   

  

 \- Guide, monitor and review the performance of each School Admission Manager.
   

 \- Ensure that Admission Managers are executing the approved admission strategy and outreach calendar.
   

 \- Ensure counsellors are following the prescribed calling, counselling and follow\-up protocols.
   

 \- Review daily/weekly/monthly performance reports.
   

 \- Conduct regular review meetings with school admission teams.
   

 \- Identify training requirements and arrange/coordinate coaching for Admission Managers and Counsellors.
   

 \- Ensure accountability for lead management, follow\-up and conversion.
   

 \- Promote coordination between Admission Managers and Counsellors for seamless execution.
   

 \- Ensure that the school admission team operates independently while remaining aligned with zonal objectives.
   

  

 Note: The role will focus specifically on admission operations and performance. The Prodigy/academic operations team will remain outside the direct admission function, while coordination may be required wherever it impacts student acquisition or parent communication.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Outreach \& Lead Generation
   

  

 Ensure that every school has a strong and continuous outreach program.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will monitor and guide school teams in executing:
   

  

 \- Residential society outreach programs
   

 \- School visits and student engagement programs
   

 \- College and institutional outreach
   

 \- Career fairs
   

 \- Education fairs
   

 \- Parent engagement programs
   

 \- Student engagement activities
   

 \- Community outreach
   

 \- Corporate/community tie\-ups
   

 \- Local events and social activities
   

 \- Referral programs
   

 \- Digital and social\-media\-led lead generation initiatives
   

 \- Brand promotion activities
   

 \- Local area marketing initiatives
   

  

 Ensure that every Admission Manager maintains a structured monthly outreach calendar with measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Outreach should not be activity\-driven alone; it must generate quality leads and contribute to admission conversion.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Counselling \& Parent Engagement
   

  

 Ensure that the counselling team follows a standardized and professional counselling protocol.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will ensure that counsellors:
   

  

 \- Make timely calls to all assigned leads.
   

 \- Follow up regularly and systematically.
   

 \- Maintain proper lead records and follow\-up history.
   

 \- Understand the requirements and concerns of parents.
   

 \- Provide accurate and transparent information.
   

 \- Handle parent objections professionally.
   

 \- Explain the admission process clearly.
   

 \- Explain applicable scholarships and eligibility criteria.
   

 \- Ensure timely application and enrollment.
   

 \- Maintain continuous engagement with prospective parents until closure.
   

 \- Provide appropriate post\-enrollment communication and support.
   

  

 The objective should be to create a professional, informative and trust\-based parent experience rather than a purely sales\-driven interaction.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Walk\-in \& Admission Conversion Management
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will ensure that every school follows a standardized walk\-in management process.
   

  

 Parents/clients visiting the school should receive complete information regarding:
   

  

 Academic Journey
   

  

 \- Pre\-Primary
   

 \- Primary
   

 \- Secondary
   

 \- Senior Secondary
   

 \- Higher education opportunities, wherever applicable
   

 \- Integrated/long\-term educational pathways within the ODM ecosystem
   

  

 Competitive \& Career Preparation
   

  

 Where applicable, parents should be appropriately informed about opportunities for:
   

  

 \- JEE preparation
   

 \- NEET preparation
   

 \- Other competitive examination support
   

 \- Career\-oriented academic programs
   

  

 Holistic Development
   

  

 The counselling team should effectively communicate the school's opportunities for:
   

  

 \- Sports
   

 \- Music
   

 \- Singing
   

 \- Basketball
   

 \- Cricket
   

 \- Volleyball
   

 \- Swimming
   

 \- Horse riding
   

 \- Other extracurricular activities
   

 \- Student engagement programs
   

 \- National and international\-level participation and recognition
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will ensure that such information is communicated accurately, consistently and in accordance with approved school/group communication.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Application, Enrollment \& Post\-Enrollment Process
   

  

 Ensure that the complete admission journey is managed smoothly:
   

  

 Lead → Contact → Counselling → Follow\-up → Walk\-in → Application → Scholarship/Financial Discussion → Enrollment → Post\-Enrollment Support
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Ensuring timely application processing.
   

 \- Monitoring pending applications.
   

 \- Ensuring proper documentation.
   

 \- Monitoring enrollment timelines.
   

 \- Tracking admission drop\-offs.
   

 \- Following up on incomplete cases.
   

 \- Ensuring accurate fee/course communication.
   

 \- Ensuring parents receive proper information regarding applicable fees and policies.
   

 \- Coordinating with relevant school departments for a smooth post\-enrollment experience.
   

 \- Identifying reasons for admission cancellations or drop\-outs and developing corrective measures.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. Data, MIS \& Admission Analytics
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager must establish a strong data\-driven admission management system.
   

  

 Regularly monitor:
   

  

 \- School\-wise target vs achievement
   

 \- Lead generation
   

 \- Lead source
   

 \- Calling performance
   

 \- Contactability
   

 \- Walk\-in ratio
   

 \- Application ratio
   

 \- Conversion ratio
   

 \- Counsellor\-wise performance
   

 \- Admission Manager\-wise performance
   

 \- School\-wise performance
   

 \- Scholarship cases
   

 \- Pending applications
   

 \- Lost leads
   

 \- Admission cancellations
   

 \- Revenue/fee realization, where applicable
   

  

 Prepare:
   

  

 Daily / Weekly
   

  

 Operational performance tracking and critical follow\-up review.
   

  

 Monthly
   

  

 School\-wise target vs achievement and performance review.
   

  

 Quarterly
   

  

 Trend analysis, strategy review and corrective action plan.
   

  

 Half\-Yearly
   

  

 Zonal performance evaluation and strategic planning.
   

  

 Annual
   

  

 Complete North Zone admission performance analysis and next\-year planning.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Review \& School Visits
   

  

 The base location will be Gurugram, but the candidate must be willing to travel periodically to schools under the North Zone.
   

  

 Expected locations may include:
   

  

 \- Gurugram
   

 \- Mahendragarh
   

 \- Kotputli
   

 \- Other North Zone locations added in the future
   

  

 During school visits, the Zonal Admission Manager will:
   

  

 \- Review admission performance.
   

 \- Meet the Admission Manager and Counselling Team.
   

 \- Audit lead and follow\-up records.
   

 \- Review outreach activities.
   

 \- Evaluate parent/walk\-in handling.
   

 \- Identify operational gaps.
   

 \- Conduct performance reviews.
   

 \- Provide on\-ground guidance and training.
   

 \- Ensure implementation of management directives.
   

 \- Develop location\-specific action plans.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 9\. Strategy \& Business Development
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will contribute to the development of the North Zone admission strategy by:
   

  

 \- Identifying local market opportunities.
   

 \- Understanding parent/student demographics.
   

 \- Identifying high\-potential catchment areas.
   

 \- Developing school\-specific lead\-generation strategies.
   

 \- Identifying new outreach channels.
   

 \- Building institutional/community relationships.
   

 \- Studying competitor activities and local admission trends.
   

 \- Recommending new marketing and outreach initiatives.
   

 \- Supporting new school launches from an admission perspective.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 10\. New School Integration
   

  

 As ODM Educational Group expands its presence in the North Zone, additional schools may be added under the Zonal Admission Manager.
   

  

 The incumbent will be responsible for supporting the admission setup of new schools, including:
   

  

 \- Admission team structure
   

 \- Target planning
   

 \- Recruitment/support for admission personnel
   

 \- Counselling process
   

 \- Lead\-generation strategy
   

 \- Outreach planning
   

 \- MIS implementation
   

 \- Local market mapping
   

 \- Admission launch strategy
   

 \- Performance monitoring
   

  

 The role therefore has the potential to expand with the growth of the North Zone.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 11\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will coordinate with relevant internal functions including:
   

  

 \- School Leadership
   

 \- Admission Managers
   

 \- Counsellors
   

 \- Marketing/Branding Team
   

 \- Academic Team
   

 \- Prodigy/Program Teams
   

 \- Finance Team
   

 \- Operations Team
   

 \- HR Team
   

 \- Senior Management
   

  

 The objective is to ensure that admission activities, marketing, counselling, academics and parent experience remain aligned.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 Performance will be evaluated through measurable parameters including:
   

  

 1\. School\-wise admission target achievement
   

 2\. Monthly / Quarterly / Half\-Yearly / Annual target achievement
   

 3\. Lead generation and quality
   

 4\. Lead\-to\-walk\-in conversion
   

 5\. Walk\-in\-to\-application conversion
   

 6\. Application\-to\-enrollment conversion
   

 7\. Overall admission conversion rate
   

 8\. Follow\-up effectiveness
   

 9\. Counsellor productivity
   

 10\. Admission Manager productivity
   

 11\. Outreach activity and lead contribution
   

 12\. Pending lead/application reduction
   

 13\. Admission cancellation/dropout reduction
   

 14\. Timely MIS and reporting
   

 15\. Parent engagement and service quality
   

 16\. New\-school admission readiness and ramp\-up
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 \- Graduate/Postgraduate in Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Education or a relevant discipline.
   

 \- MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Sales or related field will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 \- 5–10\+ years of relevant experience in admissions, education sales, school admissions, counselling, business development or related roles.
   

 \- Experience managing multiple schools/branches/locations will be highly preferred.
   

 \- Candidates with experience in K\-12 schools, educational groups, coaching institutes, EdTech or higher education admissions may be considered.
   

 \- Experience in managing Admission Managers/Counsellors and achieving multi\-location targets will be an advantage.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Key Skills
   

  

 \- Multi\-location team management
   

 \- Admission \& enrollment management
   

 \- Sales \& conversion management

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:

 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

* Candidates should possess functional skills in Direct Tax, GST, and International Tax, including understanding of returns, compliance timelines, and basic tax planning concepts.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with Corporate Law and FEMA\-related compliance, including maintaining statutory records and supporting filings and documentation.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with MS Excel, Word, and accounting/tax software, along with the ability to work with digital documentation and online portals.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical, research, and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in calculations and documentation.
* Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients and team members.
* Candidates should possess a proactive and learning\-oriented mindset, integrity, time management skills, and the ability to work under supervision

Reporting to the offshore Channel Lead \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement, this role produces, governs, and readies all event and executive\-facing assets, ensuring accuracy, compliance, accessibility, and reuse across conferences, client summits, advisory boards, and virtual programs.  As the Full\-Time Affiliate Marketing Specialist/Manager, you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and scaling Jebelz’s affiliate program across the UAE and the broader GCC region. You will identify, recruit, and manage strategic partnerships with affiliate networks, publishers, coupon/deal portals, cashback websites, media houses, and content creators to drive traffic, acquire new customers, and maximize e\-commerce revenue.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Program Strategy \& Execution
 


* Design, build, and execute Jebelz’s end\-to\-end affiliate marketing strategy aligned with business revenue targets.
* Define competitive commission structures, incentive tiers, and payout models (CPA, CPL, CPS) for different partner segments.



 2\. Partner Recruitment \& Relationship Management
 


* Actively recruit, onboard, and retain top\-tier affiliates, publishers, influencer networks, price\-comparison engines, and deal/cashback platforms across the MENA region.
* Maintain strong, long\-term relationships with key affiliates through proactive communication, weekly newsletters, and tailored promotional offers.



 3\. Campaign \& Promotions Management
 


* Plan and run exclusive affiliate campaigns tied to key shopping seasons (e.g., White/Yellow Friday, Ramadan, Eid, UAE National Day, Back\-to\-School).
* Provide affiliates with optimized creative assets, tracking links, banners, product feeds, and exclusive promo codes.



 4\. Network \& Platform Optimization
 


* Manage affiliate platforms and tracking networks (e.g., Impact, Admitad, ArabyAds, CJ Affiliate, or custom software solutions).
* Ensure seamless tracking, attribution accuracy, fraud prevention, and timely partner payouts.



 5\. Performance Analysis \& Reporting
 


* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance KPIs, including sales volume, Conversion Rate (CR), Average Order Value (AOV), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
* Analyze affiliate channel profitability and optimize underperforming partnerships.
* Prepare clear performance dashboards and reports for leadership.



  





 Requirements \& Qualifications
 



  




* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of dedicated full\-time experience managing e\-commerce affiliate programs in the UAE or GCC region.
* **Network Knowledge:** 
 Established relationships with key MENA publishers, deal/cashback platforms, content sites, and affiliate networks (e.g., Admitad, ArabyAds, Impact, ArabClicks).
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Hands\-on experience with affiliate tracking software, deep linking, product feed management (XML/CSV), and web analytics tools (Google Analytics 4\).
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Strong data analysis skills to evaluate campaign performance, ROI, and partner attribution.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Outstanding negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
