title: Analyst - D2C Merchandising
description:
**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter



  





**Work Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:

 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.

**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.** 










**As the \[Position Title], you will:** 





**Operational BAU Support** 




 • Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.

**Projects**

**About you** 





**Formal Education**

**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
   

 • Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.
 



**Technical Skills**

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Platform Engineer** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Candidates should be based out of Delhi NCR / Bhopal)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-10 years total · 3\+ years owning platform architecture or data infrastructure in production
 



**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending, fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



 We are in scale\-up mode \- shipping fast, onboarding customers continuously, and standardizing the platform engineering patterns that compound across every customer and product line.
 



**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on engineering role with architectural ownership. You will spend the majority of your time designing and writing code, not running a program office and not managing a team. You will take ambiguous requirements from customer environments \- undocumented schemas, legacy ERP systems, inconsistent data quality and turn them into reliable, repeatable platform capability.
 



 You will operate with a high degree of independence, make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy calls, and be accountable for how the platform performs, scales, and stays up in front of customers.
 



**What You'll Do** 




**1\. Platform Architecture \& System Design** 



* Own the architecture of Sutra.AI’s core platform services \- service boundaries, API contracts, data models, and integration patterns across the stack.
* Translate solution and customer requirements into concrete engineering approaches, reference architectures, and build sequences the wider team can execute against.
* Design for multi\-tenancy, scale, and reuse so that platform capability built for one customer generalizes to the next.
* Proactively challenge architectural gaps, evaluate technical feasibility, and make pragmatic build\-versus\-configure decisions with clear trade\-off reasoning.
* Drive technical decisions through design documents, architecture reviews, and working prototypes rather than opinion.



**2\. Data Infrastructure \& Pipelines** 



* Design, build, and operate ingestion pipelines from diverse customer systems \- ERP, CRM, MES, relational and non\-relational databases, files, and APIs.
* Own batch and streaming data processing, orchestration, transformation layers, and the storage architecture underneath analytics and AI workloads.
* Build data quality, schema\-drift detection, lineage, and reconciliation controls so downstream models and dashboards can be trusted.
* Model relationships between operational systems, workflows, and data sources where documentation does not exist, and formalize what you discover.
* Optimize query performance, storage cost, and pipeline throughput as data volumes and customer count grow.
* Build and maintain the data foundations that AI workloads depend on, including retrieval, embedding, and feature pipelines.



**3\. Security, Governance \& Multi\-Tenancy** 



* Implement tenant isolation, access control, secrets management, and encryption standards across platform and data layers.
* Build the governance controls \- audit trails, retention, PII handling \- required to operate credibly in enterprise and regulated customer environments.
* Partner with engineering leadership to align platform practices to compliance frameworks relevant to our customers.



**4\. Engineering Standards \& Technical Leadership** 



* Establish platform engineering standards, reusable components, internal libraries, and documentation that raise the whole team’s throughput.
* Mentor engineers through design discussions, code review, and pair programming; lead by example on code quality.
* Identify engineering and operational risks early, design mitigation plans, and resolve them with stakeholders rather than only reporting them.
* Collaborate with Implementation, Solutioning, and Product teams so platform decisions stay tied to customer value and delivery timelines.



**Requirements** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6\-10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years owning platform, infrastructure, or data engineering systems in production.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership \- you have designed systems end to end, not only implemented someone else’s design.
* Strong backend engineering skills in Python (and comfort with Node.js/TypeScript services), including APIs, async systems, and distributed architectures.
* Deep data engineering experience: ETL/ELT design, batch and stream processing, orchestration, and warehouse or lakehouse modelling.
* Strong SQL and database engineering \- schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning across relational and NoSQL stores.
* Hands\-on cloud experience (AWS primary; Azure or GCP acceptable) including compute, storage, managed databases, networking, and IAM.
* Working experience with containerization, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership: systems you shipped independently from problem statement to production and then operated.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills across layers \- data quality, application behaviour, infrastructure, and system design.
* Ability to work through ambiguity: undocumented systems, incomplete requirements, and competing priorities across concurrent engagements.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.



**Preferred** 



* Experience in startups or fast\-growth product environments with high ownership and low process overhead.
* Experience building platform or data foundations for AI/ML workloads \- retrieval systems, vector stores, feature or embedding pipelines.
* Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS platform experience.
* Exposure to enterprise system integration (ERP, CRM) and to industrial domains such as manufacturing, supply chain, or production.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2\) and enterprise security review processes.
* Open\-source contributions, published technical writing, or internal platform tooling you built and others adopted.



**Core Technical Competencies** 




**Languages:** 
 Python (primary), SQL, TypeScript/JavaScript; Bash for automation
 



**Data Engineering:** 
 Airflow or equivalent orchestration, dbt, Spark, Kafka or similar streaming, batch and incremental pipeline design
 



**Storage \& Query:** 
 PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, object storage, columnar warehouses, Trino or equivalent query engines
 



**Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC) primary; Azure/GCP secondary; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 



**DevOps \& Reliability:** 
 CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, monitoring and alerting, logging and tracing, incident response
 



**APIs \& Services:** 
 REST and GraphQL design, FastAPI, Node.js/Express, event\-driven and microservices patterns, authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT)
 



**AI Platform Exposure:** 
 Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS), RAG and retrieval infrastructure, LLM orchestration frameworks
 



**Security \& Governance:** 
 Tenant isolation, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, access control, audit logging
 



**Success Metrics** 



* Platform Reliability: uptime, performance, and stability of platform services and pipelines in customer environments.
* Data Trust: pipeline success rates, data quality issues caught before delivery, and reduction in analytics and AI defects traced to data.
* Delivery Leverage: reduction in time and effort to onboard a new customer or stand up a new use case on existing platform capability.
* Engineering Quality: first\-time build quality, defect rates, and reduction in quality\-driven escalations across engagements.
* Efficiency: cloud and infrastructure cost per customer as scale increases.



**The Ideal Candidate** 



* Builder\-owner: you take a problem from an ambiguous statement to running a production system without needing constant direction.
* Systems thinker: you see how components interact, and you design for the failure modes as much as the happy path.
* Pragmatic: you optimize for what the business needs now while keeping the door open for what it will need next, and you can tell those apart.
* Detective mindset with data: undocumented schemas and messy source systems are a puzzle to solve, not a blocker to escalate.

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager on BCG’s IT HR Systems Group, you will serve as a hands\-on configuration expert across Workday, with deep focus on Advanced Compensation—designing, building, and maintaining salary, bonus, eligibility rules, and cycle frameworks—while also supporting configuration across Core HCM, Security, and other modules as needed to ensure cohesive, scalable system design aligned with business strategy. You will work with Global Comp Stakeholders and Product Team to translate BCG’s compensation strategy into scalable Workday solutions, combining technical configuration and functional expertise to ensure accurate execution of compensation cycles, data integrity, and continuous platform improvement
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources or information systems with 7\+ years of deep, hands\-on configuration experience with Workday Advanced Compensation and Core Compensation is a must
* Strong Understanding of merit pools, compensation review statements, proration rules, complex scorecards, grade setups, eligibility rules, etc. and integration points with Core HCM, Talent modules and third\-party payroll systems is a must
* Certification, such as Workday Pro \- Advanced Compensation, is strongly preferred.
* Prior Consulting experience as a Workday Comp Lead or an architect role on end\-to\-end implementation projects is strongly preferred
* Prior experience with large, global companies with complex enterprise\-scale comp implementations in Workday is strongly preferred
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans to ensure high quality before deployment is preferred
* Familiarity with Workday Docs and BIRT to build templates and control dynamic field visibility, and with Workday Security Configuration, is preferred
* Technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues, are preferred
* Skilled in stakeholder management, offering training and support to end\-users during annual compensation cycles while delivering exceptional customer service year\-round for L3 support items is preferred


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager will join a team of:
   

  

* Other members of the HR IT team, including the Workday Delivery Team, the Comp squad, and other squads under the People Portfolio
* Global Comp stakeholders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
* QA Teams for testing on specific enhancements and software releases


 Additional info
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
 Plan and Execute Comp Configuration: Design and build intricate variable pay, merit, bonus, allowances, including compensation review statements, and the overall coordination of events within Workday.
   

  

 Cycle Management: Own the end\-to\-end execution of Annual Salary Reviews, mass operation management, and merit grid setups.
   

  

 Business Processes: Configure Business Process Frameworks (BPF), condition rules, validations, and complex calculated fields.
   

  

 Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Product Team and HR/Compensation leaders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
   

  

 Testing: Perform Testing, validate self and peer configurations, and troubleshoot system defects during Workday releases.
   

  

 Documentation: Create clear and comprehensive specification documents for application modifications and new functionality additions, for Workday
   

  

 Data Integrity \& Audits: Ensure the accuracy of compensation data and maintain internal compliance and audit processes.

Your primary responsibility will be to analyze our customers' existing IT landscapes, understand their security and network architectures, and design secure and scalable AWS solutions. You will be instrumental in helping customers modernize their security infrastructure, including migrating from legacy firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and adopting SD\-WAN technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Security Architecture Design:
* Assess customers' existing security and network architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective AWS cloud solutions aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Develop detailed security architecture diagrams, documentation, and migration plans.
* Recommend and implement security enhancements and transformations, such as moving to VM\-series firewalls and SD\-WAN.
* Cloud Security Implementation:
* Configure and deploy AWS security services (e.g., IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, VPCs, Security Groups, NACLs) to protect workloads in the cloud.
* Implement and manage security infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and web application firewalls (WAFs).
* Automate security configuration and deployment using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like CloudFormation or Terraform.
* Security Transformation:
* Lead the transformation of customers' security posture from traditional models to modern, cloud\-centric approaches.
* Provide expertise in migrating from port\-based firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN technologies.
* Design and implement network segmentation strategies to isolate workloads and minimize the attack surface.
* Risk Management and Compliance:
* Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify security gaps in the cloud environment.
* Develop and implement security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with industry regulations (e.g., HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR).
* Participate in security audits and compliance reviews.
* Collaboration and Communication:
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, including cloud engineers, developers, and project managers.
* Communicate security requirements and best practices to stakeholders at all levels.
* Provide security training and mentorship to other team members.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in security architecture, with a focus on cloud security and AWS.
* Strong understanding of network and security architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Deep expertise in AWS security services and best practices.
* Experience designing and implementing security solutions for cloud migration projects.
* Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, CIS, ISO 27001\).
* Familiarity with security tools and technologies, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and SIEM solutions.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform).
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty or equivalent certification is highly preferred.
* Experience migrating from traditional firewalls to VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN solutions.
* Experience with cloud security automation tools.
* Experience working with enterprise customers.

**About Tarutium**
 Tarutium Global Consulting (pronounced as taru\-shee\-yum) delivers transformative insights, strategies, and solutions to drive sustainable, resilient, and inclusive global progress. Our mission is to \`bridge the Science\-Institutions\-Society interface with a core agenda of providing transformative solutions to the development challenges. Established in 1996 by eminent development professionals, it caters to a diverse range of bilateral and multi\-lateral agencies, government departments, corporations, and other development organizations through research, technology, solution innovations, and implementation support. Over the past two and a half decades, Tarutium has undertaken policy analysis, strategy development, action research, technical assistance, program design, project management support, assessments, and evaluations. We have addressed various institutional, financial, economic, social, and technical issues across diverse public systems, cultures, and corporate formations.
   

  

 Tarutium works in Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, and Southeast Asian countries like Afghanistan, Indonesia, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, UAE, Eswatini, Bangladesh, Tanzania, Myanmar and others. The organization is committed to quality, accuracy, and succinctness in its consulting and advisory services. Tarutium’s team of professionals has extensive national and international experience and a strong network of advisors, consultants, partner institutions, and associations worldwide. Our expertise spans critical sectors such as climate, disaster management, sustainability, infrastructure, urban services, social impact, economic growth, entrepreneurship, behaviour change, health, and more. title: IT Systems Administrator
description:
**About The Role**
 Protsahan India Foundation operates 5 centres in Delhi, with 50\+ staff, each managing their own devices, alongside shared infrastructure — CCTVs, biometric attendance systems, WiFi networks, and programme equipment. As we scale, formal IT management is required for each of the 5 centers and the administrative office location.
   

  

 The IT Systems Administrator will own all of this — not as a helpdesk ticket\-taker, but as the person who makes sure none of it fails. You will be the single point of accountability for IT infrastructure, device health, data security, and digital compliance across all locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Device Management
* Manage 50\+ laptops across 6 locations: setup, configuration, asset tagging, condition tracking, maintenance, and repair
* Maintain the IT asset register per Protsahan’s asset management SOPs — every device tracked by location, user, and condition
* Coordinate hardware procurement: obtain quotes, recommend vendors, and process purchase requests through Finance
* Manage device allocation for new joiners and secure retrieval at exit — within the timelines defined in HR SOPs
* Initiate and document write\-off requests for end\-of\-life devices per the disposal policy
* Network and Connectivity
* Manage WiFi, LAN, and internet connectivity at all 6 centre locations
* Troubleshoot network outages and connectivity issues; escalate to ISP vendors where required
* Maintain router and network device configurations; document network topology for each location
* Coordinate with ISP vendors on service quality, renewals, and upgrades
* CCTV Systems
* Maintain and monitor CCTV infrastructure at all 6 locations
* Manage CCTV storage: ensure recording continuity, footage retention per policy, and periodic storage health checks
* Control access to CCTV footage — only authorised personnel per the IT and Data Protection Policy
* Coordinate with CCTV vendors for installation, repair, and expansion
* Biometric Attendance Systems
* Maintain biometric attendance devices at all locations; ensure data sync and accuracy
* Coordinate with HR on attendance data extraction and troubleshoot device failures
* Manage device firmware and software updates; coordinate vendor support for hardware issues
* IT Helpdesk and Staff Support
* First\-line IT support for all 50\+ staff across 6 locations — hardware issues, software queries, account access problems
* Respond to support requests within 24 hours; resolve or escalate within 3 working days
* Provide hands\-on support at centre locations through scheduled visits (minimum monthly) and emergency visits when required
* Conduct basic IT literacy orientation for new staff on Day 1 as part of the onboarding process
* Google Workspace Administration
* Administer Protsahan’s Google Workspace: create and deactivate user accounts, manage shared drives, set access permissions
* Enforce the Shared Drive folder structure per ADM SOPs — ensure staff create and store files in Shared Drive, not personal My Drive
* Manage storage quotas, conduct periodic access audits, and generate usage reports for ED
* Troubleshoot Google Workspace issues for staff
* IT Security and Data Protection Compliance
* Enforce Protsahan’s IT and Data Protection Policy across all locations
* Implement and maintain password policies, device locking, and access control practices
* Support compliance with DPDP Act 2023 requirements — data inventory, access logs, incident response
* Conduct quarterly IT security audits across all 6 locations and report findings to ED
* Manage software licensing: track all licences, renewals, and compliance — no unlicensed software on Protsahan devices
* Programme Equipment Support
* Support Canon DSLR camera geotagging setup at all GECs: Canon Camera Connect app pairing, Location Services configuration, and staff training per SOP\-EE\-07
* Troubleshoot programme AV equipment, projectors, and other tech used in GEC activities
* Ensure camera and device firmware is kept up to date
* Vendor Management
* Maintain a vendor register for all IT service providers: ISP, hardware, CCTV, biometric, software
* Obtain comparative quotes for hardware and service procurement per Finance SOPs
* Monitor vendor service quality and SLA compliance; escalate persistent issues to ED


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field
* 2 to 4 years of experience in IT administration, systems administration, or IT helpdesk
* Hands\-on experience managing Google Workspace (user admin, Shared Drive, permissions)
* Working knowledge of WiFi and LAN network management
* Experience with CCTV systems and/or biometric attendance devices
* Basic understanding of data protection and IT security principles
* Ability to work independently across multiple locations with minimal supervision
* Willingness to travel across all 6 Delhi centre locations as required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience in an NGO or social sector organisation
* Familiarity with DPDP Act 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection) requirements
* Experience with asset management and maintaining IT asset registers
* Relevant certifications: CompTIA A\+, Google Workspace Administrator, or equivalent


**What We Expect**
 This role is not a 9\-to\-5 desk job. When the biometric device at a centre fails on a Monday morning, you are the person who resolves it — not who logs a ticket and waits. You will be expected to:
   

  

* Be responsive. Staff across 6 locations depend on functional equipment to run their programmes.
* Be proactive. Don’t wait for things to break — maintain, audit, update.
* Own the documentation. Every device, every vendor, every access permission must be on record — not in your head.
* Understand the stakes. Protsahan works with vulnerable children. IT failures have programme consequences. Data breaches have child protection consequences.


**How To Apply**
 Send your CV and a brief note on your relevant experience to hr@protsahan.co.in with the subject line: Application — IT Systems Administrator.

title: Senior Fire Engineer
description:
**Joining Arup**
 Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
   

  

 We are an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services. Through our work, we make a positive difference in the world.
   

  

 As a Senior Fire Engineer you will be working with a creative, innovative, multi\-cultural and self\-motivated team of fire safety consultants in India, the wider UKIMEA region and globally. The successful candidate will complement our fire safety consultants by assisting with the implementation of fire engineering solutions and fire strategies across our projects. Due to our geographic location, we are very well positioned to work closely with our fire teams globally. It's an exciting time to be a part of our growth in India.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The successful candidate will form part of the project team on a range of different projects, managing junior engineers, and being supported by the wider team as necessary. The role will involve interactive and collaborative working with our fire engineers and with colleagues throughout the multidisciplinary teams at Arup. The projects will be diverse, exciting and range from conceptual fire strategy and masterplan developments through to detailed design and handing over landmark projects.
   

  

 Our Fire Engineering team takes a particularly active role in the development of our people and routinely provide opportunities to attend appropriate training and development courses. Also, because of the developing nature of fire engineering, employees are encouraged to attend annual conferences and CPD events (both internal and external). Once you have demonstrated a suitable skill level in fire engineering and delivery of projects there will be a number of opportunities to advance your career.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is technically excellent and capable of delivering quality fire safety solutions on time and on budget. A proven track record of gaining agreement for prescriptive and performance\-based design solutions from approving authorities is also essential.
   

  

 As a senior member of the Fire team, you will have strong communication and negotiating skills and experience of leading project teams. You will be a team player capable of imparting knowledge and experience to other members of the team to grow and develop them under your support.
   

  

 You should have strong commercial and client facing skills and be able to represent Arup externally with minimal supervision. An existing portfolio of clients / contacts in the industry would be of benefit.
   

  

 Experience in the principles of smoke control and means of escape are essential and knowledge of fire safety codes, standards and guidance associated with the industry is also important.
   

  

 At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Is this role right for you?**
**We Are Looking For Candidates With**
* A minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant degree subject (fire engineering, other types of engineering, or architecture related degree).
* Chartered status with a relevant institution such as the Institution of Fire Engineers or be close to gaining Chartered Engineer status or equivalent (e.g. Professional Engineer in USA).
* 7\+ years’ experience in a consultancy or similar environment with at least 3 years in a similar senior position. Extensive experience in delivering fire engineered solutions.
* Awareness of industry challenges and code changes and experience in implementation in projects as well as discussing/presenting to clients and stakeholders on the topic.
* Knowledge of IBC and NFPA codes and standards would be a benefit but not essential.
* Be familiar with RIBA stages of design or other design frameworks and understand the total fire concept: from the client brief through to construction and operation, the fire engineering challenges relevant to different design stages and the level/type of fire engineering input required to progress the design and contribute to completion.
* Experience in managing other engineers in the development and implementation of fire strategies, projects, and research initiatives.
* Experience in managing financial performance on projects.
* Experience in negotiation and agreement of scope, fee, contractual terms and conditions with clients. Understand and manage the scope and relevant programme constraints of projects, experience in project changes management.
* Experience in presenting and discussing design solutions, including fire engineering assessments, to approving authorities and other stakeholders.
* Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting junior engineers in their career development.
* Excellent report writing, presentation and communication skills, be collaborative, be creative and engaging.
* Experience in business development activities and establishing a network of clients / colleagues inside and outside Arup.


**Reward And Benefits**
 We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance
   

  

**Different people, shared values**
 At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
   

  

 At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks \- BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ\+ and Women \- provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference \- discover more about life at Arup here.
   

  

 At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
   

  

 At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
   

  

**What happens next?**
 If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
   

  

 Stay safe online \- Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

 Full\-time
 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 





 The ORD Rider sits at the point where vehicle testing meets live customer delivery. The role runs two activities in parallel: On\-Road Deployment (ORD) testing of Pluto's EV fleet under real duty cycles, and last\-mile delivery execution for Pluto's clients. Every shift on the road doubles as a data point on vehicle performance and a completed customer order.

* Operate the assigned Pluto EV to collect orders from the spoke location and deliver them within the assigned area.
* Deliver a minimum of 35 orders per day \- ideally 50\-55 orders per day,ensuring timely pick\-up and delivery of all orders assigned through the platform.
* Return undelivered or failed\-delivery orders to the spoke location, or wherever instructed by the client’s operations team
* Report to the spoke location at the scheduled reporting time on all working days.
* Handle all goods with due care and deliver them in the condition received, following safety and operational protocols.



**Vehicle Operation \& Testing** 



* Operate and test the assigned EV during shifts, accumulating kilometres through real delivery routes as directed by the supervisor.
* Maintain the EV in its provided condition, normal wear and tear excepted, and return it on termination.
* Charge or swap the EV battery at the Pluto Hub.
* Promptly and elaboratively notify of any defect, malfunction, breakdown, or damage to the EV.
* Report faults observed during delivery to the Quick Reaction Team.



**Compliance \& Conduct** 



* Hold and maintain a valid driving licence throughout the engagement.
* Wear the uniform, helmet, and any specified equipment at all times while on duty.
* Not consume alcohol, narcotics, or controlled substances during service.
* Treat customers, client staff, Pluto staff, and the public with courtesy\- no harassment, intimidation, discrimination, or abuse.
* Not solicit extra payments, tips, or consideration from customers beyond prescribed charges.



**Reporting \& Feedback** 



* Attend all training sessions, safety briefings, and meetings.
* Attend brief weekly check\-ins with the operations team to share feedback on vehicle usability, testing insights, and deployment experience.
* Report accidents, incidents, customer complaints, or unusual circumstances promptly.
* Cooperate with any audit, inspection, or investigation by company or the client.



**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 



* Valid driving licence for two\-wheeler/EV operation
* Prior experience as a delivery rider, driver, or in a similar field\-based logistics role preferred.
* ITI Diploma
* Comfortable navigating assigned areas and working with app\-based order/delivery platforms.
* Basic ability to read and follow instructions in Hindi/English; clear communication with customers.



**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* Prior exposure to EV operation or battery\-swap workflows.
* Experience working in hub\-and\-spoke or last\-mile delivery operations.
* Familiarity with reporting faults or incidents through digital tools (WhatsApp groups, trackers, apps).



**ATTRIBUTES \& CULTURE FIT** 



* Physically fit and comfortable with a full day on the road, six days a week.
* Height and Weight Criteria\- Height (5’6/7\) and Weight (65\-75kgs)
* Reliable, punctual, and safety\-conscious.
* High integrity and accountability — for the vehicle, the goods, and the customer relationship.
* Courteous and well\-mannered in customer\-facing interactions.
* Willing to be deployed flexibly across hub/spoke locations and adapt to changing operational needs.

description:
**About ReDial Clinic:** 




 ReDial Clinic (Reversing Diabetes with Lifestyle Management) is one of India's pioneering physician\-led centres focused on reversing chronic metabolic disease, not merely managing it.
 



 Founded by Dr. Gagandeep Singh, the clinic has helped over 1,000 patients achieve meaningful reversals across Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension, Obesity, PCOS, Dyslipidaemia, and Fatty Liver Disease through structured, evidence\-based lifestyle interventions.
 



 Our approach treats root causes, not symptoms. Every patient is enrolled in the Doctor\-Led Programme (DLP), a structured reversal protocol in which a Doctor, Nutritionist, and Fitness Coach work together as a dedicated clinical triad.
 



***The Role:***




 This is not a conventional OPD or prescription\-only role. You will own the full patient review, assessing medical, dietary, and fitness dimensions together in every consultation. The Nutritionist and Fitness Coach support delivery under your clinical direction, and you will report directly to Dr. Gagandeep Singh.
 



***Conditions You Will Manage***



* Type 2 Diabetes — glycaemic assessment, medication review, and structured reversal protocols
* Hypertension — blood pressure management, medication tapering, and lifestyle\-led normalisation
* Obesity — body composition assessment, metabolic risk stratification, and intervention planning
* PCOS — hormonal and metabolic evaluation, dietary and lifestyle intervention
* Dyslipidaemia, Non\-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), and Metabolic Syndrome



 The common thread across all these conditions is insulin resistance. Our clinical model is built on understanding and reversing this root cause.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead structured one\-on\-one patient consultations covering medical status, dietary adherence, and fitness progression as a unified assessment
* Review blood work and metabolic panels at defined intervals, and adjust medication, diet, and fitness plans accordingly
* Direct medication tapering as lifestyle interventions take effect
* Design and own the integrated patient plan covering medical interventions, dietary framework, and fitness protocol
* Brief and lead the clinical triad (Nutritionist and Fitness Coach), and hold weekly internal team reviews to align on patient progress
* Maintain complete and timely patient records on all designated platforms
* Actively participate in training and clinical discussion sessions led by Dr. Gagandeep Singh



***Qualifications***




***Required***



* MBBS from a recognised, accredited medical institution — mandatory
* Valid registration with the NMC (formerly MCI) or the respective State Medical Council
* 4\+ years of post\-MBBS, patient\-facing clinical experience
* Working knowledge of Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension, Obesity, or PCOS management
* Ability to independently read and interpret lab reports and metabolic panels
* Strong patient communication skills, with the ability to explain clinical reasoning clearly and empathetically
* Fluency in English and Hindi
* Willingness to be trained in a structured, protocol\-based clinical approach



***Preferred — Strong Advantage***



* Prior exposure to disease reversal, lifestyle medicine, or preventive medicine
* Familiarity with low\-carb nutrition, therapeutic fasting, or metabolic nutrition frameworks
* Experience with medication tapering or de\-prescribing under clinical supervision
* Formal certification in nutrition, sports nutrition, personal training, or fitness coaching
* A personal orientation toward fitness and nutrition — doctors who apply these principles in their own lives bring a depth of practical understanding that is difficult to teach



**What We Offer** 



* The opportunity to practise root\-cause, reversal\-focused medicine rather than symptom management
* Structured, ongoing clinical training and mentorship under Dr. Gagandeep Singh
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment
* Competitive compensation with growth opportunities as the clinic expands



**How to Apply** 




 Send your updated CV along with a copy of your MBBS degree and NMC / State Medical Council registration certificate to:
 


* Email: hr@redialclinic.com
* **Call / WhatsApp: \+91 96679 48320**

 Job Description

title: Channel SE - Identity Security
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

****Who We Are****
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

****Job Summary****
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
   

  

 Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
   

  

 We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
   

  

 We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
   

  

******Job Summary** 
 :****
 We are seeking a skilled and motivated Channel Domain Consultant to join our team to support the North Asia region. In this critical partner\-facing role, the Channel Systems Engineer will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for PANW Idira Identity Security products and solutions. The individual will foster and nurture relationships with technical partners, including System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), Managed Service Providers (MSP), and other strategic partners. This role requires a combination of technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills to enable and guide partners in delivering best\-in\-class Identity Security Management solutions including Human Identity Security, Machine Identity Security, Agentic AI Identity Security.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for driving partner Activation, ecosystem integrations, technical solution design, and supporting partners throughout the sales lifecycle. They will also play a key role in the development and execution of technical go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies.
   

  

******Key Responsibilities:******
****Partner Activation \& Ecosystem Integration:****
* Foster and build strong relationships with technical partners (SI, VAR, MSP) to expand the reach and success of solutions.
* Lead partner Activation efforts by creating training and certification pathways, including developing and improving certification processes.
* Collaborate with Technical Alliances to ensure the correct integration and development of technical selling plans.
* Work on partner onboarding and knowledge transfer, ensuring partners are equipped with the tools, knowledge, and resources to successfully position and sell products.
* Develop and implement Activation programs that educate and empower partners to be self\-sufficient in selling and supporting solutions.


******Solution Design \& Technical Strategy:******
* Gather and analyze end\-customer requirements from partners, translating business needs into technical solutions and system architectures.
* Provide technical leadership by designing and delivering tailored solutions architectures for partner\-engaged end\-customer projects.
* Work with channel partners on customer meetings and joint solution documentation, ensuring high\-quality technical outcomes.
* Break down complex technical concepts into simple, customer\-driven outcomes and messaging, enabling partners to effectively communicate these solutions to end\-customers.
* Support partners in technical sales presentations, white\-boarding sessions, and other customer\-facing activities.
* Develop joint value propositions for solutions, ensuring alignment with business challenges and technical requirements across a variety of customer personas and segments.


******Marketplace \& GTM Strategy:******
* Lead the creation and execution of technical go\-to\-market strategies for Idira platforms, ensuring the correct approach for product integration and sales.
* Drive partner Activation in marketplace scenarios, including marketplace certifications, architecture validation, and joint product promotion.
* Ensure the technical messaging and positioning for products is clear, impactful, and aligned with market needs.


******Channel Partner Support \& Collaboration:******
* Provide ongoing support to channel partners in the form of product demos, technical consultations, and sales training.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure alignment between product development, partner sales teams, and marketing.
* Provide and Maintain a NFR demo environment for all Idira solutions, ensuring partners have access to the necessary resources for their sales efforts.


****Qualifications****
* 3\+ years of experience in Partner Solution Consulting, pre\-sales engineering, or a similar technical role within the technology industry
* Proficiency with PAM, IAM, Endpoint security solution experience with CyberArk’s / Idira’s solutions preferred
* Strong understanding on AI and AI agent cybersecurity (at least one of the major AI platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, Microsoft)
* Proficiency in Active Directory / Entra ID administration, Unix/Linux systems, and related technologies.
* Proficiency with cloud services (at least one of the major cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud or Azure) admin and security experience
* Proficiency with CI/CD application development security experience
* Strong understanding of machine identity management, public key infrastructure (PKI), and encryption technologies.
* Strong understanding of security concepts and regulatory compliance.
* Strong presentation and demonstration skills for both technical and executive audiences.
* Proven experience in technical sales, solution architect, or partner Activation role, ideally within the cybersecurity, identity management, or cloud technologies space.
* Strong experience in designing and delivering technical solutions and translating customer requirements into actionable and scalable solutions.
* Experience working with System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), and Managed Service Providers (MSP) to enable technical solutions and partner sales.
* Strong experience in designing and delivering technical solutions and translating customer requirements into actionable and scalable solutions.
* Ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders at all levels.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for simplifying complex technical topics.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product management.
* Experience identity management solutions are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives and projects effectively.


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Management Trainee (Freshers) - RCM
description:
**NEOLYTIX**
**Management Trainee, RCM**
 Revenue Cycle Management \| Full\-Time Opportunity \| Gurugram
 **DEPARTMENT**
**Revenue Cycle Management** 
**LOCATION**
**Gurugram (Onsite)** 
**SHIFT**
**US Shift (5:00 PM–2:00 AM IST)** 
**⚠ US Shift: This role operates on a US\-aligned schedule, 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, 5 days a week, onsite at our Gurugram office. Please apply only if you can fully commit to this schedule.** 
**⚠ Eligibility Gate: Open to 2025 and 2026 graduates. Candidates who completed graduation in 2024 may apply and will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis, subject to approval. Candidates currently pursuing their degree or who graduated before 2024 are not eligible.**
**The 6\-Month Learning Journey**
 Joining Neolytix as a Management Trainee, RCM is a full\-time opportunity that begins with a structured 6\-month learning journey. You are not thrown on the floor from day one. You will be trained, assessed, and made ready for live operations before you independently handle client work. Every stage of the journey is designed to build your skills progressively.
   

  

**Phase 1**
**Classroom Training**
*8 to 12 Days (Max 14\)*
 Structured instructor\-led sessions covering US healthcare, medical billing, coding basics, and RCM workflows. Your LOB is decided within the first 2 to 3 days based on your performance, knowledge check, and operations team input.
 **Phase 2**
**Operations Readiness Training**
*8 to 12 Days*
 You move to the floor alongside senior team members and trainers. You apply classroom learning in a supervised, live operations environment with ongoing assessments.
 **Phase 3**
**Production Ramp\-Up**
*4 Weeks*
 You begin handling real client work under close supervision. Accuracy, speed, and process adherence are tracked. Performance here determines your readiness to go live independently.
 **Phase 4**
**Go Live**
*Full Production*
 You are cleared for independent production on your assigned LOB. This marks your transition from trainee to fully operational team member.
   

  

 Throughout the 6 months, there will be several assessments to evaluate your skill development. Your training path and LOB may be refined based on these assessment outcomes.
   

  

**Career Path**
 Neolytix promotes from within. Here is where this journey takes you:
   

  

**Management Trainee** 
**Associate 1** 
**Associate 2** 
**Senior Associate 1** 
**QA / SME**
**About The Role**
 Neolytix is a US\-headquartered healthcare managed services organization serving 270\+ provider organizations across the United States. We are building our next generation of RCM professionals through this full\-time opportunity and we are looking for fresh graduates who are motivated, disciplined, and ready to build a real career in US healthcare operations.
   

  

 Revenue Cycle Management is how US healthcare providers get paid for the services they deliver. As a Management Trainee, you will be assessed, trained, and placed into one of three core RCM functional areas based on your skills and performance during the first days of training. Your LOB is not a default assignment. It is matched to where you will thrive.
   

  

**The Three RCM Areas**
**Charge Posting \& Payment Posting**
 Translating patient services into medical billing codes and submitting claims to insurers, plus recording and reconciling payments received. Requires speed, accuracy, and coding discipline.
 **Accounts Receivable (AR)**
 Following up on submitted claims, resolving denials, and ensuring payments are collected from insurance payers. Requires analytical thinking, persistence, and clear communication.
 **Credentialing**
 Enrolling healthcare providers with insurance payers so they can legally bill for services. Covers CAQH, PECOS, payer portals, expirables, and compliance. Requires strong process discipline and attention to deadlines.
   

  

 Your LOB assignment is made within the first 2 to 3 days of classroom training, based on your knowledge check scores and the evaluation of the operations team. Once assigned, your entire training is aligned to that LOB.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Attend and complete all classroom training modules within the defined timeline, meeting assessment benchmarks at each stage
* Commit to the LOB assigned to you and engage fully in the training path designed for that functional area
* Apply classroom learning during operations readiness training under the supervision of senior team members and trainers
* Meet accuracy and productivity benchmarks during the 4\-week production ramp\-up before going live independently
* Support team leads and senior specialists in achieving client SLAs and compliance targets once on the floor
* Continuously learn and adapt to US payer requirements, billing rules, and client\-specific workflows
* Demonstrate consistent progress through assessments to qualify for transition to Associate 1


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have**
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline, fully completed. Candidates currently pursuing a degree or with an incomplete graduation are not eligible
* Graduated in 2025 or 2026\. Candidates from 2024 will be considered on an exceptional basis only
* Minimum 70% aggregate in 12th grade (CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent board)
* Minimum 70% aggregate in graduation
* Excellent spoken and written English. You will be trained on and operate in live US healthcare processes
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word
* Full commitment to the US shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, onsite in Gurugram, 5 days a week


**Preferred**
* Schooling from Delhi NCR or Tier 1 or Tier 2 cosmopolitan cities
* Science or Commerce with Mathematics background (B.Sc, BCA, BBA, B.Com, or similar)
* Any internship or prior exposure to US healthcare, medical billing, or BPO operations


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline, fully completed. No exceptions for incomplete or in\-progress degrees
* Batch: 2025 and 2026 graduates are the primary eligible batch. 2024 graduates may be considered on an exceptional basis subject to thorough review and approval
* Academic Scores: Minimum 70% aggregate in 12th grade (CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent) and minimum 70% in graduation
* Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory. Communication below this standard will not progress past the assessment stage
* Systems: Basic MS Excel and MS Word. Comfortable learning new billing and EHR software during training
* Shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, onsite in Gurugram, 5 days a week. Non\-negotiable
* Notice Period: Immediate joiners strongly preferred


**Performance Expectations**
**During the Learning Journey**
* Assessment pass rate: minimum passing threshold on every module assessment throughout classroom and OJT phases
* Attendance: full attendance during all training phases is expected without exception
* Assignment completion: all practice tasks and training exercises completed on time
* Ramp\-up accuracy: error rate within acceptable threshold during the 4\-week production ramp\-up
* Production readiness: cleared for independent live work by end of the learning journey


**Post Go Live**
* Daily productivity: meet case or task targets for the assigned LOB consistently
* Quality: accuracy rate maintained within client and internal benchmarks
* SLA contribution: support team\-level SLA compliance on assigned client accounts


**Hiring Process**
* Stage 1: Resume Screening. Verified against eligibility criteria: graduation year, degree completion, 70% score thresholds, and shift readiness
* Stage 2: Pre\-Hire Assessment. Aptitude, comprehension, and communication test conducted at the Gurugram office. Evaluates English proficiency, analytical basics, and role readiness
* Stage 3: Technical Interview. Interview with the Training Department to assess learning ability, communication standard, and initial LOB suitability
* Stage 4: Counseling Session. Shortlisted candidates attend a session with the Analytics and Operations team to fully understand the role, the learning journey, the shift, and career expectations before a final decision is made
* Stage 5: Offer


**Benefits \& Perks**
* Group Health Insurance: Medical insurance coverage
* Complimentary Dinner: One meal provided during shift hours at the Gurugram office
* Cab Facility: Two\-way pick\-up and drop for the night shift


**Why Join Neolytix**
**Structured Learning, Real Work**
 6 months of structured training before going live on client accounts, not tutorials, not simulations. You build real skills on real processes.
 **Defined Career Ladder**
 Management Trainee to Associate 1 to Associate 2 to Senior Associate to QA or SME. Your pace is driven by your performance.
 **US Healthcare Exposure**

title: IT Systems Analyst
description:
NEOLYTIX
   

  

 IT Systems Analyst
   

  

 IT Team \| Workforce Tools Administration \| Adoption \& Compliance \| Excel Reporting
   

  

 DEPARTMENT
   

  

 IT Team
   

  

**Experience**
 0–1 Year
   

  

 LOCATION
   

  

 Gurugram (Onsite)
   

  

 REPORTS INTO
   

  

 Assistant Manager
   

  

 SHIFT
   

  

 US Shift (5:00 PM–2:00 AM IST)
   

  

 ⚠ US Shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, 5 days a week, onsite in Gurugram. This is not a hybrid role. Apply only if you can fully commit to this schedule.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Neolytix runs its operations on a set of third\-party workforce tools, including Dialpad for communication and Hubstaff for time and productivity tracking. These tools only deliver value when they are properly administered and actively used. When licenses go unmanaged or teams aren't using tools correctly, it creates waste and compliance gaps.
   

  

 As an IT Systems Analyst, you will wear two hats. The first is platform administrator: you will manage user accounts, assign and revoke licenses, onboard new joiners, offboard exits, and be the go\-to person for access and user management across these tools. The second is analyst: you will track adoption, monitor compliance, manage license costs, and produce Excel\-based reports and dashboards for IT and management.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level role open to fresh graduates and candidates with up to 1 year of experience. Strong Excel skills and an organised, detail\-oriented approach are the core requirements. You will develop the full scope with guidance from the IT Manager.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Platform Administration \& User Management
   

  

* Create, manage, and deactivate user accounts across Dialpad, Hubstaff, and other assigned tools.
* Assign and revoke licenses based on team requirements, role changes, and access levels.
* Onboard new employees to tools and ensure timely offboarding of departed staff.
* Manage user permissions and access control settings within each platform.
* Serve as the first point of contact for user access issues, login problems, and tool\-related queries.
* Coordinate with tool vendors on admin\-level issues, outages, and support tickets.


 Tool Adoption \& Compliance Tracking
   

  

* Track how teams across Neolytix are using each tool: who is active, how often, and whether usage meets expected standards.
* Identify and report underutilization or non\-compliance to the IT Manager with supporting data.
* Monitor adoption trends over time and flag drops or anomalies before they become larger issues.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand usage patterns and address adoption gaps.


 License Management \& Cost Tracking
   

  

* Maintain a complete record of all licenses: total seats, active users, inactive seats, and renewal dates.
* Track utilization on a rolling basis and flag unused or underused seats to the IT Manager.
* Prepare summaries that help the IT Manager make renewal and cost decisions.
* Monitor monthly tool spend and flag variances before billing cycles.


 Reporting \& Excel Dashboards
   

  

* Build and maintain Excel\-based dashboards and reports covering user activity, adoption rates, license utilization, and cost trends.
* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports in a clear, structured format for IT leadership.
* Handle ad\-hoc data and reporting requests from the IT team accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Keep all reports updated on schedule with no stale data.


 What You Bring
   

  

 Must\-Have
   

  

* Graduate degree in BBA, MBA, BTech, or equivalent. Mandatory.
* MS Excel at a working level: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, data cleaning, and structured report building. This is the primary reporting tool for the role.
* Organised and process\-driven: you manage tasks, follow\-ups, and deadlines without being reminded.
* Analytical thinking: you can look at a usage table and tell what looks right, what looks off, and what it means.
* Attention to detail: your reports and records are always accurate and up to date.
* Good written and verbal English for internal coordination, user support, and management reporting.


 Strong Preference
   

  

* Prior exposure to SaaS tool administration: any experience managing user accounts or access in any platform (even Google Workspace, Zoom, or similar).
* Basic understanding of software license models: per seat, per user, concurrent pricing.
* Internship or project work involving data, reporting, or IT operations.
* Familiarity with Dialpad, Hubstaff, or similar workforce management or communication tools.


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Basic understanding of IT asset or software asset management (SAM) concepts.
* SQL: basic querying for data extraction.
* Exposure to ITSM or ticketing tools (Freshdesk, Jira, Zendesk, etc.).
* Power BI or any other reporting tool familiarity.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You keep things organised. Licenses, user lists, and reports are always current because you maintain them without being asked.
* You do not miss deadlines and you do not wait to be reminded.
* You are comfortable being the person teams come to with access issues, and you resolve them calmly and quickly.
* You want to understand why a metric matters, not just how to pull it.


 Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* Education: BBA / MBA / BTech or equivalent is mandatory.
* Excel: functional working level required. Will be tested in the assessment.
* Shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, 5 days a week, onsite in Gurugram. Non\-negotiable.
* Work Mode: fully onsite, Gurugram. No remote or hybrid option.
* Notice Period: immediate preferred. Up to 15 days considered.


 Performance Expectations (KPIs)
   

  

 In the first 6 months:
   

  

* User onboarding and offboarding completed within 24 hours of request, consistently.
* License registry complete and current within 45 days of joining.
* Inactive or underused licenses flagged monthly with supporting data.
* Reports delivered on time with zero data errors.
* Tool adoption rates tracked by team, with changes flagged proactively.
* User access issues resolved within the agreed response window.


 Hiring Process
   

  

* Stage 1: Talent Management screening.
* Stage 2: Practical Excel assessment covering data structuring, reporting, and analytical interpretation. Skills\-based, not theoretical.
* Stage 3: Interview with the IT Manager covering your assessment output, approach to user management, and analytical reasoning.
* Stage 4: Offer.


 Why Join Neolytix
   

  

 Own a Live Tool Ecosystem
   

  

 You are the platform admin from day one. Real user management, real licenses, real impact on how teams work.
   

  

 Dual Skill Development
   

  

 Build both IT administration and data analytics skills simultaneously, a combination that opens strong career paths in IT operations and systems analysis.
   

  

 Direct Business Impact
   

  

 Your license flags affect real spend. Your adoption reports inform decisions that touch the entire operations floor.
   

  

 Clear Growth Path
   

  

 A defined track from Analyst to Senior Analyst and beyond as Neolytix's IT and tools function grows with the business.
   

  

 Questions? Reach out to Lakshay at Neolytix Talent Management \| This document is confidential and for internal use only
   

  

 Powered by JazzHR

title: Enterprise Integrations & API Engineer (B2B SaaS)
description:

 Gurgaon / Remote (Hybrid / Flexible Work Policy)

 Full\-Time

 3–5 Years
   

  

**Industry\-Standard Salary Range:** 
 16 LPA – 28 LPA
   

  

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 For an enterprise B2B SaaS platform specializing in supply chain analytics and fintech settlement, onboarding a new corporate client isn't just about handing over a login—it often involves seamlessly integrating our platform with their legacy ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), warehouse management software (WMS), and core banking APIs.
   

  

 Our engineering culture values robust interface design, bulletproof error handling, and extensible integration architectures. If you love building universal adapters, webhook engines, and enterprise\-grade API gateways that bridge disparate software ecosystems, you will find your professional home here.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled
 **Enterprise Integrations \& API Engineer** 
 to take complete ownership of our client onboarding integration pipelines and B2B API gateway. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain secure integration connectors that ingest data from diverse external enterprise systems into our core platform. You will act as the technical bridge between our product infrastructure and our enterprise clients' complex technical environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Connector Development: Design and build robust ETL connectors, middleware adapters, and API wrappers for major enterprise systems (SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce, WMS platforms).
* Webhook \& Event Engine: Architect and scale our reliable webhook delivery system, ensuring guaranteed at\-least\-once delivery, automatic retries, and rate limiting for external clients.
* API Gateway Management: Manage API versioning, authentication protocols (OAuth2, mTLS, API keys), request validation, and developer portal documentation.
* Data Transformation: Write flexible data mapping and transformation logic (using Python/Node.js and JSON/XML/EDI formats) to normalize disparate external data schemas into our internal data models.
* Troubleshooting \& Support: Collaborate with customer success and client engineering teams to diagnose integration blockers, payload mismatches, and authentication errors during client onboarding.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional backend software engineering experience focusing heavily on API design, integration engineering, or enterprise middleware development.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in Python (FastAPI/Django) or Node.js, advanced RESTful API design principles, GraphQL, and asynchronous programming.
* Protocol Knowledge: Hands\-on experience with standard enterprise data exchange formats (JSON, XML, EDI X12, CSV) and secure communication protocols (OAuth2, Webhooks, mTLS).
* Database \& Tooling: Strong SQL skills, experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ/Kafka), and familiarity with API gateway tools or Kong/Apigee.
* Communication Skills: Excellent client\-facing technical communication skills and the ability to translate complex integration requirements into clean code.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-standard salary package (16–28 LPA) backed by performance bonuses and equity participation.
* High\-Visibility Role: Direct impact on enterprise client onboarding velocity and platform revenue growth.
