* Manage engineers who support on\-premises, virtualized, and cloud infrastructure (servers, storage, containers) ensuring high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Drive local team capacity planning, patching, configuration management, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure team executes on infrastructure\-as\-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) vision to improve consistency and speed.


**Cloud Services and Data Enablement**
* Oversee engineers who manage and optimize multi\-cloud platforms (AWS and Azure), including landing zones, IAM, networking, security, and guardrails.
* Ensure team executes on cloud cost management and FinOps practices for transparency, optimization, and budgeting.
* Align with broader IOC team to evaluate and pilot emerging technologies for practical, secure, and compliant business use cases; articulate value and adoption paths.


**DevOps and CI/CD Enablement**
* Partner with DevOps resources in the design and operation of secure, resilient CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, and GitOps workflows.
* Align with broader IOC team to establish SLOs/SLAs, observability (monitoring, logging, tracing), incident response, and post\-incident reviews.
* Ensure global collaboration to improve existing runbooks, automation, and standards to reduce issues and improve meantime to recovery.


**Networking and Voice Infrastructure**
* Oversee engineers that manage infrastructure elements of WAN/LAN, VPN, DNS, load balancers, and cloud networking.
* Ensure uptime of integrations between voice/communication platforms and cloud/infrastructure services in collaboration with relevant teams.


**Security, Compliance, and Governance**
* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain security controls (MFA, RBAC, encryption, key/secrets management, vulnerability management).
* Lead engineers that embed policy\-as\-code and compliance guardrails; support audits and regulatory requirements across geographies.
* Collaborate with architects to refine standards, implement technology roadmaps while ensuring consistent and secured implementations.


**Service Delivery and Operations**
* Provide “follow the sun” service delivery and incident response for infrastructure and cloud platforms; track and report on performance metrics, SLAs, and operational KPIs.
* Drive problem, change, and configuration management aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, reliability, and customer satisfaction.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with practices, product teams, data teams, InfoSec, and global IT groups to align platform capabilities with business needs.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to non\-technical leaders; build business cases and executive\-ready narratives that link technology investments to outcomes.
* Partner closely with peer IOC managers to ensure seamless end\-to\-end service integration across global operations.


**Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of experience managing cloud services and infrastructure in a global context, with at least 5\+ years leading engineering teams.
* Demonstrated knowledge of data center, virtualization and cloud networking including, but not limited to: VPN, load balancing, DNS, and cloud network architectures.
* Solid understanding in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP; knowledge of cloud\-native services, IAM, networking, security, and cost optimization.
* Strong grasp of observability, incident and change management, and ITIL\-aligned operations.
* Proven track record driving process improvements, standardization, and operational excellence across distributed teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Demonstrated inclusive leadership, talent development, and team\-building skills across diverse, cross\-cultural teams.


**Qualifications Preferred**
* Master’s degree in a related field.
* Experience operating in multinational organizations and supporting 24x7 global services.
* Knowledge and understanding in containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure\-as\-code, automation, and CI/CD.
* Relevant certifications and training in AWS/Azure/GCP professional\-level, ITIL, project management, Databricks, or security certifications.
* Familiarity of Databricks and AI/ML platform enablement, emerging AI technologies (e.g., OpenAI, Google PaLM) and enterprise adoption patterns.

title: Product Support Engineer
description:
We are looking for a
 **Product Support Engineer for M365 \& Power Platform** 
 domain who combines strong hands\-on
 **technical skills** 
 with a
 **product mindset** 
 .
 



  





 This is not a traditional helpdesk or ticket\-based support role. You will own the day\-to\-day health, usability, support, and continuous improvement of business applications and solutions built on
 **Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power Automate** 
 .
 



  





 The right person will be comfortable troubleshooting production issues, understanding how users interact with a solution, identifying recurring problems, evaluating enhancement requests, working with developers and business stakeholders, and driving issues through to resolution.
 



  





 You should think beyond
 **“How do I fix this issue?”** 
 and ask
 **“Why did this happen, how can we prevent it, and how can we make the product better for the user?”** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Product Support \& Ownership** 



* Own day\-to\-day support and operational health of
 **M365, SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power Automate solutions and overall Microsoft ecosystem.**
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for application and platform\-related issues.
* Triage incidents, determine business impact and priority, and drive issues through resolution.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for recurring or complex issues and recommend permanent fixes.
* Monitor application behavior, workflows, integrations, permissions, and user experience.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, usability, and performance.
* Maintain clear documentation of known issues, resolutions, dependencies, and support procedures.



  





**2\. Product Mindset \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Understand the business purpose and user journey behind each application or solution.
* Evaluate enhancement requests based on business value, user impact, effort, and technical feasibility.
* Work with business stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into actionable technical changes.
* Maintain and prioritize a product/support backlog of defects, enhancements, and technical improvements.
* Identify recurring user pain points and proactively recommend improvements.
* Participate in solution design discussions with a focus on usability, maintainability, scalability, and long\-term supportability.
* Challenge requirements when a simpler or better solution is possible.



  





**3\. Microsoft 365 \& SharePoint** 



* Support and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services including Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint Online.
* Manage SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, pages, permissions, and configurations.
* Troubleshoot SharePoint functionality, access, workflow, and performance issues.
* Develop and maintain SharePoint solutions using
 **SPFx, PowerShell, and PnP** 
 .
* Support SharePoint governance, permissions, information architecture, and site structures.
* Identify and implement improvements to existing SharePoint solutions.



  





**4\. Power Apps \& Power Automate** 



* Support, troubleshoot, and enhance business applications built using
 **Power Apps** 
 , including Canvas and Model\-driven apps.
* Troubleshoot and maintain
 **Power Automate** 
 workflows and integrations.
* Analyze failed flows, performance issues, connector issues, permissions, and data\-related problems.
* Work with SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, Teams, and other data sources.
* Make controlled changes to applications and workflows based on approved requirements.
* Test enhancements and fixes before production deployment.
* Ensure solutions remain maintainable and aligned with Power Platform best practices.



  





**5\. Incident, Change \& Release Management** 



* Manage incidents, service requests, defects, and enhancement requests through
 **Azure DevOps (ADO)** 
 or similar tools.
* Participate in prioritization, sprint planning, and release activities where applicable.
* Coordinate with developers, QA, business analysts, and stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver enhancements.
* Perform functional validation and support UAT for application changes.
* Maintain appropriate change and release documentation.
* Follow issues through deployment and post\-release validation.



  





**6\. User \& Stakeholder Support** 



* Work directly with business users and stakeholders to understand issues and requirements.
* Explain technical issues and solutions in clear, business\-friendly language.
* Provide guidance and best practices to users without simply treating every request as a ticket.
* Identify training or usability gaps that may be contributing to support issues.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and establish credibility as the person who understands both the technology and the business problem.



  





**7\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management** 



* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues, root causes, workarounds, and permanent resolutions.
* Maintain application inventories, dependencies, ownership information, and support documentation.
* Help build a knowledge base that reduces repetitive support requests.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 6–8 years of relevant experience in Microsoft technologies, application support, product support, or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* **Microsoft 365**
* **SharePoint Online**
* **Power Apps**
* **Power Automate**
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Experience supporting business applications in a production environment.
* Experience with
 **SharePoint development using SPFx, PowerShell, and PnP** 
 .
* Experience integrating Power Platform with
 **SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, Teams** 
 , and other data sources.
* Experience working with
 **Azure DevOps (ADO)** 
 or similar ticketing/backlog management tools.
* Good understanding of M365 security, permissions, governance, and administration.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working directly with business users and stakeholders.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Product mindset:** 
 Thinks about the complete user experience, not just the individual ticket or technical task.
* **Ownership:** 
 Takes an issue from identification through resolution and post\-resolution validation.
* **Curiosity:** 
 Wants to understand why something is happening rather than applying a quick workaround.
* **Problem solver:** 
 Comfortable investigating ambiguous or complex production issues.
* **Business orientation:** 
 Understands the business impact of technical decisions.
* **Proactive:** 
 Identifies recurring problems and opportunities for improvement before they become larger issues.
* **Practical:** 
 Knows when to configure, when to customize, and when to recommend a different approach.
* **Strong communicator:** 
 Can work effectively with both technical teams and non\-technical users.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Microsoft certifications such as
 **PL\-100, PL\-200, MS\-100, MS\-101** 
 , or related certifications.
* Experience with Azure Cloud and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Experience supporting enterprise Power Platform applications in production.
* Understanding of application lifecycle management and release processes.
* Experience with Power Platform governance and environment management.
* Experience working in an Agile/product\-oriented environment.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

description:
**Key Highlights** 




  




* **Position** 
 : Intern, Creative Strategy
* **Location**

**About Airblack \& Zudo:** 




  





 Airblack is India’s largest alternate skilling platform, helping people become microentrepreneurs and creators. Our mission is to help the next 100 million people in the workforce get access to meaningful opportunities.
 



  





 We currently operate in sectors such as beauty, fashion, nutrition, digital \& home businesses, impacting over 1M learners every month. Our flagship school in the beauty space is India’s \#1 Beauty Academy brand, with an alumni base of over 40,000 entrepreneurs in 300\+ cities in India. Our apps consistently rank in top 10 education apps in India with 1M\+ users and 40M\+ minutes of learning content being consumed every month.
 



  





 Airblack has raised Rs. 100cr\+ from marquee investors such as Elevation Capital, Info Edge Ventures, Michael \& Susan Dell Foundation, Blume Founders Fund and Better Capital, and leading angels such as Vidit (Meesho), Kunal (CRED), Deepinder (Zomato), Harshit \& Shashank (Razorpay) and so on.
 



  





 One of our new products, Zudo, is now India’s fastest growing apps in the skilling / content space. Built with the mission of helping people get access to meaningful opportunities, it offers microcourses across Social media, Beauty, Fashion and other digital businesses. Few numbers:
 



  




* 10M downloads / 1M MAU / growing 100% QoQ
* Over 50,000 businesses already launched in beauty / fashion / nutrition / digital sectors



  





**What would you be doing?** 




  




* **Script Generation at Volume:** 
 This is the core of the role. You'll be responsible for producing a high volume of ad scripts every week. Scripts need to be on\-brand, culturally relevant, trend\-aware, and built to perform on Instagram and YouTube. Speed and quality aren't a tradeoff here \- both are non\-negotiable. If you've never operated at this kind of volume before, this role will teach you what creative velocity actually means.
* **AI\-Powered Creative Production:** 
 You'll use AI tools end\-to\-end to go from script to final video \- including voiceover, avatar generation, captions, and editing. We're not looking for someone who's just curious about AI; we want someone who already lives in these tools. Experience with platforms like HeyGen, Higgsfield, Kling, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut, or similar is a strong signal. Hands\-on output matters more than theoretical familiarity.
* **Data\-Backed Creative Thinking:** 
 Great creative instinct is only half the job. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team to read dashboards, identify what's working, and translate signals into sharper creative decisions. When something underperforms, your first move is to look at the data \- not your gut. This means designing structured experiments (hooks, CTAs, visual styles), tracking results, and iterating with intent.
* **Research \& Trend Intelligence:** 
 You'll lead primary research (customer interviews, surveys) and secondary research (competitor ad libraries, cultural trends) to stay ahead of what resonates with our Tier 2/3 audience. You spot what's about to trend before it does \- and you move fast enough to use it.



  





**What makes you a suitable candidate?** 




  




* Recent grad or final year student \- background matters less than output
* Demonstrated interest in the creative field \- a portfolio, side project, or body of work that shows you've been doing this on your own
* Hands\-on experience with AI video/creative tools (HeyGen, Higgsfield, Kling, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut AI, or similar) would be a massive plus
* Native fluency in internet culture \- you know what's trending before it trends
* Comfortable with data \- can read a performance dashboard and act on it
* High ownership and accountability \- you don't wait to be told twice, and you take the outcome personally
* Previous experience with content creation is a massive plus



  





**Why should you join Airblack?** 




  




* **Skilling with a difference:** 
 We are one of the very few education companies in India that have been able to do all the following things together: deliver outcomes, stay lean (under 50 people), raise funds in a down market from top investors, have an infinite runway, and lead a completely new whitespace. Get the opportunity to be the face of a new era in the education \& skilling sector in a high\-skin\-in\-the\-game leadership role
* **Experimentation \& Build:** 
 We have a culture of rapid experimentation, freedom to fail \& iterate, and owning scale\-up through process building
* **Thriving Market** 
**Opportunity** 
 : We are building in a whitespace with massive opportunity \& headstart \- India has 15 million people entering the workforce every year and less than half a million jobs. Your impact will help create a dent in India’s future
* **Work with a stellar team** 
 : Great missions require great people \- and we are fortunate to have some of the smartest and nicest people supporting us in our journey. Our team comprises ex\-entrepreneurs, VCs, and operators from places such as Goldman Sachs, Paytm, Oyo, Bain \& Co., BCG, Urban Company, top IITs and so on

description:
We are seeking a talented and analytically minded Specialist\-Research \& Market Intelligence to support our talent sourcing, recruitment strategy, and talent marketplace initiatives. This role focuses on market intelligence, competitive analysis, candidate behavior research, and talent ecosystem dynamics that inform our recruitment strategy, platform positioning, and talent marketplace expansion. You'll combine quantitative and qualitative research methodologies to deliver actionable insights that drive hiring effectiveness, candidate quality, and marketplace growth across geographies and verticals.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities** 




**Talent Marketplace \& Recruitment Technology Competitive Analysis** 



* Conduct competitive landscape analysis of talent sourcing platforms.
* Track and analyze pricing models, feature releases, and market positioning of competing talent marketplaces
* Research emerging talent marketplace players, funding rounds, M\&A activity, and market consolidation patterns
* Identify white spaces in the talent marketplace ecosystem (underserved geographies, verticals, candidate segments)



**Recruitment Strategy \& Talent Sourcing Research** 



* Research and document emerging trends in talent sourcing strategies across industries and geographies
* Study talent acquisition best practices, hiring funnel optimization, and recruitment process automation
* Monitor employer branding strategies, EVP (Employer Value Proposition) positioning, and talent attraction trends
* Research skills gap analysis, high\-demand talent segments, and emerging skill requirements



**Candidate Behavior \& Demographic Research** 



* Analyze candidate preferences, job search behaviors, and platform engagement patterns
* Research demographic shifts in job seeking (age cohorts, geographic origins, education backgrounds)
* Research underrepresented talent pools and barriers to entry for diverse candidate segments
* Track candidate sentiment and satisfaction with recruitment experiences through surveys and social listening



**Talent Marketplace Performance Analytics** 



* Analyze marketplace metrics: candidate registrations, profile completion rates, employer adoption, placement rates
* Research talent pool quality, matching effectiveness, and placement success rates by geography and industry
* Create dashboards and KPIs tracking marketplace health, growth, and user engagement
* Conduct funnel analysis: sourcing → engagement → application → hire → retention
* Benchmark our marketplace performance against competitors and industry standards
* Identify drop\-off points and optimization opportunities in recruitment workflows

Calculate figures for inventories, orders, and costs. Conduct inventory audits to determine inventory levels and needs. Notify manager/supervisor of low stock levels. Troubleshoot vendor delivery issues and oversee return process. Verify and track received inventory. Reconcile shipping invoices and receiving reports. Receive, unload, and process deliveries. Monitor PAR levels for all food items to ensure proper levels. Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items.
   

  

 Assist management in training, scheduling, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Assist other employees to ensure proper coverage and prompt guest service. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand\-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and stairs and/or service ramps. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

 Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

title: University Talent Partner
description:
**University Talent Partner** 




  





**About Graviton** 
 : Graviton Research Capital is a global quantitative trading and investment firm driven by technology, mathematics and rigorous problem\-solving. We bring together exceptional talent across quantitative research, software engineering and technology to solve some of the most challenging problems in the industry.
 



 Our university talent ecosystem is one of the most important engines for building Graviton's future — and one of the most operationally demanding to run well.
 



  





**The Role** 
 : We are looking for a campus talent professional who can both
 **think in systems and execute in detail** 
 — someone who can shape how Graviton identifies, engages, assesses and converts exceptional early\-career talent, and who is equally comfortable owning the on\-the\-ground execution that makes a hiring cycle run without friction.
 



 Depending on experience, this role can be scoped as a hands\-on execution owner running the campus hiring engine end\-to\-end, or as a strategic owner architecting the assessment frameworks, university strategy and program design that the engine runs on — in both cases, you will partner closely with Quant and Tech leaders and be accountable for the full lifecycle: university outreach, assessments, internships, PPO conversion and onboarding.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**Campus Talent Strategy \& Ecosystem Building** 



* Build and maintain relationships with priority institutions (IITs, IIITs, BITS and relevant global universities), placement offices, faculty and student communities.
* Drive year\-round engagement \- events, technical talks and competitions — to strengthen Graviton's employer brand outside peak hiring windows.



**Assessment \& Selection** 



* Coordinate (or design and standardize, at senior levels) rigorous selection frameworks in partnership with Tech and Quant teams — scheduling assessments, allocating panels, driving timely feedback, and building interviewer calibration mechanisms to keep evaluation objective and consistent.



  





**Internships \& PPO Conversion** 



* Own the operational lifecycle of internship programs: onboarding, logistics, engagement tracking and performance milestones.
* Manage the transition from internship to PPO/FTE with clear communication, decision timelines and (at senior levels) program design that maximizes conversion of high\-performing interns.


- 


**Operations \& Candidate Experience** 



* Be the primary point of contact for candidates, delivering a high\-touch experience with transparent timelines from first contact through onboarding.
* Own budget tracking, vendor relationships, venue booking, travel and infrastructure for on\-ground and virtual events.
* Build and maintain robust SOPs and checklists for scalable, repeatable execution.



  





**Data, Reporting \& Leadership** 



* Maintain real\-time hiring metrics, trackers and dashboards (funnel conversions, offer acceptance, joining rates) and use them to guide decisions and inform leadership.
* At senior levels: act as a strategic partner to executive leadership and mentor the broader campus talent team.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Campus hiring cycles run predictably, with zero operational friction and complete data transparency.
* Candidates, interviewers and university stakeholders receive an exceptional, high\-touch experience.
* Selection frameworks consistently identify top\-tier quantitative and technical talent.
* Internship and PPO programs serve as Graviton's primary pipeline for high\-performing full\-time hires.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 6–12 years of experience in campus recruitment, university relations, early\-career programs, or program management, ideally within a highly selective technical or quantitative talent environment
* Proven experience managing (or architecting) end\-to\-end campus hiring campaigns across multiple universities simultaneously.
* Strong project management skills, high attention to detail and operational discipline; at senior levels, demonstrated experience in assessment design, interview calibration and multi\-year strategy building.
* Proficiency with recruitment data, tracking systems and reporting dashboards, with an analytical, decision\-driven mindset.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to build trusted relationships with candidates, faculty, university placement teams and internal leadership.
* Ability to operate independently, solve problems quickly and take complete ownership of outcomes.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 
 Great campus hiring is won in the details and built on strategy. From the first student touchpoint to assessment design, internship execution and final conversion, every interaction shapes how top talent views Graviton. You will help build — and run — a world\-class university hiring engine that operates with speed, precision and rigor.

title: Field Operations Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 myfollo.com is the technology brand of Valion P.R.E.F.O., India’s first Private Real Estate Family Office, focused on transforming real estate advisory and transaction services. The platform uses an “Aggregate, Control \& Transact” model to bring landlords, property owners, and developers online, optimize inventory, and enable efficient distribution channels for real estate transactions. Through an O2O (Online to Offline) activation model, myfollo.com engages customers via its PropCare property management brand and free aggregation platform, then connects them to the best transaction channels. A personalized online dashboard helps users track performance and transaction status of their real estate portfolios. Backed by Valion P.R.E.F.O.’s 10\+ years of experience, the company serves over 350 corporate clients and 1,700\+ families in India and Singapore, with combined investments and aggregated assets exceeding INR 9,600 crores.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Field Operations Specialist will manage and coordinate day\-to\-day on\-site activities to support real estate transactions and property management operations in Gurugram. This full\-time role involves visiting properties, liaising with landlords, property owners, developers, and distribution partners, and ensuring accurate data collection and timely updates in the myfollo.com systems and dashboards. The specialist will oversee field\-level process implementation, monitor service quality, and help resolve operational issues that arise during site visits or customer interactions. Responsibilities include supporting documentation and verification, coordinating with internal teams for smooth O2O execution, and providing clear status updates to stakeholders. The role is on\-site in Gurugram and requires regular local travel to project and property locations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Field Operations and on\-ground coordination skills, with experience managing site visits and property\-related activities.
* Operations Management capabilities, including process adherence, workflow optimization, and basic reporting.
* Analytical Skills to interpret property data, portfolio performance, and operational metrics for decision\-making.
* Effective Communication abilities for interacting with customers, landlords, developers, and internal teams.
* Troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, service issues, and on\-site challenges.
* Knowledge of real estate processes or property management is an advantage.
* Comfort with using digital tools, mobile apps, and dashboards for data entry and tracking.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Real Estate, or a related field preferred.
* Ability to work independently in the field, maintain professionalism, and manage time effectively.

title: Global Product Director
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest \& most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable the global technology for BCG’s entire HR \& People Function including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility, \& Career Development); L\&D and Teaming; and Core HR (including Workday \& Compensation). Over the past two years, the HR Product Portfolio has more than doubled in size, and there is more growth to come.
   

  

 With this growth comes amazing new leadership opportunities, including the Product Owner for a new squad focused on delivering Data \& Analytics for Learning@BCG. This product owner role will be responsible for a new data product, consolidating Learning completions and other HR data about Learners to support both reporting, analytics and agentic personalization.
   

  

 Initially, this role will be part of a larger Learning Transformation project. Long\-term this role will be part of a growing suite of data products and analytics, focused on enabling our HR functions.
   

  

 As the Product Owner, you will represent the voice of the customer, manage stakeholder alignment, and oversee the squad's backlog to deliver impactful results. You will also collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and high data quality.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Deliver business results and customer value
* Drive incremental delivery of features for the Learning Data Product, ensuring timely customer value creation.
* Monitor product performance metrics and adjust strategies based on insights.
* Support Learning reporting, analytics in the long\-term.
* Prioritize impactful work to meet measurable Key Results for the squad.
* Manage the squad’s budget and collaborate with leadership on funding needs.
* Serve as the voice of the customer or end\-user
* Gather and translate user needs into actionable user stories for Data \& Analytics.
* Engage stakeholders to align expectations and enhance trust.
* Conduct ongoing discovery activities to identify pain points and opportunities.
* Balance customer value, cost, and execution speed in decision\-making.
* Set an overall vision to direct and inform the squad’s work
* Bring a strong sense of ownership to the product squad and engage deeply in understanding the current and future needs of the function.
* Align squad activities with broader product and organizational goals.
* Translate objectives into a roadmap with clear goals.
* Foster collaboration with other Product Owners to ensure organizational alignment.
* Oversee what is delivered by the squad and when
* Apply design\-thinking to understand system user engagement and solve problems effectively.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of user stories with clear delivery timelines.
* Define acceptance criteria ensuring output meets business needs.
* Support and enable the squad to get its work done
* Collaborate with the squad to remove impediments and clarify requirements.
* Partner with Chapter Leads for resourcing and technical expertise.
* Provide performance feedback to squad members and cross\-functional team members.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 13\+ years of overall professional experience, with 7\+ years in a Product Owner or equivalent HR technology/product delivery role
* Experience in managing data\-driven products and analytics solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with HR leadership.
* Agile product management expertise, with proven experience in leading Agile teams.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake and SQL sufficient to engage with technical teams and interpret data workflows.
* A data\-driven mindset, leveraging insights for strategic decision\-making.
* Knowledge of integrations, including API and data ingestion workflows is a plus.
* Experience in consulting, learning products or HR is a plus.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Squad members, as their Product Owner and guide.
* Internal customers, to understand and translate their needs into user stories.
* Product Team and Portfolio Leaders, for vision, roadmap, and budget alignment.
* Technical Area Leaders, for architectural alignment.
* Scrum Leads, to address operational challenges and maintain Agile workflows.
* Other Product Owners, for best practice sharing and cross\-team alignment.


 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
**Job Purpose**
 To direct \& administer the wealth management business in the designated zone \& devise strategies to achieve its customer, profit, growth \& customer service objectives. The product service portfolio includes portfolio \& wealth management advisory services for stocks, mutual funds, broking services, real estate advisory and other relevant financial services products.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
 Job Context: Aditya Birla Money Mart Ltd. (ABMML) is primarily a distribution house of third party investment products through investment advisory and Wealth Management Services to it’s High net worth, Institution \& Retail clients. ABMM has also started its new vertical of Tele Sales in FY 12 for Insurance selling.
   

  

 ABM is the second largest Investment Advisory in the country with over 25,000 crores of AUA as of November 2012\. Its one of the leading securities trading companies and amongst the largest non\-bank promoted Wealth advisor in the country.
   

  

 ABM has a daily turnover of over 1,000 crores and has been rapidly improving its market shares in the various segments it operates in. In the otherwise fragmented equity broking business, ABM has doubled it market share to over 1\.6% of retail cash equity volumes in the last 18 months. The commodity market shares have also doubled during this period.
   

  

 ABM remains one of the largest distributor for BSLI and BSLAMC and the largest distributor for other manufacturing organisations within ABFSG.
   

  

 ABM brings value to other line of business within ABFSG and adds Rs \~ 25\-30 Crores to the bottom line of BSLI / BSLAMC / ABFL / ABPE etc…
   

  

 ABM works in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating it’s day to day operations.In addition to the regulator ABM is also subject to close monitoring and inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX/ NSDL / CDSL etc..
   

  

 ABM also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of local Broking outfits.
   

  

 ABMML competition is from Major Distribution Houses like NJ India Invest, Bajaj Capital Prudent, IIFL and a range of Banks (both Indian and MNC). ABMMU is a unique award winning innovative digital business in the financial services space that offers the functionality of automated aggregation of all financial services relationships of a customer in a single location and enabling advice and transaction handling on the aggregated data. ABMU is a category killer new business line that has been launched to service the ‘digitally savvy but financially uninformed’ client segment to thereby ensuring that the financial services products penetration in India improves significantly. The mission of MU is ‘To make India financially confident’. ABMMU recently crossed a customer base of over 100,000 within a very short time of launch and has over Rs. 3,300 crores money aggregated on the site till date.
   

  

 The Wealth management division is engaged in providing strong research backed financial services advisory to the HNI clients and managing their ongoing financial advisory and Portfolio Management needs. The product portfolio includes Mutual funds, Life insurance, Bonds, Structured products, Real estate advisory, Company fixed deposits \& Equity and commoditybroking services
   

  

 The Zonal head is responsible for directing the affairs of the wealth management business in his zone to achieve profit, growth \& customer service objectives.
   

  

 Job Challenges: The main challenges faced by this profile include increasing the market share amidst stiff competition, motivating the channel to promote high revenue yielding and research backed products, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, controlling all the operational requirements of the zone \& effective cost management. The critical skill sets that this profile requires are excellent analytical, communication \& presentation skills, a strong industry network and an ability to resource new business with a strategic vision to interpret market trends \& high target \& customer service orientation
   

  

**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 To plan and drive new client acquisition \& growth ? To build marketing and business expansion strategies for the region and deploy resources \& timelines to achieve them
   

  

* To identify business potential in new cities through market sources \& penetrate them by setting branches in strategic locations \& sales activities.
* To create strong institutional and dealer networks for business expansion and review their performance periodically
* To forge newer tie ups for business expansion in the zone


 KRA2 To promote development of new products and analytical tools ? To liaise with the research and product teams to develop superior customer friendly tools for financial planning, analysis and portfolio management
   

  

* To add newer product offerings in the portfolio
* To actively review the existing portfolios \& market trends \& advise new investment plans to de\-risk against attrition \& achieve stability of book


 KRA3 To achieve targeted profitability \& fee income ? To strategize product\-customer mix for optimal revenue generation
   

  

* To initiate cross selling initiatives for generating additional revenues
* To regularly monitor achievement of branch \& regional targets


 KRA4 To drive customer satisfaction and retention initiatives ? To work with the customer servicing teams to continually develop new customer friendly initiatives
   

  

* Benchmarking the portfolio\-service offerings with the competition and highlight the critical modifications required
* To prioritize customer grievance addresal and take corrective action for avoiding similar issues in future


 KRA5 To ensure policy adherence and coordination ? To supervise and ensure compliance of all critical policies \& procedures \& ensure compliance with them
   

  

* To ensure adequate documentation of all transactions and coordinate with market intermediaries like banks for smooth operations


 KRA6 To present MIS Dashboards ? To send periodic business reports to HO for profit, new product launches, new clients \& new channel development \& changes/improvement in business plans
   

  

* To promote and ensure effective usage of WMS/ CTP and other systems


 KRA7 To ensure skill enhancement and team development of resources ? To ensure that requisite product \& behavioral trainings are imparted in various branches in conjunction with the HR dept
   

  

* To ensure retention through planned talent management, career progression \& performance linked incentives

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
**About the team:**
 Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network of 21,000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories \- from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
   

  

 Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save upto 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dineout feature on the Swiggy app Using the Dineout feature on the Swiggy app, users can discover and avail the best deals and discounts at restaurants, cafes, bars, and pubs in their city. Users can search for their favourite restaurants based on various parameters such as cuisine, location, price range, and availability.
   

  

 For customers, our vision is to become their default app for all their dining\-out occasions. We intend to do so by building a full stack solution for them to discover restaurants they might like, make a table reservation, make payment, and avail the best discounts/value across restaurants.For restaurants, our vision is to become their de facto platform of choice to grow their dine\-in business. We aspire to do so by becoming the most cost\-efficient marketing channel for them to build their brand, drive demand and acquire \& engage customers.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview:**
 The Senior Account Manager / Partner Success Manager will own the post\-sales relationship with restaurant partners, ensuring successful adoption, active usage, and measurable ROI. This role is critical in driving partner satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth by acting as a trusted growth advisor to restaurant partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Partner Onboarding \& Adoption:
* Own end\-to\-end post\-sales onboarding of our product suite for assigned restaurant partners, including Digital Menu, CRM tools, reservations, and QR\-based ordering.
* Coordinate product setup, POS integration, QR deployment, and account configuration (menu, floor plans, shifts, outlet details).
* Conduct structured product walkthroughs, demos, and staff training to ensure smooth go\-live within defined timelines.
* Partner Success \& Relationship Management:
* Act as the single point of contact for restaurant partners in the city.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with owners, decision\-makers, and outlet managers.
* Regularly engage partners through check\-ins, reviews, and on\-ground visits
* Driving ROI \& Business Growth:


 Help restaurant partners translate product feature usage into measurable business outcomes, including:
   

  

* Higher AOV / table value through upsell and cross\-sell
* Improved repeat visits using CRM and targeted campaigns
* Better table utilization and demand shaping
* Reduced operational friction via QR\-led ordering and billing
* Track and communicate ROI metrics such as adoption depth, repeat rate uplift, campaign performance, and menu\-led revenue impact.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reviews:
* Conduct monthly/quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) with partners.
* Analyze partner performance data and recommend actionable improvements.
* Identify early warning signs of churn and proactively resolve issues
* Expansion \& Feature Adoption Support
* Identify opportunities to increase depth of usage across available product features.
* Train restaurant staff on new workflows and ensure adoption remains stable despite staff churn through repeat training and SOPs.
* Support expansion across multiple outlets by demonstrating value and best practices.
* Work closely with Sales and City teams to enable renewals and portfolio expansion through strong post\-sales outcomes.
* Product Support \& Issue Resolution
* Act as first\-level support for product\-related queries and issues.
* Coordinate with Product, Tech, Ops, and Support teams to resolve bugs, integrations, and workflow challenges.
* Ensure minimal downtime and a smooth partner experience.
* Partner Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
* Act as the voice of restaurant partners by sharing structured feedback on product usability, gaps, and enhancement needs.
* Contribute inputs to improve product features, onboarding journeys, and partner\-facing processes.


**Key Success Metrics (KPIs):**
* Product Features adoption \& activation rate
* Partner retention and churn reduction
* Usage frequency of the features
* Partner ROI metrics and satisfaction (NPS)
* Revenue expansion from existing partners


**Experience \& Qualifications:**
**Experience**
* Experience in: Account Management, Customer Success, Partner Success, B2B relationship management, Prior experience in F\&B, hospitality, SaaS, CRM, POS, or restaurant\-tech is highly preferred
* Experience managing city\-level or portfolio\-based accounts is a strong plus


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Good understanding of business metrics, ROI, and growth levers
* Comfortable with data, dashboards, and performance reports
* Ability to train and influence non\-tech restaurant owners and staff
* High ownership mindset with strong problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent communication skills (local language \+ English preferred)


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Marketing, or a related field.
* MBA or hospitality background is a plus but not mandatory.


**Additional Information**
**Why This Role is Important:**
* Directly impacts restaurant partner success and retention.
* Plays a key role in scaling Dineout ecosystem.
* Acts as the face of DineOut for partners at a city level.

 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. 1. **Accounts Receivable (AR) \& Collections Management**


* Credit Analysis: Evaluate new customer creditworthiness, analyze risk profiles, and recommend appropriate credit limits and payment terms.
* Aging Management: Actively monitor AR aging reports to identify overdue accounts, trends in delinquency, and potential bad debt risks.
* Collections Strategy: Execute proactive collection activities for high\-value or severely delinquent accounts via phone and formal written communication.
* Dispute Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex customer billing, pricing, or tax discrepancies by partnering with internal sales and operations teams.



  





**2\. Accounts Payable (AP) \& Compliance Management** 



* Invoice Verification: Execute rigorous 3\-way matching (Purchase Orders, Receiving Logs, and Vendor Invoices) for incoming vendor billings.
* Payment Optimization: Manage weekly payment runs via banking portals, balancing cash preservation with early\-payment discounts.
* Tax Compliance: Review and ensure compliance regarding local statutory requirements, including accurate withholding tax (TDS) deductions and GST reconciliation.
* Vendor Reconciliation: Perform monthly or quarterly reconciliations of vendor statements against internal sub\-ledgers to prevent duplicate or missed payments.



  





**3\. Month\-End \& Analytical Reporting** 



* Ledger Reconciliation: Reconcile AR and AP sub\-ledgers against the General Ledger (GL) to ensure complete data integrity.
* Accrual Management: Calculate and post monthly AP accruals for goods or services received but not yet invoiced.
* KPI Tracking: Generate and analyze operational cash flow metrics for leadership, including:
* Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
* Days Payable Outstanding (DPO)
* Collection Effectiveness Index (CEI)
* Process Improvement: Identify system bottlenecks and assist in transitioning manual processes toward automated ERP workflows.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) DSO Reduction: Maintain Days Sales Outstanding within target corporate thresholds.
* Overdue Percentage: Keep accounts past 60/90 days below a defined percentage of total AR.
* AP Accuracy: Achieve greater than 98% accuracy in 3\-way matching and voucher creation.
* Reconciliation Timeliness: Complete monthly ledger reconciliations within the standard close timeline.



  





**Job Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* Technical \& Professional Skills Experience: 6 Months to 1 year of progressive experience in corporate accounting, specifically focusing on dual AR/AP workflows or general ledger management.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related business field.
* ERP Proficiency: Solid working experience with established ERP software (such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Tally Prime, or QuickBooks).
* Advanced Excel Capabilities: High proficiency in data manipulation using VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, logical formulas, and text/data parsing.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Sound operational knowledge of GST, TDS, corporate taxation, and fundamental accounting principles.



  





**Behavioral \& Interpersonal Competencies** 



* Assertive Diplomacy: Ability to negotiate firm payment timelines with delinquent clients while maintaining a professional business relationship.
* Detail Orientation: High visual and analytical precision to spot pricing discrepancies across high\-volume transaction files.
* Confidentiality: Demonstrated commitment to handling sensitive corporate cash positions and supplier contract pricing with strict data discretion.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Commuter assistance

**Contract type: B2B (business\-to\-business contract)** 




  





 As a Network Technician, you'll install, configure, and maintain network hardware and connectivity solutions across client environments. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems on the ground, working with physical infrastructure, and keeping systems running smoothly from the ground up.
 



  





  





**What You'll Do** 



* Install, configure, and maintain network hardware and connectivity solutions
* Perform troubleshooting and testing to resolve incidents and service requests
* Support client environments in line with operational procedures and SLAs
* Maintain accurate documentation of installations and configurations
* Coordinate with other teams to ensure smooth service delivery
* Perform site visits and on\-site support as required
* Assist with equipment upgrades, replacements, and decommissioning



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Experience or training in network installation and technical support
* Working knowledge of networking hardware and cabling standards
* Strong troubleshooting and hands\-on technical skills
* Willingness to work on\-site at client locations as needed
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail
* Valid driver's license, if on\-site travel is required



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Basic certification (CompTIA Network\+ or similar)
* Experience with structured cabling and physical network layouts
* Familiarity with common networking vendors (Cisco, Ubiquiti, Aruba)



  





**Interested in joining our team? Apply now — we'd love to hear from you!**

title: Network Analyst
description:
***Contract type: B2B (business\-to\-business contract)***




  





 As a Network Analyst, you'll monitor network performance, analyze operational data, and identify opportunities for service improvement across our customer environments. You'll investigate incidents and trends, and produce reporting that supports smarter operational decisions. This role suits someone who's naturally curious, enjoys digging into data, and wants their analysis to have a direct, visible impact on network reliability.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Monitor network performance and analyze operational data across customer environments
* Investigate incidents, trends, and recurring issues to improve reliability
* Identify opportunities for service improvement and efficiency
* Produce reporting and recommendations for operational and business stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering and operations teams on improvement initiatives
* Track key performance indicators and service metrics over time
* Support root\-cause analysis for recurring network issues



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Experience in network monitoring, analysis, or operations
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data and reporting tools
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals
* Excellent written communication skills for reporting and recommendations
* Detail\-oriented with a proactive, improvement\-driven mindset
* Ability to translate technical data into clear, actionable insights



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, Grafana)
* Familiarity with network monitoring platforms
* Basic scripting or SQL knowledge for data analysis



  





**Interested in joining our team? Apply now — we'd love to hear from you!**

title: IT Ops Engineer
description:
**Description**
 The IT Ops Engineer \- India owns regional IT support, office technology and systems administration for Articore's India office. The role is a peer regional systems administrator to the US engineer, not a ticket\-only position.
   

  

 It gives the India team a dedicated local escalation point for the first time, and contributes to shared follow\-the\-sun coverage across the global IT team, reporting to the Head of IT.
   

  

* Regional IT Support \& Service Desk (30%): Act as the India escalation point for IT requests, operating the service desk and \#ask\-it channel and triaging issues using published severity levels.
* Onboarding, Offboarding \& Lifecycle Support (20%): Manage onboarding and offboarding execution for the India region \- provisioning starter access and devices, and recovering devices/removing access for leavers.
* Endpoint \& Asset Management (20%): Procure, configure, image, deploy and support company\-managed devices for the India office; maintain asset inventory, device assignment and warranty handling.
* SaaS \& Vendor Coordination (15%): Administer SaaS tools for India\-based staff and coordinate with local vendors on renewals, licensing and support issues.
* Office Technology \& Follow\-the\-Sun Coverage (15%): Support office Wi\-Fi, meeting room technology and workplace systems; contribute to shared queue coverage across time zones, maintaining documentation and runbooks.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years' experience in IT support or systems administration, ideally in a regional or office\-support capacity.
* Experience with endpoint management tooling (JAMF, Intune or equivalent) and basic device security hygiene.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration, and coordinating SaaS vendor renewals.
* Working knowledge of office networking and workplace technology (Wi\-Fi, meeting rooms, printers, AV).
* Comfortable working with written, documentation\-first processes to support cross\-timezone handovers.

title: Mac Support Engineer – L3 (JAMF Specialist), GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are looking for an experienced Mac Support Engineer at Level 3 to join our IT team. This senior role is responsible for the advanced support, administration, and management of our Apple device estate using JAMF Pro. The successful candidate will act as the escalation point for complex macOS issues, drive automation and policy management, and contribute to the ongoing development of our Apple device management strategy.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Provide Level 3 technical support for macOS devices across the organisation, acting as the final escalation point for complex issues
* Design, configure, and maintain JAMF Pro policies, profiles, smart groups, and deployment workflows
* Manage the full Apple device lifecycle including procurement, enrolment via Apple Business Manager (ABM), deployment, and decommissioning
* Develop and maintain JAMF scripts (Bash/Python/Shell) to automate device configuration, software deployment, and remediation tasks
* Create and manage software packages for deployment via JAMF Self Service and automated policies
* Enforce security baselines and compliance policies across the Mac fleet, including FileVault, Gatekeeper, SIP, and CIS benchmarks
* Collaborate with the security team to support endpoint detection, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
* Integrate JAMF with third\-party tools such as Microsoft Entra ID/Intune and enterprise SSO solutions
* Manage certificate issuance and lifecycle across the Mac estate, including deployment of device certificates ensuring certificates are correctly provisioned for Wi\-Fi (802\.1x), VPN, and application authentication
* Maintain accurate device inventory, asset records, and documentation within JAMF and ITSM tooling
* Mentor and provide guidance to L1/L2 engineers on Mac support best practices
* Contribute to IT projects, infrastructure improvements, and technology refresh programmes
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Apple/Mac support within an enterprise environment
* Deep expertise in JAMF Pro administration, including policies, profiles, scripts, patch management, and Self Service
* Strong knowledge of macOS system architecture, directory services, networking, and security frameworks
* Proficiency in scripting languages including Bash and/or Python for automation and remediation
* Experience with Apple Business Manager (ABM) and Automated Device Enrolment (ADE)
* Solid understanding of MDM protocols, configuration profiles (mobileconfig), and OMA\-URI settings
* Experience integrating macOS endpoints with identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)/Intune
* Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across hardware, software, and networking issues
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical issues to non\-technical
* JAMF 100, 200, or 300 certification (or equivalent JAMF Certified Associate/Admin/Expert)
* Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) or Apple Certified IT Professional (ACITP)
* Experience with endpoint security tools such as Microsoft Defender, Falcon, SentinelOne, or similar
* Knowledge of Zero Trust security principles and their application in Apple environments
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling in an IT operations context
* Experience supporting hybrid Mac/Windows environments and cross\-platform tooling
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or AWS
* Experience of privilege management tools such as Beyond Trust or Delinea PrivMan
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision
* Methodical approach to problem\-solving with strong attention to detail
* Proactive mindset with a desire to continuously improve processes and tooling
* Collaborative team player who contributes positively to the wider IT function
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment and managing competing priorities


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Workday Specialist, GCC
description:
*Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Workday Specialist* 
*to join our office in Gurugram, India.*
**Team**
 The Gurugram office of CIP Fund Solutions supports fund management, investment activities and integrated business services across the CIP platform. This office combines local presence with close integration across a global organization. It supports specialist delivery across functions and contributes to scalable, high\-quality execution.
   

  

 As part of our Global People team, you will work closely with HR, and business stakeholders to maximise the value of our Workday platform and report directly to Senior Manager, People Technology and Operations. You will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of HR system, driving continuous improvements, and supporting the delivery of scalable HR solutions that meet the needs of a dynamic and growing business.
   

  

**Role**
 You will help optimize our Workday platform and contribute to the development of our HR Operating Model. This includes system configuration, user support, reporting, data management, process improvements, system enhancements, releases, and the implementation of new modules and integrations as required.
   

  

 You will work in a work\-from\-office environment, collaborating closely with colleagues and working daily with the Workday HRIS.
   

  

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**
**Workday Administration \& Support**
* Configure and maintain Workday Core HCM functionality.
* Manage and resolve support tickets related to Workday modules (Core HCM, Compensation, Recruitment, Reporting, etc).
* Troubleshoot system issues and work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive timely resolution.
* Assist with system configuration updates, data uploads, and testing for ongoing enhancements (WD releases).


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Act as focal point for Reporting needs and development.
* Design and maintain custom reports and dashboards.
* Develop calculated fields and Report\-as\-a\-Service (RaaS) solutions.
* Provide workforce metrics, headcount reports, attrition analysis, and compliance reporting.


**Data Integrity, Documentation \& Training**
* Ensure data integrity by performing audits and routine system checks.
* Document processes, maintain user guides, and support training efforts for end users.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Collaborate with HR, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure the system supports business needs.
* Act as a trusted advisor on Workday\-related processes and capabilities.


**You**
 We are looking for a motivated individual holding a relevant degree in Information Technology, Digital Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, with 5\+ years of experience in Workday HRIS administration, implementation, or application management roles. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required.
   

  

 You have hands\-on experience working with Workday HCM, including configuration, business process design, reporting, security administration, EIBs, and data management. You have a strong track record of optimising and enhancing HR systems within international organisations and driving process improvements and automation across multiple Workday modules, supported by a solid understanding of HR processes and workflows.
   

  

 Integration experience within the Workday ecosystem is considered a nice\-to\-have.
   

  

**We look for the following in a candidate:**
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage issues, handle conflicts, and drive escalations to resolution effectively.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships and work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken, with the confidence to engage with stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised and detail\-oriented, with a structured approach to work and the ability to prioritise effectively during busy periods.
* Strong cross\-cultural awareness and a service\-oriented mindset, with experience supporting stakeholders across different countries, time zones, and working cultures.


**The process**
 Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
   

  

 As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
   

  

 Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
 CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
   

  

 A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.
   

  

**CIP Fund Solutions**
 CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy\-period \- supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large\-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M\&A.
   

  

 For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.
